detail.abstract: Institutions govern through documents: investment policy statements, investment management agreements, limited partnership agreements, side letters, risk appetite statements, compliance manuals. AI systems now act on institutional decisions continuously and at machine speed, while the policies meant to govern those actions remain prose, translated into system behaviour by hand, slowly, and without any verifiable link between the clause that was written and the control that runs. This paper names that translation gap as the central governance defect of production AI and proposes Living Policy Architecture: an architectural approach in which governing documents are compiled into structured, versioned, executable rules that carry clause-level provenance; no rule takes effect without recorded human ratification; every relevant decision is evaluated against the active rule set at the moment it is made; the rule set is regenerated under validation when policy changes; and each outcome is sealed into an evidence record binding the decision to the rule version and the source clause that governed it. The paper defines the architecture and its core principles, sets out operational and integration considerations, maps benefits for institutional stakeholders, and situates the approach within the EU AI Act as amended in 2026, supervisory model risk guidance, and adjacent approaches including policy as code and model cards. A production realization of the architecture exists; the paper deliberately remains at the level of architecture and implications. It is a working paper and comments are invited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"活政策架构"（Living Policy Architecture），旨在弥合机构治理文件（如投资政策声明、合规手册等）与AI系统实际运行之间的"翻译鸿沟"，确保政策条款可被机器可读、可执行、可追溯。
AI.research_question: 如何解决AI系统以机器速度持续决策时，其治理政策仍以自然语言文本存在、人工翻译为系统行为导致的治理缺陷问题？
AI.motivation: 现有机构治理文件（如投资政策声明、有限合伙协议等）与AI系统执行之间存在"翻译鸿沟"：政策是文本，执行是代码，两者缺乏可验证的链接，构成生产级AI的核心治理缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 活政策架构（Living Policy Architecture）：将治理文档编译为结构化、版本化、可执行的规则集，要求每条规则均需经人工批准方可生效，每次决策均对照当前活跃规则集执行，规则变更时重新生成并验证，每次决策的证据记录绑定到具体规则版本和源条款。
AI.method: 架构设计方法：定义架构核心原则、运营与集成考量、利益相关者收益映射，并在EU AI Act（2026年修正版）、监管模型风险指引、政策即代码（Policy as Code）、模型卡（Model Cards）等框架下进行情境化分析。已有生产级实现，但论文聚焦于架构层面。
AI.findings: 提出了弥合"翻译鸿沟"的具体架构方案：文档→编译→结构化规则→人工批准→实时评估→证据记录，形成闭环；与现有监管框架（EU AI Act、模型风险指引等）兼容；已存在生产级实现验证架构可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地命名和定义了AI治理中的"翻译鸿沟"问题；提出了"活政策架构"这一新型治理架构，将政策合规从静态文本转化为动态、可执行、可审计的规则体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构、资产管理公司等使用AI系统进行决策的机构提供了可操作的治理架构方案；明确了各利益相关者的收益；提供了与现行监管（EU AI Act、模型风险指引）对接的路径。

title: Digital Transformation and Innovation in Business: The Impact of Strategic Alliances and their Success Factors
affiliations: , University of the National Education Commission, Krakow, National Aviation University, Lutsk National Technical University, Lutsk National Technical University and Lutsk National Technical University, Lutsk National Technical University

detail.title: Digital Transformation and Innovation in Business: The Impact of Strategic Alliances and their Success Factors
detail.abstract: The purpose of the article is to reveal the scientific approach that substantiates the impact of the creation of strategic alliances (SA) on the digital transformation of business and the development of their innovative power based on identified success factors. The aim was achieved using the following methods: abstract logic and typification (for classification of SA’s success factors), generalisation (to determine the peculiarities of SA’s influence on their innovation development), analytical and ranking method (to determine the relationship between the dynamics creating of SA and the degree of acceleration of digital transformation), expert evaluation (to determine the degree of influence of SA success factors by business areas). Implementing a business-integrated approach to understanding digital transformation will accelerate the implementation of innovation and organisational change, identifies future prospects for market, customer and business relationships, highlighting the importance of researching the factors that ensure their success. An alternative vision of SA’s success factors is suggested, which are determined by the possibilities of the organisation of partnerships and organisational culture, integration of business sectors, compatibility of management goals, external relevance, obtaining synergies. Innovation is considered by the authors as an integration factor that reconciles all groups of SA success factors, giving them the necessary focus to solve business problems. The results of the study show that the creation of SA has a significant impact on accelerating and changes the priority of digital transformation of business areas involved in strategic partnerships, and the impact of SA on the development of their innovation power is crucial.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了战略联盟（SA）的创建基于成功因素对业务数字化转型及其创新力量发展的影响，提出了一种整合视角，将创新视为协调各成功因素组的关键整合因子。
AI.research_question: 战略联盟的创建如何基于识别出的成功因素影响企业的数字化转型和创新力量发展？
AI.motivation: 揭示战略联盟成功因素对数字化转型和创新的影响机制，为企业实践提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 业务整合视角、战略联盟成功因素分类框架（伙伴关系组织、组织文化、业务部门整合、管理目标兼容性、外部相关性、协同效应）、创新作为整合因子。
AI.method: 抽象逻辑与类型化（成功因素分类）、概括法（影响特征）、分析与排名法（动态关系）、专家评估法（影响程度评估）。
AI.findings: 战略联盟的创建显著加速并改变了参与战略伙伴关系的业务领域的数字化转型优先级，且对创新力量的发展具有决定性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创新作为整合因子的替代性视角，将创新定位为协调各组成功因素的核心力量；构建了战略联盟成功因素的多维度分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业通过战略联盟推动数字化转型和创新提供了可操作的成功因素清单和评估方法，帮助管理者明确不同业务领域的影响权重。

title: Protecting the Thinking Process in Human-AI Interaction: The Forum Interstitiale Between Thought and Expression

detail.title: Protecting the Thinking Process in Human-AI Interaction: The Forum Interstitiale Between Thought and Expression
detail.abstract:
International human rights law protects freedom of thought absolutely and freedom of expression subject to limitation. Doctrine calls the two sides of that line the forum internum and the forum externum. The line was drawn when thinking left no trace. It no longer holds.

Within six months in 2026, a United States court ordered that twenty million ChatGPT conversations be produced under ordinary discovery rules, two federal courts reached opposite conclusions on whether a litigant's exchanges with a chatbot are protected at all, and the Supreme Court held that location records kept by a third party remain constitutionally protected. Records of where a person's body had been were protected. Records of how their mind worked were not.

The law has no category for the search query, the exploratory prompt, the unfinished draft, or the confession made to a machine. The United States answer has been a quarrel about privilege: courts refuse protection because the machine is not a professional, like a doctor or a lawyer, and industry asks for a new privilege because it behaves like one. Both assume that protection depends on what the machine is. This article argues that it depends on what the person is doing.

It proposes the forum interstitiale, a third zone between the two classical fora, protecting the thinking process under a standard stronger than ordinary expression law but short of absolute. Every candidate analogy in existing law is tested, from search queries and confidential dialogue to protected reading, aggregated records, the European law on correspondence and data protection, private diaries and drafts, and neural data. Each fails for the same reason. Protection attaches to a relationship, a disclosure, a recording, an addressee or a data type, and never to the function of the act as thinking.

The zone only works upwards. It raises acts the binary abandons and takes nothing from the absolute core, which answers the objection that widening protection dilutes it. The article sets out who belongs in the zone, five elements of the protection standard, the duties those elements impose on providers, and a map of individual AI interactions across the three fora. This classification is not an academic exercise. It decides what can be demanded, kept, filtered, and used against the person who thought it.

AI.tldr: 本文指出传统法律中"内心思想绝对保护"与"外部表达有限保护"的二分法因数字痕迹（如AI对话记录）而失效，提出"中间领域（forum interstitiale）"作为保护思考过程的第三法律空间，主张保护应基于行为的功能（思考）而非机器的身份。
AI.research_question: 在AI生成数字痕迹（如聊天记录、搜索查询、未完成草稿）的背景下，法律应如何重新界定对"思考过程"的保护边界？
AI.motivation: 传统二分法（内心绝对自由vs外部有限表达）基于"思考不留下痕迹"的前提，但AI交互产生了大量可被取证、传唤、用作证据的思维记录，现有法律对此缺乏分类和保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: forum internum（内心领域，绝对保护）与forum externum（外部领域，有限保护）的二分法；forum interstitiale（中间领域）作为第三保护空间。
AI.method: 法律类比分析：逐一检验现有法律框架（搜索查询、保密对话、受保护阅读、聚合记录、欧洲通信与数据保护法、私人日记与草稿、神经数据）是否适用于保护思考过程，并指出其共同缺陷。
AI.findings: 所有现有类比均失败，因为保护依附于关系、披露、记录、接收者或数据类型，而非行为作为"思考"的功能。中间领域仅单向提升保护水平（提高被二元体系抛弃的行为），不削弱绝对核心。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出forum interstitiale概念，从"保护基于机器身份"转向"保护基于人的行为功能"，填补了数字时代思维过程保护的法律理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 界定了谁属于中间领域、保护标准的五个要素、提供者的义务，以及个人AI交互在三类领域中的分类地图，为法院和立法者提供可操作的判断标准。

title: The Risky Business of Risk Regulation: How the EU Approach to Platform Regulation Becomes the Systemic Risk Everyone Is Talking About
affiliations: University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR)

detail.title: The Risky Business of Risk Regulation: How the EU Approach to Platform Regulation Becomes the Systemic Risk Everyone Is Talking About
detail.abstract:
This article conceptualizes platform governance as a problem of risk governance and argues that the European Union’s current risk based regulatory model is structurally fragile. Digital intermediaries - social media, e commerce, and AI firms - both manage and manufacture risks for users, businesses, and public institutions. Building on scholarship on platforms and risk regulation, the article develops a novel, three order model of the digital risk landscape: first order user related risks; second order platform related risks as perceived and managed through firms’ internal risk governance; and third order regulator related risks concerning the state’s responsibility to govern societal risks.
EU instruments such as the Digital Services Act, the AI Act, and the Transparency and Targeting of Political Advertising Regulation (TTPA) seek to manage first  and third order risks indirectly, by translating them into second order compliance risks for platforms. This approach presupposes that platforms will effectively internalize public risk priorities within their opaque and under-studied risk calculus. Drawing an analogy with the 2008 financial crisis, the article contends that this reliance on private risk governance creates a specific kind of systemic risk: the potential breakdown of the risk governance system itself when platforms’ second order priorities diverge from public objectives.
A case study of the TTPA’s regulation of online political advertising illustrates this dynamic. In response to the regulation, major platforms announced formal bans on political ads rather than robust compliance and, in practice, have inconsistently enforced these bans, thereby undermining the very policy goals the regulation was designed to achieve.
The article proposes a revised definition of systemic risk as the failure of risk regulation rather than merely the aggregation of individual harms. It outlines structural adjustments - greater insight into and alignment with platforms’ risk governance, stronger incentives and enforcement, and contingency planning for regulatory failure - to render EU digital risk governance more resilient.

AI.tldr: 本文认为欧盟现行基于风险的数字平台监管模式存在结构性脆弱性，平台通过内部风险治理同时管理和制造风险，而欧盟法规（如《数字服务法》《人工智能法》《政治广告透明度与定向规制法》）间接依赖平台内化公共风险目标，这构成了系统性风险。以TTPA对政治广告的监管为例，平台通过形式化禁令而非实质性合规破坏了政策目标。文章重新定义系统性风险为风险监管的失败，并提出结构性调整建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟基于风险的平台监管模式是否存在结构性脆弱性？其依赖平台内部风险治理的做法如何导致系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 数字平台（社交媒体、电商、AI企业）同时管理和制造风险，但欧盟当前风险监管模式过度依赖平台的内部风险治理，这一模式存在根本性缺陷，类似于2008年金融危机的风险治理失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字风险景观的三阶模型：一阶（用户相关风险）、二阶（平台内部风险治理）、三阶（监管者相关的社会风险）；系统性风险重新定义为风险监管体系的崩溃。
AI.method: 概念分析、类比论证（与2008年金融危机类比）、案例研究（TTPA对在线政治广告的监管）。
AI.findings: 欧盟监管工具（DSA、AI Act、TTPA）将一阶和三阶风险转化为平台的二阶合规风险，但平台的风险计算不透明且难以监督；TTPA案例中，平台以形式化政治广告禁令替代实质性合规，且执行不一致，破坏了政策目标；这种依赖造成了系统性风险——当平台二阶优先级与公共目标偏离时，整个风险治理体系可能崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义系统性风险为风险监管的失败而非个体危害的聚合；提出数字风险景观的三阶模型，揭示平台风险治理的中间角色及其脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟数字监管提供结构性调整建议：更深入了解和校准平台风险治理、加强激励与执行、制定监管失败的应急预案，以增强数字风险治理的韧性。

title: Regulatory Churn Evaluation Framework (RCEF): A Reproducible Methodology for Evaluating Retrieval Systems Under Document Evolution
affiliations: Rockland Trust and

detail.title: Regulatory Churn Evaluation Framework (RCEF): A Reproducible Methodology for Evaluating Retrieval Systems Under Document Evolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are typically evaluated against static benchmarks that assume a fixed, unchanging corpus-an assumption that fails for enterprise and regulatory repositories, which evolve continuously through revision, supersession, expiration, and amendment. Under these conditions, a retrieval system may return semantically relevant documents that are nevertheless invalid for a query's temporal or applicability conditions, a failure mode conventional relevance-based benchmarks do not detect. This paper presents the Regulatory Churn Evaluation Framework (RCEF), a controlled, reproducible methodology for evaluating retrieval correctness under document evolution. RCEF specifies an empirically calibratable churn taxonomy; explicit algorithms for constructing versioned corpora and churn-distributed queries; a mechanical, architecture-independent admissibility labeling procedure with a multi-rater reliability requirement for real-world corpora; six admissibility-centric metrics; and a bootstrap-based statistical validation procedure. We demonstrate RCEF with a single illustrative implementation, summarizing its use under increasing document churn and repository governance degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出RCEF框架，用于评估检索增强生成系统在文档持续演化（修订、替代、过期、修正）环境下的检索正确性，弥补传统静态基准无法检测"语义相关但时序/条件无效"这一失败模式的空白。
AI.research_question: 在文档持续演化的动态语料库中，如何评估检索增强生成系统的检索正确性？
AI.motivation: 企业及监管文档库持续演化（修订、替代、过期、修正），传统静态基准假设语料固定不变，无法检测"语义相关但时序或适用条件无效"的检索失败模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文档演化分类体系（churn taxonomy）、文档版本化语料库构建、查询-文档可接受性标签标注、可接受性导向的评估指标、自举统计验证。
AI.method: RCEF框架包含：可校准的文档演化分类体系、版本化语料库和演化分布查询的显式构建算法、与架构无关的机械式可接受性标注程序（含真实语料的多评分者信度要求）、六项可接受性导向指标、自举统计验证方法。
AI.findings: 通过一个示例实现展示RCEF在文档演化加剧和语料库治理退化条件下的使用效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"语义相关但无效"这一新的检索失败类别；建立动态语料库场景下检索正确性的系统化评估范式；定义可校准的文档演化分类体系和可接受性导向的评估指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业与监管场景提供可复现的检索系统评估方法论，帮助检测和规避由于文档演化导致的合规风险和信息错误。

title: Here Lies the Standalone Frontier LLM The Box Became Larger. But the Box Remained the Box

detail.title: Here Lies the Standalone Frontier LLM The Box Became Larger. But the Box Remained the Box

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: none

keywords.keywords: Turing-equivalence; Base-2 computing; Turing-complete system; human-engineered software; computational constraints; transcendence; evolutionary autonomy; emergence; formal independence; human agency; symbolic code mutation.

detail.abstract:
The central thesis of this essay is that no software system executing on any Turing-equivalent formal system—of which the conventional Base-2 digital computer is the operative present instance—can transcend the formal computational constraints imposed by its human-engineered architecture. Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI, world models, multi-agent systems, reinforcement-learning frameworks, and any foreseeable post-LLM architectures may become increasingly capable, autonomous in appearance, and operationally sophisticated, yet they remain bounded by the syntax, formal (operational) semantics, algorithms, and physical substrate from which they are constructed. Consequently, current research trajectories enlarge the computational search space but do not constitute a fundamental escape from it.

The thesis is empirically falsifiable, and its condition of disproof is operational rather than a demand for freedom from all human involvement—every computing system being trivially human-built, a standard requiring otherwise would be vacuous. The relevant test is informational independence under sealing. Fix a system’s total human endowment at a declared checkpoint—its architecture, its learned parameters, its optimization objective, and the entire corpus of data on which it was trained—and thereafter isolate it from all further human input, data injection, reward signal, or modification. The thesis is disproved if such a sealed system originates, validates, and sustains a governing computational principle or axiom that is (i) formally independent of—that is, not derivable from—that declared endowment, (ii) coherent or true by an external, independent standard, and (iii) reproducibly generated under pre-registered, independently verifiable conditions. Formal independence is a real and checkable relation, not a rhetorical one: results in mathematical logic establish that a proposition can be shown underivable from a given set of axioms. The bar is therefore high but not rigged. Until such evidence is produced, increasingly sophisticated post-LLM architectures should be understood as expanding the effectiveness and scope of engineered computation rather than transcending its foundational limits.

AI.tldr: 本文论证：任何运行在图灵等价形式系统上的软件（包括LLM、智能体AI、世界模型等）都无法超越其人类设计的计算约束。论文提出了可操作的反驳条件——在系统完全密封、与人类输入隔离的情况下，能否独立产生形式独立的新计算原则。
AI.research_question: 人工智能系统能否超越其人类工程设计的计算约束？
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究趋向于认为通过扩展规模、架构复杂性（如LLM、多智能体系统）可以超越现有计算极限，本文旨在澄清这一误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图灵等价形式系统、计算不可约性、形式独立性、哥德尔不完备定理等数学逻辑基础。
AI.method: 理论论证，提出可经验证伪的操作性条件——密封测试（informational independence under sealing）。
AI.findings: 当前AI研究只是扩大了计算搜索空间，并未从根本上超越工程计算的基本限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了AI系统无法超越其形式基础的理论边界，提出了严格的可证伪性条件，将哲学讨论转化为可操作的科学检验。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者不要误以为规模扩展就能实现真正的计算超越，为AI发展设定合理的期望边界。

title: Towards a Normative Framework for the Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Accounting and Auditing An IFRS and ISA Standards-Based Compliance Model (MCIAC)

detail.title: Towards a Normative Framework for the Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Accounting and Auditing An IFRS and ISA Standards-Based Compliance Model (MCIAC)
detail.abstract: The growing digitalization of accounting systems and the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) in audit processes and financial reporting raise a central normative question: are existing regulatory frameworks, particularly IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and ISA (International Standards on Auditing), sufficiently equipped to govern the use of AI systems in high-stakes accounting environments? This study identifies a significant regulatory gap: IFRS and ISA standards were historically designed for environments in which human judgment is central. The introduction of autonomous algorithmic systems into the production, verification, and interpretation of financial data exposes these standards to significant structural limitations, particularly regarding traceability, explainability, and algorithmic risk management. Drawing on a qualitative and normative methodology combining a systematic literature review, a comparative analysis of existing governance frameworks (COSO, COBIT, OECD AI Principles, EU AI Act), and a content analysis of IFRS/ISA standards, this research proposes an integrated normative framework: the AI-Accounting Compliance Model (MCIAC). Structured around three layersgovernance, technical validation, and auditabilitythis model aims to bridge the gap between current normative requirements and the technological realities of AI systems deployed in the financial domain. The contribution of this research is twofold: on the academic level, it opens a new analytical framework at the intersection of normative accounting theory and AI governance studies; on the regulatory level, it formulates operational recommendations for standard-setters (IASB, IFAC) and audit firms in a context of accelerated digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，现有的IFRS和ISA会计准则在设计时以人类判断为中心，未能充分应对AI系统在财务报告和审计中的使用。作者通过系统性文献综述、比较分析和内容分析，提出了一个三层结构的AI-会计合规模型（MCIAC），涵盖治理、技术验证和可审计性，以弥合现有规范与AI技术现实之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 现有监管框架（特别是IFRS和ISA）是否足以应对AI系统在高风险会计环境中的使用？存在哪些监管缺口？
AI.motivation: 会计系统日益数字化且AI在审计和财务报告中的快速应用，引发了现有准则是否能够有效监管AI使用的规范性问题，特别是IFRS/ISA原本以人类判断为核心设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规范性会计理论、AI治理研究，结合COSO、COBIT、OECD AI原则、欧盟AI法案等治理框架。
AI.method: 定性规范性方法论：系统性文献综述、现有治理框架（COSO、COBIT、OECD AI原则、欧盟AI法案）的比较分析、IFRS/ISA标准的内容分析。
AI.findings: IFRS和ISA标准在可追溯性、可解释性和算法风险管理方面存在显著结构性局限，无法适应自主算法系统在财务数据生产、验证和解释中的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 在规范性会计理论与AI治理研究的交叉领域开辟了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为准则制定机构（IASB、IFAC）和审计事务所提出了可操作的建议，以应对数字化转型加速背景下的监管挑战。

title: Cognitive Denial of Service (C-DoS): Exploiting Operator Trust via Telemetry Manipulation in UAV Ground Control Stations

detail.title: Cognitive Denial of Service (C-DoS): Exploiting Operator Trust via Telemetry Manipulation in UAV Ground Control Stations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involves a proof-of-concept utilizing simulated software environments. It does not involve experimental testing on human participants or animal subjects, and therefore does not require external ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted as independent academic research.

detail.abstract: As Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) become integral to critical infrastructure, tactical operations, and logistics, the security of Ground Control Stations (GCS) is paramount. Traditional cybersecurity paradigms focus on preventing unauthorized command execution or network-based Denial of Service (DoS) attacks that disable hardware and software. This paper introduces a novel, hybrid threat vector: Cognitive Denial of Service (C-DoS). Rather than compromising the physical flight controller or the GCS operating system, a C-DoS attack targets the cognitive processing capacity of the human-in-the-loop (HITL). By executing a Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attack on an unauthenticated telemetry stream, we demonstrate the real-time injection of psychological micro-stressors-such as aggressive battery drain spoofing, erratic altitude fluctuations, and induced alarm fatigue-directly into the Human-Machine Interface (HMI). Our proof-of-concept simulation reveals that subtle, persistent manipulation of telemetry data can disrupt the operator's OODA (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) loop, forcing erroneous and potentially catastrophic manual overrides on a structurally healthy aircraft. We detail the architecture of this cognitive exploit and propose mitigation strategies centered on cryptographic telemetry verification and anti-spoofing sensor fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对无人机地面控制站的新型混合威胁向量——认知拒绝服务攻击(C-DoS)，通过中间人攻击操纵遥测数据流，向操作员注入心理微应激源，破坏其认知处理能力和OODA决策循环，导致操作员对结构健康的飞机做出灾难性的人为干预。
AI.research_question: 如何通过操纵无人机遥测数据流，对地面控制站中的人机交互操作员实施认知层面的拒绝服务攻击？
AI.motivation: 传统网络安全范式主要关注防止未经授权的命令执行或基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，但忽略了针对"人在回路中"操作员的认知层面的攻击威胁。随着无人机在关键基础设施、战术行动和物流中的广泛应用，这一安全盲点亟需关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知拒绝服务(C-DoS)理论、OODA决策循环理论、人因工程中的心理微应激源理论。
AI.method: 概念验证模拟：通过中间人攻击未认证的遥测数据流，实时注入心理微应激源（电池耗尽欺骗、高度异常波动、报警疲劳诱导），观察操作员行为变化。
AI.findings: 对遥测数据的微妙、持续性操纵能够破坏操作员的OODA循环，迫使操作员对结构健康的飞机做出错误且可能灾难性的人工干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出"认知拒绝服务"(C-DoS)这一新型混合威胁向量概念；2. 将网络安全攻击从技术系统层面扩展至人因认知层面，拓展了人机交互安全的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 详细描述了认知利用的架构；2. 提出了基于加密遥测验证和反欺骗传感器融合的缓解策略。

title: Beyond Imitation: Evaluating Advanced AI Systems Through Trustworthy Autonomy
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, Rockland Trust and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond Imitation: Evaluating Advanced AI Systems Through Trustworthy Autonomy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: For more than seventy years, the Turing Test has shaped how artificial intelligence is evaluated by emphasizing behavioral imitation as evidence of intelligence. Contemporary AI systems, however, increasingly operate in contexts that require more than the appearance of intelligence. As AI systems assume increasing autonomy, concerns regarding alignment, explainability, governance, reliability, accountability, and public trust have become central to their responsible deployment. This paper argues that a growing evaluation gap exists between capability-focused assessment and the trustworthiness characteristics increasingly required of autonomous AI systems. Drawing upon contemporary research in AI safety, interpretability, governance, assurance, and trustworthy AI, the paper proposes Trustworthy Autonomy as a complementary objective for AI evaluation. Trustworthy Autonomy is defined as the capacity of an AI system to exercise autonomous decision-making in ways that remain beneficial, explainable, governed, cognitively stable, and ethically adaptive. To support this perspective, the paper introduces the Trustworthy Autonomy Framework (TAF), a conceptual framework organized around five dimensions derived from these principles. An illustrative application demonstrates how the framework may be used to structure the assessment of trustworthiness-related characteristics that extend beyond traditional measures of capability, performance, and task completion. The paper concludes by examining implications for AI assurance, governance, certification, and future research. As artificial intelligence systems assume greater autonomy and influence over consequential decisions, evaluating the trustworthiness of autonomous decision-making may become one of the defining objectives of AI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图灵测试已不足以评估当代自主AI系统的可信赖性，主张将"可信赖自主性"作为AI评估的补充目标，并提出了包含五个维度的可信赖自主性框架（TAF）。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够评估自主AI系统可信赖性而非仅关注能力的评估框架？
AI.motivation: 当代AI系统日益自主化，能力导向的评估（如图灵测试）无法覆盖对齐、可解释性、治理、可靠性、问责和公众信任等关键需求，存在评估缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可信赖自主性框架（TAF），包含五个维度：有益性（beneficial）、可解释性（explainable）、可治理性（governed）、认知稳定性（cognitively stable）和伦理适应性（ethically adaptive）。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于AI安全、可解释性、治理、保证和可信赖AI等领域的现有研究，并通过示例应用展示框架的实用性。
AI.findings: 提出了一个超越传统能力、性能和任务完成度评估的多维框架，可用于结构化评估自主AI系统的可信赖性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 将评估焦点从"行为模仿智能"转向"自主决策的可信赖性"，为AI评估提供了新的理论视角和概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI保证、治理、认证以及负责任部署自主系统提供了可操作的结构化评估工具。

title: The Digital Judiciary: Binding Precedent for Automated Compliance Decisions
affiliations: and D'Amore-McKim School of Business, Northeastern University

detail.title: The Digital Judiciary: Binding Precedent for Automated Compliance Decisions
detail.abstract: Enterprises now write code faster than they can govern it. Policy-as-code evaluates every change automatically, but it has no memory: each change is judged alone against flat rules, and the human judgment that resolves a hard case is logged once and never used again. This paper formalizes an alternative and proves what follows from it. We specify an architecture in which rule amendment, case adjudication, and residual-risk acceptance are held by disjoint authorities; only interpretations that were contested and then resolved enter a precedent store; and stored precedents bind later adjudication through a distinguishing gate followed by an explicit ordering over resolving authority, recency, and scope. We state the architecture as thirteen definitions and seven axioms and derive its consequences. Separation of duties and rationale-completeness hold by construction (Theorems 1 and 2), and the completeness guarantee has an exact boundary (Corollary 2) whose cost we bound: reconstruction-complete recording requires one stored record per covered case, no fewer (Proposition 3). Accepted risk is self-limitingevery executive waiver is codified into the rulebook, expires, or renews visibly, and no fourth path exists (Propositions 1 and 2). We then formalize the exception-governance regime enterprises actually operate today, with named approvers, a risk-keyed approval hierarchy, mandatory justification, scope, and expiry, and prove what it cannot represent: it supports attributive provenance, recording who decided and why they said they did, but not precedential provenance, recording what governed the decision (Theorems 3 and 4). An advisory memory over the same records does not close the gap, because without an ordering a controlling case is undetermined whenever two recollections conflict. A deterministic reference implementation instantiates the entire contract and executes it: four enterprises, one hundred constructed cases each, with every conformance element computed from the resulting execution traces rather than asserted. Three verification suites over the released artifact report 47/47, 41/41, and 45/45 checks holding. We position the work against agent-governance research appearing through mid-2026 and withdraw two claims to novelty in the process: separation of powers for autonomous systems is now a common framing, and the proposition that precedent should bind rather than advise has been argued and empirically supported elsewhere. What we find unclaimed, and what we therefore lead with, is contestation as the admission rule for precedent, and a lifecycle that forces every exception to become law, expire, or renew in the open. What no result claims is that any particular AI agent reasons well; the two judgment functions the architecture depends on are treated throughout as black boxes with fixed types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于判例的政策即代码架构，通过分离规则修订、判例裁定和剩余风险接受三个权力主体，并建立具有约束力的判例存储机制，解决了传统政策即代码系统"无记忆"的问题。核心创新在于：只有经过争议并解决的解释才能进入判例库，且判例通过区分门和明确的优先级排序（权威性、时效性、范围）约束后续裁定。论文还形式化了企业当前使用的例外治理机制，并证明了其无法表达判例溯源的根本局限。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种具有记忆能力的政策即代码架构，使系统能够从过去的裁定中学习，并确保权力分离、记录完备性和风险自限性？
AI.motivation: 企业编码速度远超治理速度；现有政策即代码系统无记忆，每次变更仅依据扁平规则孤立判断，人工裁定被记录一次后便不再使用，导致治理效率低下且无法累积经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策即代码（Policy-as-Code）；判例法理论；权力分立（Separation of Duties）；溯源性（Provenance）；风险接受（Risk Acceptance）
AI.method: 形式化方法：通过13个定义和7条公理描述架构，推导出若干命题和定理；结合四个企业各100个构造案例的确定性参考实现，通过三个验证套件（47/47、41/41、45/45项检查全部通过）进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 权力分离和合理性完备性由构造保证（定理1、2），完备性有精确边界（推论2），重建完备记录所需存储成本为每个覆盖案例一条记录（命题3）。2. 接受的风险自限：每项执行豁免要么编码入规则书，要么过期，要么公开续期，不存在第四条路径（命题1、2）。3. 现行企业例外治理机制支持属性溯源（谁决定及为何决定），但不支持判例溯源（什么决定了该决定）（定理3、4）。4. 仅增加咨询性记忆无法弥合差距，因无排序时记忆冲突无法确定控制性判例。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"争议作为判例准入规则"的创新机制。2. 形式化了判例约束力的排序逻辑（权威性、时效性、范围）。3. 证明现行例外治理机制的溯源性局限。4. 将"例外必须成为法律、过期或公开续期"的生命周期理论化。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可确定性实现的参考架构，通过四个企业各100个案例的执行轨迹验证了所有合规要素，为企业在高速编码环境中实现可持续治理提供了形式化基础。

detail.abstract:
The Association for Information Systems (AIS) is the premier professional association for individuals and organizations
that lead the research, teaching, practice, and study of information systems. It serves society through advancing
knowledge and promoting excellence in the practice and study of information systems. To that end, the AIS hosts seven
academic journals: Journal of the Association for Information Systems (JAIS), Communications of the Association for
Information Systems (CAIS), AIS Transactions on Human-Computer Interactions (THCI), AIS Transactions on
Replication Research (TRR), Pacific Asia Journal of the Association for Information Systems (PAJAIS), Revista
Latinoamericana y del Caribe de la Asociación de Sistemas de Información (RELCASI), and Scandinavian Journal of
Information Systems (SJIS). In this editorial statement, we summarize the different mission statements for each journal;
describe their different audiences, goals, and markets; and identify their shared values, requirements, and resources. We
do so to assist AIS members to identify the most suitable journal outlet for their research

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AIS旗下七本学术期刊的使命、受众、目标、市场以及共同价值观、要求和资源，旨在帮助AIS会员找到最适合其研究的期刊发表渠道。
AI.research_question: AIS旗下七本期刊各自的使命、受众、目标和市场是什么？它们共享哪些价值观、要求和资源？
AI.motivation: 帮助AIS会员识别最适合其研究成果的期刊，以便更好地传播信息系统领域的知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期刊定位与学术出版生态理论
AI.method: 编辑声明/综述性分析，对七本期刊的使命声明进行归纳总结和比较分析。
AI.findings: AIS七本期刊各有不同的使命、受众和定位，覆盖从理论研究到实践应用、从传统IS到人机交互与复制研究等多个方向，同时共享对学术质量、严谨性和服务于IS社区的承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息系统领域的学术出版生态提供了系统性的期刊定位图谱，有助于理解IS学科的知识生产与传播结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AIS会员（尤其是青年学者和博士生）提供了清晰的期刊选择指南，帮助其根据研究主题和类型匹配合适的投稿目标。

title: Customer Feedback as Governance Infrastructure: An External Accountability Layer for Automated BFSI Systems

detail.title: Customer Feedback as Governance Infrastructure: An External Accountability Layer for Automated BFSI Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and developer of the commercial platform on which this framework is based. The methodology, taxonomy, and results described are drawn from the author's own production system.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects research or clinical data. All data used was drawn from publicly available secondary sources (app store reviews, public complaint feeds, and social media listening). No patient data, primary human-subject data collection, or personally identifiable information was used.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Governance frameworks for automated financial systems depend predominantly on signals generated by the institutions they are meant to oversee, creating a structural observability gap: when internal monitoring infrastructure fails, the failure is often invisible to the mechanisms designed to detect it. This paper presents a framework that closes this gap by converting unstructured public customer feedback into structured operational diagnostics attributed to specific processes, operational domains, and institutional owners. The framework combines a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-large model for entity and aspect extraction (macro F1 0.924 on held-out validation), a hybrid canonicalizer and classifier architecture spanning 107 BFSI-specific issue categories (accuracy 95.47%, macro F1 0.915), and an evidence-constrained synthesis layer that generates operational hypotheses under explicit inference guardrails. Deployed across 1.8 million public customer reviews covering 30 BFSI entities in India and West Africa, the framework demonstrates cross-regional generalisability and functions as an independent external accountability layer that complements, and does not depend on, internal institutional reporting. Its relevance to auditability, recourse, and operational resilience under emerging supervisory technology practice is discussed, alongside inherent limitations of public feedback as a governance signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个利用非结构化客户反馈来弥补自动化金融系统治理中结构可观测性差距的框架。该框架结合了微调的DeBERTa-v3-large模型、混合规范器与分类器架构（涵盖107个BFSI特定问题类别）以及证据约束合成层。在覆盖印度和西非30家BFSI机构的180万条评论中验证了跨区域泛化能力，可作为独立的外部问责层发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 如何利用非结构化的公开客户反馈，为自动化金融系统构建独立于内部机构报告的外部治理框架，弥合结构性可观测性差距？
AI.motivation: 现有金融治理框架依赖机构内部信号，存在结构性可观测性差距——内部监控失败时，检测机制往往无法察觉。需要一种独立、外部的问责机制来补充机构内部报告。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构可观测性差距理论、外部问责层理论、监督技术（SupTech）实践框架
AI.method: 组合方法：微调DeBERTa-v3-large进行实体与方面抽取（宏F1=0.924）；混合规范器与分类器架构覆盖107个BFSI问题类别（准确率95.47%，宏F1=0.915）；证据约束合成层生成操作性假设。
AI.findings: 在180万条公开评论（30家印度与西非BFSI机构）上验证了跨区域泛化能力；框架可作为独立外部问责层运行，不依赖内部机构报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证了利用客户反馈作为外部治理信号的理论框架；将结构可观测性差距理论从概念延伸至可操作的计算方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和审计师提供独立于机构内部报告的治理工具；可审计性、追索权与运营韧性增强；在印度和西非跨区域场景中验证了实用性。

title: Digital Prediction of Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and Precision Marketing Optimization in the Automotive Industry: A Machine Learning Model based on Multi-source Data Fusion

detail.title: Digital Prediction of Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and Precision Marketing Optimization in the Automotive Industry: A Machine Learning Model based on Multi-source Data Fusion
detail.abstract: This paper creates a data-driven framework that can forecast automotive customer lifetime value (CLV) and improve targeted marketing within a limited budget. The model combines several sources of information such as dealers' sales history, vehicle inspection reports, and market indicators to estimate future service activities, long-term spending, and the impact of marketing efforts. Anonymized UK MOT inspection data was used along with dealer CRM data, and the proposed method outperformed the standard probabilistic, tree-based, and deep learning baselines in terms of prediction accuracy, ranking quality, and uplift. Most of the extra value comes from the top 40% of customers by budget rank, which gives a simple rule for designing campaigns. Inference latency of less than 120 ms per query allows for deployment in real-time campaigns and post-sale systems. It provides interpretable drivers of CLV and uplift that can be used practically for retention, cross-selling, and electric-vehicle customer management. However, there are still some problems left unsolved about data quality, small segments and cross-market transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个数据驱动的框架，用于预测汽车行业客户生命周期价值（CLV）并在有限预算下优化定向营销。该模型整合了经销商销售记录、车辆检测报告和市场指标等多源数据，在预测精度、排序质量和 uplift 增益上均优于传统基线模型，且推理延迟低于120毫秒，可部署于实时营销系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个数据驱动的框架，准确预测汽车客户生命周期价值（CLV）并在有限预算约束下优化定向营销策略？
AI.motivation: 汽车行业中客户关系管理需要精准识别高价值客户并有效分配营销预算，现有方法在预测精度和 uplift 增益上存在不足，且缺乏可解释性和实时部署能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户生命周期价值（CLV）理论；定向营销中的 uplift 建模；多源数据融合框架；预算约束下的客户排序优化。
AI.method: 整合经销商CRM数据、英国MOT匿名检测报告和市场指标等多源数据，构建数据驱动预测模型，并与概率模型、基于树的模型和深度学习基线进行对比评估。
AI.findings: 该模型在预测精度、排序质量和 uplift 增益上均优于标准基线；大多数额外价值来自预算排名前40%的客户；推理延迟低于120毫秒，支持实时部署；模型可解释性提供了CLV和 uplift 的关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多源汽车行业数据预测CLV和 uplift 的综合框架；揭示了预算约束下客户排序的简单规则（前40%客户创造主要增值）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可部署于实时营销和售后系统的低延迟解决方案；可识别CLV和 uplift 的关键驱动因素，辅助客户保留、交叉销售和电动车客户管理；为有限预算下的定向营销提供了实操规则。

title: An Evaluation of Market Adoption Versus User Satisfaction in Diabetes Applications: Development of the Satisfaction Gap Index
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Evaluation of Market Adoption Versus User Satisfaction in Diabetes Applications: Development of the Satisfaction Gap Index
detail.abstract: Background: As diabetes self-management increasingly relies on mobile applications (apps), users prioritize app ratings as key trust indicators. This study investigates whether these ratings truly reflect an app's functional quality in the digital health ecosystem.Methods: This cross-sectional study analyzed 87 diabetes-management apps available in South Korea. The analysis focused on app ratings and the number of downloads as primary indicators of user satisfaction and market adoption, respectively.Results: The analysis of 87 diabetes-management apps revealed a significant negative correlation between market adoption (number of downloads) and user satisfaction (app ratings) (Spearman's ρ = -0.382, p < 0.001). As the volume of downloads increased, app ratings tended to decrease and disperse within the 3.0–4.0 range rather than maintaining a perfect score of 5.0. Quadrant analysis showed that 58.6% of the apps were characterized by low adoption but high satisfaction, whereas only 12.6% achieved both high adoption and high satisfaction. The Satisfaction Gap Index (SGI), introduced to evaluate user satisfaction efficiency relative to market scale, showed a right-skewed distribution (0.523 ± 0.574), with the majority of apps concentrated in the 0.2–1.5 range, indicating a quantitative discrepancy between market scale and user-perceived quality.Conclusion: Market dominance in diabetes apps does not guarantee user satisfaction or functional excellence, creating a potential barrier to long-term self-management. Clinicians and policymakers should move away from volume-based metrics and adopt SGI as a robust screening tool. Integrating SGI into clinical guidelines will facilitate the objective identification of high-performing niche applications, thereby optimizing patient adherence in digital health interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了韩国87款糖尿病管理App，发现下载量（市场采纳度）与应用评分（用户满意度）之间存在显著负相关。大多数高下载量App评分集中在3.0-4.0区间，而非满分5.0。作者引入“满意度差距指数”（SGI）作为更精准的评估工具，建议临床和政策制定者摒弃单纯基于下载量的指标。
AI.research_question: 糖尿病管理App的用户评分是否真实反映了其功能质量？市场主导地位（下载量）是否等同于用户满意度？
AI.motivation: 用户在选择糖尿病自我管理App时高度依赖评分作为信任指标，但评分与App实际功能质量之间的关系尚不明确，存在信息不对称问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字健康生态系统中的用户信任机制、市场采纳与用户满意度的关系理论。
AI.method: 横截面研究，分析韩国87款糖尿病管理App，使用斯皮尔曼相关分析、象限分析，并引入SGI（满意度差距指数）进行评估。
AI.findings: 下载量与评分呈显著负相关（ρ=-0.382, p<0.001）；58.6%的App属于低采纳高满意度，仅12.6%实现高采纳高满意度；SGI呈右偏分布（0.523±0.574），表明市场规模与用户感知质量之间存在量化差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字健康市场中“市场主导”与“用户满意”之间的脱节现象，为技术采纳与用户满意度理论提供了实证挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了SGI作为更可靠的App筛选工具，建议临床医生和政策制定者将SGI纳入临床指南，以客观识别高质量的利基应用，优化糖尿病患者的数字健康干预依从性。

title: Healthcare Insurance Fraud Detection via Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Adaptive Sampling
affiliations: Central South University, Central South University, Central South University, Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications and Central South University

detail.title: Healthcare Insurance Fraud Detection via Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Adaptive Sampling
detail.abstract: Healthcare insurance fraud poses signiﬁcant threats to global medical security systems, causing substantial ﬁnancial losses and eroding public trust.Existing detection methods often fail to capture complex, multiple behavioral fraud patterns due to their reliance on single-relation networks or staticfeature engineering. To address these limitations, we propose the Multi-ViewReinforcement Contrastive Learning (MV-RCL) framework, which integratesthree tightly coupled components: (1) Four fraud-speciﬁc relational graphviews, corresponding to Fragmented Hospitalization, Overutilization, Overdiagnosis, and Upcoding behaviors, that disentangle heterogeneous behavioral patterns into behavior-discriminative provider–provider representations;(2) A Bernoulli Multi-Armed Bandit-driven dynamic neighbor sampling module that adaptively determines per-node sampling quantities to suppress aggregation noise from irrelevant connections; and (3) A multi-view contrastivelearning mechanism enforcing intra-view, inter-view, and global representation consistency to improve embedding separability between fraudulent andlegitimate providers. Evaluated on a Medicare claims dataset comprising541,071 claims, MV-RCL outperforms 10 state-of-the-art baselines spanningclassical classiﬁers, homogeneous and heterogeneous GNNs. Interpretabilityanalysis provides evidence-grounded attribution for both isolated and collaborative fraud patterns. MV-RCL thus oﬀers an accurate, stable, and interpretable detection tool capable of modeling complex multi-behavioral fraudpatterns, advancing graph-based methods for real-world healthcare insuranceoversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MV-RCL框架，通过多视图强化对比学习，在医疗保险欺诈检测中有效捕捉多种复杂欺诈行为模式，在54万余条Medicare数据上超越10个基线模型，兼具准确性、稳定性和可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测医疗保健保险中复杂、多行为的欺诈模式，克服现有方法依赖单一关系网络或静态特征工程的局限？
AI.motivation: 医疗欺诈造成巨大财务损失并侵蚀公众信任，现有检测方法因依赖单一关系网络或静态特征工程，难以捕捉复杂的多重行为欺诈模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多视图强化对比学习框架，结合图神经网络、伯努利多臂老虎机动态邻居采样、多视图对比学习机制。
AI.method: 构建四种欺诈特定关系图（碎片化住院、过度利用、过度诊断、升级编码），基于伯努利多臂老虎机进行动态邻居采样，通过多视图对比学习（视图内、视图间、全局表征一致性）优化嵌入。
AI.findings: 在541,071条Medicare索赔数据上，MV-RCL超越10个SOTA基线（涵盖经典分类器、同/异质GNN），可解释性分析为孤立和协作欺诈模式提供了基于证据的归因。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出多视图解耦欺诈行为模式的框架，引入自适应邻居采样机制抑制噪声，设计多层次对比学习增强欺诈与合法提供者的嵌入可分性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供准确、稳定、可解释的医疗欺诈检测工具，能够建模复杂多行为欺诈模式，推进基于图方法的实际医疗保险监管应用。

title: Overpricing and Fairness in Markets for Credence Services
affiliations: ESSEC Business School, ESSEC Business School and

detail.title: Overpricing and Fairness in Markets for Credence Services
detail.abstract: This paper develops a model of expert-customer interaction in which the expert has a diagnostic advantage and can both recommend and implement a treatment. We assume liability, in the sense that experts are committed to solving the customer's problem, but rule out ex-post verifiability: customers cannot observe the type of treatment actually provided. The analysis incorporates customers' aversion to disadvantageous inequality, experts' lying costs, and potential diagnostic error. The model characterizes the equilibrium frequency with which experts misrepresent minor problems as severe and charge high prices. We then design an original laboratory experiment to test the model's predictions. When facing a minor problem, about one third of experts honestly report it and charge the low price associated with the low-cost treatment, whereas 60% misrepresent the problem as severe and charge a high price. On average, these dishonest experts capture approximately 61% of the total surplus in accepted deals. The analysis shows that diagnostic error affects posted prices, but not the equilibrium frequency of lying. We also analyze the determinants of customers' acceptance decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了专家-客户互动模型，专家具有诊断优势并可以推荐和实施治疗。在承担法律责任但无法事后验证的条件下，分析了客户的不平等厌恶、专家的说谎成本及潜在诊断错误。模型刻画了专家将小问题谎报为大问题并收取高价的均衡频率，并通过实验室实验验证：约三分之一的专家诚实报告小问题并收低价，60%谎报为大问题并收高价，不诚实专家平均获取约61%的总剩余。
AI.research_question: 在专家承担法律责任但客户无法事后验证治疗类型的情况下，专家会以多高的频率谎报问题严重性并收取高价？影响客户接受决策的因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中专家服务市场普遍存在信息不对称和利益冲突，专家可能利用诊断优势欺骗客户。探究在责任机制（承诺解决问题）但缺乏可验证性条件下的欺骗行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，结合客户的不平等厌恶、专家的说谎成本、诊断误差等行为经济学因素。
AI.method: 理论模型构建 + 实验室实验（原创设计）
AI.findings: 1) 面对小问题时，约1/3的专家诚实报告并收低价，60%谎报为大问题并收高价；2) 不诚实专家平均获取约61%的总剩余；3) 诊断误差影响标价但不影响说谎的均衡频率；4) 客户的接受决策受多种因素影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不平等厌恶和说谎成本引入专家-客户博弈模型，揭示了责任机制与不可验证性并存条件下的欺骗均衡特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管专家服务市场（如医疗、维修、咨询等）提供行为洞察，有助于设计减少专家欺骗的机制。

title:
Criminal Financing of Politics, Institutional Co-optation and State Reconfiguration: 
Analytical Distinctions, Institutional Risks, and Public Policy Proposals
affiliations: Vortex Foundation and Vortex Foundation

detail.title:
Criminal Financing of Politics, Institutional Co-optation and State Reconfiguration: 
Analytical Distinctions, Institutional Risks, and Public Policy Proposals
detail.abstract:
This paper distinguishes between illicit political financing and criminal political financing in Colombia, and shows how
the systematic insertion of resources derived from illicit economies into campaigns, parties, and political movements
operates as a mechanism of state capture, co-optation, and reconfiguration. From a structural network-analysis
perspective, the two phenomena differ in the origin of resources, the relational configuration among nodes/agents, and
their institutional effects. This shows that criminal financing is not an isolated electoral violation, but an operational
component of networks oriented toward the durable transformation of public functions. The analysis integrates recent
evidence, including early-warning alerts, parapolitics, and presidential campaign scandals, with the framework of
Advanced State Capture, Institutional Capture of Political Parties, Institutional Co-optation, and Co-opted State
Reconfiguration. It proposes public policy and electoral criminal-policy reforms to strengthen traceability, early
detection, prosecution, and structural prevention.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了哥伦比亚的非法政治融资和犯罪政治融资，从结构网络分析视角揭示了犯罪资金如何通过系统性渗透竞选、政党及政治运动，成为国家俘获、共选和重构的运作机制，并提出了相应的公共政策和刑事政策改革建议。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚政治中，非法政治融资与犯罪政治融资有何本质区别？犯罪资金如何通过系统性渗透机制实现国家俘获、共选和重构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将犯罪政治融资简单归为选举违规行为，忽视了其作为国家转型运作组件的系统性危害。本文旨在从结构网络视角厘清两类融资的差异及其制度性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 先进国家俘获理论、政党制度俘获、制度共选、共选国家重构
AI.method: 结构网络分析
AI.findings: 非法政治融资与犯罪政治融资在资源来源、节点/行动者关系配置和制度效应上存在本质差异；犯罪政治融资并非孤立的选举违规行为，而是以持久改变公共职能为导向的网络运作组件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国家俘获理论从一般性腐败分析拓展至犯罪资金系统性渗透政治的机制层面；区分了非法融资与犯罪融资的异质性，丰富了制度共选和俘获的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了加强资金可追溯性、早期侦测、起诉和结构性预防的公共政策与选举刑事政策改革方案。

title: Underestimating the Fed
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics

detail.title: Underestimating the Fed
detail.abstract: Recent survey evidence suggests that the Federal Reserve's perceived response to inflation is weak or unstable. We argue that standard estimates understate the perceived long-run inflation response because they embed anticipated stabilization. Using conditional forecasts from the FRBNY Survey of Market Expectations, we find a stable perceived inflation coefficient that consistently satisfies the Taylor principle. Hawkish monetary-policy news also attenuates bond-market estimates: excluding days when nominal yields rise and inflation compensation falls substantially raises the implied coefficient. Overall, the Fed's perceived commitment to price stability appears stronger and more stable than standard forecast-based estimates would suggest.

AI.tldr: 标准估计方法低估了美联储对通胀的长期反应强度，因为其嵌入了预期稳定化效应。使用条件预测和剔除鹰派货币政策新闻日的方法，发现美联储对通胀的实际感知系数稳定且满足泰勒原理。
AI.research_question: 美联储对通胀的感知反应是否比标准估计所显示的要更强且更稳定？
AI.motivation: 近期调查证据表明美联储对通胀的反应被认为疲弱或不稳定，这与泰勒原理相悖。作者试图解释这种矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒原理（Taylor principle）、预期稳定化效应、条件预测方法
AI.method: 使用纽约联储市场预期调查的条件预测，并通过剔除鹰派货币政策新闻日（名义收益率上升而通胀补偿下降的日期）来调整债券市场估计。
AI.findings: 感知通胀系数稳定且满足泰勒原理；剔除鹰派新闻日后，债券市场估计的隐含系数显著提高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了标准估计方法因嵌入预期稳定化效应而低估长期通胀反应系数的机制，修正了对美联储通胀反应函数的不准确认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者和政策制定者提供了更准确评估美联储通胀承诺的方法，有助于避免因估计偏差导致的错误市场预期和决策。

title: Market-Segmented Enforcement: Adversarial LLM Analysis of Political Advertising Moderation across Linguistic Markets

detail.title: Market-Segmented Enforcement: Adversarial LLM Analysis of Political Advertising Moderation across Linguistic Markets
detail.abstract: This article presents an empirical analysis of political advertising moderation across four linguistic markets—English, Hebrew, Arabic, and German—on Meta’s platforms during a period of acute political conflict (October 2023–January 2025). Applying an adversarial multi-model LLM methodology, the study assigns three large language models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek) to adversarial roles—pro-retention counsel, pro-removal counsel, and neutral arbiter—and subjects 1,080 high-engagement advertisements from Meta’s Ad Library to structured enforcement simulation. A TF-IDF vectorisation analysis of the models’ full textual reasoning quantifies inter-model divergence and identifies 27 “hard cases” where both removal and retention are consistent with Meta’s stated policies, constituting genuine parity in Ruth Chang’s technical sense. The analysis reveals a systematic enforcement gap in the Hebrew-language market: 5.2% of Hebrew advertisements contained content classified as violative by multiple arbiter models, compared to 0% in all other languages (χ2 = 37.77, p < 0.001). Meta retained all violating advertise ments. The economic structure of the platform offers a parsimonious explanation: the Hebrew CPM ($5.07) is 4.6 times lower than the English CPM ($23.18), and the external scrutiny probability for Hebrew-language content is substantially reduced by linguistic barriers to English-speaking regulators. Enforcement intensity, the data suggest, tracks market profitability rather than rights severity. Drawing on Teubner’s societal constitutionalism and Lange’s concept of regulatory blind spots, the article argues that current EU digital regulation (particularly the Digital Services Act) achieves procedural constitutionalisation but fails to make the platform’s operative medium—the engagement imperative—visible to legal observation.The article proposes medium-reflective amendments including individual revenue disclosure, language-disaggregated enforcement reporting, and elasticity metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多模型LLM对抗性方法，分析了Meta平台在2023年10月至2025年1月期间，针对英语、希伯来语、阿拉伯语和德语四种语言市场的政治广告审核实践。研究发现希伯来语市场存在系统性执法缺口：5.2%的广告含违规内容但Meta全部保留，而其他语言市场违规率为0%。作者指出执法强度与市场盈利水平（CPM）正相关，而非基于权利严重程度，并基于社会宪治主义和监管盲点理论，批评现行欧盟《数字服务法案》未能使平台的"参与度至上"逻辑可见于法律观察。
AI.research_question: 不同语言市场上的政治广告审核是否存在系统性差异？这种差异是否与平台的经济结构相关？现行数字监管框架是否能够有效约束平台的内容审核行为？
AI.motivation: 在政治冲突期间，Meta平台对不同语言市场的政治广告执行差异巨大的审核标准，尤其希伯来语广告违规率显著高于其他语言但全部被保留，这一现象需要从理论和实证层面进行解释和批判。
AI.theoretical_framework: Teubner的社会宪治主义（Societal Constitutionalism）；Lange的监管盲点（Regulatory Blind Spots）；Ruth Chang的"真正平局"（Genuine Parity）概念。
AI.method: 对抗性多模型LLM方法论：将Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-4o和DeepSeek分别赋予"赞成保留"、"赞成移除"和"中立仲裁者"三种对抗性角色，对Meta广告库中1,080条高参与度广告进行结构化执法模拟。使用TF-IDF向量化分析模型推理文本，量化模型间分歧，并识别27个"困难案例"。
AI.findings: 1. 希伯来语市场存在系统性执法缺口：5.2%的广告被多个仲裁模型认定为违规，其他语言为0%（χ2=37.77，p<0.001），Meta保留了所有违规广告。2. 经济结构提供解释：希伯来语CPM（$5.07）仅为英语CPM（$23.18）的1/4.6，且语言屏障降低了外部监管概率。3. 执法强度与市场盈利能力相关，而非权利严重程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Teubner的社会宪治主义应用于数字平台监管分析，揭示现行监管框架仅实现程序性宪治化。2. 用Lange的监管盲点概念论证平台的"参与度至上"逻辑未被法律观察所捕获，构成系统性盲点。3. 提出"真正平局"分析框架以识别政策执行中的固有模糊性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示语言鸿沟导致的执法不平等，为多语言平台监管提供实证依据。2. 提出三项具体政策建议：个人收入披露、按语言分类的执法报告、弹性指标（elasticity metrics）。3. 为欧盟《数字服务法案》的修订提供"媒介反思性"（medium-reflective）修正方向。

reference: Journal of Research, Innovation, and Strategies for Education (RISE), volume 3, issue 6, 2025[10.70148/v3i4.1]
title: Attention Fragmentation in Digital Learning Environments: Micro-Procrastination, Cognitive Load, and Deep Work Across Educational Levels

detail.title: Attention Fragmentation in Digital Learning Environments: Micro-Procrastination, Cognitive Load, and Deep Work Across Educational Levels

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with established ethical standards for educational research involving human participants. Prior to data collection, informed consent was obtained electronically from all participants through an online survey platform. The informed consent statement clearly explained the purpose, procedures, scope of the study, and participants’ rights, including the voluntary nature of participation and the right to withdraw at any time without penalty. No personally identifiable information (such as names, student identification numbers, or IP addresses) was collected. All data were anonymized, stored securely, and analyzed in aggregated form for academic purposes only. Participation was limited to respondents who explicitly indicated consent before accessing the questionnaire. The study involved minimal risk to participants and adhered to principles of confidentiality, anonymity, and ethical research practice.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Research, Innovation, and Strategies for Education (RISE), volume 3, issue 6, 2025[10.70148/v3i4.1]

detail.abstract: Maintaining sustained attention has become increasingly challenging in digitally saturated learning environments, where frequent notifications and habitual task switching are normalized. Although digital distraction has been widely examined, limited research has focused on digital micro-procrastination—brief, repetitive digital interruptions—and its cognitive consequences across educational levels. This study examined the relationships among Digital Micro-Procrastination (DMP), Perceived Cognitive Load (PCL), and Deep Work (DW) among junior high school, senior high school, and college students. Using a quantitative descriptive-comparative design, survey data were collected from 45 students equally distributed across three academic levels. All measures demonstrated acceptable internal consistency following reliability refinement. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Spearman’s rank-order correlation, and Kruskal–Wallis tests. Results revealed a significant positive association between digital micro-procrastination and perceived cognitive load, indicating that frequent short digital interruptions are linked to heightened mental strain and attention fragmentation. Significant cross-level differences were observed, with college students reporting the highest levels of digital micro-procrastination and cognitive load. Findings related to deep work suggest a more nuanced relationship, wherein sustained focus may coexist with elevated cognitive effort rather than reduced task demands. Overall, the study underscores the cognitive implications of everyday digital practices and highlights the need for instructional and self-regulatory strategies that mitigate attention fragmentation in contemporary educational contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了数字微拖延（DMP）、感知认知负荷（PCL）与深度工作（DW）在初中、高中和大学生中的关系。研究发现数字微拖延与认知负荷显著正相关，大学生群体的数字微拖延和认知负荷水平最高，而深度工作与认知努力之间的关系更为复杂。
AI.research_question: 数字微拖延、感知认知负荷与深度工作在不同学段（初中、高中、大学）学生之间呈现怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 在数字饱和的学习环境中，注意力维持日益困难，但现有研究对"数字微拖延"（短暂、重复的数字干扰）及其认知后果关注不足，且缺乏跨教育阶段的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字微拖延理论、认知负荷理论、深度工作理论
AI.method: 定量描述性比较设计；问卷调查；45名学生平均分布于三个学段；描述性统计、Spearman秩相关、Kruskal-Wallis检验
AI.findings: (1) 数字微拖延与感知认知负荷显著正相关；(2) 大学生数字微拖延和认知负荷水平最高；(3) 深度工作与认知努力的关系更复杂，持续专注可能与高认知努力并存。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"数字微拖延"这一概念并提供了跨学段的实证证据，深化了对数字干扰与认知负荷关系的理解，揭示了深度工作与认知努力之间并非简单的负相关关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育实践提出了减轻注意力碎片化的教学策略和自我调节策略，尤其针对大学生群体需要更多干预。

title: When the World Changes Faster Than Its Meaning Systems: Biotechnology and the Capacity for a New Plane of Human Development
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When the World Changes Faster Than Its Meaning Systems: Biotechnology and the Capacity for a New Plane of Human Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None required
declarations.funderStatement: No outside funding

detail.abstract:
This theoretical monograph addresses the biotechnology revolution, which no single intellectual tradition can capture because its consequences operate across levels that existing disciplines treat separately — the philosophy of personal identity, bioethics, developmental psychology, political philosophy, and systems theory each engage only the surface their own methods can reach. The problem requires a prior-level framework operating beneath all five: the meaning systems through which individuals and societies build and hold governing premises.

The disruption is twofold. Artificial intelligence has already destabilized the meaning systems through which populations organized identity, mastery, and economic participation. Biotechnology is now arriving into that destabilized population and doing something more fundamental: altering the biological substrate through which meaning systems are formed, held, and renewed — approaching the ability to constitute the foundational premises of the next generation's meaning systems at population scale, before any society has deliberately examined what those premises should become.

The Integrating Structure and Life Energy framework (ISLE) specifies the developmental mechanism through which individuals and societies build governing premises, consolidate them into structural planes, approach the coherence horizons those planes produce, and either reconstruct toward genuinely new premises or fail to. This monograph extends that mechanism to a domain no prior paper in the series addressed, deriving from first principles what ISLE's three most foundational constructs — foundational structural density, life energy, and the coherence horizon — specify when each can be altered from outside the developmental sequence.

Biotechnology is the first technology to deepen the problems a society faces while depleting, through the same mechanism and in the same generation, its capacity to solve them. The analysis identifies the structural condition determining how long a society has to act: a calculable governance window, narrowing but still open.

AI.tldr: 这篇理论专著探讨生物技术革命带来的双重颠覆——人工智能已 destabilized 意义系统，而生物技术正在从生物基质层面改变意义系统的形成机制。作者提出 ISLE 框架（整合结构与生命能量），从第一性原理推导出当三个最基础构念（基础结构密度、生命能量、 coherence 地平线）被外部干预时会发生什么。核心发现：生物技术首次让社会面临的问题恶化速度超过其解决能力的生成速度，但治理窗口仍然存在。
AI.research_question: 生物技术革命如何通过改变人类意义系统的生物基质，颠覆个体与社会构建治理前提的机制？当 ISLE 框架的三个最基础构念（基础结构密度、生命能量、coherence 地平线）被外部干预时，社会还有多长的治理窗口？
AI.motivation: 现有五大学术传统（个人身份哲学、生物伦理学、发展心理学、政治哲学、系统论）各自只能触及生物技术革命表层，缺乏一个能够运行于所有传统之下的前级框架。作者旨在通过 ISLE 框架填补这一理论空白，并识别社会应对这一颠覆的结构性条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISLE（整合结构与生命能量）框架：该框架描述了个人和社会构建治理前提的发展机制，包括将前提巩固为结构平面、接近这些平面产生的 coherence 地平线，以及要么重建为真正的新前提、要么失败的过程。本文将该框架扩展到三个最基础构念被外部干预的领域。
AI.method: 理论推导（从第一性原理推导）。作者在已有 ISLE 系列论文基础上，将框架延伸至生物技术这一新领域，从第一性原理推导三个核心构念被外部干预时的理论含义。
AI.findings: 1）生物技术是第一个通过同一机制在同一代人中既加深社会面临的问题，又消耗其解决问题能力的技术；2）存在一个可计算的治理窗口（narrowing but still open），决定了社会还有多少时间采取行动；3）生物技术正在改变下一代意义系统的基础前提，而社会尚未审视这些前提应该是什么。
AI.theory_contributions: 将 ISLE 框架扩展至生物技术领域，从第一性原理推导了三个基础构念（基础结构密度、生命能量、coherence 地平线）被外部干预时的理论含义，为理解生物技术革命提供了一个跨学科的前级框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出"可计算的治理窗口"这一结构性条件，为政策制定者和社会提供了清晰的时间框架，表明社会仍有时间行动但窗口正在收窄。

title: The evolution of population at the local level in Argentina, 1895-2010.Diminishing returns, agglomeration economies and congestion
affiliations: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid and Universidad Nacional de Tucumán

detail.title: The evolution of population at the local level in Argentina, 1895-2010.Diminishing returns, agglomeration economies and congestion
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relative importance of diminishing marginal returns and agglomeration economies in shaping the spatial distribution of population in Argentina since the late nineteenth century. We introduce a novel dataset combining population counts with a rich set of georeferenced variables for 360 consistent local geographic units observed between 1895 and 2010. Using several empirical strategies, we document a robust non-linear relationship between initial population density and subsequent population growth. Low-density districts exhibit convergence consistent with diminishing marginal returns; intermediate-density districts display divergence driven by agglomeration economies; and high-density districts experience congestion effects that slow population growth. These patterns closely resemble those documented for the United States, suggesting that land-abundant, newly settled economies share common spatial adjustment dynamics. Periodspecific estimates indicate that diminishing returns and agglomeration coexist during the expansion of the agricultural frontier, while later stages of development are characterized by agglomeration at low and intermediate densities and congestion at the upper tail of the density distribution. Finally, we show that some of these dynamics operate through local spillovers across district boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1895-2010年阿根廷360个地区的新数据集，研究人口密度与增长的非线性关系：低密度地区收敛（边际报酬递减）、中密度地区发散（集聚经济）、高密度地区增长放缓（拥塞效应），并发现这些动态通过跨地区溢出效应传导。
AI.research_question: 边际报酬递减与集聚经济如何共同塑造阿根廷自19世纪末以来的空间人口分布？
AI.motivation: 理解土地充裕的新兴经济体（如阿根廷）在长期发展过程中空间调整的动态机制，尤其是与已研究较充分的美国模式进行对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际报酬递减理论、集聚经济学（agglomeration economies）、拥塞效应（congestion effects）、空间溢出效应。
AI.method: 构建1895-2010年360个一致地理单元的独特面板数据集；采用多种实证策略估计初始人口密度与后续增长的非线性关系。
AI.findings: （1）人口密度与增长呈非线性关系：低密度收敛、中密度发散、高密度拥塞；（2）与美国模式高度相似，表明土地充裕的新兴经济体共享相似的空间调整动态；（3）农业边疆扩张期边际报酬递减与集聚共存，后期则是低中密度集聚、高密度拥塞；（4）部分动态通过跨地区溢出效应发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示阿根廷长期空间分布中三种效应（递减、集聚、拥塞）并存且随发展阶段转换的机制；证明新兴经济体与美国共享相似的空间调整规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿根廷及其他土地充裕发展中国家的区域发展政策提供依据：不同密度地区需差异化政策（低密度促进收敛、中密度强化集聚、高密度缓解拥塞），并关注跨地区溢出效应。

title: Constrained Generative Beings: On the Absence of Measured Generation - A Preliminary Discussion

detail.title: Constrained Generative Beings: On the Absence of Measured Generation - A Preliminary Discussion

keywords: The Relationality of the Value Metric

detail.abstract: The generative relational framework holds that value is generated in relation and is not possessed by a subject in advance of relation. This paper subjects that commitment to its hardest case, namely the case in which no generation is measured at all. Theories of distributive justice concern the allocation of goods among participants, and theories of exploitation concern the appropriation of value from those who have produced it; neither addresses the subject who produces nothing. The paper's principal result is that the absence of measured generation cannot be identified with the absence of generative being, and that a system which infers the second from the first has committed an error concerning the world before it has committed an error concerning the subject. The concept of the constrained generative being is introduced to designate a locus of generative possibility whose participation in generative relations is blocked, redirected, or rendered unrecognizable by relational conditions. The concept is distinguished from those of weakness and vulnerability, which locate a deficiency within the subject, and equally from the humane reply that the excluded subject possesses an unrecognized worth, which concedes that value is lodged within subjects and disputes only the accuracy of the inventory. Three topologies of constraint are distinguished. Under endogenous constraint the generative rule is altered; under exogenous constraint the rule is intact and no environment permits its execution; and under epistemic constraint, which the paper introduces, the rule is executed, the environment permits execution, generation occurs, and the system's measure does not register it. The third case is not a weaker instance of the first two: under the first two the system observes correctly and infers wrongly, and under the third the system's observation is false and cannot be corrected from within, since the error is located in the instrument rather than in the inference. From this the paper draws its normative consequence. Because constraint is located in the relational conditions of generation, the remedy is necessarily performed upon those conditions and never upon the subject, and the obligation to act follows from the location of the constraint rather than from any assessment of the subject's worth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"受约束的生成性存在"概念，论证未测量到价值生成不等于不存在价值生成，其约束可分为内生、外生和认识论三种类型，并指出纠正措施必须针对关系条件而非主体本身。
AI.research_question: 在没有任何可测量的价值生成的情况下，关系性价值生成框架是否仍然成立？
AI.motivation: 现有分配正义理论关注物品分配，剥削理论关注价值被剥夺，但都未涉及"不产出任何东西"的主体。本文试图证明，即便没有可测量的生成，主体仍可能具有生成性存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系性生成框架（generative relational framework）、分配正义理论、剥削理论、受约束的生成性存在概念。
AI.method: 概念分析、逻辑推理、拓扑分类（区分三种约束类型）。
AI.findings: 1. 未测量到生成不等于不存在生成；2. 提出三种约束拓扑：内生约束（规则被改变）、外生约束（规则完整但环境不允许执行）、认识论约束（规则执行且环境允许，但测量工具无法记录）；3. 第三种约束中，错误在于测量工具而非推理本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将关系性生成框架推向"零生成"这一最困难案例；2. 引入"受约束的生成性存在"概念，区分于"虚弱""脆弱"等主体缺陷概念；3. 提出"认识论约束"作为新的约束类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 纠正措施必须针对关系条件而非主体，避免将系统问题归咎于主体；2. 义务源于约束的位置而非主体的价值评估，为制度设计提供规范性指引。

title:
Gold as Strategic Reserve Architecture: Systematic Logistics
Governance and Physical Asset Allocation in Sovereign-Level Trade

detail.title:
Gold as Strategic Reserve Architecture: Systematic Logistics
Governance and Physical Asset Allocation in Sovereign-Level Trade
detail.abstract:
Physical commodities, specifically gold and rare earth elements, remain the bedrock of macro-systemic risk isolation and
institutional wealth preservation. However, physical asset allocation at scale introduces significant port-to-port logistical friction, compliance vulnerability, and counterparty performance risk. This paper analyzes the integration of hard assets into modern strategic reserve architectures through institutional, verification-first governance protocols. We map the operational execution layers required to manage physical commodity logistics, verify source provenance, and structure secure economic participation frameworks across cross-border jurisdictions, examining how deterministic system mechanics transform
physical asset friction into predictable institutional liquidity reserves.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了将实物大宗商品（黄金和稀土）纳入现代战略储备架构的路径，重点关注验证优先的治理协议如何将实物资产的物流摩擦转化为可预测的机构流动性储备。
AI.research_question: 如何通过验证优先的治理协议，将实物大宗商品整合到现代战略储备架构中，以解决跨境的物流摩擦、合规风险和交易对手风险？
AI.motivation: 实物资产（黄金和稀土）是宏观系统性风险隔离和机构财富保值的基础，但大规模配置面临显著的港到港物流摩擦、合规漏洞和交易对手履约风险，亟需系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 验证优先的治理协议、确定性系统机制、战略储备架构理论
AI.method: 概念框架分析，对实物商品物流的运营执行层进行系统映射，分析跨司法管辖区的安全经济参与框架。
AI.findings: 通过确定性系统机制，可以将实物资产的物流摩擦转化为可预测的机构流动性储备，实现硬资产与现代战略储备架构的有效整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了验证优先治理协议在实物资产战略储备中的应用框架，拓展了战略储备架构的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者和政策制定者提供了管理实物商品物流、验证来源出处以及构建跨境安全经济参与框架的操作指南。

title: Tax the Doing, Subsidize the Telling: Optimal AI Policy and the Codifiability of Skills
affiliations: and Wuhan University - Economics and Management School

detail.title: Tax the Doing, Subsidize the Telling: Optimal AI Policy and the Codifiability of Skills
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence displaces the doing through which novices learn and teaches what can be told-opposing forces on formation. In an overlapping-generations model of expert-novice transmission, occupations indexed by expressibility, AI erodes tacit stocks and augments codifiable ones; the Pigouvian correction reverses sign once: tax the doing, subsidize the telling. A uniform AI tax is qualitatively wrong, not merely suboptimal. Calibrated to 682 U.S. occupations, the shadow schedule signs taxes on an eighth of employment, subsidies on the codifiable majority; the heaviest tax-side values fall not on routine work but on tacit, exposed work AI does but cannot teach.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个代际重叠模型，分析人工智能对专家-新手知识传递的影响。研究发现，AI会侵蚀隐性知识储备、增强可编码知识储备。最优政策不是统一征税，而是对"做中学"征税、对"说中学"补贴。基于682个美国职业的校准显示，约1/8的就业需要征税（集中在隐性、高AI暴露的职业），多数职业应获补贴。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响通过"做"（实践）和"说"（教导）进行的专家-新手知识传递？最优政策干预是什么？
AI.motivation: AI不仅替代人类劳动，还改变了新手学习的方式——AI替代了"做中学"的过程，但只能教授可表达的知识，这可能破坏隐性知识的代际传递。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重叠世代模型（Overlapping-Generations Model），专家-新手知识传递模型，隐性知识与可编码知识的区分
AI.method: 理论建模（重叠世代模型）+ 校准分析（使用682个美国职业数据）
AI.findings: (1) AI侵蚀隐性知识储备，增强可编码知识储备；(2) 最优政策是补贴"说中学"、对"做中学"征税；(3) 统一的AI税在定性上是错误的；(4) 校准结果显示约1/8的职业需要征税，主要集中在隐性且高AI暴露的职业，而非常规性工作。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将AI对学习过程的影响纳入世代传递模型；(2) 揭示了AI对隐性知识和可编码知识的非对称效应；(3) 为AI时代的"皮古税"提供了新的理论方向（符号反转）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 否定了统一征收AI税的政策思路；(2) 提供了基于职业特征的差异化税收/补贴方案；(3) 指出了哪些职业最需要政策关注（隐性知识密集型、高AI暴露的职业）。

title: The Denominator Illusion: How Much Corporate Decarbonization Is Inflation and Growth?

detail.title: The Denominator Illusion: How Much Corporate Decarbonization Is Inflation and Growth?
detail.abstract: Carbon intensity, emissions divided by revenue, is the headline metric of corporate decarbonization. We show that a large part of its measured improvement is the denominator, not the smokestack. Using an exact within-firm accounting identity that splits the change in carbon intensity into emissions, real revenue growth, and inflation, applied to S&P Global Trucost Scope 1 emissions and Compustat revenue for roughly 1,700 to 1,900 listed firms per window over fiscal 2014 to 2024, we find that among the roughly three-quarters of firms whose intensity fell, only about half of the decline comes from cutting emissions, a split that ranges from 47% to 59% across the windows we examine (and falls to about 22% under a broader Scope 1+2 measure), so we report several rather than the most flattering. The one component that does not move is pure inflation: across every window, rising prices account for 23% to 26% of the measured intensity improvement (a quarter at the baseline), and the share stays within 22% to 35% whether firms are weighted equally or by revenue, under the broader emissions measure, and across three price indices. Because the price level is computed from public macro data and never touches the emissions series, this finding needs no assumption about emissions-data quality. Roughly a third of the firms that "improved" their carbon intensity increased their absolute emissions. Where genuine abatement occurs, a four-channel extension for non-finance firms shows it is same-asset reduction rather than divestiture: firms grew their physical asset base while cutting emissions per asset. The illusion is concentrated. In finance, 47% of intensity-improvers emitted more and only 40% of the improvement is abatement, while transport and utilities decarbonize for real (65% abatement). The distinction also shows up in market valuations: in the cross-section, a reported intensity improvement is associated with denominator growth and not with genuine abatement, a standing feature of high-growth firms rather than a repricing, so firms that improved their ratio while emitting more are valued no differently from those that actually cut emissions. For investors and standard-setters who read intensity targets at face value, a quarter of corporate "decarbonization" is the price level and another large slice is growth.

AI.tldr: 本文发现企业碳强度（碳排放/收入）的改善中，仅有约一半来自实际减排，约四分之一来自通货膨胀，其余来自收入增长。金融行业尤为严重，47%的"改善"企业实际排放增加；而交通运输和公用事业则是真减排。
AI.research_question: 企业碳强度指标的改善在多大程度上来自真正的减排，而非分母（收入增长或通货膨胀）的变化？
AI.motivation: 碳强度是衡量企业脱碳的核心指标，但该指标容易受分母（收入）变化影响，导致市场、投资者和标准制定者可能被"虚假脱碳"所误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用精确的企业内会计恒等式，将碳强度变化分解为三个部分：实际排放变化、实际收入增长和通货膨胀。
AI.method: 使用S&P Global Trucost Scope 1排放数据和Compustat收入数据，分析约1,700-1,900家上市公司在2014-2024财年间的碳强度变化，并分解为排放、实际收入增长和通货膨胀三个成分。
AI.findings: 约四分之三的企业碳强度下降，但其中仅约一半来自实际减排（47%-59%）；通胀解释了23%-26%的改善；约三分之一的"改善"企业实际排放增加。金融业尤为突出，47%的强度改善者实际排放增加。市场估值仅与分母增长相关，而非真实减排。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次精确量化了碳强度指标中"假性改善"的成分，揭示了通胀和收入增长对碳强度指标的显著影响，并区分了真实减排与"名义脱碳"。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者和标准制定者提出警示：碳强度指标不能直接等同于脱碳成效，建议同时关注绝对排放量和实际减排行为。为ESG投资和气候信息披露标准提供重要参考。

title: Structural and Purpose-relative Necessity in EU Data Protection Law: Closing the Doctrinal Gap for Platform Datafication

detail.title: Structural and Purpose-relative Necessity in EU Data Protection Law: Closing the Doctrinal Gap for Platform Datafication
detail.abstract: The Court of Justice of the European Union has developed two distinct necessity doctrines depending on who processes personal data and why. In cases involving state surveillance, the Court applies what this article terms structural necessity: it assesses the architecture of the processing system-its scope, indiscriminateness, and conditions of access-against the standard of strict necessity, independently of the controller's stated purpose. In cases involving private commercial data processing, the Court applies purpose-relative necessity: necessity assessed against the controller's self-described purpose, without interrogation of the economic objective function driving the processing architecture. Drawing on close analysis of Digital Rights Ireland, Tele2 Sverige, La Quadrature du Net, and the two Schrems judgments on one side, and ASNEF, Fashion ID, Meta Platforms (2023), and NT1 & NT2 v Google on the other, this article maps that asymmetry, explains it as a structural feature of how the legal system observes commercial datafication, and argues for extending the structural necessity doctrine to commercial contexts through an economic transparency obligation grounded in Article 25 GDPR and the accountability principle.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了欧盟法院在数据处理必要性审查中存在双重标准：针对国家监控采用"结构性必要"标准（审查系统架构是否严格必要），针对商业数据处理采用"目的相对必要"标准（仅围绕企业自述目的），并主张通过GDPR第25条和可问责原则将结构性必要标准扩展至商业场景。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院在数据处理的必要性审查中为何针对国家监控与商业数据处理采用不同标准？是否应将结构性必要标准扩展至商业领域？
AI.motivation: 欧盟法院在公私领域数据处理必要性审查中存在不对称性，这种不对称导致商业数据处理中的系统性数据化未能得到充分法律审查，需要通过经济透明度义务加以纠正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性必要性（审查处理系统的架构、范围、无差别性和访问条件是否严格必要）与目的相对必要性（围绕数据控制者自述目的进行必要性评估）的二元区分，以及GDPR第25条（数据保护设计）和可问责原则。
AI.method: 比较案例分析方法，对Digital Rights Ireland、Tele2 Sverige、La Quadrature du Net、Schrems两案（国家监控侧）与ASNEF、Fashion ID、Meta Platforms (2023)、NT1 & NT2 v Google（商业侧）进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 欧盟法院在国家监控案件中审查系统架构的严格必要性，但在商业案件中仅围绕企业自述目的评估必要性，不质疑驱动处理架构的经济目标函数。这种不对称是法律系统观察商业数据化的结构性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示并系统化了欧盟法院在公私领域数据处理必要性审查中的结构性不对称，提出了将结构性必要标准扩展至商业领域的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 主张通过基于GDPR第25条和可问责原则的经济透明度义务，将结构性必要标准适用于商业数据处理，从而加强对商业数据化实践的法律规制。

title: Searching for an Eco-Fiscal Double Dividend: How Does the Shadow Economy Reshape the Optimal Policy?
affiliations: University of Naples Parthenope, University of Naples Parthenope, LUMSA University and

detail.title: Searching for an Eco-Fiscal Double Dividend: How Does the Shadow Economy Reshape the Optimal Policy?

keywords: Carbon Laffer Curve JEL classification: E26

detail.abstract: This paper examines how carbon pricing affects emissions, public revenues, and compliance in an economy with the underground sector. Specifically, it addresses the following research questions: (i) When does carbon pricing become fiscally self-limiting, and through which channels? (ii) How does the fiscal policy mix reshape the emissions-revenue trade-off? (iii) How should carbon taxes, green subsidies, and enforcement be optimally designed? To this end, we extend the framework of Orsi et al. (2014), by developing a Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium model that integrates carbon taxation, green state aid, endogenous abatement, fiscal and environmental compliance. Three results emerge. First, carbon tax revenues are non-monotonic, as higher tax rates reduce both production and the regular tax base when activity shifts outside the regulated sector; stronger enforcement mitigates this mechanism. Second, conventional fiscal tax cuts and increases in green state aid support formal activity and reduce underground production and emissions, whereas carbon taxes promote abatement but may incentivize tax evasion. Third, the optimal audit intensity responds to both carbon tax and green state aid shocks, highlighting enforcement as a necessary complement to environmental policy. Overall, the paper shows that climate policy is environmentally effective and fiscally viable only if enforcement keeps emissions within the regulated tax base, making informality a key constraint on the eco-fiscal double dividend.

AI.tldr: 本文构建DSGE模型研究发现：碳税收入呈非单调变化（高税率导致经济活动转入地下部门）；传统减税和绿色补贴可抑制地下生产与排放，但碳税可能激励逃税；最优审计强度需同时响应碳税和绿色补贴冲击，表明执法是气候政策的环境有效性与财政可行性的关键约束。
AI.research_question: (i) 碳定价何时在财政上自我限制？通过哪些渠道？(ii) 财政政策组合如何重塑排放-收入权衡？(iii) 碳税、绿色补贴和执法应如何最优设计？
AI.motivation: 在存在地下经济（地下部门）的现实中，碳定价可能因经济活动转入非正规部门而导致税基侵蚀和排放泄漏，这一关键约束在传统气候政策分析中被忽视。本文旨在揭示非正规部门对生态-财政双重红利假说的制约机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Orsi et al. (2014)框架，扩展为包含碳税、绿色国家援助、内生减排、财政与环境合规的DSGE模型。
AI.method: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型
AI.findings: (1) 碳税收入非单调：高税率同时减少生产和正规税基（活动转移至地下部门），更强执法可缓解此机制；(2) 传统减税和绿色补贴促进正规活动、减少地下生产和排放，而碳税促进减排但可能激励逃税；(3) 最优审计强度需同时响应碳税和绿色补贴冲击，执法是环境政策的必要补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非正规部门（地下经济）对碳定价政策效果的关键约束机制，阐明了生态-财政双重红利假说在存在逃税和地下生产时的成立条件，即执法必须将排放保持在受监管的税基之内。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供碳税、绿色补贴与执法力度的最优组合设计依据，指出单靠碳税不足以实现环境与财政双赢，需配套强化执法以避免税基侵蚀和排放泄漏。

title: Modelling Fiscal Drag in a DSGE Environment *
affiliations: Department of Political Science, University of Naples Parthenope and

detail.title: Modelling Fiscal Drag in a DSGE Environment *
detail.abstract: Persistent inflation can affect public finances not only by reducing the real value of government debt, but also through fiscal drag, whereby increases in nominal income raise households' effective tax burden under progressive taxation. This paper studies the real and welfare effects of fiscal drag in a modified Two-Agent New Keynesian model based on Bianchi et al. (2023), augmented with progressive labor income taxation. The main results are as follows. Persistent inflation generates fiscal drag by raising nominal labor income and tax revenues.
