The effect is stronger under progressive taxation, where nominal income growth also increases the effective labor income tax rate. Results are heterogeneous across households: savers benefit from higher labor and financial income, whereas hand-to-mouth households experience lower consumption despite working more. Interestingly, sensitivity analysis shows that fiscal drag is stronger when monetary policy reacts less aggressively, inflation is more persistent, and tax progressivity is higher. Finally, welfare analysis confirms real effects: progressive taxation reduces aggregate welfare by dampening savers' gains and amplifying the losses of liquidity-constrained households. The analysis identifies fiscal drag as a key channel through which persistent inflation affects fiscal outcomes and household welfare, highlighting the trade-off between automatic fiscal consolidation and its distributional costs.

AI.tldr: 本文在Bianchi等(2023)的双主体新凯恩斯模型中引入累进劳动所得税，研究持续性通胀通过财政拖累（fiscal drag）对公共财政和家庭福利的影响。结果表明：持续性通胀通过提高名义劳动收入和税收收入产生财政拖累，累进税制下效应更强；家庭异质性显著——储蓄者受益，而手口相食家庭消费下降；福利分析显示累进税制降低总体福利。
AI.research_question: 持续性通胀如何通过财政拖累渠道影响公共财政和家庭福利？累进税制在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注通胀通过降低政府债务实际价值影响财政，但通胀通过财政拖累（名义收入增长推高有效税率）影响财政和福利的机制尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bianchi等(2023)的双主体新凯恩斯模型（TANK），引入累进劳动所得税，分析财政拖累的宏观效应和分配效应。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟，包括敏感性分析和福利分析。
AI.findings: (1) 持续性通胀通过提高名义劳动收入和税收收入产生财政拖累；(2) 累进税制下财政拖累效应更强；(3) 异质性显著：储蓄者受益，手口相食家庭消费下降；(4) 货币政策反应越不积极、通胀越持久、税制累进性越高，财政拖累越强；(5) 累进税制降低总体福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别财政拖累是持续性通胀影响财政结果和家庭福利的关键渠道，揭示自动财政巩固与分配成本之间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解通胀环境下的财政自动稳定器效应及其分配后果提供理论依据，提示需关注累进税制在通胀时期的非预期分配效应。

title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
affiliations: Sogang University - Department of Economics, University of Michigan and KU Leuven

detail.title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
detail.abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个比较不同减排技术补贴相对有效性的框架，发现中间技术（HEV）可能比最清洁技术（BEV）更有效减少排放，并应用于韩国乘用车市场验证了这一结论。
AI.research_question: 在排放减少技术补贴中，中间技术（如HEV）与最清洁技术（如BEV）相比，哪种补贴更有效？
AI.motivation: 现有政策常优先补贴最清洁技术（如BEV），但中间技术（如HEV）可能通过诱导消费者从高排放技术转向而实现更大减排效果，这一可能性尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术替代框架：比较不同减排技术补贴的相对有效性，核心机制是中间技术通过诱导更大程度地替代高排放技术来实现减排。
AI.method: 构建理论框架，并应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用包含里程异质性的需求模型（里程是影响燃料类型选择的重要因素）。
AI.findings: （1）将现有补贴从BEV重新分配给HEV，可额外减少47%的温室气体排放；（2）BEV补贴要优于HEV补贴，需要电力碳排放强度下降约45%；（3）HEV补贴比BEV补贴更有效，直到消费者愿意转向BEV或电力充分脱碳。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个比较不同减排技术补贴相对有效性的理论框架，揭示了中间技术可能比最清洁技术更有效的条件机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化补贴分配提供了实证依据，提示在消费者接受度和电力脱碳程度不足时，HEV补贴可能比BEV补贴更有效。

reference: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 26-11
title: A Life-Course Model of Neighborhood Effects on Health
affiliations: University of Chicago and University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility

detail.title: A Life-Course Model of Neighborhood Effects on Health

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 26-11
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Concentrated poverty is widely understood to affect health, but theories of neighborhood effects differ on when exposure matters most. Some emphasize adolescence as a critical period, others cumulative exposure across the life course, and still others contemporaneous conditions. Prior research has not adjudicated among these perspectives because it typically measures neighborhood characteristics at one point in time or summarizes longitudinal exposures using restrictive duration-weighted averages. We develop a life-course model that distinguishes the timing, accumulation, and sequencing of exposure to concentrated poverty from adolescence
through midlife. Using data from Add Health and novel methods of causal inference, we estimate age-specific effects of neighborhood poverty on multiple indicators of adult health. We find limited evidence that adolescence is uniquely consequential or that effects operate primarily through contemporaneous exposure. Instead, our results support a cumulative model: exposure to concentrated poverty at each life-course stage has a similarly adverse effect on health. These effects compound over time, such that sustained exposure to concentrated poverty is linked with a 0.15 standard deviation decline in self-rated health, a 1.25 kg/m² increase in body mass index, and approximately 25 percent higher concentrations of C-reactive protein, an indicator of chronic inflammation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Add Health数据和因果推断新方法，构建了一个区分暴露时机、累积和顺序的生命历程模型，发现集中贫困对健康的影响并非青春期关键期或即时暴露主导，而是累积性的——每个生命阶段的贫困暴露都对成年健康产生类似的负面影响，且效应随时间叠加。
AI.research_question: 集中贫困对成年健康的影响中，暴露时机（青春期关键期、累积暴露、即时条件）哪种解释成立？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多采用单一时点测量或限制性的加权平均方法，无法区分不同生命历程理论（关键期、累积、即时）对贫困健康效应的预测差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命历程理论（关键期模型、累积暴露模型、即时条件模型）
AI.method: 使用Add Health纵向数据，结合新颖的因果推断方法，构建区分暴露时机、累积和序列的生命历程模型，估计从青春期到中年各年龄段的集中贫困对健康的年龄特异性效应。
AI.findings: 青春期并非独特关键期，效应也非主要由即时暴露驱动；支持累积模型——每个生命阶段的集中贫困暴露对健康都有相似的负面影响，效应随时间叠加。持续暴露导致自评健康下降0.15个标准差、BMI增加1.25 kg/m²、C反应蛋白浓度升高约25%。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过精细化的生命历程建模，在方法论上区分了暴露时机、累积和序列，为邻里效应理论中"何时暴露最重要"的争议提供了实证裁决，支持了累积暴露理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策干预不应仅聚焦于青春期，而应在整个生命周期持续减少集中贫困，以最大程度减轻其对健康的累积损害。

title: Made, Earned, or Extracted? Platform Scale, Housing Scarcity, and Short-Term Rental Regulation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Made, Earned, or Extracted? Platform Scale, Housing Scarcity, and Short-Term Rental Regulation
detail.abstract: Short-term rental platforms create urban value by matching visitors with underusedhousing, but they can also redirect scarce residential units toward transient demand.This paper develops a margin-based framework for distinguishing matching surplus fromhousing-scarcity and regulatory rents, then applies it to New York City and to large U.S.metro policy events. Using 2019 Airbnb listings, Zillow rent and home-value panels, NewYork City’s post-enforcement short-term-rental registry, council-district boundaries,and ACS housing denominators, the analysis shows that high-availability whole-homelistings were concentrated among multi-listing hosts and in high-rent districts whereposted short-term capacity prices exceeded local rent benchmarks. After Local Law 18platform verification, the legal registry was much smaller and spatially distinct fromthe pre-enforcement whole-home exposure margin. Stacked event studies and synthetic-control diagnostics around restrictive policy events in Boston, Los Angeles, and NewYork show suggestive rent relief in some policy windows, but treatment heterogeneity,pandemic overlap, and pre-policy dynamics bound the causal interpretation. Theevidence supports margin-specific urban regulation: registration, platform verification,primary-residence rules, night caps, and targeted exclusions can preserve incidentalhome sharing while limiting the conversion of scarce housing into visitor accommodation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个区分短租平台共享剩余与住房稀缺性租金的边际框架，利用纽约市及美国大城市政策事件的数据分析表明，高可用的整套房源集中在多房源房东和高租金区域，政策实施后合法注册规模显著缩小且空间分布不同。事件研究发现限制性政策在某些窗口期带来租金缓解，但因果解释受限于异质性和疫情干扰。证据支持边际特定的城市监管策略。
AI.research_question: 短租平台（如Airbnb）如何在不同城市空间中产生价值与成本？如何区分短租带来的匹配剩余与住房稀缺性租金及监管租金？限制性政策是否有效缓解住房压力？
AI.motivation: 短租平台一方面通过匹配游客与闲置住房创造城市价值，另一方面可能将稀缺住宅单元转向短期需求，加剧住房可负担性危机。现有研究缺乏区分这两种效应的分析框架，也缺乏对政策效果的系统因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边际分析框架（margin-based framework），区分匹配剩余（matching surplus）、住房稀缺性租金（housing-scarcity rent）与监管租金（regulatory rent）。
AI.method: 利用2019年Airbnb房源数据、Zillow租金与房价面板数据、纽约市短租登记数据、议会选区边界及ACS住房分母数据；采用堆叠事件研究（stacked event studies）和合成控制诊断（synthetic-control diagnostics）方法，分析波士顿、洛杉矶和纽约的限制性政策事件。
AI.findings: 1. 高可用性整套房源集中在多房源房东和高租金区域，短租价格超过当地租金基准。2. 纽约地方法律（Local Law 18）实施后，合法注册规模远小于执法前整套房源暴露边际，且空间分布不同。3. 限制性政策在某些窗口期显示出租金缓解的暗示性证据，但处理异质性、疫情重叠和政策前动态限制了因果推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分短租平台匹配剩余与住房稀缺性租金的边际分析框架，为理解短租平台的城市影响提供了理论区分工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市监管提供边际特定政策建议：注册制度、平台验证、主要住所规则、夜间上限和定向排除可以在保护临时共享住宿的同时，限制稀缺住房向游客住宿的转化。

title: The Structural Trap of Low Fertility in East Asia: Educational Fever, Marriage Gate, and Gendered Constraints

detail.title: The Structural Trap of Low Fertility in East Asia: Educational Fever, Marriage Gate, and Gendered Constraints
detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified theoretical framework to explain the mechanisms underlying the commonly observed low fertility in East Asia. In analyzing educational fever as a cause of low fertility after family formation, this paper focuses on three underlying factors: the low substitutability between academic and vocational education, negative externalities from neighboring countries, and the high competitive sensitivity driven by the narrowness of success paths and economic inequality. Regarding declining and delayed marriages, we highlight not only the flow constraint of women's childcare and childbearing burdens that has been extensively discussed in previous literature, but also the asset stock constraint faced by men that is pronounced in East Asia. Both constraints stem from deeply ingrained gender norms.Throughout this paper, the key concepts are substitutability and its closely related concepts of diversity and complementarity. Based on this theoretical framework and key concepts, we derive policy implications for addressing the structural trap of low fertility.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的理论框架，从教育狂热、婚姻推迟与性别规范三个维度解释东亚低生育率的机制，核心概念是可替代性、多样性与互补性。
AI.research_question: 东亚地区普遍低生育率现象背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 东亚低生育率已成为严峻的社会问题，但现有研究缺乏一个能够整合教育、婚姻、性别规范等多重因素的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以可替代性（substitutability）、多样性（diversity）和互补性（complementarity）为核心概念，整合教育狂热、婚姻约束与性别规范的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建构与演绎分析，结合东亚各国/地区的经验现象。
AI.findings: 1）教育狂热导致低生育率的三个机制：学术与职业教育低可替代性、邻国负外部性、成功路径狭窄与经济不平等带来的高竞争敏感度；2）婚姻推迟不仅源于女性育儿负担的流量约束，还源于男性面临的资产存量约束；3）两种约束均根植于根深蒂固的性别规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合性的理论框架，将可替代性概念引入生育率研究，区分了流量约束与存量约束对婚姻决策的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 基于理论框架提出应对低生育率结构性陷阱的政策启示，强调需要从教育体系、性别规范等多方面进行系统性改革。

title: The Insurability Frontier: Ambiguity, Capital, and the Supply of Insurance

detail.title: The Insurability Frontier: Ambiguity, Capital, and the Supply of Insurance
detail.abstract: High layers of catastrophe reinsurance trade at large multiples of expected loss, cyber cover repriced by more than one hundred percent year-on-year at the height of the ransomware surge, and pandemic business interruption found no private price at all. I argue that these supply-side patterns follow from a single mechanism: model uncertainty, unlike sampling risk, is common to every policy in a book and therefore cannot be pooled away. In a smooth-ambiguity model of an insurer, the per-policy ambiguity load rises with book size and converges to the worst-case price over the insurer's set of loss models, so that scenario-based pricing emerges as the large-portfolio limit rather than as an assumption. Worst-case supply combined with demand anchored on best-estimate probabilities yields a closed-form insurability frontier: cover exists only where the ratio of worst-case to best-estimate loss probability lies below a risk-aversion multiplier. Treating the model set as a market convention that expands non-Bayesianly after surprise losses and contracts only as confirming data arrive reproduces the asymmetric hard-soft pattern of reinsurance prices. I derive testable predictions, relate the frontier to published market evidence, and set out an incentive-compatible experimental design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模型不确定性（而非抽样风险）是再保险和巨灾保险市场供给端异常定价的核心机制。模型不确定性无法通过分散化消除，因此每保单的模糊性溢价随承保规模增长，最终收敛至最坏情景定价。基于此，推导出可保性边界，并解释了再保险市场的非对称硬软市场周期。
AI.research_question: 模型不确定性如何解释再保险和巨灾保险市场中观测到的供给端异常定价模式（如高倍乘数定价、网络险保费翻倍、疫情险无市价等）？
AI.motivation: 传统保险定价模型（基于可分散的抽样风险）无法解释再保险市场中系统性、非对称的定价现象。作者试图用一个统一的机制——模型不确定性——来解释这些看似离散的市场异常。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平滑模糊性模型（smooth-ambiguity model）和可加性厌恶；模型不确定性 vs. 抽样风险的区分。
AI.method: 理论建模：在平滑模糊性框架下构建保险公司最优化问题，推导出均衡定价条件和可保性边界。
AI.findings: (1) 模型不确定性无法通过分散化消除，每保单模糊性溢价随组合规模增大而上升，收敛至最坏情景价格；(2) 最坏情景供给与最佳估计需求结合，产生封闭形式可保性边界；(3) 模型集作为市场惯例，在意外损失后非贝叶斯式扩张、仅在确认数据到来后收缩，再现非对称硬软市场周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模型不确定性而非抽样风险作为保险供给的核心约束，统一解释了多种再保险定价异常；理论上证明场景定价是大组合极限的结果而非假设；推导出可检验的可保性边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为再保险公司和监管机构提供了理解定价周期和可保性边界的分析框架；提出了激励相容的实验设计方案；帮助解释为何某些风险（如疫情业务中断）在私人市场根本无法定价。

title: The Entropy Standard: The Biosphere Fluid, Time Ledgers, and the Physical Limits of Civilization
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Entropy Standard: The Biosphere Fluid, Time Ledgers, and the Physical Limits of Civilization
detail.abstract: Grounded in a hard-core perspective at the intersection of thermodynamics and information theory, this paper strips away the symbolic illusions of traditional political economy, redefining human society as an active, viscoelastic "colloidal fluid" dissipative structure driven by external energy throughput and the fundamental "time ledgers" of carbon-based individuals. Moving beyond monetary and financial fictions, the framework establishes the Dual Constraint Equations of Civilizational Survival: 1. The Upper Limit Constraint Equation, which maps the physiological and physical time limits imposed on carbon-based components by the combined demands of innovative labor, unmechanized repetitive labor, and exponential administrative/game-theoretic complexity overhead ; and 2. The Lower Limit Maintenance Equation, which dictates the non-negotiable minimum energy baseline required to prevent system disintegration. Using this apparatus, the work diagnoses two terminal pathologies plaguing modern advanced societies: Mechanization Blockade Disease (where stalled technological evolution forces human flesh to brute-force unmechanized repetitive labor, triggering population cliffs) and Complexity Parasitism (where skyrocketing administrative and defensive friction devours society's scarce innovative brainpower). The classical scholar Gu Yanwu once distinguished between the "fall of a state" (wangguo) and the "collapse of all-under-heaven" (wang tianxia)-the former representing the mere succession of ruling algorithms, and the latter the disintegration of a civilization's high-order negative entropy system. Examining the present, the global sphere is deeply mired in the quagmire of AI algorithm bubbles and capital centralization; from Asia, Africa, and Latin America to Europe and the Americas, state will is reasserting comprehensive control over physical resources. History and the laws of physics indicate that even though technological bubbles will ultimately burst, and even though centralized control will cause internal friction and complexity overhead to expand exponentially, we must still hope that this represents merely a transient system damping in the long river of history. For the Second Law of Thermodynamics has long delivered its ultimate verdict: without free physical sampling and distributed trial-and-error, human civilization will inevitably descend into absolute information dead silence. This theory may well transcend its era. Humanity remains trapped in the illusions of gold and fiat currency vouchers, unable as yet to embrace a true "Entropy Standard." Yet, a day will come when civilization is anchored upon the physical ledger of entropy-based accounting, and humanity will no longer rely on crude "combustion and explosions" to enact its achievements, but will instead drive grand phase transitions via minute energy leaps. So long as civilization's informational genes are not swallowed by entropy increase, the myth will endure across the starry seas of the universe.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学与信息论交叉的硬核视角出发，将人类社会重新定义为一种由外部能量驱动的粘弹性"胶体流体"耗散结构，提出文明存续的双重约束方程，诊断现代社会的机械化阻滞病与复杂性寄生两大病理，并主张以熵本位取代货币幻觉作为文明记账基础。
AI.research_question: 如何从热力学和信息论的基本物理定律出发，重新定义人类社会运行的本质逻辑，并解释现代文明面临的结构性危机？
AI.motivation: 传统政治经济学停留在货币、金融等符号幻觉层面，未能触及文明存续的物理本质。本文试图突破这一局限，建立基于热力学第二定律和熵增原理的文明分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学（耗散结构理论、熵增定律）、信息论、碳基个体的"时间账簿"概念、文明存续的双重约束方程（上限约束方程与下限维持方程）、机械化阻滞病与复杂性寄生病诊断。
AI.method: 理论推演与跨学科概念嫁接，将热力学、信息论、政治经济学、历史分析相结合，构建形式化约束方程。
AI.findings: 现代社会面临两大致命病理：一是技术进化停滞导致人类被迫用肉体承担不可机械化的重复劳动，引发人口断崖；二是行政与博弈复杂性膨胀吞噬创新脑力。同时指出，若没有自由物理采样和分布式试错，文明必然陷入绝对信息死寂。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会运行还原为热力学与信息论的物理基础，提出"熵本位"记账标准替代货币幻觉，以双重约束方程形式化表达文明存续的物理边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 诊断现代社会的两种结构性病理（机械化阻滞病、复杂性寄生病），警示技术泡沫与中央集权控制的物理极限，呼吁将文明锚定在熵基物理账本上。

title: Analysis of Factors Affecting Child Mortality in Afghanistan; Case Study -Balkh Province

detail.title: Analysis of Factors Affecting Child Mortality in Afghanistan; Case Study -Balkh Province
detail.abstract: Children are considered a country's assets. Child mortality is an important indicator of the overall health situation in a country and one of the most important issues facing developing countries today. In Afghanistan, child mortality is linked to social, socioeconomic , demographic, health, cultural and environmental factors. Moreover, child mortality is linked to fertility. The main purpose of this study is to determine the socioeconomic factors affecting child mortality in Afghanistan.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了阿富汗儿童死亡率的社会经济影响因素，发现儿童死亡率与生育率、社会、社会经济、人口、健康、文化和环境因素密切相关。
AI.research_question: 影响阿富汗儿童死亡率的社会经济因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 儿童死亡率是衡量国家整体健康状况的重要指标，也是发展中国家面临的最重要问题之一。在阿富汗，儿童死亡率与多种因素相关，但尚需系统研究社会经济因素的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童死亡率与社会经济、人口、健康、文化、环境因素及生育率之间的关系理论。
AI.method: 基于阿富汗数据的定量分析，研究社会经济因素与儿童死亡率之间的关系。
AI.findings: 阿富汗儿童死亡率与社会经济、人口、健康、文化、环境和生育率因素密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别了影响阿富汗儿童死亡率的社会经济因素，补充了发展中国家儿童死亡率影响因素的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿富汗及其他发展中国家制定降低儿童死亡率的政策提供了实证依据，有助于针对性地改善社会经济条件。

title: Determinants of Housing Situation for Adults with Cognitive Impairments
affiliations: Stony Brooke University and State University of New York (SUNY), Stony Brook

detail.title: Determinants of Housing Situation for Adults with Cognitive Impairments
detail.abstract: We use multinomial logit and data from the American Community Survey and State of States in Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities to estimate how standard explanatory variables and two fiscal state-specific variables affect living arrangements of people with intellectual disabilities.  We find that state expenditure on people with intellectual disabilities has a small effect on the proportion of such people who live with their parents.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国社区调查和智力与发展性残疾州状况数据，通过多项逻辑回归模型，估计了标准解释变量和两个州级财政变量如何影响智力残疾人士的居住安排。研究发现，州政府对智力残疾人士的支出对其与父母同住的比例影响较小。
AI.research_question: 州级财政支出和标准解释变量如何影响智力残疾人士的居住安排（特别是与父母同住的比例）？
AI.motivation: 了解财政政策对智力残疾人士居住安排的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多项逻辑回归模型，结合标准解释变量和州级财政变量分析居住安排决策。
AI.method: 采用多项逻辑回归（Multinomial Logit），数据来源为美国社区调查（American Community Survey）和智力与发展性残疾州状况数据（State of States in Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities）。
AI.findings: 州政府对智力残疾人士的支出对其与父母同住的比例影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为智力残疾人士居住安排的影响因素研究提供了财政变量层面的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者，单纯增加州级财政支出可能对改变智力残疾人士与父母同住的比例效果有限，需考虑其他综合干预措施。

title: Historical Air Pollutant Emission Levels and Differential Changes in Lung Cancer Incidence Across Countries: A Global Difference-in-differences Analysis
affiliations: Fujian Medical University - Department of Thoracic Surgery, Zhangping Municipal Hospital, Zhangpu Hospital, Zhangping Municipal Hospital, Zhangpu Hospital, Fujian Medical University - Department of Thoracic Surgery and Fujian Medical University - Department of Thoracic Surgery

detail.title: Historical Air Pollutant Emission Levels and Differential Changes in Lung Cancer Incidence Across Countries: A Global Difference-in-differences Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: Key Laboratory of Cardio-Thoracic Surgery (Fujian Medical University), Fujian Province University (No.2019-67); National Key Clinical Specialty of Thoracic Surgery; Clinical Research Center for Thoracic Tumors of Fujian Province (2024YGPT001); Fujian provincial health technology project (2025QNB004).

detail.abstract:
Background: Over the past two decades, substantial reductions in anthropogenic pollutant emissions (APE) have reshaped environmental conditions worldwide. However, countries entered this period of environmental transition with markedly different historical emission levels, and it remains unclear whether these differences have been associated with distinct long-term trajectories of lung cancer incidence.

Methods: We conducted a global longitudinal ecological study including 192 countries from 1990 to 2022. Historical APE levels were defined as the average national APE during the pre-transition period (1990–2005) and were analyzed as both continuous and tertile-based variables. Age-standardized lung cancer incidence was obtained from the Global Burden of Disease Study. A two-way fixed-effects difference-in-differences (DID) framework was used to evaluate differential changes in lung cancer incidence before and after 2006. The parallel trends assumption was assessed using an event-study design, and multiple prespecified sensitivity analyses were conducted to evaluate the robustness of the findings.

Findings: The event-study analysis supported the parallel trends assumption. Temporal changes in lung cancer incidence differed across countries with different historical APE levels during a period of global environmental transition. In the continuous DID analysis, higher historical APE levels were consistently associated with greater post-2006 declines in lung cancer incidence, although the interaction term did not reach statistical significance (β = −0.21, P = 0.162). In the categorical DID analysis, countries in the highest historical APE tertile experienced significantly greater post-2006 declines in lung cancer incidence than those in the lowest tertile (β = −1.57, P = 0.020), whereas no significant difference was observed for the middle tertile. Sensitivity analyses yielded consistent results across alternative model specifications.

Interpretation: Our findings indicate that temporal changes in lung cancer incidence differed across countries with different historical environmental contexts during a period of global environmental transition. These findings highlight the importance of considering historical environmental context when evaluating long-term population health responses to environmental change.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1990-2022年192个国家的面板数据，采用双重差分法检验发现：在2006年后的全球环境转型期，历史人为污染物排放水平较高的国家，其肺癌年龄标准化发病率下降幅度显著大于历史排放水平较低的国家，提示环境转型的健康效应因历史排放背景不同而存在差异。
AI.research_question: 在全球污染物排放减少的环境转型背景下，各国不同的历史排放水平是否与肺癌发病率的长期变化轨迹存在关联？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年全球人为污染物排放大幅减少，但各国进入这一环境转型期时的历史排放水平差异显著，而此前研究未充分探讨这种历史背景差异是否导致肺癌发病率呈现不同的长期变化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境流行病学理论、环境转型与健康效应异质性假说、历史环境暴露的滞后健康效应理论
AI.method: 全球纵向生态学研究，涵盖192个国家1990-2022年数据。使用双重差分固定效应模型，以2006年为政策/转型断点，历史APE水平（1990-2005年均值）作为连续变量和三分位变量进行分析。采用事件研究法检验平行趋势假设，并进行多项敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 事件研究支持平行趋势假设。连续DID分析中，历史排放水平与2006年后肺癌发病率下降呈正相关但未达统计显著（β=-0.21, P=0.162）。分类DID分析中，最高历史排放三分位组国家相比最低组，2006年后肺癌发病率下降显著更大（β=-1.57, P=0.020），中间组差异不显著。敏感性分析结果稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了环境转型期历史排放背景差异导致健康效应异质性的跨国实证证据，拓展了环境健康领域的历史暴露-健康结果动态关系的理论理解，强调了在评估环境变化对人口健康长期影响时需考虑历史环境背景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国制定差异化的空气污染治理与肺癌防控策略提供依据：历史高排放国家在减排后可能更早、更显著地获得肺癌发病率下降的健康红利，而历史低排放国家可能需要更长的观察周期。有助于全球肺癌防控资源针对不同历史环境背景的国家进行差异化配置。

title: Is Relatively Lenient Punishment vis-à-vis Adults Driving Juvenile Crime? Evidence from India

detail.title: Is Relatively Lenient Punishment vis-à-vis Adults Driving Juvenile Crime? Evidence from India
detail.abstract: The 2015 amendment to India's Juvenile Justice Act reduced the age of criminal majority for heinous offences from eighteen to sixteen. This seems to remind one of Becker's (1968) deterrence logic: if juveniles perceive that adult courts impose harsher sanctions (higher f), they will offend less. This premise rests on two empirical assumptions-riskaverse, fully informed offenders and a positive behavioural response to sanction severity. Using original survey data from juveniles in Delhi, we find no evidence that awareness of more lenient juvenile treatment predicts offending; instead, alcohol or drug use, school dropout and adult co-offending are the dominant correlates. These results imply that the behavioural response to sanction severity is negligible for this population, undercutting the utilitarian case for the amendment. A simple welfare extension that allows society to derive utility from retributive punishment-absent in Becker's original framework-provides a coherent rationale for the reform without invoking deterrence.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于德里少年调查数据发现，青少年对刑罚严厉程度的认知与犯罪行为无关，真正相关的是酗酒、辍学和与成年同犯；因此，2015年印度《少年司法法》将重罪刑事责任年龄降至16岁的修改，无法用威慑理论辩护，但引入报应性惩罚的社会效用可提供替代性解释。
AI.research_question: 印度2015年《少年司法法》修正案将重罪刑事责任年龄从18岁降至16岁，这一基于贝克尔威慑逻辑的政策是否有效？青少年对刑罚严厉程度的认知是否真的影响其犯罪行为？
AI.motivation: 检验贝克尔(1968)威慑理论在青少年群体中的经验前提：风险厌恶且信息充分的犯罪者，以及刑罚严厉性对行为的正向威慑效应。如果这些前提不成立，则改革缺乏功利主义依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝克尔(1968)犯罪经济学威慑理论；报应性惩罚的效用函数扩展
AI.method: 使用来自德里青少年的原始调查数据，分析青少年对少年法庭与成人法庭刑罚差异的认知与其犯罪行为的关联。
AI.findings: 没有证据表明青少年对更宽容的少年司法处理的认知预测了犯罪行为；酒精/药物使用、辍学和与成年同犯才是犯罪的主要相关因素。青少年对刑罚严厉程度的行为反应可以忽略不计。
AI.theory_contributions: 证伪了贝克尔威慑框架在青少年司法领域的经验前提，揭示了威慑逻辑的局限性；引入报应性惩罚的社会效用作为替代性理论基础，补充了贝克尔原始框架中缺失的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 对印度少年司法改革提供实证挑战，指出降低刑事责任年龄无法通过威慑效应达到预期目的；政策制定者应关注辍学、药物滥用和成年同犯等真正风险因素。

title: Predicting Early Default in SBA 7(a) Loans: Public-Data Risk Ranking Across a Regime Shift

detail.title: Predicting Early Default in SBA 7(a) Loans: Public-Data Risk Ranking Across a Regime Shift

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study used existing secondary data and did not involve direct participation or intervention with human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper asks whether public SBA 7(a) origination records can rank early-default risk when defaults are rare and lending conditions have shifted. Using SBA FOIA loan-level records, it compares logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost in a time-ordered design. Models are trained on FY2010-FY2019 approvals, tuned on FY2020-FY2021 approvals, and tested on FY2022-FY2024 Q2 approvals. Early default is defined as charge-off within 18 months of approval. In the held-out test set, 361 of 127,464 loans default early (0.283 percent). XGBoost records test AUC-ROC of 0.9747 and AUC-PR of 0.2347. Calibrated logistic regression records 0.8387 and 0.0130, while random forest records AUC-PR of 0.2284. Because the event is rare, the paper emphasizes AUC-PR, lift, and threshold behavior more than AUC-ROC alone. XGBoost's validation-to-test AUC-ROC decline is about 0.014, consistent with persistent out-of-time rank ordering in this design. The signal is also interpretable. SHAP rankings place term length, loan amount, and initial interest rate at the top, with lender historical default rate next. A term-only benchmark performs strongly in the highestrisk decile, so the full model is best understood as refining queue design and precision-recall tradeoffs rather than discovering hidden predictors. Resolved-loan early-default rates rise after COVID, but alleligible cohort prevalences remain much lower because many recent loans have not resolved. Resolvedloan rates are therefore stress indicators, not portfolio prevalences. The paper supports supervisory triage and lender monitoring, not approval gating, causal lender-type claims, or policy inference from denominator-insensitive default rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在违约事件稀少且贷款条件变化的背景下，公共SBA 7(a)发放记录能否对早期违约风险进行排序。使用逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost在时间顺序设计中建模，发现XGBoost在AUC-PR和排序稳定性上表现最佳，且模型具有可解释性，但主要价值在于优化队列排序和精度-召回权衡，而非发现隐蔽预测因子。
AI.research_question: 公共SBA 7(a)发放记录能否在违约事件稀少且贷款条件变化的条件下，对早期违约风险进行有效排序？
AI.motivation: SBA 7(a)贷款项目中早期违约事件极为稀少（仅0.283%），且贷款条件随时间变化，传统风险排序方法面临挑战。解答这一问题有助于监督分类和贷款人监测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习的时间顺序设计（Time-ordered design），强调AUC-PR、Lift和阈值行为在稀有事例评估中的重要性，而非仅依赖AUC-ROC。
AI.method: 使用SBA FOIA贷款级记录，比较逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost三种模型。训练集：FY2010-FY2019；调优集：FY2020-FY2021；测试集：FY2022-FY2024 Q2。早期违约定义为批准后18个月内核销。
AI.findings: 测试集127,464笔贷款中361笔早期违约（0.283%）。XGBoost的AUC-ROC为0.9747，AUC-PR为0.2347；校准逻辑回归AUC-PR为0.0130；随机森林AUC-PR为0.2284。XGBoost验证集到测试集的AUC-ROC下降约0.014，排序稳定性较好。SHAP排名显示期限长度、贷款金额和初始利率最重要，贷款人历史违约率次之。仅含期限的基准模型在高风险十分位表现强劲。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在极度稀少违约事件和时间推移条件下，集成树模型（XGBoost）仍能保持稳定的风险排序能力；强调了AUC-PR而非AUC-ROC在稀有事例评估中的核心作用；揭示了模型价值在于优化精度-召回权衡和队列排序，而非发现新预测因子。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持监督分类和贷款人监测，而非用于贷款审批门控、因果性贷款人类别主张或对分母不敏感的违约率进行政策推断。为SBA监管者提供了一种基于公开数据的风险排序工具。

title: Percussion Instruments Made From Recycled Material: Its Impact on Performance, Audio Perception and the Environment
affiliations: Goldcrest International and

detail.title: Percussion Instruments Made From Recycled Material: Its Impact on Performance, Audio Perception and the Environment
detail.abstract: Sound is inherently subjective, yet the materials from which an instrument is built fundamentally shapes how it sounds and how it is perceived. Recycled materials are increasingly important in instrument manufacturing due to environmental, acoustic, educational, and socio-cultural considerations aligned with global sustainability goals. Traditional percussion instruments depend on virgin hardwoods, high-grade metal alloys, and petroleum-derived polymers, all of which face growing ecological and supply pressures. This paper examines whether recycled and recyclable materials can serve as viable alternatives to traditional materials in the construction of percussion instruments, evaluated across three dimensions: acoustic performance, audio perception, and environmental impact. Drawing on literature spanning vibro-acoustics, psychoacoustics, composite material science, and life cycle assessment, the findings suggest that recycled materials can approximate the acoustic behaviour of conventional materials when used at moderate proportions, broadly up to around 50% recycled content. Beyond this threshold, degradation in mechanical properties becomes acoustically meaningful, particularly for instruments that endure repeated high-energy impacts. Perceptual differences, while subtle, can emerge under comparative listening conditions or extended performance contexts. Environmentally, the benefits of recycled content are real but not unconditional, as reduced component durability and energy-intensive reprocessing can partially offset initial gains. The paper concludes that sustainable percussion instrument manufacturing is best achieved not through wholesale material substitution, but through an intelligent, evidence-based blending of recycled and virgin materials, validated by rigorous acoustic testing and comprehensive lifecycle analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了回收材料在打击乐器制造中的可行性，从声学性能、听觉感知和环境影响三个维度评估，发现适度使用（约50%以内）回收材料可接近传统材料表现，但超过阈值会导致声学性能下降；可持续制造的最佳路径是回收材料与原生材料的智能混合，而非完全替代。
AI.research_question: 回收和可循环材料能否作为传统材料在打击乐器制造中的可行替代方案？
AI.motivation: 传统打击乐器依赖原始硬木、高级金属合金和石油基聚合物，这些材料面临日益增长的生态和供应压力；同时，回收材料在乐器制造中的重要性因环境、声学、教育和社会文化因素而日益增加，与全球可持续发展目标相一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 振动声学、心理声学、复合材料科学、生命周期评估（LCA）
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合振动声学、心理声学、复合材料科学和生命周期评估等多学科文献进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）回收材料在适度比例（约50%以内）时可接近传统材料的声学行为；（2）超过阈值后，机械性能退化会显著影响声学表现，尤其是承受反复高能量冲击的乐器；（3）听觉感知差异在对比聆听或长时间演奏条件下虽微妙但可能显现；（4）环境效益真实但有条件，组件耐久性降低和能源密集型再加工会部分抵消初始收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为回收材料在打击乐器制造中的应用提供了多学科整合的理论评估框架，明确了回收含量与声学性能之间的非线性关系阈值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可持续打击乐器制造的最佳路径不是完全材料替代，而是基于证据的回收材料与原生材料智能混合策略，并强调需经严格的声学测试和全面的生命周期分析验证。

title: Covered Interest Parity: The Long Run Evidence
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), , University of Cambridge - Judge Business School and Princeton University

detail.title: Covered Interest Parity: The Long Run Evidence
detail.abstract: Employing a novel daily dataset for 19 advanced-economy currencies over the years 1963-2025, we find that, contrary to the prevailing view, deviations from the covered interest parity (CIP) condition were both large and frequent over the long-run. The 2000-06 period immediately preceding the Global Financial Crisis when CIP held unusually closely is therefore the exception rather than the period that followed. The long-run pattern in CIP deviations maps closely to measures of intermediary frictions and FX swap market imbalances. Our findings indicate that intermediary frictions have been a persistent feature of international financial markets over the past six decades.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1963-2025年19种发达经济体货币的日度数据，发现抛补利率平价（CIP）条件在长期内频繁且大幅偏离，而2000-2006年（全球金融危机前）的紧密成立反而是例外。CIP偏离与中介摩擦和外汇掉期市场失衡高度相关，表明中介摩擦是过去60年国际金融市场的持久特征。
AI.research_question: 抛补利率平价（CIP）条件在长期（1963-2025年）是否真正成立？其偏离的模式和驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 挑战主流观点——即CIP在2008年全球金融危机前长期成立，之后才出现持续偏离——基于更长时段和更高频数据重新检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抛补利率平价（CIP）理论；金融中介摩擦理论；外汇掉期市场微观结构理论。
AI.method: 采用1963-2025年19种发达经济体货币的原创日度数据集，进行长周期时间序列分析，将CIP偏离与中介摩擦、掉期市场失衡指标进行映射。
AI.findings: （1）1963-2025年间，CIP偏离在长期内既大又频繁；（2）2000-2006年CIP紧密成立是例外而非常态；（3）CIP偏离与金融中介摩擦和外汇掉期市场失衡高度相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了CIP在长期内成立的经典认知，提出中介摩擦是国际金融市场的持久性特征而非阶段性现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和央行提供CIP偏离长期规律的系统性证据，有助于理解外汇掉期市场的风险定价和金融中介监管。

title: The Influence of the Unemployment Rate, Population Size, and Wages on Economic Growth during the Administration of President Joko Widodo
affiliations: and Universitas Teknologi Digital Indonesia

detail.title: The Influence of the Unemployment Rate, Population Size, and Wages on Economic Growth during the Administration of President Joko Widodo
detail.abstract: Economic growth is one indicator of a government's success. President Joko Widodo's two terms have received positive responses from several researchers. Unfortunately, no research has focused on examining economic growth during these two periods. This article aims to examine the influence of the unemployment rate, population, and wages on Indonesia's economic growth during President Joko Widodo's administration. This study uses a quantitative approach with secondary data sources obtained from the Central Statistics Agency (BPS) report for 34 provinces in Indonesia for the period 2016-2024. Data analysis uses the Multiple Regression method for Panel Data with Eviews 12 software. The results of the study indicate that the unemployment rate does not significantly influence economic growth, with a probability value of 0.344 > 0.05. Meanwhile, population and wages significantly influence economic growth, with probability values of 0.000 < 0.05 and 0.000 < 0.05, respectively. Although based on this study, the unemployment rate does not negatively affect economic growth, the government still needs to continue to strive to reduce the unemployment rate to achieve public welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用2016-2024年印尼34个省份的面板数据，采用多元回归方法分析佐科·维多多总统执政期间失业率、人口和工资对印尼经济增长的影响。结果显示失业率对经济增长无显著影响，而人口和工资则有显著正向影响。
AI.research_question: 在佐科·维多多总统执政期间，失业率、人口和工资如何影响印尼的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 尽管多位研究者对佐科总统两届任期的经济表现给予了积极评价，但尚无研究专门聚焦并系统检验这两个任期内的经济增长影响因素，填补了这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济增长理论，考察失业率（奥肯定律）、人口规模（人口红利理论）和工资水平（劳动力成本理论）对经济增长的影响。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，使用印尼中央统计局（BPS）2016-2024年34个省份的面板数据，采用面板数据多元回归分析，借助Eviews 12软件进行处理。
AI.findings: （1）失业率对经济增长无显著影响（p=0.344>0.05）；（2）人口对经济增长有显著正向影响（p=0.000<0.05）；（3）工资对经济增长有显著正向影响（p=0.000<0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统奥肯定律在印尼情境下的适用性，发现失业率与经济增长之间并无显著关联，为发展中国家经济增长理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼政府提供了政策启示：尽管失业率在统计上不显著影响经济增长，但政府仍需继续努力降低失业率以促进公共福利；同时应关注人口结构和工资水平对经济增长的驱动作用。

title: TradeBench: Domain-Specific Evaluation of Language Models and Multi-Agent Systems for Cross-Border Trade Execution

detail.title: TradeBench: Domain-Specific Evaluation of Language Models and Multi-Agent Systems for Cross-Border Trade Execution
detail.abstract: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them are increasingly proposed for professional decision support, yet existing benchmarks do not test the compound, consequence-laden tasks of cross-border trade execution: customs classification, documentary evidence review, landed-cost calculation, sanctions and denied-party screening, rules-of-origin interpretation, logistics exception management, supplierrisk assessment, escrow and dispute reasoning, and multilingual importer communication. This paper proposes TradeBench, a domain-specific benchmark for evaluating language models and multi-agent systems in crossborder trade. Its design rests on five components: a frequency-severity-observability task ontology of twelve families; a four-class scoreability scheme that separates deterministic, evidence-span, numerical, and structured expert-judgment items with an annotation, adjudication, and inter-annotator reliability protocol; an authorityweighted evidence model; a decision-theoretic scoring rule in which item weights and the human-review trigger derive from expected trade loss rather than arbitrary points; and a reliability-theoretic model that scores LLMonly, retrieval-assisted, tool-using, and multi-agent systems across serial, parallel, and adjudicated topologies with a multi-trial consistency metric. Because several trade tasks are not language-generation taskscounterparty risk is a graph problem, document fraud a multimodal anomaly-detection problem, landed cost a numerical estimation problem-TradeBench evaluates systems rather than models alone, and treats validity, inter-annotator reliability, temporal decay of dynamic gold answers, and contamination control as first-class concerns. The benchmark is presented as a design and validation agenda whose scores are intended to bound deployment, extending prior work on AfCFTA execution, importer trust infrastructure, and pharmaceutical supply-chain security toward a measurable evaluation layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TradeBench，一个专为评估大语言模型及多智能体系统在跨境贸易执行场景中表现而设计的领域基准。该基准基于频率-严重性-可观察性任务本体、四分可评分性方案、权威加权证据模型、决策理论评分规则和可靠性理论模型五大组件构建，涵盖海关分类、单证审核、税费计算、制裁筛查、原产地规则、物流异常、供应商风险、争议推理与多语言沟通等12类任务家族。TradeBench不仅评估模型，更评估系统（包括纯LLM、检索辅助、工具使用和多智能体等拓扑结构），并将效度、标注者间信度、动态金标准时间衰减和污染控制作为首要关注点。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够有效评估大语言模型及多智能体系统在复杂、高风险的跨境贸易执行任务中表现的领域专用基准？
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法测试跨境贸易执行中具有复合性、后果关键性的任务（如海关分类、单证审核、税费计算、制裁筛查等），而这些任务涉及确定性推理、证据跨度推理、数值估计和结构化专家判断等多种认知类型，且需要跨模态、跨系统的协同能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 频率-严重性-可观察性任务本体、四分可评分性方案、权威加权证据模型、决策理论评分规则、可靠性理论模型
AI.method: 提出TradeBench基准设计，包含五大组件：（1）12类任务家族的任务本体；（2）四分可评分性方案（确定性、证据跨度、数值、结构化专家判断），配备标注、裁决和标注者间信度协议；（3）权威加权证据模型；（4）基于预期贸易损失的决策理论评分规则；（5）评估纯LLM、检索辅助、工具使用和多智能体系统在串行、并行和裁决拓扑结构下的可靠性理论模型，含多轮一致性指标。
AI.findings: 跨境贸易任务并非纯语言生成任务（如交易对手风险是图问题、单证欺诈是多模态异常检测问题、到岸成本是数值估计问题），因此需要评估系统而非仅评估模型。TradeBench将效度、标注者间信度、动态金标准时间衰减和污染控制作为首要设计关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将任务类型学、评分方案、证据模型、决策理论和可靠性理论整合为统一基准框架的设计方法论；将评估对象从"模型"扩展至"系统"，并引入多拓扑结构比较。
AI.practical_contributions: TradeBench的评分结果旨在为实际部署提供边界约束；在AfCFTA执行、进口商信任基础设施和医药供应链安全等领域的先前工作基础上增加了可测量的评估层。

title: Does Vertical Integration Pay Off in a Crisis? Evidence from the COVID-19 Pandemic
affiliations: Prairie View A&M University, East Carolina University and Prairie View A&M University

detail.title: Does Vertical Integration Pay Off in a Crisis? Evidence from the COVID-19 Pandemic
detail.abstract: Using the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment, we examine if vertical integration (VI) helps firms weather a severe market-wide supply chain shock. Drawing on text-based vertical integration scores and a sample of 2,939 unique U.S. public firms over the 2017–2023 period, we employ the difference-in-differences panel regression method and find that high-VI firms exhibit significantly greater operational resilience during the pandemic, suffering smaller declines in return on assets than their low-VI counterparts. We identify inventory turnover as the primary channel through which vertical integration improves firm performance during the crisis. We further document that shareholders reward the crisis-time value of vertical integration, with high-VI firms buffering COVID-induced losses in Tobin’s Q and stock returns better. Our findings suggest that vertical integration functions as an organizational insurance mechanism, imposing costs in normal times but delivering substantial protection during systemic supply chain disruptions and thus have implications for antitrust policies.

AI.tldr: 以新冠疫情为自然实验，研究发现垂直整合（VI）能够帮助企业在严重的市场范围供应链冲击中提升运营韧性，高VI企业的资产回报率下降更少，且库存周转是主要作用渠道。股东也会奖励VI在危机中的价值，高VI企业能更好地缓冲Tobin's Q和股票回报的损失。VI作为一种组织保险机制，在正常时期有成本，但在系统性供应链中断时提供实质性保护，对反垄断政策有启示。
AI.research_question: 垂直整合是否以及在多大程度上帮助企业在严重的市场范围供应链冲击中提升运营韧性？
AI.motivation: 利用新冠疫情作为外生的市场范围供应链冲击自然实验，检验垂直整合在危机中的价值，弥补以往研究多关注正常时期垂直整合成本的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织保险机制理论：垂直整合在正常时期带来成本，但在系统性供应链中断时提供保护。
AI.method: 基于文本分析的垂直整合得分，采用双重差分面板回归方法，样本涵盖2017-2023年期间2,939家美国上市公司。
AI.findings: 高VI企业在疫情期间资产回报率下降显著更小；库存周转是主要作用渠道；高VI企业能更好地缓冲Tobin's Q和股票回报的损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垂直整合界定为一种"组织保险机制"，揭示了其在正常时期有成本、危机时期提供保护的非对称价值特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在供应链风险管理中考虑垂直整合策略提供决策参考；为反垄断政策在评估垂直整合时考虑危机时期的保护效应提供启示。

title: Beyond Financial Performance: Reclassifying State Ownership in Uzbekistan by Economic Function
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond Financial Performance: Reclassifying State Ownership in Uzbekistan by Economic Function
detail.abstract:
This policy brief examines how Uzbekistan can improve state ownership reform by moving beyond a narrow focus on financial performance and privatization transactions. It argues that financial results alone are not sufficient to determine whether a state-owned enterprise should be privatized, restructured, retained, or subject to special safeguards. Different enterprises perform different economic functions: some operate in competitive markets, some provide public-service obligations, some manage natural monopolies, and others control strategic resources or generate important fiscal revenues.

The brief proposes a functional classification of state-owned enterprises based on their economic role rather than legal status or profitability alone. This approach helps distinguish between enterprises that should be exposed to market opening and privatization, those that require transparent compensation for public-service obligations, those that need stronger regulation as natural monopolies, and those that may require safeguards before partial listing or restructuring.

The analysis highlights that privatization should follow market opening, not replace it. In competitive sectors, privatization should be preceded by a review of market barriers, exclusive rights, and regulatory advantages. Where such barriers exist, reform should address them before divestment; otherwise, privatization may simply transfer protected rents from the state to private owners. At the same time, enterprises delivering socially necessary but commercially unviable services should not be treated as commercial failures if their mandates are clearly defined and transparently financed.

Drawing on international experience, the brief emphasizes that institutional design is critical for the durability of state ownership reform. It recommends shifting from transaction-based privatization toward a functional model of state ownership policy, supported by clear classification criteria, market-opening measures, safeguards for strategic-resource enterprises, transparent treatment of public-service obligations, and stronger legal protection for long-term reform objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出乌兹别克斯坦应超越单纯的财务绩效和私有化交易视角，采用基于经济功能的国有企业分类方法，通过市场开放、分类监管和制度设计推动国有所有权改革。
AI.research_question: 乌兹别克斯坦应如何超越以财务绩效和私有化交易为核心的改革路径，改进国有所有权改革？
AI.motivation: 单纯依赖财务结果无法判断国有企业是否应私有化、重组或保留，不同国企承担不同的经济功能（市场竞争、公共服务、自然垄断、战略资源等），需要差异化的改革策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能性分类理论：基于经济角色而非法律地位或盈利能力对国企进行分类；市场开放优先于私有化的改革逻辑；制度设计对改革可持续性的影响。
AI.method: 政策分析（政策简报），结合国际经验比较与案例梳理。
AI.findings: （1）私有化应紧跟市场开放而非替代市场开放；（2）竞争性行业应先消除市场壁垒再私有化，否则可能将寻租从国有转为私有；（3）承担公共服务的国企如职责明确且透明资助，不应被视为商业失败；（4）制度设计对改革可持续性至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出从交易导向的私有化转向功能性国有所有权政策模型，丰富了国有企业改革的分类治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌兹别克斯坦及其他转型经济体提供可操作的国企改革路径：明确分类标准、推进市场开放、制定战略资源企业保障措施、透明化公共服务补偿、加强法律保护。

title: The Missing Layer: Mentorship in Uzbekistan's Youth Support System
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Missing Layer: Mentorship in Uzbekistan's Youth Support System
detail.abstract:
This policy brief examines the role of mentorship in strengthening Uzbekistan’s youth support system. Uzbekistan has developed substantial financial and institutional channels for young people, including mahalla-based outreach, social registries, education measures, entrepreneurship support, and targeted youth programs. However, the next practical challenge is to improve how these resources help young people make realistic decisions about employment, skills, entrepreneurship, and social mobility.

The brief argues that structured mentorship can serve as a missing guidance layer within the existing youth support system. Mentorship is understood as regular guidance provided by trained and accountable individuals with relevant experience. It differs from one-off motivational events or masterclasses by offering sustained, practical support that helps young people weigh options, sequence decisions, avoid common mistakes, and make better use of available public programs.

International evidence suggests that mentoring can improve educational, career, and youth development outcomes, although its effects are usually modest and depend strongly on match quality, mentor preparation, supervision, and safeguarding. Mentorship should therefore complement, not replace, existing finance, education, employment, and social protection measures.

The brief highlights that mentorship already exists in Uzbekistan through several targeted initiatives, including university admissions support, women’s entrepreneurship programs, and start-up mentoring. The policy opportunity is to connect and standardize these efforts into a broader guidance mechanism linked to existing youth-support and mahalla delivery channels. The brief recommends starting with a limited, independently evaluated regional pilot, with mentor training, safeguarding, and a formal decision point before any national scale-up.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了导师制如何作为乌兹别克斯坦青年支持体系中的"缺失指导层"，通过结构化、持续的导师指导帮助青年在就业、技能、创业和社会流动方面做出更明智的决策，并提出在现有青年支持渠道基础上进行区域性试点和标准化推广的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 导师制如何弥补乌兹别克斯坦现有青年支持体系中的指导缺口，从而帮助青年在就业、技能、创业和社会流动方面做出更现实的决策？
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克斯坦已建立了完善的青年财政和制度支持渠道（如社区外展、社会登记、教育措施、创业支持和专项青年项目），但青年在利用这些资源进行关键人生决策时仍缺乏有效的指导层，存在"资源有、方向缺"的实践困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 导师制被定义为由受过培训且负责任的、具有相关经验的个体提供的定期指导，区别于一次性激励活动或大师课。其核心在于提供持续的、务实的支持，帮助青年权衡选项、排序决策、规避常见错误并更好利用公共项目。
AI.method: 政策简报类研究，基于国际导师制证据综述（包括教育、职业和青年发展成果的元分析）以及对乌兹别克斯坦现有导师制举措（大学入学支持、女性创业项目、初创企业导师制）的梳理分析。
AI.findings: 1) 国际证据表明导师制对教育、职业和青年发展成果有适度改善作用，效果高度依赖于匹配质量、导师准备、监督和安全保障；2) 乌兹别克斯坦已存在若干分散的导师制举措；3) 导师制应作为补充而非替代现有金融、教育、就业和社会保障措施；4) 建议开展有限规模、独立评估的区域试点，并设置正式决策节点后再考虑全国推广。
AI.theory_contributions: 将导师制概念化为青年支持体系中的"缺失指导层"，明确了导师制与既有资源支持之间的互补关系而非替代关系，为发展中国家青年政策中"资源-指导"双轨框架提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌兹别克斯坦政府提供了具体的政策路径：连接和标准化现有导师制举措，将其嵌入已有的青年支持和社区（mahalla）交付渠道；建议从有限规模的区域试点起步，强调导师培训、安全保障和独立评估的重要性，为政策决策提供了可操作的执行框架。

title: Understanding the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI): What drives Uzbekistan's scores?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Understanding the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI): What drives Uzbekistan's scores?
detail.abstract:
This policy brief examines the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI) and their relevance for understanding Uzbekistan’s governance performance and international positioning. The WGI are widely used by international financial institutions, investors, rating agencies, and development partners as reference points for assessing institutional quality, governance risks, and reform progress. For Uzbekistan, WGI scores matter not only as descriptive indicators, but also because they influence external perceptions of sovereign risk, investment attractiveness, and the credibility of public sector reforms.

The brief argues that WGI indicators should be understood as external assessments of how governance systems are perceived, rather than as direct measurements of government actions. Since 2016, Uzbekistan has demonstrated a positive reform trajectory, with visible improvements in areas such as Government Effectiveness and Political Stability. However, performance remains uneven across WGI dimensions, particularly in Voice and Accountability, Rule of Law, and Control of Corruption.

A key challenge is the gap between reform implementation and external recognition. Even when substantive reforms are undertaken, they may not be fully reflected in WGI scores due to time lags, limited documentation, language barriers, differences in source methodologies, and weak consolidation of governance-related information across institutions.

The brief highlights that WGI dimensions evolve at different speeds and are influenced by different types of sources, including expert assessments, surveys, and international datasets. It concludes that improving Uzbekistan’s WGI performance requires a balanced and sequenced approach: continued substantive reforms should be complemented by systematic documentation, transparency, stronger engagement with relevant international assessment organizations, and better communication of reform outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球治理指标（WGI）对乌兹别克斯坦治理绩效和国际定位的影响，指出WGI反映的是外部对治理体系的感知而非政府行为的直接测量，并分析了改革实施与外部认可之间的差距，提出系统性改进建议。
AI.research_question: 全球治理指标（WGI）如何影响乌兹别克斯坦的治理绩效评估与国际定位？改革实施与外部认可之间的差距如何产生及应对？
AI.motivation: WGI被国际金融机构、投资者、评级机构和发展伙伴广泛用于评估制度质量、治理风险和改革进展，对乌兹别克斯坦的主权风险认知、投资吸引力和公共部门改革可信度有重要影响，因此有必要系统分析WGI与乌兹别克斯坦治理改革之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理指标作为外部感知评估的理论框架，强调WGI衡量的是对治理体系的感知而非政府行为的直接测量；治理指标维度演化速度差异理论；改革实施与外部认知之间的时滞效应理论。
AI.method: 政策性简报分析方法，通过对WGI六个维度的系统性分析，结合乌兹别克斯坦2016年以来的改革实践，比较改革实施与WGI评分之间的差异，并分析指标来源的差异（专家评估、调查、国际数据集）。
AI.findings: 1) 2016年以来乌兹别克斯坦在政府效能和政治稳定方面有显著改善；2) 但在话语权与问责、法治和腐败控制等维度表现仍不均衡；3) 改革实施与外部认可之间存在显著差距，原因包括时滞、文档不足、语言障碍、来源方法论差异及信息整合薄弱；4) WGI各维度演化速度不同，受不同类型数据源影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了治理指标作为感知评估而非直接测量的理论特性；提出了改革实施与外部认知差距的多维成因框架；强调了WGI维度演化速度差异的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌兹别克斯坦提供了系统性改善WGI表现的政策建议：继续深入推进实质性改革，同时加强系统性文档记录、提升透明度、加强与相关国际评估组织的互动、更好传达改革成果。

title: Welfare Implications of Power Sector Restructuring under Mixed Duopoly: A Theoretical Exercise

detail.title: Welfare Implications of Power Sector Restructuring under Mixed Duopoly: A Theoretical Exercise

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest exists.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical approval is required as this is a theoretical model.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: We study the welfare implications of the power sector restructuringin a mixed duopoly set up. To study the optimum relative vertical structure of the public and private utility we have constructed four scenarios with two firms at different vertical structures. We find that when both the utilities are integrated, deintegration of the public utility leads to welfare loss. When both the utilities are in a deintegrated form, integrating the public utility leads to welfare gain. When one of the utilities is deintegrated and the other is vertically integrated, welfare gain can be obtained by integrating the decoupled utility.Deintegration of any one of the utilities reduces the output of that utility. We also find that integration of the utilities improves reliability of the power supply system. The analysis implies that the policy of decoupling the power utilities is expected to produce welfare loss as well as fall in output and consequently loss in reliability. The possible policy suggestion would be to formulate a reform model that would not lead to the loss in vertical economies that exist in the power industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨混合双寡头市场中电力部门重组对福利的影响，通过构建四种不同的垂直结构场景，发现公共电力企业的去整合会导致福利损失，而整合则可带来福利增益和供电可靠性提升。
AI.research_question: 在混合双寡头电力市场中，公共与私人电力企业的不同垂直结构（整合 vs. 去整合）如何影响社会福利？
AI.motivation: 电力部门重组实践中存在关于垂直分离（去整合）是否有利于竞争的争论，本研究旨在通过理论模型分析最优的垂直结构安排，为电力改革政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合双寡头理论、垂直结构理论、电力产业组织理论
AI.method: 构建设含公共企业和私人企业的混合双寡头模型，比较四种垂直结构场景（双方整合、双方去整合、公共整合+私人去整合、公共去整合+私人整合）下的福利水平。
AI.findings: 1. 双方整合时，公共企业去整合导致福利损失；2. 双方去整合时，公共企业整合带来福利增益；3. 一方去整合另一方整合时，整合去整合方带来福利增益；4. 任何一方去整合都会降低该企业产出；5. 整合提升供电系统可靠性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垂直结构理论系统引入混合双寡头电力市场分析，揭示了公共企业与私人企业在不同垂直结构下的福利效应差异，丰富了电力产业组织理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力部门改革提供政策建议：盲目推行电力企业去整合可能导致福利损失、产出下降和可靠性降低，改革应避免破坏电力行业存在的垂直经济性。

title: Beyond the Colonial Trope: Economic Independence and Spiritual Agency Among North Indian Women, c. 1400-1799

detail.title: Beyond the Colonial Trope: Economic Independence and Spiritual Agency Among North Indian Women, c. 1400-1799

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no financial or personal interest that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in "Beyond the Colonial Trope: Economic Independence and Spiritual Agency Among North Indian Women, c. 1400–1799." This research was self-funded. I am affiliated with University of Delhi, which does not hold any stake in the outcome of this research.

detail.abstract: Colonial historiography of South Asia, most of it written between the late eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, built an enduring picture of the North Indian woman as secluded, propertyless, and without a religious voice of her own. That image did double duty; one, it was offered as proof of Indian civilizational decline and other, at the same time, as moral cover for British rule. This is to test that picture against the documentary and material record of North India from roughly 1400 to 1799, drawing on Mughal administrative and mercantile records, hagiographical and devotional literature, and the historiographical work of scholars such as Uma Chakravarti, Kumkum Sangari, Lata Mani, and Ruby Lal. Two arguments are developed. First, elite and sub-elite women exercised real, sometimes substantial, economic agency through landed revenue jagirs, commercial investment, and customary property rights called stridhan. Second, the bhakti and Sufi devotional movements opened avenues of spiritual authority and self-authorship that operated partly outside patriarchal and caste hierarchies, with Mirabai being the perfect example. The study also pushes back against both the colonial "declension narrative" and its nationalist mirror image, the "golden age" counter-narrative, warning against swapping one totalizing myth for another. The record, in the end, supports a picture of agency that was constrained but real, and unevenly distributed by class, caste, and religious community as a picture that colonial epistemology worked hard to obscure.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了殖民史学构建的北印度女性形象（幽居、无财产、无宗教话语权），通过1400-1799年的文献与物质证据，论证了精英与次精英女性在土地收入、商业投资和习惯财产权中拥有实质经济能动性，并在巴克提与苏菲派 devotional 运动中获得了 spiritual 权威。研究同时批判了殖民"衰落叙事"及其对立面"黄金时代"叙事，指出能动性受阶级、种姓和宗教共同体制约但真实存在。
AI.research_question: 殖民史学对北印度女性（1400-1799年）的刻画——即幽居、无财产、无宗教话语权——是否成立？女性在莫卧儿时期的经济与宗教生活中是否拥有能动性？
AI.motivation: 殖民史学构建的北印度女性形象被用于证明印度文明衰落并为英国统治提供道德辩护，但这种图像是否真实亟待检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民知识生产理论、女性主义史学（Uma Chakravarti, Kumkum Sangari, Lata Mani, Ruby Lal等）、后殖民批判。
AI.method: 文献与物质证据分析，包括莫卧儿行政与商业记录、圣徒传记与 devotional 文献，以及殖民史学与民族主义史学的比较研究。
AI.findings: 1. 精英与次精英女性通过土地收入（jagirs）、商业投资和习惯财产权（stridhan）行使了实质经济能动性。2. 巴克提与苏菲派运动为女性开辟了 spiritual 权威和自我表达的途径（以Mirabai为例）。3. 殖民"衰落叙事"和民族主义"黄金时代"叙事均为总体化神话，需警惕。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 修正了殖民史学对前殖民时期北印度女性地位的错误认知。2. 超越"衰落"与"黄金时代"的二元对立，建立了更 nuanced 的分析框架。3. 揭示了殖民知识生产如何系统性地遮蔽了女性的历史能动性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为南亚女性史研究提供了基于原始文献的实证基础。2. 提醒当代研究避免陷入殖民或民族主义的宏大叙事陷阱。3. 有助于更准确地理解印度女性经济与宗教参与的历史渊源。

title: Volatility-Managed Factor Portfolios: A Replication and Extension on the Fama-French Five Factors and Momentum

detail.title: Volatility-Managed Factor Portfolios: A Replication and Extension on the Fama-French Five Factors and Momentum
detail.abstract: We replicate and extend Moreira and Muir (2017) by volatility-managing the Fama-French five factors plus the momentum factor over 1963 to 2026, using daily data from the Kenneth French Data Library. Each factor's exposure is scaled by the inverse of its prior-month realized variance, so the leverage decision uses only past information. Regressing the managed factor on the original (the Moreira-Muir spanning test, with Newey-West standard errors) gives an honest, factor-dependent answer: volatility timing earns large and statistically significant alpha on the crash-prone factors, momentum (8.9% per year, t = 5.0) and profitability (RMW, 2.3% per year, t = 2.9), while it adds nothing for size, value, or investment, and the market factor's managed alpha is positive but insignificant over the full sample. Volatility-managed momentum raises the annualized Sharpe ratio from 0.51 to 0.89 (0.81 net of a 14 basis point per turn transaction cost). The results are consistent with Barroso and Santa-Clara (2015): the factors that benefit are those whose left-tail crashes cluster in high-volatility states. We treat the study as performance attribution rather than a live strategy, reporting turnover and net-of-cost Sharpe throughout, and we include sector-level factor attribution and a sector-momentum baseline as context.

AI.tldr: 本文复制并扩展了Moreira和Muir（2017）的研究，通过对Fama-French五因子加上动量因子进行波动率管理（1963-2026年），发现波动率择时仅对易发生崩盘的因子（动量、盈利因子）产生显著超额收益，而对规模、价值、投资因子无效。
AI.research_question: 波动率管理（volatility-managing）是否能为Fama-French五因子及动量因子带来显著的超额收益？哪些因子能从波动率择时中获益？
AI.motivation: Moreira和Muir（2017）发现波动率管理能提升因子的风险调整后收益，但该结论在不同因子上的表现可能不同。本文旨在通过更长的样本期和更多因子，系统检验波动率择时的有效性及其条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率择时假说、因子崩盘风险（左尾风险）理论、Barroso和Santa-Clara（2015）关于高波动状态下崩盘聚集的理论。
AI.method: 使用1963-2026年Kenneth French数据库的日度数据，对每个因子进行波动率管理，即用前一月已实现方差的倒数调整因子暴露。采用Moreira-Muir跨期检验（Newey-West标准误），进行绩效归因分析，并报告换手率和扣除交易成本后的夏普比率。
AI.findings: 波动率管理仅对动量因子（年化8.9%，t=5.0）和盈利因子RMW（年化2.3%，t=2.9）产生显著alpha；对市场因子alpha为正但不显著；对规模、价值和投资因子无显著效果。波动率管理的动量因子夏普比率从0.51提升至0.89（扣除交易成本后为0.81）。获益的因子是在高波动状态下左尾崩盘聚集的因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了波动率择时的有效性取决于因子的崩盘风险特征，支持了Barroso和Santa-Clara（2015）的理论：只有那些在高波动状态下左尾风险聚集的因子才能从波动率管理中获益，为波动率择时理论提供了边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证资产定价和量化投资提供了可操作的波动率管理策略指南：投资者应优先对动量因子和盈利因子进行波动率管理，而对规模、价值、投资因子进行波动率管理无显著增益。报告了扣除交易成本后的实际收益，更具实践参考价值。

title: The Garden, Measured: Loading, Exploitation, and the False-Positive Rate of LLM-Assisted Specification Choice

detail.title: The Garden, Measured: Loading, Exploitation, and the False-Positive Rate of LLM-Assisted Specification Choice
detail.abstract: Researchers increasingly delegate empirical analysis to large language models, raising the concern that this will amplify p-hacking. We find no such amplification: a frontier model instructed to select the regression specification most likely to yield statistical significance, on placebo panels where the true effect is zero by construction, falsely rejects in 4.8% of panels. Gelman and Loken hold that honest, data-contingent analysis falsely rejects above the nominal level of the reported test; Rubin holds that the relevant pertest rate is not inflated. The quantity separating them, whether the analysis chosen covaries with the analyses that reject across the datasets that could have occurred, had never been measured. Here it is measurable, and it is zero. The risk lies elsewhere: the tests themselves are not calibrated, rejecting true nulls at rates from 2.4% to 11%, so where a researcher's preferred specifications sit on this tilted floor is what sets the false-positive rate of the reported analysis. Calibration on placebo data is a feasible certification step before deployment.

AI.tldr: 研究将经验分析委托给大语言模型是否会加剧p-hacking问题。通过 placebo 面板数据（真实效应为零）测试发现，前沿模型在指令下选择最可能显著的结果时，错误拒绝率仅为4.8%，并未放大p-hacking。核心发现是测试本身存在校准问题（错误拒绝率2.4%-11%），而非模型选择偏差。建议在部署前对placebo数据进行校准认证。
AI.research_question: 将经验分析委托给大语言模型是否会放大p-hacking问题？
AI.motivation: 研究者越来越多地将经验分析委托给大语言模型，这引发了是否会放大p-hacking（通过数据挖掘获取显著结果）的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gelman和Loken认为诚实的、数据依赖的分析会导致错误拒绝率高于报告检验的名义水平；Rubin则认为相关的每次检验率并未被膨胀。两者分歧的核心在于所选分析是否与可能出现的不同数据集中的拒绝性分析共变，此前这一量从未被测量过。
AI.method: 使用placebo面板数据（真实效应为零）构建实验，指令前沿模型选择最可能产生统计显著性的回归规范，测量错误拒绝率。
AI.findings: (1) 模型在placebo数据上的错误拒绝率为4.8%，并未放大p-hacking；(2) 所选分析与拒绝性分析之间的共变量为零；(3) 风险在于检验本身未校准，真实零假设的错误拒绝率在2.4%到11%之间波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次测量了Gelman和Loken与Rubin之间分歧的核心量——所选分析与拒绝性分析在不同可能数据集上的共变量，发现该量为零，调和了理论争议。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 缓解了对LLM放大p-hacking的担忧；(2) 指出真实风险在于检验校准而非选择偏差；(3) 提出在部署前对placebo数据进行校准认证的可行步骤。

title: The Dialectic Planning Method

detail.title: The Dialectic Planning Method

declarations.funderStatement: This research was written and cultivated independently during my Studies as an MCRP candidate at the Bloustein School

detail.abstract:
Planning teaches some of the most critical skills we develop through lived experience, yet most of us are introduced to only minimal portions of these skills through the social institutions and systems that shape our early lives. As adults, acquiring these skills becomes more challenging, with reliance on an individual’s will to develop new methodologies for navigating our complex society.
Studying for a degree in City Planning, I have sought to deepen my understanding of these skills. This journey has brought recognition that systems—at their core—are deeply flawed and inherently conformed, constrained by the rationality of those who design and control them. This dynamic extends across all social and infrastructural systems, limiting the paths forward to those enabled by the tools we create to plan our society. 
This project culminates three separate, yet interconnected inquiries: a redefinition of rational planning through a phenomenological lens, a critique of systemic constraints, and the proposal of a new dialectical methodology for planning’s future as a professional occupation. Chapter I explores rational planning through philosophical inquiry and phenomenological deduction, providing guidance for navigating a society characterized by marketization and hierarchical power. Chapter II explores the self-limiting nature of planning methods, introducing the concept of Transdimensional Conformation. Chapter III synthesizes these insights, reframing planning as a dialectical interplay between structure and freedom, action and consequence, system and spirit—what is termed Synthesized Rebirth of Planning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过现象学视角重新定义理性规划，批判系统内在约束，并提出一种新的辩证方法论——"规划的综合重生"，以超越现有社会与基础设施系统的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过现象学重新定义理性规划？系统约束如何限制规划方法？规划作为专业职业的未来方法论应是什么？
AI.motivation: 规划技能通过生活经验习得，但社会制度仅提供极小部分；成年后更难获取这些技能。作为城市规划专业学生，作者认识到系统本质上存在缺陷且受制于设计者与控制者的理性，亟需新的方法论来应对复杂社会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学（phenomenological lens）、辩证方法论（dialectical methodology）、Transdimensional Conformation（跨维度构型）
AI.method: 哲学探究（philosophical inquiry）与现象学演绎（phenomenological deduction）
AI.findings: 规划方法存在自我限制性（self-limiting nature）；理性规划可通过现象学重新定义；规划的未来应是一种结构性与自由、行动与后果、系统与精神之间的辩证互动，即"规划的综合重生"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"跨维度构型"（Transdimensional Conformation）概念来解释规划方法的自我限制性；重新定义了理性规划的现象学基础；提出了"规划的综合重生"这一辩证方法论框架，将规划从技术性操作提升为系统与精神的辩证互动。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划从业者提供了一种超越现有系统约束的新方法论；帮助个人在市场化与等级权力主导的社会中更好地导航；为规划作为专业职业的未来发展指明了方向。

title: Remittance-Led Resilience: A Structural Analysis of Bangladesh's Migrant Labor Economy, External Sector Stability, and the Post-LDC Graduation Transition

detail.title: Remittance-Led Resilience: A Structural Analysis of Bangladesh's Migrant Labor Economy, External Sector Stability, and the Post-LDC Graduation Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: he author declares no personal or financial relationship with any organization mentioned in this paper (including Bangladesh Bank, BGMEA, ADB, CPD, and IMF) that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects. It is based entirely on secondary, publicly available macroeconomic data; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author

detail.abstract: Two things have been holding up Bangladesh’s external accounts for the last four fiscal years: money sent home by migrant workers, and garment exports. That’s really the whole story in one sentence, and this paper spends the rest of its length unpacking it. Remittances hit a record US$35.56 billion in FY2025–26, roughly 17.3% more than the year before, and that money has done a lot of quiet work–steadying the taka, rebuilding reserves, giving households something to fall back on while the economy was still shaking off the mid-2024 political transition. I pulled together publicly available figures from Bangladesh Bank, the EPB, BGMEA, the IMF, the ADB, the World Bank, and CPD to trace where the remittances are actually coming from, what happened to RMG export earnings this year, and what risks are sitting ahead of the country as it heads toward LDC graduation on 24 November 2026. What the numbers show isn’t quite the ”everything’s fine” story you tend to hear. Total merchandise exports actually fell 0.58% to US$48.00 billion in FY2025–26, and RMG exports on their own dropped 1.64% to US$38.70 billion– even as remittances grew by double digits for the second year running. So it’s not that Bangladesh’s external sector broadly held up; it’s that one part of it did the heavy lifting while the other slipped. Add sub-trend GDP growth, inflation that hasn’t really come down, private investment at a five-year low, and the coming erosion of preferential trade access, and the picture looks less like a resolved crisis and more like resilience that’s being propped up from one side only. The paper ends with some thoughts on diversifying exports, formalising remittance channels, and getting through the graduation transition in one piece.

AI.tldr: 孟加拉国外部账户在过去四个财年主要依赖两大支柱：侨汇和服装出口。侨汇创下355.6亿美元的历史新高（同比增长17.3%），而商品出口总额却下降0.58%，其中服装出口下降1.64%。外部韧性实际由侨汇单边支撑，而非整体向好。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国外部账户的韧性究竟来自何处？侨汇和服装出口这两个传统支柱的表现如何分化？在LDC毕业（2026年11月）前夕面临哪些风险？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国即将于2026年11月24日从最不发达国家（LDC）毕业，届时将丧失优惠贸易准入。在此关键节点，需要系统分析其外部账户的真实状况，揭示"表面一切安好"叙事背后的结构性失衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部账户韧性理论、出口多元化理论、LDC毕业陷阱（preference erosion）理论、侨汇作为稳定器的作用机制。
AI.method: 公开数据汇编与分析，数据来源包括孟加拉国央行、出口促进局（EPB）、孟加拉国服装制造商和出口商协会（BGMEA）、国际货币基金组织（IMF）、亚洲开发银行（ADB）、世界银行（WB）以及政策对话中心（CPD）。
AI.findings: 1）侨汇创历史新高（355.6亿美元，同比+17.3%），连续第二年双位数增长，是稳定塔卡汇率、重建外汇储备的关键力量；2）商品出口总额下降0.58%至480亿美元，其中服装出口下降1.64%至387亿美元；3）经济增长低于趋势水平、通胀未实质回落、私人投资降至五年新低；4）LDC毕业将带来优惠贸易准入丧失的额外压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"外部整体向好"的流行叙事，揭示出外部韧性是由侨汇单边支撑的片面韧性（one-sided resilience），而非均衡的、可持续的稳定结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国政策制定者提供具体建议：推动出口多元化、正规化侨汇渠道、制定应对LDC毕业过渡期的策略。

title: Symbolic Governance and the Transformation of National Identity in Contemporary India

detail.title: Symbolic Governance and the Transformation of National Identity in Contemporary India
detail.abstract: This article examines symbolic governance in contemporary India as a deliberate strategy to transform national identity through Hindu nationalist (Hindutva) ideology. Since the BJP's rise to power in 2014 under Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the government-guided by the RSS and Sangh Parivar-has deployed political iconography (such as the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya and statues of Hindu warrior kings), historical memory (textbook revisions and urban renaming like Rajpath to Kartavya Path), and legal instruments (the 2019 abrogation of Article 370, the Citizenship Amendment Act, cow protection laws, and temple reclamation efforts) to recentre the nation's symbolic core around a Hindu civilizational ethos. Drawing on Supreme Court judgments, policy documents, and scholarly literature on secularism and majoritarianism, the study analyses the resulting tension between India's constitutional commitment to pluralism and secularism (Articles 25-28) and the consolidation of a majoritarian vision of belonging. While these practices have strengthened Hindu coalitions and electoral support by invoking cultural pride and correcting perceived historical wrongs, they have also sparked contestation from minorities, regional identities, and civil society, raising critical questions about social cohesion, democratic pluralism, and the future of the "Idea of India" in the world's largest democracy.

AI.tldr: 本文剖析了印度自2014年莫迪政府上台后，如何通过政治符号、历史记忆重塑和法律工具等象征性治理策略，以印度教民族主义意识形态重构国家身份，并分析由此引发的世俗宪法承诺与多数主义愿景之间的张力。
AI.research_question: 当代印度如何通过象征性治理策略，以印度教民族主义（Hindutva）意识形态改造国家身份？这种策略对宪法世俗主义与多元主义造成了怎样的挑战？
AI.motivation: 理解印度作为世界最大民主国家，在民选政府主导下如何系统性地运用象征性手段推进多数主义民族建构，以及这种策略对社会凝聚力和民主多元主义的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 象征性治理（symbolic governance）、印度教民族主义（Hindutva）意识形态、世俗主义与多数主义、国家身份建构理论。
AI.method: 文献分析：综合最高法院判决、政策文件以及关于世俗主义和多数主义的学术文献，进行质性分析。
AI.findings: 1）印度政府通过政治图像（如阿约提亚罗摩神庙、印度教武士国王雕像）、历史记忆（教科书修订、城市改名如"国王大道"改为"责任之路"）和法律工具（废除第370条、公民身份法、牛保护法、寺庙收回）三大策略系统重塑国家象征核心；2）这些实践强化了印度教联盟和选举支持，但也引发少数群体、地区认同和公民社会的强烈争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 将象征性治理理论应用于印度教民族主义研究，揭示了符号政治、历史记忆和法律手段三者协同运作的机制，丰富了关于民主政体下多数主义身份建构的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示了印度宪法第25-28条所保障的世俗多元主义与当前政治实践之间的现实张力；2）为社会凝聚力和民主健康发展提供了警示；3）对理解全球范围内宗教民族主义与民主制度的关系具有比较政治学的启示。

title:
RUPERT 

A Distributed Rust Implementation of a Cellular Genetic Algorithm for Integer Constrained Portfolio Optimization

detail.title:
RUPERT 

A Distributed Rust Implementation of a Cellular Genetic Algorithm for Integer Constrained Portfolio Optimization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Independent researcher. No financial relationship to third party
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Integer constrained portfolio optimization is a NP-problem. There are numerous heuristic
methods to find good enough solutions for such problems [1]. One well known member are
Genetic Algorithms. In Cellular Genetic Algorithms (cGAs) the individuals can only interact
with their neighbors in the reproductive cycle where the variation operators are applied. A
comprehensive description of cGAs can be found in [2].
This paper describes the implementation of a distributed cGA for the components of the
S&P-500.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一种分布式细胞遗传算法（cGA）来解决S&P-500成分股的整数约束投资组合优化问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将分布式细胞遗传算法应用于S&P-500成分股的整数约束投资组合优化？
AI.motivation: 整数约束投资组合优化是NP难题，传统启发式方法存在局限性，需要更高效的算法来寻找优质解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 细胞遗传算法（cGA）——个体仅与邻居交互进行繁殖和变异操作。
AI.method: 实现分布式细胞遗传算法，应用于S&P-500成分股数据。
AI.findings: 论文描述了分布式cGA的具体实现方案，但摘要未提供具体的实验结果或性能对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 将细胞遗传算法扩展到分布式计算环境，拓展了cGA在金融优化领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模投资组合优化问题提供了一种分布式计算解决方案，可应用于S&P-500等大型股票池。

title:
Law Applicable to International AI Torts.

A Note on a Forthcoming Contribution
affiliations: University of Lisbon - Faculdade de Direito

detail.title:
Law Applicable to International AI Torts.

A Note on a Forthcoming Contribution
detail.abstract: This note summarizes the analysis, key insights and proposals advanced in the contribution "Law Applicable to International AI Torts: An Introduction", forthcoming in Memorial Publication in Honour of Prof. Dr. Dr. h.c. mult Erik Jayme, ed. by Martin Gebauer and Heinz-Peter Mansel, Verlag Gieseking, Bielefeld, to be published in May 2027. The choice of subject is a fitting tribute to a scholar who, throughout his distinguished academic life, devoted so much attention to Portuguese Conflict of Laws: the choice-of-law issues raised by AI torts are largely common to the Portuguese and German legal systems and are addressed mainly by EU instruments, complemented by convergent domestic sources.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际人工智能侵权案件中的法律适用问题，重点关注欧盟法律框架下葡萄牙与德国法律体系的共同挑战，作为对Erik Jayme教授在葡萄牙冲突法领域学术贡献的致敬。
AI.research_question: 国际人工智能侵权案件中应适用何种法律？
AI.motivation: 人工智能侵权的跨境特性带来传统冲突法规则难以适用的新挑战，而Erik Jayme教授对葡萄牙冲突法的长期关注使得以此为主题致敬其学术生涯具有特殊意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突法（Choice of Law）理论、欧盟法律框架、葡萄牙与德国国内法渊源。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（Normative legal analysis），比较法方法。
AI.findings: 国际人工智能侵权的法律适用问题在葡萄牙和德国法律体系中存在大量共通之处，这些问题主要通过欧盟法律文件加以解决，辅以趋同的国内法渊源。
AI.theory_contributions: 将冲突法理论延伸至新兴的AI侵权领域，填补了国际私法中AI侵权法律适用的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国AI侵权案件的法律选择提供了分析框架和解决方案参考，有助于司法实践中的法律适用统一。

title: Liquidity in Electricity Markets: How Generation Technology Shapes Price Impact
affiliations: Macquarie University, Macquarie University and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: Liquidity in Electricity Markets: How Generation Technology Shapes Price Impact
detail.abstract: We bring the market-microstructure framework of liquidity supply and demand to Australia’s National Electricity Market, where forecast errors in consumption and generation create short-run imbalances that flexible technologies must absorb. We estimate that a one-GW imbalance raises prices by $47.83/MWh, with larger effects near dispatch and during high-demand intervals. Consumer demand shocks have larger price impacts than renewable supply shocks. Our estimates show that liquidity roles differ by technology: wind and solar demand liquidity, while coal, gas, hydro, and batteries supply it. Coal adjusts most in absolute terms, hydro, gas, and batteries adjust most proportionally; hydro becomes the largest supplier above $300/MWh. Among flexible technologies, battery provision is associated with the highest price impact and hydro with the lowest. Our findings suggest that, as renewable penetration rises, the flexible generation mix, not capacity alone, shapes how costly imbalances are to absorb.

AI.tldr: 本文利用市场微观结构中的流动性供需框架，分析澳大利亚国家电力市场中由预测误差导致的短期失衡问题。研究发现，1 GW的失衡会导致电价上涨47.83美元/MWh，且不同技术类型的发电资产在流动性供需中扮演不同角色：风能和太阳能是流动性的需求方，而煤、气、水、电池是供给方。随着可再生能源渗透率提高，灵活发电的构成（而非仅容量）是影响失衡成本的关键。
AI.research_question: 在电力市场中，预测误差造成的短期失衡如何影响电价？不同发电技术在这种失衡中的流动性供需角色有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源占比提升，供需预测误差导致的不平衡成为电力市场的重要挑战。现有文献多关注电池等单一技术的灵活性，缺乏对不同技术间流动性供需角色的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构中的流动性供需理论（Liquidity supply and demand framework），将电力市场中短期失衡类比为金融市场的流动性问题。
AI.method: 基于澳大利亚国家电力市场的实证分析，估计预测误差导致的失衡对电价的影响，并比较不同技术类型的流动性供需弹性。
AI.findings: 1 GW失衡推高电价47.83美元/MWh；风、光为流动性需求方，煤、气、水、电池为供给方；消费者需求冲击比可再生能源供给冲击影响更大；水电在价格高于300美元/MWh时成为最大流动性供给方；电池供给的价格影响最大，水电最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融市场微观结构中的流动性供需概念引入电力市场分析，为理解不同技术类型在应对短期失衡中的差异化角色提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场政策制定者和投资者提供参考：高可再生能源渗透率下，灵活发电的构成比容量总量更能决定失衡成本，需关注不同技术的互补性。

title: The Term Structure of a Prediction Market

detail.title: The Term Structure of a Prediction Market
detail.abstract: Every event contract trades continuously and must converge to its realization at a known date. That boundary condition yields a conservation law. Lifetime price variation is pinned by opening odds. The fraction realized is the accuracy schedule. It measures when a market learns. It bounds the premium separating price from probability. It governs the manipulability of the close. Manipulability falls with the terminal information rate. The close is defended by paid attention. That attention is financed by internal transfers. Settlement distortion grows at most like the cube root of the stake under the benchmark technology. A committed monopolist corrector removes at most half of the frictionless displacement. Optimal design may withhold an integrity reserve.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个连续时间模型研究预测市场的价格动态。由于事件合约必须在已知日期收敛到真实结果，这一边界条件导致了价格变化的守恒定律。文章发现合约寿命内的价格变动由开盘赔率决定，并提出了"准确性进度表"来度量市场何时学习。该进度表约束了价格与概率之间的溢价，并决定了收盘的可操纵性——操纵性随终端信息率下降而下降。收盘价格由"付费注意力"来维护，这种注意力通过内部转移融资。在基准技术下，结算扭曲的增长最多是赌注的立方根。一个承诺的垄断纠正者最多能消除无摩擦位移的一半。最优设计可能需要保留一部分"诚信储备金"。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中的事件合约价格如何随时间演化？市场的学习速度（准确性进度表）如何影响价格的动态特征、可操纵性以及最优市场设计？
AI.motivation: 预测市场（如期货、赌博市场）中的合约价格理论上应反映事件发生的概率，但现实中价格与概率之间存在偏离（溢价），且市场可能被操纵。现有文献缺乏一个统一的连续时间框架来理解价格动态、学习速度、操纵成本以及最优市场设计之间的内在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间金融模型、守恒定律（由边界条件导出）、信息经济学、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 建立连续时间交易模型，利用合约到期必须收敛到0或1的边界条件推导守恒关系。通过准确性进度表（accuracy schedule）刻画信息到达速率，分析价格偏离概率的溢价边界。推导操纵者最优策略下的结算扭曲表达式，并研究垄断纠正者和诚信储备机制的最优设计。
AI.findings: (1) 寿命内价格变动由开盘赔率决定；(2) 准确性进度表度量市场学习速度，并约束价格-概率溢价；(3) 收盘可操纵性随终端信息率下降；(4) 收盘价格由内部转移融资的"付费注意力"捍卫；(5) 结算扭曲增长最多为赌注的立方根；(6) 垄断纠正者最多消除无摩擦位移的一半；(7) 最优设计可能需保留诚信储备金。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在连续时间框架下推导出预测市场的守恒定律，建立了准确性进度表（学习速度）与价格偏离、可操纵性之间的解析关系，为理解预测市场的价格形成机制提供了统一的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场的设计者提供了关于如何设置开盘赔率、如何评估市场学习效率、如何抵御操纵以及如设计诚信储备机制以维护市场完整性的具体指导。

title: State Capacity and Public Service Delivery: An Institutional Framework for Reliable Governance

detail.title: State Capacity and Public Service Delivery: An Institutional Framework for Reliable Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Governments frequently evaluate public policy through legislation enacted, public expenditure, programme expansion, or formal service provision. While these indicators measure governmental activity, they provide only limited evidence of whether public institutions consistently translate policy commitments into meaningful improvements in citizens' lives. This paper argues that implementation reliability-the consistent, continuous, predictable, equitable, responsive, and high-quality delivery of public services-provides a more appropriate basis for evaluating governmental performance because it represents the principal evaluative mechanism through which state capacity becomes observable in public service delivery.
Building upon scholarship in state capacity, public administration, and policy implementation, the paper develops the State Capacity Screening Framework (SCSF), a conceptual and diagnostic framework for assessing institutional readiness before major public programmes are introduced, expanded, or substantially reformed. Rather than treating implementation failure as the consequence of isolated administrative deficiencies, the framework conceptualizes reliable public service delivery as an emergent property of interacting institutional capacities, including political, administrative, fiscal, coordination, monitoring, enforcement, human capital, digital, local implementation, and adaptive capacities. Together, these complementary institutional capacities determine whether governments possess the institutional conditions necessary to sustain reliable implementation over time.
The paper operationalizes the SCSF through a structured institutional readiness assessment, illustrates its application across major public service sectors, and demonstrates its value as a practical diagnostic instrument for identifying implementation risks before policy rollout.
