title: Stackelberg Monopolists: Rational Myopia in Classic Oligopolies
affiliations: and Yale University

detail.title: Stackelberg Monopolists: Rational Myopia in Classic Oligopolies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford University Graduate School of Business Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Stanford Graduate School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that for a wide class of demand functions in the classic oligopoly games, a Stackelberg leader chooses the same action as an uncontested monopolist. By classic oligopoly games we mean both price competition in perfect complements with heterogeneous constant marginal costs and quantity (Cournot) competition in perfect substitutes with zero marginal costs. We characterize the class of all demand functions which make the best response of price setters or quantity setters affine in the aggregate action already taken by rivals. We show that with such affine-exponential demand, it is rational for every firm to act myopically, ignoring the future, no matter how many predecessors, simultaneous actors, or followers. Examples of affine-exponential demand include linear, log-linear, constant elasticity, and power demand curves, encompassing markets with either strategic complements or strategic substitutes.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在一大类需求函数下，寡头博弈中的Stackelberg领导者会选择与不受挑战的垄断者相同的行动。研究刻画了使价格或数量设定者的最佳反应函数呈仿射形式的需求函数类别，并证明在仿射指数需求下，无论有多少先行者、同时行动者或跟随者，每家企业都可以理性地短视行事，忽略未来影响。
AI.research_question: 在经典寡头博弈中，Stackelberg领导者的最优行动是否等价于垄断者最优行动？何种需求函数能保证这一性质？
AI.motivation: 传统寡头理论中，Stackelberg领导者通常需要考虑跟随者的反应，其最优决策不同于垄断者。本文试图发现一类需求函数，使得领导者的决策问题简化为垄断者问题，从而简化理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典寡头博弈理论、Stackelberg领导模型、垄断定价理论、仿射指数需求函数理论
AI.method: 数学推导与理论建模：特征化使最佳反应函数呈仿射形式的需求函数类别；证明在仿射指数需求下，Stackelberg领导者与垄断者行动等价；验证该需求函数包含线性、对数线性、常弹性、幂函数等常见形式。
AI.findings: （1）刻画了使价格或数量设定者的最佳反应函数呈仿射形式的需求函数类别（仿射指数需求）；（2）在此类需求下，Stackelberg领导者选择与垄断者相同的行动；（3）企业可以理性地短视行事，忽略竞争者的动态影响；（4）该需求函数族涵盖战略互补和战略替代市场。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）发现了Stackelberg领导者-垄断者等价性成立的条件，拓展了寡头理论；（2）特征化了一类重要的需求函数（仿射指数需求），为后续研究提供了分析工具；（3）揭示了短视行为在动态寡头博弈中的理性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业决策提供了简化框架：在仿射指数需求下，领导者可忽略跟随者反应，直接按垄断者方式定价或定产；（2）为反垄断监管和市场竞争分析提供了理论指导，帮助识别哪些市场条件下先行者优势被放大或缩小。

title: When Winning Streaks Mislead: Regime Dependence, Tail Deferral, and Survivorship Bias in Retail Fixed Coupon Notes

detail.title: When Winning Streaks Mislead: Regime Dependence, Tail Deferral, and Survivorship Bias in Retail Fixed Coupon Notes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: A member of the author's household holds occasional, small retail positions in fixed coupon notes, typically redeemed at the first autocall. These positions are immaterial, and the author has no financial interest in the issuance, distribution, or sale of structured products. The author declares no other competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants, patient data, or personal data. It uses only publicly available historical security prices and computational simulation. No investor beliefs, questionnaires, or choice data were collected.
declarations.funderStatement: None. This research received no funding from any agency, institution, or commercial entity.

detail.abstract: A retail Fixed Coupon Note (FCN) is, in economic substance, a short position in a worst-of down-and-in put sold by the investor. This paper asks what a long no-assignment streak reveals about future tail risk. We use streak illusion in a statistical, not psychometric, sense: regime-dependent tail deferral can generate a benign record that says little about resilience after a state change. We do not observe investor beliefs or estimate behavioural bias. Monte Carlo simulation, a fixed-calendar regime-switching model, and a 2000–2026 historical backtest yield three findings. First, in a strong-bull single-regime benchmark, eight placements avoid Scenario D about 78% of the time, and the expected run before D is about 32 completed placements; placement counts are not calendar time. In purged forward test blocks, a streak-only model has mean block AUCs of 0.489 for the next note and 0.467 for a one-year event, indicating no stable ranking ability. Second, positive modelled returns rely on regime-conditional equity and variance risk premia; the negative pricing wedge in the sequential decomposition is a stylised residual, not an issuer-fee estimate. Third, a 1,260-trading-day simulation beginning in a bull state has a -8.9% median total return and a -71.8% 5th percentile. Historical comparison uses nine surviving semiconductor stocks and 108,780 overlapping hypothetical contract-start/basket observations. Assignment clusters in 2000–02 and 2008, reaching 54.4%. Of fixed 504-day paths, 56.8% have no Scenario-D settlement despite completing 11.5 notes on average; fixed 1,260-day paths have a +23.9% median and a -68.3% 5th percentile. A start-year block bootstrap gives a 95% interval of [+0.5%, +39.7%] for the five-year median, but only partly addresses dependence among overlapping windows. Synthetic casualties are an assumption-driven sensitivity analysis, not a survivorship-bias correction. Cross-industry results show a broad, non-monotonic association between volatility and assignment. The evidence supports state-conditional risk disclosure; effects on investor understanding or choice require separate investor-level data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零售固息票据（FCN）中“无被指派事件”的持续记录能否预测未来尾部风险。通过蒙特卡洛模拟、制度转换模型和2000-2026年历史回测，发现无指派记录主要源于制度依赖的尾部递延，而非真实韧性，因此不具备稳定的预测能力。
AI.research_question: 零售FCN中，长期无被指派事件的记录能否揭示未来的尾部风险？
AI.motivation: FCN经济实质是投资者卖出最差表现标的的向下敲入看跌期权。投资者常因长期未发生指派事件而低估风险，本文旨在检验这种“无指派记录”是否具有预测尾部风险的统计价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: “延续错觉”（streak illusion）的统计含义：制度依赖的尾部递延（regime-dependent tail deferral）可能在状态转换后产生良性记录，但与真实韧性无关。采用统计而非心理测量学视角。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟、固定日历的制度转换模型、2000-2026年历史回测。使用纯化前向测试块、重叠假设性合约起始/篮子观测、起始年份区块自助法。
AI.findings: (1) 单制度基准下78%概率避免场景D，预期连续完成约32次；纯化测试中仅基于记录长度的模型无稳定排序能力（AUC约0.47-0.49）；(2) 正回报依赖制度条件性权益和方差风险溢价；(3) 模拟中位数总回报-8.9%，5分位数-71.8%；历史回测504天路径56.8%无场景D，但1260天路径中位数+23.9%、5分位数-68.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了“无指派记录”不能作为未来尾部风险的可靠代理指标，强调了状态条件性风险披露的重要性，区分了统计上的延续错觉与行为偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FCN投资者和发行方提供风险披露建议：应基于状态条件性风险而非无记录历史；监管层面应关注产品风险呈现方式；产品设计应考虑制度转换风险。

title: Digital Economy, Artificial Intelligence, and Foreign Direct Investment: Catalysts for Sustainable Development and Environmental Quality

detail.title: Digital Economy, Artificial Intelligence, and Foreign Direct Investment: Catalysts for Sustainable Development and Environmental Quality
detail.abstract: The convergence of digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI), and crossborder capital flows is reshaping the relationship between economic growth and environmental sustainability. While foreign direct investment (FDI) has long been regarded as a catalyst for industrial upgrading and technological diffusion, its environmental consequences remain contested. This article examines the tripartite interaction among the digital economy, AI adoption, and FDI inflows, and their combined influence on sustainable development trajectories and environmental quality. Drawing on panel data from 45 countries spanning 2010 to 2022, we employ a two-way fixed-effects model augmented by threshold regression techniques to capture nonlinear dynamics. Our findings reveal that the digital economy exerts a positive but diminishing effect on sustainable development, while AI adoption significantly enhances green innovation capacity among firms. FDI exhibits a dual character: it intensifies carbon emissions in developing economies with weak absorptive capacity, yet this pollution effect attenuates-and in some cases reverseswhen digital infrastructure and AI capabilities are sufficiently developed. The interaction between digital economy imports and FDI produces a statistically significant negative coefficient on industrial carbon emissions, suggesting that digitalization acts as a moderating buffer between capital inflows and environmental degradation. These results carry substantial policy implications for designing green investment frameworks, digital infrastructure strategies, and AI governance mechanisms that align economic openness with ecological stewardship.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2010-2022年45国面板数据，运用双向固定效应模型和门槛回归，发现数字经济对可持续发展的正向效应递减，AI提升绿色创新，FDI在吸收能力弱的发展中国家加剧碳排放，但数字基础设施和AI能力可缓冲这一污染效应。
AI.research_question: 数字经济、人工智能采纳与外商直接投资如何相互作用，并共同影响可持续发展路径与环境质量？
AI.motivation: FDI的环境后果长期存在争议，而数字转型与AI的快速发展为理解这一关系提供了新视角，需要考察三者交互对可持续发展的非线性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字经济发展理论、绿色创新理论、FDI环境效应理论、吸收能力理论
AI.method: 2010-2022年45国面板数据，双向固定效应模型，门槛回归技术
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济对可持续发展的正向效应呈递减趋势；2. AI采纳显著增强企业绿色创新能力；3. FDI在吸收能力弱的发展中国家加剧碳排放，但在数字基础设施和AI能力充分发展时污染效应减弱甚至逆转；4. 数字经济进口与FDI的交互项对工业碳排放有显著负系数，即数字化缓冲资本流入的环境退化效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字经济、AI与FDI三者交互对可持续发展的非线性影响机制，识别出数字化对FDI环境效应的调节（缓冲）作用，拓展了FDI环境效应理论与吸收能力理论的适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计绿色投资框架、数字基础设施战略和AI治理机制提供政策参考，指导如何协调经济开放与生态保护之间的关系。

title: Culture as Capital: Reimagining Power, Identity and Development in a Globalising World

detail.title: Culture as Capital: Reimagining Power, Identity and Development in a Globalising World
detail.abstract: In an era of globalisation and evolving conceptions of power, culture has become a strategic resource for shaping national identity, international influence, and sustainable development. Drawing on Joseph Nye's theory of soft power, Benedict Anderson's concept of imagined communities, and UNESCO's research on the cultural and creative industries, this paper argues that culture functions as a form of capital capable of generating economic value, strengthening social cohesion, promoting intercultural dialogue, and enhancing global competitiveness. The analysis examines four interconnected dimensions of culture: as soft power, as a tool for peace building, as a foundation for nation-building, and as a driver of the cultural and creative economy. Using South Korea and Nigeria as comparative case studies, alongside the author's experience as a National Youth Service Corps member in Nasarawa State, the paper demonstrates how cultural exchange, education, and creative industries contribute to inclusive development and international engagement. While recognizing the opportunities presented by globalization, the paper also highlights the risks of cultural homogenization and underscores the importance of preserving cultural diversity. It concludes that nations which strategically invest in culture and intercultural institutions are better positioned to achieve economic resilience, social cohesion, and global relevance. Consistent with Kim Koo's vision, the paper contends that a nation's greatest strength lies not in coercive power but in the richness of its culture and its capacity to inspire others.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨文化作为战略性资源，在全球化背景下如何塑造国家认同、增强国际影响力并推动可持续发展，通过韩国与尼日利亚的比较案例研究，论证文化软实力、和平建设、国家建构和创意经济四个维度的重要性。
AI.research_question: 文化如何在全球化时代作为一种战略性资源，从软实力、和平建设、国家建构和创意经济四个维度促进国家发展与国际影响力提升？
AI.motivation: 在全球化与权力观念演变的背景下，文化日益成为国家竞争的关键资源，但系统性分析文化如何在多维度上发挥作用的研究仍显不足，特别是通过发展中国家与发达国家的比较案例来检验理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约瑟夫·奈的软实力理论、本尼迪克特·安德森的"想象的共同体"概念、联合国教科文组织关于文化创意产业的研究，以及金九关于国家力量源于文化而非强制力的思想。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法：以韩国和尼日利亚为案例，结合作者在纳萨拉瓦州国家青年服务团（NYSC）的个人经验进行分析。
AI.findings: 文化作为资本能产生经济价值、增强社会凝聚力、促进跨文化对话并提升全球竞争力；战略性投资文化和跨文化机构的国家更能实现经济韧性、社会凝聚力和全球影响力；但需警惕文化同质化的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将软实力理论、想象的共同体与创意产业研究整合为统一分析框架，并通过韩国（发达国家）与尼日利亚（发展中国家）的比较验证了文化作为战略资源的多维度作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和发达国家提供文化战略投资的政策启示，强调文化多样性保护的重要性，以及文化教育、文化交流和创意产业在促进包容性发展中的具体实践路径。

title: The Third Wave of Finance
affiliations: Technology Institute,  and

detail.title: The Third Wave of Finance
detail.abstract: The financial system develops in waves. The first wave expanded access to financial products; the second improved convenience through frictionless banking, brokerage, and automated investment tools. Both remained productcentric. This paper argues that a third wave is emerging, enabled by data aggregation and agentic AI, in which financial services can be organized around people rather than products. The key opportunity lies in mobilising the financially inert Emerging Wealthy: HENRYs and EMILLIs who hold significant cash reserves but remain underinvested. Their inertia reflects negative net valence, where perceived complexity, risk, stress, and choice overload outweigh the expected benefits of action. We argue that independent, AI-native financial companions can reduce this inertia by combining consolidated personal financial data with conversational guidance, structural independence, and regulated execution partners. By helping users ask the right questions, reducing complexity, and providing trust-enhancing safeguards, such systems can shift net valence from negative to positive and enable informed financial action. The paper further argues that this architecture creates a defensible person-centric relationship layer rather than another product interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出金融体系正在经历第三次浪潮——从以产品为中心转向以人为中心。通过数据聚合和智能体AI驱动的金融陪伴系统，可以调动新兴富裕阶层（HENRYs和EMILLIs）的财务惰性，将负向净效价转为正向，构建不可替代的以人为中心的关系层。
AI.research_question: 金融系统第三次浪潮如何通过数据聚合与智能体AI，以人为中心地组织金融服务，从而调动新兴富裕阶层的金融惰性？
AI.motivation: 尽管前两次金融浪潮（扩大准入、提升便利）取得了进展，但大量新兴富裕群体（高收入但尚未富裕的HENRYs和EMILLIs）仍持有大量现金且投资不足，存在显著的金融惰性问题亟待解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 净效价（Net Valence）理论——感知的复杂性、风险、压力和选择过载超过预期收益，导致金融惰性；以人为中心的金融架构理论。
AI.method: 概念论证与理论推理，基于对金融系统演进阶段的分析以及新兴富裕群体行为模式的理论建模。
AI.findings: 独立、AI原生的金融陪伴系统通过整合个人金融数据、对话式引导、结构独立性和受监管的执行伙伴，能够将用户的净效价从负转正，从而促成明智的金融行动；这一架构创造了可防御的、以人为中心的关系层，而非又一个产品界面。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融系统第三次浪潮的概念框架，扩展了净效价理论在金融惰性研究中的应用，界定了以人为中心的金融关系层与产品界面的本质区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技企业和传统金融机构提供了AI驱动的金融陪伴系统的设计原则与架构思路，指导如何服务新兴富裕群体并建立长期客户关系壁垒。

title: Digital Financial Exclusion in the EU: Socio-Economic Determinants and Inclusion Effects
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, Slovakia and Matej Bel University - Economics

detail.title: Digital Financial Exclusion in the EU: Socio-Economic Determinants and Inclusion Effects
detail.abstract:
Research purpose: This paper examines the potential of digital financial services to increase financial inclusion. It analyses socioeconomic factors associated with the adoption of basic and advanced digital options. By distinguishing between levels of digital engagement, the study clarifies whether digitalisation is associated with broader access to finance or serves as an additional benefit for already advantaged groups. 

Design / Methodology / Approach: Using micro-level data from the Flash Eurobarometer 509 for EU countries, the study employs logistic and probit regression models. These methods are used to examine potential socioeconomic factors of digital financial service adoption and to evaluate whether their use is associated with financial inclusion or exclusion. The empirical approach allows us to compare basic services, such as mobile banking and digital payments, with more advanced tools, including digital investments. In addition, robustness checks and alternative model specifications are employed to compare the results across different measures of financial inclusion. 

Findings: The results show that digital financial services vary widely by socioeconomic group. Older people, those with lower levels of education, and the economically inactive are more likely to experience digital financial exclusion. These patterns suggest that digital finance is shaped by existing socioeconomic structures, rather than being universally accessible. While basic digital services are linked to significantly lower exclusion, advanced options are mostly used by already advantaged groups. This means digital finance may help with basic financial inclusion but may further reinforce disparities at higher levels. 

Originality / Value / Practical implications: By linking digital financial service adoption to financial inclusion outcomes, the study provides new empirical evidence on the limits of digitalisation as an inclusion strategy. Unlike much of the existing literature, it jointly examines both the factors associated with its adoption and the consequences for financial inclusion. The results suggest that policies should focus not only on expanding digital financial technologies but also on reducing socioeconomic barriers that shape their use. Attention needs to be paid to digital skills, financial literacy, and access to digital infrastructure. Such targeted approaches are likely to be more effective in ensuring that digital finance contributes to inclusive economic participation rather than reproducing existing inequalities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用欧盟Flash Eurobarometer 509微观数据，通过逻辑回归和概率回归模型，分析了数字金融服务采用的社会经济因素及其对金融包容性的影响。结果发现，老年人、低教育水平和经济不活跃群体更容易遭受数字金融排斥；基础数字服务有助于降低排斥，但高级数字服务主要被优势群体使用，可能加剧不平等。
AI.research_question: 数字金融服务能否促进金融包容性？数字化的普及是带来更广泛的金融准入，还是仅为已有优势群体提供额外便利？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多单独考察数字金融的采用因素或金融包容性后果，但鲜有研究将二者联合分析，且缺乏对基础与高级数字服务不同层次使用差异的深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字金融包容性理论、社会分层与数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 采用Flash Eurobarometer 509欧盟国家微观数据，运用逻辑回归（logistic）和概率回归（probit）模型，并进行稳健性检验和替代模型规格比较。
AI.findings: （1）老年人、低教育水平和经济不活跃群体更易遭受数字金融排斥；（2）基础数字服务（如手机银行、数字支付）显著降低金融排斥；（3）高级数字服务（如数字投资）主要被已有优势群体使用；（4）数字金融受现有社会经济结构塑造，并非普遍可及，可能在基础层面促进包容，但在高级层面加剧不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数字金融作为包容性战略存在局限性的新实证证据；区分了基础与高级数字服务的不均衡影响，揭示了数字化可能"双刃剑"效应的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定不仅应关注扩大数字金融技术，还需同时减少社会经济障碍，注重数字技能、金融素养和数字基础设施的建设，以确保数字金融促进包容性经济参与而非复制既有不平等。

title: An Attempt to Integrate the Lacanian Formalism into Generative Relational Being

detail.title: An Attempt to Integrate the Lacanian Formalism into Generative Relational Being
detail.abstract: Theories of value generation and of distributive justice presuppose that participants can recognize a relation as reciprocal and can identify extraction as extraction. These are interpretive capacities, and they are assumed throughout and explained nowhere. Inferentialist accounts of normative practice describe the keeping of deontic score and leave the participants' investment in the score unaccounted. No available framework in governance or economics explains why participants sustain the very relations that damage them. Psychoanalysis supplies such an account, and this paper asks what may be taken from it and at what price. The apparatus is separated into three levels-the phenomena it addresses, the concepts it deploys, and the calculus of primitives in which those concepts are written-and each is examined for derivation, translation, or refusal. The results are asymmetric. Three central mathemes are derived: the Other is what composition produces, the barred subject is an occupancy with nonzero residue, and the signifier of the barred Other is the non-coincidence of a position with its own claim. They are shown to stand in one process that the source lacks, in which the master signifier conceals the barring of the Other. Two primitives are dissolved: the object-cause of desire is the residue of an operation, hypostatized by a theory with nowhere to put it, and the lozenge proves undefinable for relating a subject to that reification. One posit is refused with argument: the Real reintroduces an exterior, and its phenomena admit a better account as structural exclusion. One consequence reaches beyond the source. The attempt to make occupancy exact operates at the level of the order, where it is domination, and at the level of the participant, where it is exploitation. This yields a derivation of a condition that theories of generative justice have identified and left underived: a configuration providing no locus at which a participant's excess can register consumes the capacity by which it would go on generating. The unifying operation is identified and left undefined. Every occurrence of the bar in the source calculus marks one thing: composition fails to close. Its formal identity is stated as the central open problem, with four constraints on any candidate.

AI.tldr: 本文借助精神分析（尤其是拉康学派）的框架，批判性地审视了价值生成理论、分配正义理论和规范实践理论中一个共同的根本缺陷：这些理论都预设参与者具备识别互惠关系和提取行为的解释能力，但从未解释这种能力从何而来。作者将精神分析 apparatus 分为三个层次（现象、概念、原始运算），逐一评估其能否被移植到社会科学中。结果是不对称的：推导出了三个核心数学素（大他者、 barred 主体、 barred 大他者的能指），消解了两个原始概念（欲望的对象-原因、菱形符号），拒绝了一个设定（实在界），并推导出了一个超越精神分析来源的结论——一种使参与者剩余无法被登记的结构性配置，会消耗其持续生成的能力，这正是生成正义理论所识别但未推导出的条件。论文最后指出，整个分析中的统一操作——即“bar”的每次出现都标志着“构成无法闭合”——是核心开放问题。
AI.research_question: 精神分析（尤其是拉康学派的概念装置）能否以及如何被移入社会科学框架，以解释现有理论（价值生成理论、分配正义理论、规范实践理论）未能回答的根本问题：为什么参与者会维持那些实际上损害自身的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学和治理理论无法解释参与者为何持续维系损害自身的关系。精神分析似乎提供了这种解释，但将其概念工具移植到社会科学需要严格审视其可行性与代价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉康精神分析的概念装置（被分为三个层次：现象、概念、原始运算），与价值生成理论、分配正义理论、规范性实践的推理主义理论进行对话。
AI.method: 概念分析与跨理论推导。将拉康的 apparatus 分解为三个层次（现象、概念、原始运算的演算），对每一层次分别评估其能否被推导、翻译或拒绝进入社会科学框架。
AI.findings: 不对称的结果：（1）推导出三个核心数学素：大他者是构成（composition）的产物， barred 主体是带有非零剩余占据（occupancy）， barred 大他者的能指是位置与其声称的不重合；（2）消解了两个原始概念：欲望的对象-原因是操作的剩余被理论物化为独立实体，菱形符号无法定义；（3）拒绝了实在界设定，认为其现象可被更好地解释为结构性排斥；（4）推导出生成正义理论未能推导的条件：一种使参与者剩余无法被登记的结构消耗了持续生成的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将精神分析概念严格分解为可检验的层次，展示了哪些概念可以被推导性地移入社会科学、哪些必须被消解或拒绝；2) 推导出了“生成正义”理论家们已识别但未推导的关键条件，即剥削/支配的结构性条件如何消耗生成能力；3) 识别出“bar”（构成无法闭合）作为统一操作，并将其正式同一性确立为开放问题，给出四条约束条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为批判经济学和治理理论提供了精神分析基础，解释了参与者为什么在损害自身的关系中持续投入；2) 揭示了剥削与支配在秩序层面和参与者层面的双重运作机制；3) 指出了当制度结构无法容纳参与者的“剩余”（excess）时，系统本身会丧失持续生成的能力，这对组织设计和治理改革具有警示意义。

title: Tax Competitiveness and Business R&D Expenditures: Do Taxes Matter for Innovation?
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, Slovakia and Faculty of Economics, Matej Bel University in Banska Bystrica, Slovakia

detail.title: Tax Competitiveness and Business R&D Expenditures: Do Taxes Matter for Innovation?
detail.abstract:
Purpose – tax policies can be seen as one of the factors potentially affecting firms’ investment decisions and innovation. The paper examines the relationship between tax competitiveness and business Research and Development (R&D) expenditures across EU countries. Specifically, it analyses the tax rules governing corporate taxation in EU countries. 

Research methodology – based on a combination of data from several databases (International Tax Competitiveness Index, OECD, and Eurostat) – we comprehensively examined the relationship. Using cluster analysis and PCA on cross-sectional data, we identified countries with similar tax competitiveness in relation to business R&D expenditures. Subsequently, we identified the effects of tax policy instruments and tax competitiveness on business R&D by using panel regression models (fixed effects and general method of moments).

Findings – our results suggest that countries that are very similar in terms of tax competitiveness and the structure of individual tax elements (especially the Baltic countries) also achieve relatively low levels of R&D spending. While we get mixed results on R&D tax credits as a standalone R&D factor, tax competitiveness in general is significantly associated with business R&D expenditures in EU countries. The results also indicate the importance of tax instruments, which are hitherto less examined within the context of business innovation, such as tax depreciation rules.

Research limitations – the size and geographical focus of the sample used in the analysis may limit general applicability and comparability with some previous studies based on datasets from different countries.

Practical implications – the results are discussed within the current context of policies sup- porting innovation, and several policy recommendations have been highlighted. They help to guide more effective tax policies to boost business R&D and innovation.

Originality/Value – there are only a few up-to-date empirical studies examining the effects of tax competitiveness on business R&D. Unlike prior studies, this paper analyses the relationship using a combination of quantitative techniques and classifies countries into clusters based on their tax competitiveness. The findings highlight the impact of overlooked aspects, such as tax depreciation rules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟国家税收竞争力与企业研发支出之间的关系，发现税收竞争力与企业研发投入显著相关，波罗的海国家税收竞争力相似但研发支出较低，同时揭示了税收折旧规则等此前被忽视的税收工具的重要性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟国家的税收竞争力与企业研发支出之间存在怎样的关系？具体税收政策工具如何影响企业研发投入？
AI.motivation: 税收政策是影响企业投资决策和创新的关键因素之一，而现有关于税收竞争力对企业研发影响的实证研究较为缺乏，尤其缺乏综合运用多种定量方法的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收竞争力理论；企业创新投资决策理论；税收政策工具（如税收抵免、折旧规则等）对企业行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 结合国际税收竞争力指数、OECD和Eurostat等多个数据库的数据；采用聚类分析和主成分分析（PCA）对横截面数据进行国家分类；使用固定效应和广义矩估计（GMM）面板回归模型进行因果关系检验。
AI.findings: （1）税收竞争力相似的国家（尤其是波罗的海国家）研发支出水平较低；（2）税收抵免作为独立因素的效应呈混合结果；（3）税收竞争力整体与企业研发支出显著相关；（4）税收折旧规则等此前被较少研究的税收工具对企业创新具有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了税收竞争力与企业创新关系的实证研究；创新性地综合运用聚类分析、PCA和面板回归多种定量方法；揭示了税收折旧规则等被忽视的税收工具的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟国家制定更有效的税收政策以促进企业研发和创新提供了政策建议；帮助政策制定者识别不同税收工具的相对重要性。

title: Integration Without Leadership: Cross-Venue Price Discovery in UFC Prediction Markets

detail.title: Integration Without Leadership: Cross-Venue Price Discovery in UFC Prediction Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: None applies.
declarations.funderStatement: Myself.

detail.abstract: Modern prediction markets are a fast-growing market structure, and sports contracts now account for around 90% of activity on Kalshi, one of the largest venues. The research attention is allocated in nearly the opposite proportion, as the previous literature concentrated on political markets, above all a single event, the 2024 United States presidential election. The sports contracts that dominate actual trading remain almost unexamined. This paper tests whether conclusions drawn from that election generalise to the markets where the volume actually is: sports contracts, trading at comparatively smaller per-market volume and liquidity. Data were collected through custom-built scrapers and a publicly distributed archive covering Kalshi and Polymarket trade histories: 281 UFC fights matched across venues over fourteen months. Contrary to the election evidence, where Polymarket led Kalshi, no venue leads price discovery in the sports setting: venue returns co-move within the same bar (+0.103 at five minutes, +0.203 at thirty minutes), while no lead-lag correlation is distinguishable from zero at any horizon. Large jumps propagate symmetrically in both directions, the single directional asymmetry fades exactly where Kalshi's one-cent grid predicts. Inter-venue gaps close within about half an hour on liquid fights, and a pre-registered test finds that aggressive order flow predicts reversal, not continuation, with a magnitude well inside fees. The findings suggest that venue leadership is not an inherent feature of fragmented prediction markets but a product of a specific configuration of salience, segmented clienteles and concentrated informed flow.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在体育预测市场（UFC格斗）中，不存在政治市场中Polymarket领先Kalshi的"场馆领导力"现象，两个平台的定价几乎同步，价差在流动性好的合约中约半小时内消除。场馆领导力不是碎片化预测市场的固有特征，而是特定事件显著性、客户群分割和知情交易流集中的产物。
AI.research_question: 从2024年美国总统选举中得出的"Polymarket领先Kalshi"的结论，能否推广到实际交易量更大的体育预测市场（如UFC合约）？体育预测市场中是否存在场馆间的价格发现领导力？
AI.motivation: 现有预测市场文献几乎全部聚焦于政治市场（尤其是单次事件），而体育合约占据了Kalshi约90%的实际交易量，却几乎未被研究。这种研究注意力与市场活动的严重错配，亟待检验既有结论的外部有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格发现理论、跨市场信息传导、微观结构理论（订单流与价格反转）、碎片化市场中的领导力假说
AI.method: 自建爬虫与公开数据库收集Kalshi和Polymarket上281场UFC格斗的逐笔交易数据（跨度14个月）；运用向量自回归（VAR）分析收益率同期与领先-滞后相关性；事件研究法分析大幅跳动的对称性传播；预注册检验激进的订单流是否预测反转而非延续。
AI.findings: 体育市场中无场馆领导力：两平台收益率在5分钟间隔同期相关+0.103，30分钟时+0.203，而任何时滞下的领先-滞后相关均不显著；大幅跳动的传播是对称的；流动性好的合约价差约半小时内收敛；激进订单流预测价格反转（幅度在手续费以内）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统检验碎片化预测市场中的跨场馆价格发现机制，证明场馆领导力并非市场碎片化的必然结果，而是受事件显著性、客户群分割和知情交易流集中度等情境因素调节。挑战了既有研究中"一个场馆主导"的隐含假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 对交易者和平台设计者的启示：在体育等流动性分散的市场中，套利机会有限且快速消失；碎片化市场的价格质量与特定资产特征高度相关，不能简单将政治市场的结论迁移到其他合约类型。

title: Greenwashing in Earnings Conference Calls
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and NUS Business School

detail.title: Greenwashing in Earnings Conference Calls

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n.a.

detail.abstract: We examine the presence, use, and consequences of corporate greenwashing in earnings conference calls for a large sample of U.S. firms from 2008 to 2022. We develop a measure of greenwashing as the absolute difference between the actual and a model-based expected level of climate change discussions by management. To validate our proxy, we show that the abnormal (greenwashing) component does not convey material information about concurrent and future environmental performance, while the predicted component does. Greenwashing is widespread, has increased over time, and responds to reporting incentives such as high-profile environmental scandals and disasters. When it comes to potential benefits, we find that capital markets do not price greenwashing, consistent with investors not being fooled by this overly optimistic communication. However, we do find near-term reputational benefits of greenwashing in the form of a more positive sentiment towards the firm as expressed in environmental ratings, news articles, blog entries, and social media posts. Our results suggest that corporate greenwashing may be less aimed at capital markets but rather at other important stakeholders beyond investors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国上市公司在财报电话会议中的"漂绿"行为（即过度美化企业环保表现的沟通），发现这类行为普遍存在且随时间增加，资本市场并未被其欺骗，但企业的声誉（如环境评级、媒体报道和社交媒体情绪）在短期内确实受益。
AI.research_question: 企业如何在财报电话会议中进行"漂绿"沟通？这种行为的动因是什么？它是否能为企业带来资本市场或声誉上的收益？
AI.motivation: 尽管"漂绿"现象在商业实践中愈发普遍，但学术界对其在有形沟通渠道（如财报电话会议）中的具体表现、量化衡量及其经济后果仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、印象管理理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 基于2008-2022年美国上市公司大样本数据，构建"漂绿"指标（实际气候变化讨论水平与模型预测水平的绝对差异），通过回归分析验证指标有效性，并检验其与资本市场反应、声誉指标的关系。
AI.findings: （1）漂绿现象普遍且随时间增加；（2）漂绿行为与高曝光的环境丑闻和灾难等报告动机相关；（3）资本市场并未对漂绿行为定价（投资者未被欺骗）；（4）漂绿带来了短期声誉收益：环境评级、新闻文章、博客和社交媒体帖子的情绪更积极。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了"漂绿"研究的量化方法，系统区分了漂绿沟通的信息性与非信息性成分，揭示了企业绿色沟通策略在不同利益相关者群体中的差异化效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示投资者、监管机构和环保组织关注非资本市场利益相关者（如公众、媒体、评级机构）可能被漂绿所影响，为制定更有效的绿色信息披露监管政策提供实证依据。

title: Partisan Alignment in Supply Chains
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Finance and University of Groningen

detail.title: Partisan Alignment in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: We document a novel trade-off from political polarization in supply chains: firms gain supply chain stability by choosing co-partisan suppliers but pay a price in higher markups and foregone innovation. Following exogenous regulatory and weather shocks, both Republican and Democratic customers are over twice as likely to choose sameparty suppliers, aligned relationships are 15% less likely to dissolve, and firms with more aligned suppliers experience 61% smaller stock price declines following weather shocks. However, aligned suppliers charge 14% higher markups, and customers patent less and launch fewer new products. Partisan alignment acts as a costly hedge against supply chain risk.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，供应链中的政治党派一致性会带来一种权衡：企业通过选择同党供应商获得供应链稳定性，但需付出更高加价和放弃创新的代价。
AI.research_question: 政治极化如何影响供应链中的供应商选择、关系稳定性及企业绩效？
AI.motivation: 揭示党派一致性在供应链中作为"昂贵对冲工具"的权衡机制，解释企业为何愿意为政治匹配支付更高成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治极化理论、供应链风险管理理论、交易成本经济学
AI.method: 基于外生监管冲击和天气冲击的准自然实验，结合企业供应商-客户关系数据与政治捐赠数据进行分析。
AI.findings: (1) 共和党和民主党客户选择同党供应商的概率是异党供应商的两倍以上；(2) 党派一致的关系破裂概率低15%；(3) 拥有更多一致供应商的企业在天气冲击后股价下跌幅度小61%；(4) 但一致供应商加价率高14%，且客户专利产出和新产品推出减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示党派一致性在供应链中既是"稳定性保险"又是"创新成本"的双刃剑效应，丰富了政治经济学与运营管理交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒企业管理层在供应链风险管理中需审慎权衡政治匹配带来的稳定性收益与更高的采购成本及创新抑制效应。

title: CBAM: The Carbon Price That Is Already Hitting Your Supply Chain

detail.title: CBAM: The Carbon Price That Is Already Hitting Your Supply Chain
detail.abstract:
CONTEXT

The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism entered its final financial phase on 1 January 2026. Industry
consensus reads the phase as an import carbon tax to be managed by procuring reporting software, yet that
reading misstates what the phase requires of importers in 2026.

FINDINGS

Four themes that dominate vendor marketing are not supported by closer reading of regulatory texts. There
is no CBAM certificate market in 2026; sales open on 1 February 2027. The carbon-price-paid deduction
sits in Article 9, and Article 31 is the separate free-allocation adjustment. Hydrogen and electricity have
no de minimis relief. Emissions-verification tooling is not high-risk AI under the AI Act as drafted. The
determination of 2027 costs is the spread between verified emissions data and marked-up default values, with
access to verified data rationed by operational verifier capacity. This remains the binding constraint into 2026.

IMPLICATIONS

For 2026, compliance hinges on two priorities: accurate exposure modelling and early alignment with verifiers
before the first surrender on 30 September, 2027. Platform procurement is secondary. This framework changes
automatically and loads its heaviest requirements at the back end. To survive it, companies need a dynamic
exposure model that updates in real time, not a static document.

CONFIDENCE

CONFIRMED on the legal architecture, the statutory dates and the published Q1 reference price.
REPORTED on cost magnitudes and trade-f low estimates, all carried as scenario f igures.
INFERRED on the deeper structural reads, which are f lagged as they arise.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）2026年最终财务阶段的真实合规要求，驳斥了业界普遍存在的四个误解（如2026年存在CBAM证书市场、碳价扣除条款、氢电的微量豁免、排放验证工具属于高风险AI），指出2026年合规的核心在于准确的暴露建模和提前与验证机构协调，而非采购报告软件。
AI.research_question: 欧盟CBAM 2026年财务阶段的真实合规要求是什么？业界对CBAM的普遍认知存在哪些误解？
AI.motivation: 业界普遍将CBAM 2026年阶段误读为一种"进口碳税"，并认为只需采购报告软件即可应对，但这种解读偏离了监管文本的实际要求，可能导致企业合规准备不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: CBAM法规文本（第9条碳价扣除、第31条免费配额调整）、欧盟AI法案。
AI.method: 对CBAM监管文本进行细读，结合供应商营销主张进行对比分析，识别四个被普遍误解的合规要点。
AI.findings: （1）2026年不存在CBAM证书市场，证书销售2027年2月1日才开放；（2）碳价扣除在第9条，第31条是单独的免费配额调整；（3）氢和电力不享受微量豁免；（4）排放验证工具根据AI法案草案不属于高风险AI。2027年成本取决于验证排放数据与加价默认值的差异，而验证数据获取受限于验证机构的运营能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了CBAM监管文本的关键条款适用关系，纠正了学术界和实务界对CBAM证书市场启动时间、碳价扣除与免费配额调整的分离性等法律架构的常见误解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业2026年合规提供了明确优先级：首先进行准确的暴露建模，其次在2027年9月30日首次清缴前尽早与验证机构协调，而采购软件平台是次要任务；建议企业构建动态实时更新的暴露模型而非静态文档。

title: Who Initiates Takeovers?
affiliations: Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth, BI Norwegian Business School - Department of Financial Economics and

detail.title: Who Initiates Takeovers?
detail.abstract: Who initiates a takeover process determines whether observed firm-and chief executive officer (CEO) characteristics reflect participation in a transaction or the endogenous decision to start one. We hand-classify initiation for 4,636 U.S. takeover bids over 1996-2016, the largest such sample to date, and compare targets and public acquirers with characteristics of matched non-merging firms. Targets initiate as much as 55% of classified deal processes, either alone (43%) or jointly (12%). Conditioning on initiation changes the interpretation of prominent CEO-age effects reported in the literature: Retirement-age target CEOs are no more likely to initiate a sale; instead, bidders disproportionately approach firms led by CEOs nearing retirement. Moreover, young acquirer CEOs are overrepresented in both bidder-and targetinitiated deals, indicating that CEO youth predicts acquisition participation rather than active deal initiation. Target initiation is positively associated with vested CEO equity but strongly negatively associated with unvested equity, as if incentivizing the CEO to continue the firm as a stand-alone company. These and other findings show that standard takeover correlations conflate selection into deals with the choice to initiate them.

AI.tldr: 本文手动分类了1996-2016年间4,636起美国并购要约的发起方，发现目标公司发起了高达55%的交易流程。研究发现，控制发起方身份后，文献中著名的CEO年龄效应需要重新解释：退休年龄的CEO并不更可能主动发起出售，而是竞标者更倾向于接近由临近退休CEO领导的公司。此外，年轻CEO在竞标者和目标公司发起的交易中都占比过高，表明CEO年轻化预测的是并购参与而非主动发起。目标公司发起与已归属CEO股权正相关，与未归属股权强烈负相关。这些发现表明，标准的并购相关性分析混淆了参与交易的选择与发起交易的选择。
AI.research_question: 并购交易中，谁来发起交易流程？控制发起方身份后，CEO年龄、薪酬等特征对并购结果的影响是否会被重新解释？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现目标公司CEO临近退休时更可能被并购、年轻CEO更可能发起收购等结论，但这些研究未区分"参与交易"和"主动发起交易"是两回事。本文试图通过手动分类发起方来解决这一内生性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 并购发起方的内生选择理论；CEO职业生涯激励理论；股权激励与并购决策的关系
AI.method: 手工分类1996-2016年美国4,636起并购要约的发起方（目标公司主动发起、竞标者主动发起、联合发起）；将目标公司和公开竞标者与匹配的非并购公司进行特征比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）目标公司发起55%的交易流程（43%单独发起，12%联合发起）；（2）退休年龄CEO并不更可能主动发起出售，而是竞标者更倾向于选择临近退休CEO的公司作为目标；（3）年轻CEO在竞标者和目标公司发起的交易中都占比过高，说明年轻CEO预测的是并购参与而非主动发起；（4）目标公司发起与已归属CEO股权正相关，与未归属股权强烈负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了并购文献中将"参与交易"与"发起交易"混为一谈的问题，纠正了关于CEO年龄效应的既有结论，为CEO职业生涯激励与并购决策的关系提供了更精确的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会和监管机构理解并购交易的真实动因提供参考；为CEO薪酬设计（特别是股权归属安排）如何影响并购决策提供实证依据。

title: From Carbon Assets to Carbon Markets: A Strategic Review of the Kashmir Division, Jammu and Kashmir, India
affiliations: University of Jammu

detail.title: From Carbon Assets to Carbon Markets: A Strategic Review of the Kashmir Division, Jammu and Kashmir, India
detail.abstract: The voluntary carbon market is undergoing a critical phase of quality consolidation under the Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market's (ICVCM) Core Carbon Principles, while India has simultaneously initiated its domestic Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) through the Energy Conservation Amendment Act 2022. This paper examines the horticultural economy of the Kashmir Division across all nine districts and four agro-climatic zones to identify extant carbon assets and determine which global carbon standards are practically viable given the region's topographical constraints and an average landholding of 0.59 hectares. Employing a narrative review approach that synthesises secondary data from the J&K Horticulture Department, NITI Aayog, IISc, and peer-reviewed literature, the analysis identifies three principal carbon asset classes: High-Density Plantation (HDP) transitions in apple orchards, Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in paddy fields, and biochar production from annual pruning waste. The central finding is that no single carbon standard fits Kashmir across all asset classes. Verra VM0042 is appropriate for paddy AWD owing to methane quantification requirements; Plan Vivo suits horticultural carbon through simplified biomass tables amenable to smallholder aggregation via Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs); and Puro.earth is the sole viable option for biochar removal credits requiring premium pricing to justify pyrolysis infrastructure investment. The paper further identifies critical policy gaps in aggregation capacity, Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) infrastructure, biochar logistics, and regulatory alignment, and proposes specific recommendations to address each.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨克什米尔地区 horticultural 经济在自愿碳市场和印度国内碳信用交易体系下的碳资产识别与碳标准适用性，发现没有单一碳标准适用于所有资产类别，并提出了针对不同碳资产的最佳标准选择及政策建议。
AI.research_question: 在克什米尔地区的地形约束和小农经济（平均土地持有0.59公顷）背景下，哪些全球碳标准实际可行？如何匹配不同的碳资产类别？
AI.motivation: 自愿碳市场正经历ICVCM的质量整合，同时印度启动了国内碳信用交易体系（CCTS），但克什米尔地区的小农经济与地形限制使碳标准的选择面临特殊挑战，现有研究缺乏针对该地区的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳市场治理理论、碳信用标准分类体系、小农经济下的碳资产聚合理论、MRV基础设施理论。
AI.method: 叙事综述法（narrative review），综合来自J&K园艺部、NITI Aayog、IISc和同行评议文献的二手数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 识别出三大碳资产类别：1）苹果园高密度种植（HDP）转型；2）稻田间歇干湿交替（AWD）；3）修剪废弃物生物炭生产。核心发现：无单一碳标准适用所有类别——Verra VM0042适用于稻田AWD（甲烷量化需求）；Plan Vivo适合园艺碳（简化生物质表，适合通过FPOs聚合小农户）；Puro.earth是生物炭去除信用额度的唯一可行选项（需溢价定价以支撑热解基础设施投资）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了针对小农经济与地形约束地区的碳标准匹配框架；2）揭示了碳标准适用性与土地持有规模、碳资产类型之间的互动关系；3）丰富了碳市场地理异质性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为克什米尔地区碳信用开发提供了具体的标准选择指南；2）指出了聚合能力、MRV基础设施、生物炭物流和监管协调四方面的政策缺口；3）提出了针对性的政策建议以推动该地区碳市场发展。

title: Historical Analysis of Russia's External Positioning Opportunities Amid International Transformation

detail.title: Historical Analysis of Russia's External Positioning Opportunities Amid International Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, human data, human tissue, or animals. The research is based exclusively on the analysis of publicly available documents and open-source materials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The article examines the impact of the transformation of the international environment on the possibilities of Russia’s external positioning in 1991–2025. The author identifies key stages in the evolution of Russia’s international image: the post-Soviet search for foreign policy positioning, the development of humanitarian and image-building instruments, and the growing influence of sanctions pressure and information-psychological impact. The article argues that, under current conditions, nation branding can serve as a tool for the semantic systematization and strengthening of Russia’s sustainable international image.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1991-2025年国际环境转变对俄罗斯外部定位可能性的影响，识别了俄罗斯国际形象演化的关键阶段：后苏联时期外交政策定位探索、人道主义与形象塑造工具发展、制裁压力与信息心理影响加剧，并论证了国家品牌建设可作为语义系统化工具来强化俄罗斯可持续的国际形象。
AI.research_question: 国际环境转变如何影响1991-2025年俄罗斯的外部定位可能性？
AI.motivation: 理解在制裁压力和信息心理战加剧的背景下，俄罗斯如何通过国家品牌建设维持和强化其国际形象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家品牌理论、国际形象演化理论、信息心理影响理论
AI.method: 历史阶段分析法、定性案例分析
AI.findings: 俄罗斯国际形象经历了后苏联定位探索、人道主义与形象工具发展、制裁与信息心理影响加剧三个关键阶段；在当前条件下，国家品牌建设可作为语义系统化工具强化俄罗斯的可持续国际形象。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国家品牌建设理论应用于俄罗斯国际形象研究，提出国家品牌可作为语义系统化工具的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯及其他面临国际制裁和信息压力的国家提供了通过国家品牌建设维护国际形象的政策参考。

title: The Emergence of Norms in Generative Relational Being: A Preliminary Discussion

detail.title: The Emergence of Norms in Generative Relational Being: A Preliminary Discussion
detail.abstract: A norm differs from a regularity in that people hold one another to it. Where this holding comes from, and whether it can be justified, are treated by two separate literatures: one models the emergence of norms and is silent on justification, the other argues justification and treats emergence as irrelevant. The naturalist takes the division to favour him, arguing that a complete account of emergence renders justification a residue. Normative philosophy answers by invoking the is-ought gap, and thereby concedes the point it means to deny. This paper argues the reverse. A sanction cannot be distinguished from an aggression by any description of the sanctioner's behaviour, the difference being a fact about the configuration in which the act stands. Normative vocabulary therefore appears in the explanans of any emergence mechanism, and a correct account of emergence requires normative philosophy in place of eliminating it. The paper develops a positional account of normative emergence within the Generative Relational Being framework. Composition of relations generates loci occupied by no participant, and bindingness is borne at such a locus and by no relatum. The dyad is accordingly pre-normative. Power is asymmetry, of which interpretive asymmetry is the kind whose monopolization forecloses correction of the others. Generativity is the condition under which valuing occurs and is not itself a value, so the demand to justify it is malformed, and five conditions of normative generation are stated as conditions and not as evaluative criteria. Non-exploitation is derived in place of being imported: a configuration providing no locus at which a participant's excess can register has foreclosed the source of its own further generation, so that the distinction between generation and extraction becomes internal to the mechanism. As a preliminary discussion paper, its aim is to establish the mechanism and to name what the framework must next supply: a composition rule, an account of scale, and an epistemic criterion by which a configuration might determine from within whether it generates or extracts.

AI.tldr: 本文在Generative Relational Being框架下提出规范涌现的位置性理论，论证规范词汇必然出现在涌现机制的解释项中，规范性哲学是揭示涌现机制的必要条件而非可被消除的残余。文章推导出非剥削性作为规范性涌现的内在条件，并指出该框架需进一步发展的方向。
AI.research_question: 规范涌现的机制是什么？规范性词汇在解释规范涌现中是否可被消除？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将规范的"涌现"与"正当性"分为两个独立领域：一方建模规范涌现却对正当性保持沉默，另一方论证正当性却认为涌现无关。自然主义者认为完整的涌现解释会使正当性成为残余，而规范性哲学用实然-应然鸿沟来回应，反而承认了自然主义的前提。本文旨在论证相反的立场。
AI.theoretical_framework: Generative Relational Being框架；位置性涌现理论；关系的构成生成未被参与者占据的轨迹（loci），约束力（bindingness）承载于这样的轨迹而非关系项；权力被视为不对称性，其中解释性不对称是一种通过垄断解释权而排除他人纠正的类型；生成性（generativity）是价值发生的条件而非价值本身。
AI.method: 理论论证与概念分析：通过分析"制裁"与"侵略"在行为描述上的不可区分性，论证规范性差异在于行为所处的构型（configuration）而非行为本身；在Generative Relational Being框架内发展位置性规范涌现理论。
AI.findings: 制裁与侵略无法通过行为描述区分，差异在于行为所置身的关系构型；规范词汇必然出现在任何涌现机制的解释项中；二元关系（dyad）即前规范性（pre-normative）；非剥削性（non-exploitation）不是外部引入的伦理标准，而是规范性涌现的内在条件——一个无法让参与者超额（excess）得以登记的构型，已经断绝了自身进一步生成的来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 论证规范性哲学不是涌现机制的残余，而是理解涌现机制的必要条件，反驳自然主义立场；2. 在Generative Relational Being框架下提供规范涌现的位置性理论；3. 将非剥削性从外部导入的伦理标准转变为规范性涌现的内生条件；4. 区分生成（generation）与提取（extraction）成为机制内部问题，而非外部判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个分析社会规范是否具有规范性的内在判准——构型是否允许参与者的超额得以登记；2. 指出了该框架下一步需要发展的方向：构成规则、尺度问题、以及构型从内部判断自身是生成还是提取的认知标准。

title: After the Flood: Cheap Production, Costly Selection, and the Future of the Commons
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business, Northeastern University (USA) and University of Utah - Department of Management

detail.title: After the Flood: Cheap Production, Costly Selection, and the Future of the Commons
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence dramatically lowers the cost of knowledge work. When cheaper production generates a flood of new work that human evaluators must manage, how do they decide what deserves attention? In open-source software, the answer is prior working relationships. Across 792,000 pull requests to 1,145 repositories, submissions more than triple with the advent of generative AI. Yet acceptance falls from 53% to 27% for first-time project contributors while remaining nearly unchanged for prior contributors. Aversion to disclosed AI use, our measures of code quality, and coder reputation do not account for the divergence. Acceptance is instead predicted by a prior tie between the contributor and the repository's lead maintainer, the person who merges the most pull requests.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI大幅降低了知识工作的成本，导致开源软件中拉取请求数量激增三倍以上。但首次贡献者的接受率从53%骤降至27%，而有过往合作关系的贡献者接受率基本不变。这一差异主要由贡献者与仓库主要维护者之间的事先合作关系预测，而非AI使用披露、代码质量或贡献者声誉。
AI.research_question: 当生成式AI大幅降低知识生产成本，导致人类评估者需要处理海量新工作时，他们如何决定哪些工作值得关注？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使知识工作的生产成本急剧下降，这可能导致大量新工作的涌入，人类评估者面临信息过载，需要理解他们如何在这类情境下分配注意力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力分配理论、社会资本/关系网络理论（以事先合作关系作为注意力分配的机制）
AI.method: 基于792,000个拉取请求和1,145个开源软件仓库的大规模实证数据分析。
AI.findings: 生成式AI使拉取请求数量增加了三倍以上；首次贡献者的接受率从53%降至27%，而有事先合作关系的贡献者接受率几乎不变；这种差异并非由AI使用披露、代码质量或贡献者声誉解释，而是由贡献者与仓库主要维护者之间的事先合作关系预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在AI生成内容激增的情境下，社会关系（事先合作关系）成为注意力分配的关键机制，丰富了注意力分配理论和关系网络理论在AI时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开源社区、组织管理者及平台设计者提供了关于如何应对AI生成内容洪流的洞见，提示建立和维护合作关系对于获得关注和认可的重要性。

title:
Liquidity Commitment Theory 
A State-Based Framework for Measuring Executable Commitment, Strategic Withdrawal, and Latent Replenishment in Electronic Financial Markets

detail.title:
Liquidity Commitment Theory 
A State-Based Framework for Measuring Executable Commitment, Strategic Withdrawal, and Latent Replenishment in Electronic Financial Markets
detail.abstract:
Electronic markets display liquidity as price-quantity instructions resting in a limit order book. Conventional measures such as quoted depth, spread, trade volume, and order-flow imbalance are indispensable, yet they do not fully distinguish liquidity that remains available under changing conditions from liquidity that rapidly modifies, migrates, cancels, executes, or replenishes. This paper introduces Liquidity Commitment Theory (LCT), a state-based framework for measuring the degree to which displayed executable interest maintains economically meaningful participation through time. LCT is founded on a narrow but consequential proposition: displayed size is an observation, whereas commitment is a conditional property revealed through an order's lifecycle. 
The theory defines liquidity commitment as the measurable degree to which executable interest persists, maintains queue presence, interacts with incoming flow, accepts execution, replenishes after execution, or otherwise remains available as market conditions evolve. It introduces a Liquidity Commitment Vector containing persistence, identity continuity, modification intensity, withdrawal sensitivity, execution contact, replenishment, and migration. These components support a Liquidity Commitment Score and a set of commitment states ranging from transient and reactive liquidity to persistent and replenishing liquidity. The framework does not claim access to private intention. It measures observable conduct and explicitly separates behavioral classification from legal conclusions about spoofing or manipulation.
 LCT integrates prior Market Physics constructs into a unified hierarchy. The Matching Engine Response Window (MERW) supplies the event-specific observation boundary. Behavioral Jitter measures instability in order-state transitions. An Asymmetric Withdrawal Event (AWE) identifies abnormal side-specific deterioration in commitment. A Microstructural Pulse Dislocation (MPD) describes a localized divergence between aggressive flow, available commitment, and price response. Event-Driven Microstructure Collapse (EMC) describes a broader temporary regime in which aggregate commitment, absorptive capacity, and replenishment become insufficient to stabilize ordinary price formation. 
Psychology is incorporated without reducing market behavior to emotion. Human loss aversion, attention, anchoring, herding, overconfidence, inventory discomfort, and fear of adverse selection influence order placement and cancellation; algorithmic systems encode analogous objectives through risk limits, inventory penalties, urgency schedules, and response rules. The order book therefore records not thoughts but constrained choices. LCT treats those choices as observable state transitions. 
The paper develops formal definitions, proposes falsifiable hypotheses, specifies an empirical protocol using event-level Market-by-Order data, and establishes evidentiary standards for distinguishing statistical association, economic value, and claims about participant intent. Its contribution is a research architecture through which liquidity can be weighted by demonstrated commitment rather than displayed quantity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流动性承诺理论（LCT），构建了一个基于状态的框架，通过观察订单生命周期中的条件性行为（如持续、队列维持、交互、执行、补充等），来度量显示流动性在变化市场条件下的实质性参与程度，并区分了“显示规模”与“承诺”这两个概念。
AI.research_question: 如何超越传统的报价深度、价差、成交量等指标，从订单生命周期行为的角度更精确地度量流动性的质量与可持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统流动性指标无法区分那些在市场条件变化下仍保持可用的流动性与那些快速修改、迁移、取消、执行或补充的流动性，需要更精细的度量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性承诺理论（LCT），整合了匹配引擎响应窗口（MERW）、行为抖动（Behavioral Jitter）、非对称撤单事件（AWE）、微观结构脉冲错位（MPD）、事件驱动微观结构崩溃（EMC）等市场物理学构念，并结合损失厌恶、注意、锚定、羊群、过度自信等心理学因素。
AI.method: 形式化定义、可证伪假设、基于逐笔订单（Market-by-Order）数据的实证协议、区分统计关联、经济价值和参与者意图的证据标准。
AI.findings: 提出流动性承诺向量（包括持续性、身份连续性、修改强度、撤单敏感性、执行接触、补充和迁移），构建流动性承诺评分和承诺状态分类（从瞬态/反应性流动到持久/补充性流动）。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将流动性从静态显示量重新概念化为条件性属性；（2）建立基于订单生命周期的状态化度量体系；（3）明确将行为分类与法律结论（如欺诈性报价）分离；（4）整合心理学与市场微观结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场监管、交易策略和流动性质量评估提供了基于承诺权重而非仅显示数量的分析架构，有助于识别真正的市场深度与虚假流动性。

title: CSR Spending in Islamic Banks of Bangladesh: From the Point of View of Maslahah and Maqasid al-Shariah
affiliations: Southeast University, Dhaka, Bangladesh

detail.title: CSR Spending in Islamic Banks of Bangladesh: From the Point of View of Maslahah and Maqasid al-Shariah
detail.abstract: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) is a set of behaviors by a business through which business attempts to influence society positively through its direct and indirect actions for sustainable development. Banks, especially Islamic Banks, which are driven by Islamic principles are considered to be act responsibly in operations. Islamic banks are obligated as as well as morally bound to take separate CSR actions. This paper is an attempt to see whether the CSR activities of Islamic Banks are line with the Principles of Maslahah (public good) and Maqasid or Objective of Shariah and whether the banks target essential aspects of the society over non-so essential aspects in CSR actions. The study was performed with 5 major Islamic banks of Bangladesh-one of the emerging Muslim countries of the world. The results suggest that Islamic banks in Bangladesh focuses on the areas of 'necessities' for the society in Bangladesh such as education, health, and disaster management. But interesting different banks have been found to put differing weights to individual sub-categories of CSR. It bodes well for the country so as to spread sustainable development across multi sectors of the society rather than all focusing on one area only and ignoring other areas. In addition, it has also been found that Islamic banks are limited in their ability to perform CSR based on profits they make and revenue-generating assets they have.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了孟加拉国五家主要伊斯兰银行的CSR活动是否符合伊斯兰教法中的Maslahah（公共利益）和Maqasid al-Shariah（教法目标）原则，发现这些银行主要关注教育、健康、灾害管理等社会"必需品"领域，但不同银行在具体子类别上的侧重有所不同，且CSR能力受限于银行利润和创收资产。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰银行的CSR活动是否符合Maslahah（公共利益）和Maqasid al-Shariah（伊斯兰教法目标）原则？银行是否优先关注社会必需品领域而非非必需品领域？
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰银行受伊斯兰教义约束，理论上应承担更多社会责任，但现实中其CSR活动是否真正符合教法目标尚缺乏实证检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Maslahah（公共利益）原则、Maqasid al-Shariah（伊斯兰教法目标）理论、CSR与可持续发展的关联框架。
AI.method: 选取孟加拉国5家主要伊斯兰银行作为样本，对其CSR活动进行分类分析，评估其是否符合伊斯兰教法原则以及对社会不同领域的关注程度。
AI.findings: 1. 伊斯兰银行CSR聚焦于教育、健康、灾害管理等社会"必需品"领域，符合Maslahah和Maqasid原则；2. 不同银行对CSR子类别的重视程度存在差异，这种多样化有利于社会多领域可持续发展；3. 伊斯兰银行开展CSR的能力受限于其利润水平和创收资产规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 将伊斯兰教法中的Maslahah和Maqasid al-Shariah理论与企业CSR实践相结合，拓展了伊斯兰金融领域的社会责任研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰银行管理者提供CSR战略优化方向，提示银行应在利润约束下合理配置CSR资源，实现社会多领域的可持续发展。

title: Artificial Consensus: AI and Survey Measurement

detail.title: Artificial Consensus: AI and Survey Measurement
detail.abstract: Central banks, governments, industry, and investors use surveys to measure economic conditions that are otherwise difficult to observe. AI can distort survey measurement at three stages: by replacing respondents, assisting them, or analyzing the resulting data. I study all three channels by fielding an online survey based on the Survey of Consumer Expectations (SCE), benchmarking answers from fifteen AI models, and analyzing SCE microdata. A browser-side answer-origin measure distinguishes between AI-assisted humans, agentic tools, and autonomous bots, revealing that the dominant respondent-side problem is assistance rather than substitution. Among 1,294 respondents, 31.4% leave evidence of AI involvement, 4.8% disclose it, and only 0.4% are autonomous bots. AI-generated answers reproduce a plausible normal-times center of inflation expectations but collapse their dispersion, while AI-led cleaning disproportionately removes genuine upper-tail SCE responses. With independent respondents, tighter answer distributions generally signal more convergent beliefs; with a shared algorithmic source, the same pattern can arise without belief convergence. AI-induced homogenization can make surveys appear more precise while biasing inference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI在调查测量中三个阶段的扭曲效应：替代受访者、辅助受访者和分析数据。通过在线实验和SCE微观数据分析发现，主要问题是AI辅助（31.4%）而非替代（0.4%），AI生成的回答会压缩分布方差、误导推断。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过替代、辅助和分析三个渠道扭曲调查测量，以及这种扭曲对经济推断有何影响？
AI.motivation: 央行、政府和投资者依赖调查来测量难以直接观测的经济状况，而AI的广泛使用可能系统性扭曲这些测量结果，但此前缺乏对三种扭曲渠道的系统性量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 调查测量理论、AI对人类行为的替代与辅助理论、分布压缩与推断偏差理论
AI.method: 在线调查实验（基于SCE问卷）、15种AI模型基准测试、SCE微观数据统计分析、浏览器端回答来源检测技术
AI.findings: (1) 31.4%受访者留下AI参与证据，4.8%主动披露，仅0.4%为自主机器人；(2) 主要问题是AI辅助而非替代；(3) AI生成回答能再现通胀预期的正常中心值但压缩了分布离散度；(4) AI主导的数据清洗会不成比例地移除真实的尾部回答；(5) AI同质化使调查看似更精确但实际误导推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分并量化了AI在调查测量中替代、辅助、分析三个渠道的效应；揭示了AI同质化导致"看似更精确实则更偏差"的理论悖论；区分了共享算法源导致的分布压缩与真实现象收敛的本质差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查机构提供了检测AI参与的方法（浏览器端回答来源测量）；提醒政策制定者注意AI导致的虚假精度；警示数据清洗中AI可能系统性移除尾部真实观测。

title: Cities as Portfolios

detail.title: Cities as Portfolios
detail.abstract: This paper views cities as portfolios of industries and evaluates urban performance jointly in terms of wage growth and wage-growth volatility. Using U.S. data from 1990 to 2020, I show that larger cities lie closer to the empirical growth-risk frontier. An attribution framework separates inherited industrial exposure from local adjustment. Large cities' wage-growth premia reflect favourable initial industry composition and stronger reallocation toward faster-growing and higher-wage activities. Their lower wage-growth risk, however, is concentrated in adjustment margins rather than safer benchmark exposure. To shed light on mechanisms, I use the China trade shock and show that skill portability and medium-to-large establishments predict smaller wage losses. These margins explain much of the scale-dependent resilience advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文从投资组合视角将城市视为产业组合，利用1990-2020年美国数据，发现大城市更接近增长-风险前沿。大城市的工资增长溢价源于有利的初始产业结构和向高增长高工资活动的再配置，而其较低的工资增长风险则主要来自调整边际而非更安全的产业暴露。通过中国贸易冲击分析，发现技能可迁移性和中大型企业可预测较小的工资损失，这些解释了规模依赖的韧性优势。
AI.research_question: 城市规模如何影响城市在工资增长与工资增长波动性之间的权衡表现？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注城市聚集经济对生产率或工资水平的影响，但对城市经济表现的"增长-风险"权衡以及城市规模如何塑造这一权衡的理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市作为产业组合的投资组合理论、增长-风险前沿概念、产业暴露与调整边际的归因框架。
AI.method: 使用1990-2020年美国数据，构建增长-风险前沿；采用归因框架分解产业暴露和本地调整效应；利用中国贸易冲击作为准自然实验进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 大城市更接近增长-风险前沿；大城市的工资增长溢价来源于有利的初始产业结构和向高增长高工资活动的再配置；大城市的低工资增长风险主要来自调整边际而非更安全的产业暴露；技能可迁移性和中大型企业规模能预测较小的贸易冲击工资损失，这些解释了规模依赖的韧性优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融学中的投资组合理论与城市经济学结合，建立了城市规模与增长-风险权衡的系统性分析框架；区分了产业暴露效应和本地调整效应对城市经济表现的不同贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市发展政策提供了基于增长-风险权衡的评估视角；揭示了技能可迁移性和企业规模结构在增强城市韧性中的重要作用，为城市产业政策和劳动力市场规划提供依据。

title: The Development of Insurance Adaptation Assets from Pooled Insurance Premia
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Development of Insurance Adaptation Assets from Pooled Insurance Premia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I, Chris Cormack, declare that there are no conflicts of interest in the work published.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This work has ben supported by Quant Foundry Limited

detail.abstract: This paper develops the concept of an Insurance Adaptation Asset (IAA): a ring-fenced regional investment vehicle capitalised by a defined share of pooled insurance premia and remunerated by verified reductions in insured losses, risk capital and reinsurance costs created by adaptation projects. The proposed vehicle can finance nature-based solutions and conventional engineering interventions whose benefits span property, flood, motor, life, health and agricultural insurance. A multi-line actuarial framework links intervention expenditure to hazard frequency, loss severity, cross-line dependence, risk margins, premium indications and policyholder passthrough. It separates project cash flows from consolidated insurer welfare to avoid double counting internal benefit payments. A dynamic cost-benefit model then identifies conditions under which the vehicle is solvent, investable and capable of lowering premia while retaining an adequate return for participating insurers. The framework is extended to a public excess-loss layer under which government absorbs a fraction y < 50% of a defined catastrophic layer in nationally important deployment areas. Closed-form results are provided for the expected public payout and the corresponding reduction in insurer value-at-risk capital under a lognormal loss approximation. An illustrative 30-year portfolio indicates how a 2% allocation of gross written premia could finance an initial adaptation programme while producing positive project, insurer and social net present values. The numerical results are not empirical estimates; they demonstrate calibration requirements and the economic mechanics. A structured literature review finds close antecedents in impact underwriting, resilience bonds, nature-based insurance and public-private catastrophe schemes, but no established framework that jointly combines pooled local premia, multi-line avoided-claims cash flows, dynamic premium pass-through and a capped public tail-risk share. The originality claim is therefore one of integration and formalisation rather than of discovering the general insurance-adaptation linkage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型区域投资工具——保险适应资产（IAA），通过将一定比例的保费汇集并投资于适应项目（如基于自然的解决方案和工程干预），以验证的保险损失减少来获得回报，从而降低保费、风险资本和再保险成本。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和构建一种保险关联的区域投资工具（IAA），使其能够资助适应项目、同时保持偿付能力、可投资性，并为保险公司提供足够回报？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致自然灾害损失增加，保险业面临保费上升和承保压力；缺乏一种将保险保费与适应项目投资有效结合的正式化、集成化金融工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多险种精算模型（连接干预支出与灾害频率、损失严重度、跨险种依赖、风险边际和保费传递）；动态成本-收益模型（偿付能力、可投资性、保费降低条件）；公共超额损失层框架（政府承担部分巨灾风险）。
AI.method: 理论推导（封闭形式解，对数值损失近似）；结构化文献综述；30年期说明性投资组合数值演示（非实证估计，展示校准要求和经济机制）。
AI.findings: 在说明性情景下，2%的总承保保费分配可资助初始适应计划，产生正向的项目净现值、保险公司净现值和社会净现值；给出了政府期望支出和保险公司风险价值资本减少的封闭形式结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将本地汇集保费、多险种避免索赔现金流、动态保费传递和公共尾部风险分担四个要素整合并形式化为统一框架；填补了保险与适应投资结合领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司、政府和投资者提供了一种可操作的区域适应投资工具设计；展示了如何通过保费的小幅分配撬动适应项目融资，同时维持保险公司盈利和降低投保人保费。

title: Beyond Association: A Components-in-Context Agenda for Ultraprocessed Food Research

detail.title: Beyond Association: A Components-in-Context Agenda for Ultraprocessed Food Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia (NHMRC) Investigator Grant awarded to YAM (#2009776).

detail.abstract: Ultra-processed food (UPF) research has established food processing as an important dimension of nutrition science and policy. Observational studies consistently link higher UPF intake with obesity, type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, common mental disorders and premature mortality, and controlled feeding evidence suggests that ultra-processed dietary patterns can promote excess energy intake and weight gain. Yet the central object of inference remains under-specified. UPF denotes a heterogeneous category, while "reduce UPF" does not define a specific intervention. This perspective argues that the next phase of UPF research should move from a single aggregate UPF exposure towards pre-specified, component-specific estimands. These estimands should ask which features of ultra-processing are causal, through which mechanisms, in whom, compared with which alternatives, and with what consequences for health, equity and environmental sustainability. I develop this components-in-context agenda across four interacting domains: causal inference, mechanistic specificity, food environment and systems thinking, and equity. The distinctive contribution is to treat each policy-relevant UPF question as a componentspecific substitution contrast, linking the causal effect, plausible mechanism, feasible replacement, environmental footprint and distributional consequences within the same analytic frame. The agenda is illustrated using target trial emulation, substitution modelling, processing-specific mechanistic evidence, natural-experiment policy evaluation and heterogeneity analysis. This perspective builds on the observational epidemiology that brought UPFs to the centre of nutrition science, while outlining the methodological and conceptual steps needed to support more precise, equitable and policy-relevant population nutrition action.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，超加工食品（UPF）研究的下一阶段应从单一聚合暴露转向预定的、成分特定的估计目标，明确问清超加工的哪些特征是因果性的、通过何种机制、在谁身上、与哪种替代方案相比、对健康、公平和环境可持续性有何影响。
AI.research_question: 超加工食品研究应如何从单一的聚合UPF暴露转向更精确、成分特定的估计目标，以支持更精准、公平和政策相关的营养行动？
AI.motivation: 尽管UPF与多种疾病关联的观察性证据充分，但核心推断对象仍然不明确——UPF是一个异质性类别，"减少UPF"并非具体干预。需要更精确的方法论框架来指导下一阶段研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成分-情境（components-in-context）议程，涵盖因果推断、机制特异性、食物环境与系统思维、公平性四个相互作用的领域。
AI.method: 视角性论文，提出方法论框架；通过目标试验模拟、替代模型、加工特异性机制证据、自然实验政策评估和异质性分析来阐释该议程。
AI.findings: 应将每个政策相关的UPF问题视为一种成分特定的替代对比，将因果效应、合理机制、可行替代品、环境足迹和分配后果纳入同一分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 为UPF研究提供了从"关联性流行病学"迈向"因果性成分特异性估计"的概念和方法论框架，明确了下一阶段研究的核心问题域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供更精准的证据基础，支持设计成分特定、情境敏感的干预措施，兼顾健康、公平与环境可持续性。

title: Health Shocks as Drivers of Persistent Change in Health Behaviors
affiliations: , Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Health Policy & Management and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Health Policy & Management

detail.title: Health Shocks as Drivers of Persistent Change in Health Behaviors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received funding from the Erasmus Initiative Smarter Choices for Better Health (Stöckel), the Convergence Health & Technology grant No 2022030 (Bakx and Wouterse), and the Dutch Ministry of Health for the Affordable Care program, project number 1046691 (Wouterse).

detail.abstract: We study health prevention efforts after acute cardiovascular events using linked Dutch administrative and survey data. In the six years after the event, smoking and alcohol consumption decrease substantially, while preventive medication uptake is near-universal and persistent. Individuals also make forward-looking care and insurance choices. While cardiovascular events impact health, perceived health, and control beliefs, none of these channels explains the behavioral effects, which are similar across socioeconomic and health-risk groups. Our results suggest that the interaction of salient health shocks with broader health-system characteristics, rather than individual-level characteristics or the provision of information through these events, drives successful prevention.

AI.tldr: 利用荷兰行政和调查数据，研究发现急性心血管事件后，个体在六年内显著减少吸烟和饮酒，预防性药物使用普遍且持久，并做出前瞻性的护理和保险选择。这些行为变化不能用健康状况、感知健康或控制信念来解释，且在不同社会经济和健康风险群体中相似。结论是，显著的健康冲击与更广泛的卫生系统特征相互作用，而非个体特征或信息提供，驱动了成功的预防行为。
AI.research_question: 急性心血管事件后，个体的健康预防行为（如戒烟、减少饮酒、预防性用药、前瞻性护理和保险选择）如何变化？这些变化的驱动因素是个人层面的特征和信息，还是健康冲击与卫生系统特征的互动？
AI.motivation: 了解急性健康冲击如何改变个体的预防行为，并识别其背后的机制，对于设计更有效的健康干预政策和改善心血管疾病患者的长期健康管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康冲击与行为改变理论、健康信念模型、卫生系统特征对个体行为的影响
AI.method: 利用荷兰行政数据和调查数据，采用纵向追踪分析方法，比较急性心血管事件前后个体的健康行为变化，并通过排除健康状况、感知健康、控制信念等中介变量，检验行为效应的驱动机制。
AI.findings: （1）急性心血管事件后，吸烟和饮酒显著减少；（2）预防性药物使用普遍且持续；（3）个体做出前瞻性护理和保险选择；（4）上述行为变化在不同社会经济和健康风险群体中相似；（5）健康状况、感知健康和控制信念无法解释这些行为变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了显著健康冲击与卫生系统特征的互动是驱动成功预防行为的关键机制，挑战了传统认为个体特征或信息提供是主要驱动因素的观点，拓展了健康行为改变理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新思路：通过增强卫生系统的响应性（如简化预防服务获取、强化医疗系统支持）来放大健康冲击的预防效应，而非仅依赖个体层面的健康教育或风险沟通。

title: Who Gets to Compete? Institutional Barriers to Entry and Competition in Brazilian Public-Private Partnership Auctions

detail.title: Who Gets to Compete? Institutional Barriers to Entry and Competition in Brazilian Public-Private Partnership Auctions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an employee of Radar PPP, the firm that maintains the contract database used in this study, and firms analyzed in the paper may include clients of Radar PPP. The data were used with the firm's authorization. Radar PPP had no role in the study design, analysis, interpretation of results, or the decision to publish. The views expressed are the author's own and do not necessarily represent those of Radar PPP.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This version of the paper relies exclusively on publicly available procurement documents and administrative contract data; no human-subjects data were collected. The exploratory interviews described in Section 4.7 have not yet been conducted and will be submitted for review by the Insper research ethics committee prior to fieldwork.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how institutional barriers to entry-embedded in the design of procurement documents and contracts-shape competition in public-private partnership (PPP) auctions for public lighting in Brazil. Drawing on a systematic analysis of 139 public lighting PPP contracts signed between 2013 and 2025, the study combines content analysis of procurement documents with econometric methods to estimate the association between contractual requirements and the number of bidders. The theoretical framework integrates three bodies of literature: (i) barriers to entry and competitive strategy (Bain 1956; Porter 1980), (ii) auction theory and procurement design (Laffont and Tirole 1993; Kang and Miller 2022; Drake 2025), and (iii) institutional economics and state capacity (North 1990; Williamson 1985; Williams 2021). Three hypotheses are advanced: that procurement documents with more stringent qualification requirements are associated with fewer participants; that municipalities with lower administrative capacity produce procurement documents with higher barriers; and that incumbent firms exhibit disproportionately high win rates. The results at this stage represent conditional associations; causal identification is reserved for future extensions. The study aims to contribute both theoretically-by bridging the industrial organization and public procurement literatures-and empirically, by providing evidence-based recommendations for improving PPP procurement design.

AI.tldr: 本文分析巴西公共照明PPP招标中，采购文件与合同设计中的制度性进入壁垒如何影响竞争。通过对2013-2025年间139份合同的分析，发现更严格的资格要求与更少的投标者相关，行政能力低的城市产生更高壁垒，且现有企业中标率异常高。
AI.research_question: 采购文件和合同设计中的制度性进入壁垒如何影响PPP拍卖中的竞争？
AI.motivation: PPP项目采购中的竞争不足可能导致效率损失和公共资源浪费，但制度性进入壁垒（如资格要求、合同条款）如何具体影响投标竞争，缺乏系统性的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合三大文献：①进入壁垒与竞争战略（Bain 1956; Porter 1980）；②拍卖理论与采购设计（Laffont & Tirole 1993; Kang & Miller 2022; Drake 2025）；③制度经济学与国家能力（North 1990; Williamson 1985; Williams 2021）。
AI.method: 对139份巴西公共照明PPP合同（2013-2025）进行系统分析，结合采购文件内容分析与计量经济学方法，估计合同要求与投标人数量的关联。
AI.findings: ①资格要求越严格的采购文件，投标参与者越少；②行政能力越低的市政当局，其采购文件设置的壁垒越高；③在位企业（现有企业）中标率异常高。当前结果为条件性关联，因果关系待后续研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产业组织理论与公共采购文献进行桥接，为理解制度性进入壁垒如何影响拍卖竞争提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进PPP采购设计提供基于证据的政策建议，帮助降低不必要的进入壁垒，促进竞争。

title: Prioritizing Vaccination in the Social Network against a Pandemic Outbreak
affiliations: University of Kent - Kent Business School and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Prioritizing Vaccination in the Social Network against a Pandemic Outbreak

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the  British Council  (Grant  No. 870896740).

detail.abstract: We study the vaccine prioritization problem faced by a social planner aiming to mitigate the impact of a pandemic, where the disease spreads via a social network connecting individuals grouped by sectors. Each individual's infection probability is determined by the probability that it is infected by others and that from outside the society. Getting vaccinated can reduce the health loss upon infection but incurs a sector-dependent cost (e.g., vaccine side effects). The interaction between the planner and all individuals constitutes a Stackelberg game. In this game, constrained by limited vaccines, the planner prioritizes sectors according to the order of vaccination, while the individuals make incentivedriven responses to the vaccination policy. Through analyzing this game-theoretic model, we obtain an optimal and stable priority index under utilitarianism which ranks the sectors by their expected cost reduction from vaccination, while simultaneously accounting for individuals' vulnerability to the virus and the transmissibility of the disease. In addition, we show that an individual's equilibrium infection probability can be approximated by their weighted Bonacich centrality within the network. We further characterize an explicit optimal egalitarian policy designed to equalize sectoral costs after allocation. Using COVID-19 data from New York City, we calibrate our model and show that the proposed vaccination strategies outperform the common practice primarily based on the vulnerability to the virus (such as age-ordered prioritization). Moreover, the performance improvement of the optimal policy (in percentage) under the utilitarian objective increases with the society's lock-down level, which means that the existing vaccination practice performs reasonably well under little travel restriction. While interestingly, an opposite pattern emerges when the social planner focuses on the egalitarian objective. That is, the performance improvement in this case decreases as the lockdown level rises, indicating the existing practice works well under significant travel restriction. We demonstrate the robustness of our key findings to the variation of main model parameters and to alternative type of vaccines that reduce the chance of infection (rather than reducing the impact after infection as in our main model).

AI.tldr: 本文通过Stackelberg博弈模型研究流行病疫苗优先分配问题，提出了基于效用主义和平均主义的两种最优疫苗优先分配策略，并用纽约市COVID-19数据验证了其优于基于年龄的常见做法。
AI.research_question: 在有限疫苗约束下，社会规划者如何通过Stackelberg博弈确定最优的疫苗优先分配顺序，以最大化社会效用或实现部门间成本平等？
AI.motivation: 现实中的疫苗分配往往基于年龄等单一脆弱性指标，但忽略了疾病传播网络中的传染性差异以及个体激励驱动的行为响应，需要更系统的博弈论框架来优化分配策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stackelberg博弈（社会规划者为领导者，个体为追随者）、效用主义（Utilitarianism）和平均主义（Egalitarianism）福利标准、Bonacich中心性（Bonacich centrality）
AI.method: 博弈论建模分析 + 纽约市COVID-19数据校准模型 + 数值模拟比较不同疫苗优先策略
AI.findings: （1）效用主义最优策略按预期成本降低排序，同时考虑个体脆弱性和疾病传播性；（2）个体的均衡感染概率可由加权的Bonacich中心性近似；（3）平均主义政策旨在平衡部门间成本；（4）效用主义下最优策略相对于年龄优先策略的优势随封锁程度增加而增大；（5）平均主义下优势随封锁程度增加而减小。
AI.theory_contributions: 将疫苗优先分配问题建模为Stackelberg博弈，揭示了最优优先级指数与个体脆弱性和传播性的关系，并建立了感染概率与网络中心性的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于博弈论的疫苗优先分配优化方案，证明现有基于年龄的策略在部分情境下存在改进空间，且改进程度受社会封锁水平调节。

title: Bilingual Statutory Interpretation, Shared Meaning and Customs Tariff Law
affiliations: University of Windsor - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Bilingual Statutory Interpretation, Shared Meaning and Customs Tariff Law
detail.abstract: Bilingual statutory interpretation is fundamental in the Canadian legal system. Between 1969 and 1988, the federal Official Languages Act contained explicit direction on how to address discrepancies between the French and English versions of legislation. Since the repeal of those provisions, case law has developed the shared meaning rule. This article offers a review of the previous legislation and the current rule as applied in customs tariff classification appeals heard by the Tariff Board of Canada and the Canadian International Trade Tribunal. The article discusses the two approaches, considering their use as guidelines for decision-makers. The Tariff Board and the CITT did not always refer to the relevant legislative or case law rules in decisions involving bilingual interpretation. In practice, the presumption for narrow common meaning in both approaches was not followed consistently. As well, it appears that both the explicit direction and the shared meaning rule reflect overly literal analysis at odds with the modern method of unilingual statutory interpretation. Updating and reform are in order. The decisions of the Canadian International Trade Tribunal suggest a path forward.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了加拿大双语法定解释中"共同含义规则"的发展历程，分析了其在关税分类上诉案件中的实际应用，指出现行规则存在过于字面化、与当代单语解释方法脱节的问题，并提出了改革方向。
AI.research_question: 加拿大双语法定解释中的"共同含义规则"在实践中如何被应用？现行规则存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 加拿大联邦《官方语言法》中关于双语解释的明确规定被废除后，判例法发展出"共同含义规则"。但该规则在关税分类上诉案件中的应用不一致，且存在方法论上的缺陷，有必要进行系统性审视和改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双语法定解释理论；共同含义规则；现代法定解释方法
AI.method: 对加拿大关税委员会和加拿大国际贸易法庭在关税分类上诉案件中的裁决进行案例审查与分析
AI.findings: 1. 关税委员会和国际贸易法庭在处理双语解释问题时并未始终援引相关立法或判例规则；2. 两种解释方法中关于狭窄共同含义的推定在实践中未被一致遵循；3. 明确的立法指引和"共同含义规则"都反映了过于字面的分析方式，与当代单语法定解释的现代方法不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了现行双语解释规则在方法论上的局限性——过度字面化分析，与当代法定解释的现代方法（语境化、目的性解释）存在冲突。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大双语法定解释规则提供了改革建议，指出加拿大国际贸易法庭的裁决为未来改革指明了方向。

title: Measuring Market Contestability under Article 102 TFEU and the DMA
affiliations: Maastricht University and Maastricht University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Measuring Market Contestability under Article 102 TFEU and the DMA
detail.abstract: Digital platforms have accumulated substantial market power, raising concerns about anti-competitive conduct. Traditional competition law under Article 102 TFEU seeks to preserve competition on the merits but has proven constrained in digital markets by complex assessments, procedural delays, and high evidentiary standards. In response, the Digital Markets Act (DMA) has introduced an ex ante regulatory framework aimed at ensuring contestable and fair digital markets. This study develops, to our knowledge, the first systematic empirical measures using a network analysis framework to quantify market contestability under Article 102 TFEU and the DMA. It introduces three metrics: regulatory density, capturing how concentrated regulatory intervention is around actors and activities; intraconnectedness, reflecting the extent to which intervention reduces dependency and lock-in within an ecosystem; and interconnectedness, measuring the extent to which competitive interaction across services and ecosystems is facilitated. Applying these measures empirically, the study maps enforcement trends and compares regulatory trajectories across the two regimes. The findings show increased regulatory density under the DMA, while the balance between intra-and interconnectedness remains largely unchanged. This suggests intensified oversight rather than structural transformation. Longstanding concerns regarding remedy effectiveness persist, reflecting entrenched ecosystem power, limited deterrence, and a lack of competitive pressure from challengers.

AI.tldr: 本文首次运用网络分析框架，系统量化了《欧盟运作条约》第102条与《数字市场法案》下的市场可竞争性，发现DMA虽然提高了监管密度，但未改变生态系统的内部依赖与跨服务互联之间的平衡，表明监管强化而非结构性变革。
AI.research_question: 如何运用网络分析方法系统量化数字市场在《欧盟运作条约》第102条与《数字市场法案》下的市场可竞争性？
AI.motivation: 传统竞争法在数字市场面临复杂评估、程序延迟和高证据标准等限制，而DMA引入了事前监管框架，但缺乏系统性的实证度量方法来比较两种监管体制的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络分析框架；市场可竞争性理论；监管密度、内部连通性与跨系统连通性三个度量指标。
AI.method: 构建网络分析框架，提出三个量化指标（监管密度、内部连通性、跨系统连通性），并应用于实证数据，比较第102条与DMA两种体制下的执法趋势与监管轨迹。
AI.findings: DMA下监管密度显著增加，但内部连通性与跨系统连通性的平衡未发生实质性改变；长期存在的救济措施有效性问题依然存在，反映出生态系统权力根深蒂固、威慑力有限以及缺乏来自挑战者的竞争压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并验证了系统性的网络分析框架用于量化市场可竞争性，为比较事前监管与事后竞争执法提供了新的理论工具和实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了量化评估数字市场监管效果的方法论工具，揭示了DMA虽加强监管但未带来结构性变革的现实，提示需要更有效的救济措施和增强竞争压力。

title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics, Bocconi University - Department of Economics and University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics

detail.title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the European Research Council (HEUROPE 2022 ADG, GA No. 101055294) is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution F(x|θ) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n + 1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard log F(x|θ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazardlog(1-F(x|θ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.
