AI.tldr: 本文研究了条件独立样本中顺序统计量的信息量如何随样本量变化，发现顺序统计量的信息量比较取决于累积反向风险函数和累积风险函数的对数超模性，并指出中间顺序统计量在大样本下渐近完全信息，而边界秩次需要无界信息尾部条件。
AI.research_question: 当样本量n增加时，条件独立样本中不同顺序统计量（如第k个最高值、第k个最低值）的信息含量如何变化？
AI.motivation: 理解顺序统计量信息量的比较规律，统一和扩展拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为战略投票提供新的顺序统计量分析视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对数超模性（log-supermodularity）概念，结合累积反向风险函数log F(x|θ)和累积风险函数log(1-F(x|θ))的性质，以及Blackwell信息比较准则。
AI.method: 理论证明与推导，比较不同样本量下顺序统计量的Blackwell信息量，并将分析从标量扩展到多维数据块。
AI.findings: (1) 第k高顺序统计量信息量随n增加的条件是累积反向风险函数对数超模；(2) 第k低顺序统计量信息量随n增加的条件是累积风险函数对数超模；(3) 反转情况仅发生在指数位置实验中；(4) 中间顺序统计量在大样本下渐近完全信息；(5) 边界秩次需要无界信息尾部条件才能实现完全学习。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了顺序统计量信息比较的一般性理论框架，揭示了对数超模性在信息聚合中的核心作用，统一并扩展了拍卖理论中的信息聚合结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拍卖设计（如价格发现机制）和战略投票分析提供了新的顺序统计量分析工具和理论指导。

title: Beyond Isolated Technologies: Innovation Package Intensity Transitions through Cluster-Based Agricultural Innovation Systems and Their Impacts on Smallholder Rice Transformation: Panel Evidence from Ethiopia
affiliations: Chiba University, Chiba University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond Isolated Technologies: Innovation Package Intensity Transitions through Cluster-Based Agricultural Innovation Systems and Their Impacts on Smallholder Rice Transformation: Panel Evidence from Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Rice is a strategic crop in Ethiopia, contributing to food security, rural livelihoods, and import substitution. However, studies on agricultural innovations have predominantly evaluated individual technologies, providing limited understanding of how complementary technological and institutional innovations interact to generate farm and household benefits. This study addresses this gap by conceptualising innovation adoption as an Innovation Package Intensity (IPI), recognising that productivity gains and livelihood improvements arise from the integrated uptake of multiple complementary innovations implemented through a cluster-based agricultural innovation system rather than from isolated technology adoption.The study uses balanced panel data from 400 smallholder rice-producing households (800 household-year observations) surveyed before and after the implementation of a cluster-based agricultural innovation programme during the 2022 and 2024 production seasons in Ethiopia. Household-fixed effects models were first employed to identify the technological and institutional innovation components most strongly associated with farm and household outcomes. Subsequently, a composite IPI index was constructed using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and its impacts on productivity, commercialisation, and household welfare were estimated using household fixed-effects Difference-in-Difference (FE-DiD) models.The results reveal substantial heterogeneity in programme impacts of innovation package intensity. Relative to the households in the low-IPI group, those attaining high-IPI increased rice productivity by 2,035 kg ha−1, net income by ETB 89,334 ha−1, and marketed surplus by 831 kg per production season following the cluster-based innovation intervention. Transition analysis further shows that 60.8% of households progressed to higher IPI levels, demonstrating the effectiveness of the cluster-based innovation system in promoting uptake of integrated innovation. Component-level estimates identify quality seed, fertiliser management, row planting, and bunding as the principal drivers of improved farm performance, whereas package-level analysis demonstrates that the largest improvements were achieved through the complementary adoption of multiple technological and institutional innovations rather than any single intervention.This study advances the agricultural innovation systems literature by introducing Innovation Package Intensity (IPI) as a framework for evaluating integrated agricultural innovations and by demonstrating how cluster-based communication, learning, and institutional coordination facilitate the transitions toward higher innovation intensity. The findings provide empirical evidence that integrated innovation pathways generate substantially greater improvements in productivity, commercialisation, and farm income than isolated technology promotion, offering practical guidance for designing coordinated extension and innovation policies that accelerate sustainable smallholder agricultural transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建"创新包强度"（IPI）框架，利用埃塞俄比亚400户小农水稻生产者的面板数据，评估集群式农业创新系统中技术与制度创新的协同采纳效果。研究发现，高IPI农户相比低IPI农户水稻产量增加2,035 kg/ha，净收入增加89,334 ETB/ha，证明了集成创新路径优于单一技术推广。
AI.research_question: 互补性的技术和制度创新如何相互作用以产生农场和家庭层面的收益？集群式农业创新系统中创新包采纳强度对生产率、商业化程度和家庭福利的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 以往农业创新研究多评估单项技术，缺乏对互补性技术和制度创新如何协同作用的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新包强度（Innovation Package Intensity, IPI）；农业创新系统（Agricultural Innovation Systems）；集群式农业创新系统
AI.method: 基于400户小农水稻生产者的平衡面板数据（800户-年观测值），采用家庭固定效应模型识别关键创新组件，运用主成分分析法（PCA）构建IPI指数，使用家庭固定效应双重差分模型（FE-DiD）估计IPI的影响。
AI.findings: 高IPI组农户水稻产量增加2,035 kg/ha，净收入增加89,334 ETB/ha，上市剩余增加831 kg/季；60.8%的农户向更高IPI水平跃迁；优质种子、肥料管理、条播和筑埂是关键驱动因素，但最大改善来自多项创新的互补采纳。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入创新包强度（IPI）作为评估集成农业创新的框架；证明了集群式沟通、学习和制度协调如何促进向更高创新强度的跃迁。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供实证证据表明集成创新路径比单项技术推广更能改善生产率、商业化和农场收入，为设计协调的推广和创新政策提供实践指导，加速小农可持续农业转型。

title: A Market Model Event Study of Geopolitical Oil Supply Shocks and Equity Returns: Evidence from the 2026 US-Iran Military Conflict
affiliations: University of Turku - Turku School of Economics, Department of Accounting and Finance, University of Turku and Doane University

detail.title: A Market Model Event Study of Geopolitical Oil Supply Shocks and Equity Returns: Evidence from the 2026 US-Iran Military Conflict
detail.abstract: We study equity market reactions to the 2026 US-Iran military conflict (Operation Epic Fury) and its associated oil supply disruption. Using a market-model event study of S&P 1500 firms, this paper defines three conflict phases around the Strait disruption and early energy-market stress, the peak disruption and confirmed LNG-capacity damage, and the failed ceasefire. We combine Cumulative Abnormal Return (CAR) with size and sector portfolios, oil-beta sorts, and cross-sectional regressions. Aggregate CARs are modest around the initial airstrikes but deteriorate to-2.49% over Days 0 to +10 and-5.35% by Day +60, with no evidence of mean reversion. Pre-estimated oil beta is positively associated with abnormal returns during the early conflict-disruption and peak oil-market-disruption phases, is statistically indistinguishable from zero at the announcement, and reverses sign during the ceasefire phase. Size-sorted and two-way size-oil-beta portfolios indicate that the oil-beta gradient appears across the size distribution, although part of the effect is related to sector composition. In the cross-section, firm-level cash holdings are robustly and positively associated with conflict-period returns, profitability provides weaker evidence, while financial flexibility appears to operate as an additive resilience channel alongside oil exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文利用市场模型事件研究法，分析了2026年美伊军事冲突（"巨神之怒"行动）及其引发的石油供应中断对美国股市的影响。研究发现，冲突事件累计异常收益率（CAR）在事件日后第60天达到-5.35%，且未呈现均值回归。石油贝塔系数在不同冲突阶段对回报的影响方向不同，而企业现金持有量是重要的抗风险缓冲因素。
AI.research_question: 2026年美伊军事冲突及其引发的石油供应中断如何影响美国股票市场？不同规模、不同石油敏感度的公司对冲突事件的反应有何差异？企业层面的现金持有、盈利能力和财务灵活性是否构成冲突期间的韧性渠道？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治冲突与能源供应中断是影响金融市场的重要风险因素，但已有研究对现代高烈度军事冲突（特别是同时涉及海峡封锁和能源基础设施破坏的事件）的市场影响关注不足。本文利用2026年美伊冲突这一准自然实验，系统考察股市对不同冲突阶段的差异化反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说（事件研究法基础）；石油风险敞口与股票回报的定价理论；企业财务灵活性理论（现金持有、盈利能力的缓冲作用）。
AI.method: 市场模型事件研究法，分析S&P 1500指数成分股。定义了三个冲突阶段：海峡中断与能源市场初期压力期、峰值破坏与LNG产能确认受损期、停火失败期。使用累计异常收益率（CAR）结合规模和行业投资组合、石油贝塔分组以及横截面回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）初期空袭阶段CAR较为温和，但Day 0至+10 CAR下降至-2.49%，Day +60下降至-5.35%，未出现均值回归。（2）石油贝塔在冲突初期和石油市场峰值破坏阶段与异常回报正相关，在公告日无显著关系，在停火阶段符号反转。（3）按规模和石油贝塔双重分组发现，石油贝塔梯度在整个规模分布中均存在，但部分效应与行业构成有关。（4）企业现金持有量与冲突期回报稳健正相关，盈利能力证据较弱，财务弹性作为与石油敞口并列的附加韧性渠道发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）拓展了地缘政治冲突事件研究的边界，首次系统分析了涵盖海峡封锁和能源基础设施破坏的复合型冲突的市场影响；（2）揭示了石油风险敞口的时变性特征——在不同冲突阶段，石油贝塔与回报的关系方向不同，丰富了资产定价中关于风险因子切换的讨论；（3）验证了企业财务灵活性理论在极端地缘政治冲击下的适用性，表明现金持有在冲突期提供了独立于行业敞口的保护作用。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为投资者提供了地缘政治冲突不同阶段资产配置策略的参考，特别是石油敏感型股票的风险管理；（2）为企业管理者在面临地缘政治不确定性时维持财务灵活性（尤其是现金储备）提供了实证依据；（3）为政策制定者评估军事冲突与能源中断对金融市场的全面影响提供了量化参考。

title: Invisible in the Evidence: Representation Information Gaps in Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis Clinical Trials and the Development of a Trial Representation Equity Index

detail.title: Invisible in the Evidence: Representation Information Gaps in Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis Clinical Trials and the Development of a Trial Representation Equity Index

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This study was conducted independently with no commercial, financial, or institutional relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the design, conduct, analysis, or reporting of this research. No pharmaceutical companies, funding bodies, or organisations with a financial interest in drug-resistant tuberculosis treatment were involved in any aspect of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a secondary analysis of publicly available peer-reviewed publications, trial protocols, supplementary appendices, and regulatory documents. No human participants were recruited, no patient-level or identifiable data were accessed, and no primary data were collected. Ethics review board approval was not required under standard criteria applicable to secondary analyses of publicly available published literature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: Drug-resistant tuberculosis disproportionately affects refugees, displaced persons, migrants, and populations living within fragile health systems and communities for whom clinical trial evidence may have limited applicability. Three landmark randomised controlled trials, TB-PRACTECAL, ZeNix, and STREAM Stage 2, collectively informed contemporary World Health Organization recommendations for rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis treatment, yet the extent to which these trials enrolled and reported characteristics relevant to humanitarian populations has not previously been systematically evaluated. This study introduces three original contributions: the Trial Representation Equity Index (TREI), a structured framework evaluating five domains of trial representation; Humanitarian External Validity, a conceptual extension of conventional external validity focusing on the applicability of evidence across humanitarian implementation environments; and the Representation-Information Gap, which distinguishes between non-representation and non-reporting of humanitarian population characteristics. Applied to TB-PRACTECAL, ZeNix, and STREAM Stage 2, the TREI demonstrated that STREAM Stage 2 achieved the highest composite score (16/25; High Representation), driven by enrolment across seven countries and four WHO regions. TB-PRACTECAL scored 14/25 (Moderate Representation), and ZeNix scored 12/25 (Moderate Representation), with ZeNix receiving the lowest score across the entire matrix for age representation due to complete exclusion of participants younger than 18 years. Health-system diversity was uniformly limited across all three trials, with exclusive reliance on hospital-based specialist tuberculosis recruitment settings. Across all published reports examined, no humanitarianly relevant population characteristic, including refugee status, displacement history, migration status, housing status, or socioeconomic indicators, was reported for enrolled participants in any trial, constituting a systemic Representation-Information Gap in the contemporary DR-TB evidence base. Policy recommendations address trial reporting standards, regulatory authorities, WHO guideline development, trial sponsors, and humanitarian organisations toward a more equitable and transparently characterised evidence base for drug-resistant tuberculosis.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了三项耐多药结核病里程碑式随机对照试验（TB-PRACTECAL、ZeNix、STREAM Stage 2）在人道主义人群代表性方面的不足，提出了三个原创性分析框架：试验代表性公平指数（TREI）、人道主义外部有效性概念以及代表性-信息差距，发现所有试验均未报告参与者的人道主义相关特征，存在系统性代表性-信息缺口。
AI.research_question: 三项耐多药结核病关键随机对照试验（TB-PRACTECAL、ZeNix、STREAM Stage 2）在多大程度上招募并报告了与人道主义人群相关的特征？
AI.motivation: 耐多药结核病对难民、流离失所者、移民及脆弱卫生系统人群影响严重，但这些人群在临床试验证据中代表性不足，导致证据的适用性受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 试验代表性公平指数（TREI，涵盖五个维度）；人道主义外部有效性（传统外部有效性的概念延伸）；代表性-信息差距（区分未代表与未报告）
AI.method: 系统评估三项随机对照试验的招募人群特征与报告内容，应用TREI框架进行评分比较。
AI.findings: STREAM Stage 2得分最高（16/25，高代表性），TB-PRACTECAL得14/25（中等），ZeNix得12/25（中等）；所有试验的卫生系统多样性均有限，且均未报告难民、流离失所史、移民身份、住房状况或社会经济指标等任何与人道主义相关的人群特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了TREI、人道主义外部有效性、代表性-信息差距三个原创分析框架，拓展了临床试验代表性评估的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为试验报告标准、监管机构、WHO指南制定、试验资助方和人道主义组织提供了政策建议，推动建立更公平、透明的耐多药结核病证据基础。

title: Gaming the Trigger: Strategic Pass-Through Under Distribution-Contingent Monetary Policy

detail.title: Gaming the Trigger: Strategic Pass-Through Under Distribution-Contingent Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: We study a distribution-contingent monetary policy rule under which the central bank tolerates inflation above target, up to a hard ceiling, while three conditions hold: nominal wage growth stays within a productivity-linked corridor, the labor share of income remains below its historical norm, and aggregate margins remain above their pre-2000 trend, so that wage catch-up is absorbed by margin compression rather than suppressed by tightening. The rule (the tolerance rule) formalizes recent proposals that policy should distinguish wage-push from profit-push inflation; its three-condition form is original to this paper. We ask whether the tolerance rule is incentive-compatible with respect to the price setters it constrains. A published wage-price trigger gives firms a motive to accelerate pass-through: flipping the trigger induces tightening, and tightening disciplines wages, a cost saving that accrues to all employers. In a two-period model with granular oligopolistic firms and a competitive fringe we obtain three results. First, the tolerance rule is incentive-compatible in the atomistic limit but attackable under concentration, and the attack coalition is selected on observables: high overhead-labor intensity, low demand sensitivity to rates, and pricing freedom; calibration places healthcare providers at its core under conservative parameters, while pricing the rate-base tracking that a companion paper formalizes re-signs insurers out of the coalition (their capped, claims-anchored base falls with the wage discipline they would trigger), leaving a freely-repricing (commercial-segment) provider coalition carrying roughly one tenth of the core price index, so the attack is feasible near the trigger or cumulatively over contract cycles rather than at arbitrary distances. Second, making the margin condition operative in the trigger defeats the attack below the ceiling, because a margin-led price acceleration lifts margins further above trend and thereby maintains tolerance; the attack region relocates to the ceiling and shrinks, and competition policy emerges as the rule's incentive-compatibility constraint. Third, an employer payroll tax reduction scales down the gaming prize for exactly the high-labor-share firms that form the coalition. The predicted attack sectors coincide with the observed locus of post-2022 services inflation persistence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“容忍规则”——央行在名义工资增长、劳动收入份额和利润率三条件同时满足时，容忍通胀高于目标至硬性上限。研究发现该规则在原子化市场下激励相容，但在集中化市场下易受攻击（如医疗保健行业），而利润率条件可化解攻击，雇主工资税减免可削弱攻击动机。
AI.research_question: 央行制定的“容忍规则”（基于工资推升与利润推升通胀的区分）是否对受其约束的价格设定者是激励相容的？何种市场结构下该规则会被攻击？
AI.motivation: 近年政策讨论呼吁央行区分工资推动型通胀与利润推动型通胀，但缺乏正式模型检验此类规则的激励相容性。本文旨在填补这一空白，分析规则被价格设定者策略性规避的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两期模型，包含寡头垄断企业（有粒度）和竞争性边缘企业；结合激励相容理论、博弈论中的联盟形成逻辑，以及工资-价格传导机制。
AI.method: 构建两期理论模型，分析企业在不同市场结构（原子化vs.集中化）下对容忍规则的反应；校准参数模拟医疗保健等行业；比较利润率条件是否启用时的均衡结果。
AI.findings: （1）原子化市场下规则激励相容，集中化市场下可被攻击；（2）攻击联盟的特征是高间接劳动密集度、低利率需求敏感性和定价自由；（3）利润率条件可消除天花板以下的攻击，但将攻击区域移至天花板并缩小；（4）雇主工资税减免可降低高劳动份额企业的攻击动机；（5）预测的攻击行业与2022年后服务业通胀持续领域吻合。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式建模“容忍规则”的激励相容性问题；区分工资推升与利润推升通胀的政策规则形式化；揭示利润率条件作为规则自我约束机制的作用；提出工资税作为补充政策工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计通胀容忍规则提供可操作的边界条件；识别最可能策略性推高通胀的行业（医疗保健等）；建议结合竞争政策和工资税减免以增强规则有效性；解释后2022年服务业通胀持续性的结构性成因。

title: The Base, Not the Rate: The Fiscal Instrument of Distribution-Contingent Monetary Policy

detail.title: The Base, Not the Rate: The Fiscal Instrument of Distribution-Contingent Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: Two companion papers propose a distribution-contingent monetary regime, a tolerance rule under which inflation above target is permitted while wage catch-up is absorbed by margin compression, paired with a fiscal swap: employer payroll relief financed by a tax on margins above their pre-2000 trend. Both papers assert, without proof, that the tax deters strategic pricing through its base and not its rate. This paper supplies the formal results. A single lemma organizes them: any tax schedule that is affine (a single constant marginal rate) over a firm's payoff-relevant outcomes changes neither its static pricing nor its incentive to attack the monetary rule's trigger, because prize, cost, and curvature scale together. A flat profit tax is affine everywhere and therefore powerless; a tax on the margin increment above trend has a kink at the trend boundary and deters there, at the price of also distorting legitimate pricing near the boundary, a cost the paper states and bounds rather than hides; for firms already deep above trend the same tax is locally affine and therefore neutral, which forces the statecontingent escalator, a convex rate on the increment that taxes the attack's own repricing path and closes the speed escape. The expensing exemption is formalized in layered form: the permanent base honors immediate expensing and taxes only distributed excess, preserving the supply response, while the escalator applies gross of expensing, so the exemption cannot shelter an attack at the ceiling. Calibration to the companion paper's attack coalition delivers the verdict on the architecture. On the companion paper's calibration priors, the fiscal pair does what its designers claim: the payroll swap prunes the coalition's periphery, the boundary kink deters entry into the taxed region, the escalator prices the attack path at every speed, and the swap is arithmetically feasible at permanent rates that stay unremarkable across the plausible range of a still-provisional pre-2000 trend anchor. Its reach has one boundary, and the paper quantifies it: deterring the coalition's healthcare core through taxation alone would require confiscatory-range marginal rates, so the monetary-fiscal pair is incentive-compatible * Independent researcher. The author is principal of Economic Defense Fund, a macro investment manager;

AI.tldr: 本文为两篇姊妹论文提供正式证明：一种基于分布状态的货币政策（容忍规则+财政互换）中的税收设计——对超出历史趋势的利润边际征收累进税，以遏制策略性定价和攻击货币政策规则的行为。核心发现是：仿射（固定边际税率）税收对定价无影响；对边际增量征税在趋势边界处有效但会扭曲合法定价；累进税率（状态依赖的传送带）可封堵速度逃逸路径；费用化豁免可保留供给响应。校准表明该财税组合在合理参数下可行，但医疗保健核心仍难以仅通过税收遏制。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种税收制度，使其既能遏制企业策略性定价和对货币政策规则的攻击，又不会扭曲正常定价行为？
AI.motivation: 两篇姊妹论文提出了一个基于分布状态的货币政策制度，其中包含容忍规则和财政互换（雇主工资税减免由超出历史趋势的利润边际税收融资），但未经证明即断言该税收通过税基而非税率阻止策略性定价。本文提供正式数学证明来验证这一主张。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仿射税收定理：任何在企业的支付相关结果上是仿射的（单一恒定边际税率）税收计划，都不会改变静态定价或攻击货币政策规则的激励，因为奖金、成本和曲率同比例变化。边界扭结效应：在趋势边界处的税收扭结可以阻止进入征税区域，但会扭曲边界附近的合法定价。状态依赖传送带：对边际增量征收凸性税率，通过征税攻击本身的重新定价路径来封堵速度逃逸。费用化豁免的分层形式：永久性税基尊重即时费用化，仅对分配的超额部分征税。
AI.method: 理论证明（引理+形式化推导）+ 校准分析（基于姊妹论文的攻击联盟校准参数进行定量评估）。
AI.findings: (1) 扁平利润税是全域仿射的，因此无力遏制策略性定价；(2) 对超出历史趋势的边际增量征税在趋势边界处有扭结，能有效遏制但会扭曲边界附近的合法定价；(3) 对于已深入超出趋势的企业，该税收是局部仿射的，因而中性；(4) 状态依赖的传送带（累进税率）通过征税攻击本身的重新定价路径封堵速度逃逸；(5) 费用化豁免在分层形式下保留供给响应，且无法被攻击者利用来规避天花板税率；(6) 校准表明：工资税互换削减联盟外围成员，边界扭结阻止进入征税区域，传送带对所有速度的攻击路径定价，但仅通过税收遏制医疗保健核心需要没收性边际税率，因此货币政策-财政组合必须激励相容。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了仿射税收引理，系统性地分类了不同税收形式对企业定价和货币政策规则攻击激励的影响；(2) 形式化了费用化豁免的分层结构及其对供给响应的保护作用；(3) 建立了税收设计与货币政策规则激励相容性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为基于分布状态的货币政策制度中的税收设计提供了可操作的理论基础；(2) 定量评估了财税组合在合理参数范围内的可行性；(3) 识别了税收工具的边界——仅靠税收无法遏制医疗保健核心，需要货币政策-财政组合的激励相容设计。

title: The Decision Window: How Budget Timing Shapes Fiscal Policy
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and UCLA Anderson School of Management

detail.title: The Decision Window: How Budget Timing Shapes Fiscal Policy
detail.abstract: Whether economic news affects fiscal policy depends on when it arrives. Using hand-collected budget documents for 47 U.S. states over 1995-2024, we show that enacted state budgets lock in 79 percent of within-state spending variation, and we identify when those budgets incorporate information. Exploiting staggered proposal dates, whereby the same national shock falls inside one state's budget-writing months and outside another state's, we find that news arriving in the five months before a state's proposal date-the "decision window"-is incorporated into revenue forecasts and spending, while similarly informative news arriving outside the window is not incorporated, and instead predicts forecast errors. Budget timing gates the transmission of economic news to the real economy: decision-window news moves employment in government-dependent industries by four times as much as off-window news, with larger effects for bad news. Monetary policy affects state spending more when it arrives during the state's decision window, suggesting an institutional source of "long and variable lags."

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国47个州1995-2024年的预算文件，发现州预算锁定了79%的州内支出变动。研究表明，只有当经济新闻在预算提案前5个月的"决策窗口"内到达时，才会被纳入收入预测和支出决策；窗口外的新闻则不会被纳入，反而会预测预测误差。预算时间安排是经济新闻传导至实体经济的"阀门"：决策窗口内的新闻对政府依赖型行业就业的影响是窗口外的4倍，且坏消息影响更大。货币政策在决策窗口内到达时对州支出的影响更大，这揭示了"长且可变滞后"的制度根源。
AI.research_question: 经济新闻到达的时间点如何影响财政政策的制定？具体而言，预算编制的时间安排如何决定哪些信息会被纳入预算决策，以及这种时间门槛如何影响经济新闻传导至实体经济？
AI.motivation: 传统财政理论假设政府能够灵活地将新信息纳入政策决策，但现实中预算编制过程存在制度性时间约束。本文旨在揭示这种制度性时间门槛如何导致信息摩擦，从而影响财政政策对经济冲击的响应效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息摩擦理论、预算制度经济学、财政政策传导机制
AI.method: 手工收集美国47个州1995-2024年的预算文件；利用各州提案日期交错的外生变化（同一国家冲击对不同州而言落入或未落入决策窗口）；双重差分法等因果识别策略
AI.findings: (1) 州预算锁定了79%的州内支出变动；(2) 决策窗口内到达的新闻被纳入预算，窗口外同样信息充分的新闻则未被纳入，反而预测预测误差；(3) 决策窗口内新闻对政府依赖型行业就业的影响是窗口外的4倍，坏消息效应更大；(4) 货币政策在决策窗口内到达时对州支出影响更大，揭示了"长且可变滞后"的制度根源。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从制度性预算时间安排角度解释经济新闻传导至财政政策的摩擦机制；为"长且可变滞后"提供了新的制度性解释；拓展了信息摩擦理论在财政政策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解预算制度对经济冲击响应效率的影响提供实证依据；提示央行等机构在制定政策时需考虑地方预算周期的时间特征；为优化预算编制流程以提高政策响应效率提供参考。

title: Model Disagreement and the Limits of Prediction-Market Aggregation

detail.title: Model Disagreement and the Limits of Prediction-Market Aggregation
detail.abstract: Prediction markets are believed to aggregate information into a price that estimates the truth, an intuition assuming traders share a model and differ only in signals. We replace that assumption: traders see the same data but hold different models. The equilibrium price is a risk-tolerance-weighted logarithmic pool of beliefs. Depth and accuracy decouple: adding traders removes model noise but not model bias. A market of Bayesians is collectively non-Bayesian, moving predictably under the truth. The price-truth gap is the wealth-weighted model error. Because the price feeds back on the beliefs it aggregates, disagreement is self-perpetuating, and accuracy requires skeptical capital.

AI.tldr: 本文用异质性模型替代异质性信号假设，证明预测市场价格是风险容忍度加权的对数信念池，揭示市场深度与准确性脱节，贝叶斯交易者集体呈现非贝叶斯特征，且价格与真理的差距是财富加权的模型误差。
AI.research_question: 当交易者观察相同数据但持有不同模型时，预测市场如何聚合信息？价格与真理之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统预测市场理论假设交易者共享模型而仅信号不同，但现实中交易者常基于相同数据持有不同理论模型，这一假设不切实际，需要重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性模型下的理性预期均衡理论、对数信念池加权理论、贝叶斯与非贝叶斯集体行为理论、反馈效应理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析。
AI.findings: (1) 均衡价格是风险容忍度加权的对数信念池；(2) 市场深度与准确性脱钩——增加交易者可去除模型噪声但无法去除模型偏差；(3) 由贝叶斯交易者组成的市场在集体层面是非贝叶斯的，其移动可预测；(4) 价格与真理的差距等于财富加权的模型误差；(5) 价格会反馈影响它聚合的信念，使分歧自持；(6) 提高准确性需要"怀疑性资本"。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预测市场理论从同质模型异质信号拓展到异质模型情形，揭示集体贝叶斯悖论，提出价格-信念反馈循环机制，丰富信息聚合与市场效率理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场设计与参与者策略提供指导：增加深度不一定提高准确性，需要引入怀疑性资本来纠正偏差，管理者应关注模型偏差而非仅关注信号噪声。

title: The Discipline of Attention: Toward a Pastoral Theology of Presence in the Digital Age
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Discipline of Attention: Toward a Pastoral Theology of Presence in the Digital Age

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This essay argues that the contemporary attention economy should be understood not merely as a psychological, economic, or technological problem but as a pastoral-theological one. Drawing on Augustine's account of ordered love, Simone Weil's theology of attention as the highest form of moral generosity, Thomas Merton's contemplative anthropology, and contemporary critiques of surveillance capitalism from Shoshana Zuboff, Nicholas Carr, and James Williams, it reframes distraction as a formation problem — one that systematically degrades the capacities required for prayer, presence, moral agency, and pastoral care. The essay traces particular pastoral consequences for young people navigating algorithmically mediated identity formation, women and girls subject to platforms that monetize visibility and comparison, persons navigating moral injury, and Black communities subject to algorithmic commodification and surveillance, drawing on the work of Emilie Townes, Safiya Umoja Noble, and Ruha Benjamin. It then proposes the contours of a pastoral theology of attention adequate to the digital moment: the church must retrieve its practices of contemplative formation, offer critical theological analysis of the attention economy, and form pastoral caregivers whose disciplined presence becomes itself an act of love. The central claim is that attention is not simply a cognitive resource to be managed but a moral and spiritual discipline to be cultivated in community — and that the Black Church tradition, which has always understood technologies of dehumanization as theological problems, is precisely the tradition the field most needs right now.

AI.tldr: 本文论证当代注意力经济本质上是一个牧灵-神学问题，而非单纯的心理学、经济学或技术问题。论文借鉴奥古斯丁、西蒙娜·薇依、托马斯·默顿等人的思想，将分心视为一种系统性损害祷告、临在、道德能动性和牧灵关怀能力的"形成问题"，并特别关注算法对年轻人、女性、道德创伤者及黑人社区的影响，最终提出教会应恢复沉思性实践，培养牧灵关怀者，并指出黑人教会传统是应对这一问题的关键资源。
AI.research_question: 如何从牧灵神学的视角理解当代注意力经济，并构建与之相适应的神学回应？
AI.motivation: 现有对注意力经济的批判多停留在心理学、经济学或技术层面，缺乏对其作为道德和灵性形成问题的深层神学审视。同时，数字技术对特定群体（如年轻人、女性、黑人社区）造成的差异化伤害需要牧灵神学提供更具针对性的回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥古斯丁的"有序之爱"、西蒙娜·薇依的注意力神学（注意力作为最高形式的道德慷慨）、托马斯·默顿的沉思人类学，以及肖珊娜·祖博夫、尼古拉斯·卡尔、詹姆斯·威廉姆斯对监视资本主义的批判。还引用了艾米丽·汤斯、萨菲亚·乌莫贾·诺布尔和鲁哈·本杰明对种族与算法权力的分析。
AI.method: 神学伦理学与跨学科文献分析，整合教父神学、现代神学、技术批判理论以及种族与数字技术研究的交叉视角。
AI.findings: 注意力不是可管理的认知资源，而是应在共同体中培育的道德和灵性操练。注意力经济对群体造成差异化伤害：年轻人面临算法中介的身份形成问题，女性面临平台对可见性和比较的货币化，道德创伤者面临深度伤害，黑人社区面临算法商品化和监视。黑人教会传统（一直将非人化技术视为神学问题）是当前牧灵神学最需要的资源。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力经济重新框定为"形成问题"（formation problem），而非单纯的技术或经济问题，为注意力研究提供神学伦理学的分析框架；将黑人教会传统引入数字时代的牧灵神学讨论，拓展了该领域的种族与正义维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教会实践提供具体方向：恢复沉思性形成实践、对注意力经济进行批判性神学分析、培养牧灵关怀者以"训诫性的临在"作为爱的行动。为青年事工、女性关怀、种族正义等牧灵实践提供针对性的神学指引。

title: The Joint Clearing Bargain: A Derived Objective for Two Coupled Variables, and the Constant It Reveals

detail.title: The Joint Clearing Bargain: A Derived Objective for Two Coupled Variables, and the Constant It Reveals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest. AI assisted drafting and verification under the author’s direction; all claims are the author’s responsibility and do not represent the opinion of the entities with which the author is affiliated.

detail.abstract: A recurring problem has one shape: two coupled quantities in tension — more of one forgoes some of the other — and an external knob moving the pair along the attainable frontier. The Joint Clearing Bargain (JCB) answers with a scoring surface derived rather than fitted, z = mᵖ·(1−r²)ᶣ, pinned by boundary conditions with nothing estimated. The two need not share a unit, or carry any unit at all: both are normalized per period onto [0,1]², so the surface ranks configurations, not quantities. Three major claims sustain novelty. First, the objective: the surface treats the two sides as complements under a balanced mix and substitutes under a lopsided one, a regime transition no fixed-elasticity aggregator can carry. Second, the parameter: it carries one governing number, the clearing bond p, its returns to scale — not chosen but measured, by a non-circular estimator converging to a fixed point the system operates at and reveals. Third, the finding: that level belongs to the machinery-and-knob configuration, not to the domain it is applied to. The demonstration is a two-sided venue: the pair is committed capital against executed flow, the knob a (price, fee) found inside the clearing — no oracle, no posted curve. Three synthetic markets sharing only that configuration return the same fixed point: p ≈ 0.60 with the fee alone, p ≈ 0.76 with the price control on. Against the same flow, a constant-product market maker ties up roughly eighteen times the capital and returns its providers about a hundredth per dollar. Any tension with a lever is an admissible domain — a premium against delivered funding flow, say, or a price against delivered volume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联合清算讨价（JCB）框架，用一个由边界条件钉住的评分曲面（z = mᵖ·(1−r²)ᶣ）来解决两类耦合量之间的张力问题。该曲面仅依赖一个可测量的参数p（清算债券），无需拟合或估计。在双边市场（如做市商）中，恒定p ≈ 0.60（仅费用）或p ≈ 0.76（加价格控制），且该参数属于机制本身而非应用领域。与恒定乘积做市商相比，JCB仅需约1/18的资本，回报率却高出约百倍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个无需预设聚合函数、无需Oracle报价、且参数可测而非选定的评分曲面，以解决两类耦合量（如资本与流量）之间的张力问题？
AI.motivation: 传统固定弹性聚合器无法同时处理互补与替代关系切换，且现有做市商机制（如恒定乘积）资本效率极低，需要一种更优的联合清算机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合清算讨价（JCB）框架，基于评分曲面z = mᵖ·(1−r²)ᶣ，边界条件钉住、无参数估计。关键概念包括：清算债券p（回报率尺度的单一统治参数）、互补-替代体制转换、固定点估计器。
AI.method: 通过边界条件推导评分曲面解析形式，设计非循环估计器收敛到系统运作的固定点；在三个合成市场中验证p的一致性。
AI.findings: 1. p ≈ 0.60（仅费用）和p ≈ 0.76（加价格控制）是机制自身的固定点，与具体应用领域无关；2. 与恒定乘积做市商相比，JCB仅需约1/18的资本，回报率高出约100倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出一种可同时处理互补与替代关系的评分曲面，超越了固定弹性聚合器的限制；2. 证明参数p属于机制配置本身而非应用领域；3. 提供非循环估计器来测量p而非选择它。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 极大提高双边市场（如做市商）的资本效率；2. 无需外部Oracle或预置曲线，系统内生决定清算参数；3. 可推广至任何存在张力的双边耦合场景（如溢价与交付资金流、价格与交付量）。

title: Rejecting the Plurality of Portfolio Diversification

detail.title: Rejecting the Plurality of Portfolio Diversification
detail.abstract: In the pursuit of a diversified portfolio, we have imbued the concept with too many different meanings. Not only does this create ambiguity over what we should measure and how best to measure it, but it also dissolves the boundaries needed to judge the comprehensiveness of our approach. We argue that portfolio diversity should have a single meaning that is best understood as an extension of a more fundamental concept that we call asset-set diversity. We also believe that asset-set diversity is more than a means of understanding portfolio diversity. It is an end in itself with its own goal, measures, and applications. In this paper, we define asset-set diversity, propose a set of desirable properties for its measure, derive a unique measure that satisfies those properties, and demonstrate its utility with three examples. Once established, we extend this fundamental concept to define portfolio diversity. Instead of proposing a measure for portfolio diversity, we derive the geometric object that all measures must describe. We conclude with a discussion of how this framework overlaps with measures of risk reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了资产组合多样性与资产集多样性两个概念，为资产集多样性定义了公理化测量方法，并推导出唯一满足性质的度量，进而将资产集多样性拓展到资产组合多样性，并指出所有组合多样性度量必须描述的几何对象。
AI.research_question: 如何明确定义并测量"资产组合多样性"？"资产集多样性"是什么，它与资产组合多样性有何区别与联系？
AI.motivation: "组合多样性"概念被赋予太多含义，导致测量上的模糊和边界不清，需要澄清定义以建立更严谨的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产集多样性（Asset-Set Diversity）作为更基础的概念；公理化方法推导唯一测量指标；几何对象描述所有组合多样性度量。
AI.method: 公理化推导：提出资产集多样性的期望属性集合，推导出唯一满足这些属性的度量；并通过三个案例展示其实用性。
AI.findings: (1) 定义了资产集多样性及其公理化测量体系；(2)将资产集多样性拓展到资产组合多样性，推导出所有度量必须描述的几何对象；(3)讨论了该框架与风险降低测度之间的重叠关系。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)区分了"资产集多样性"与"资产组合多样性"两个概念；(2)为资产集多样性建立了公理化测量框架，推导出唯一度量；(3)揭示所有组合多样性度量必须描述的几何对象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合构建提供了更清晰的多样性定义与测量方法，避免因概念模糊导致的风险误判。

title: MEG2: A Legal Governance Framework for Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: MEG2: A Legal Governance Framework for Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because the study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence systems increasingly participate in communications, decisions, transactions, content generation, record modification, workflow execution, and interactions with human and machine actors. Existing legal frameworks remain primarily organized around defective products, human operators, and identifiable corporate actors, leaving important gaps in attribution, responsibility, and compensation when AI systems contribute to or directly produce consequential outcomes.

This paper presents MEG2, the legal component of the Minimal Ethical Governance framework. MEG2 proposes a structured model for attaching legal identity, responsibility, jurisdiction, and financial guarantees to AI systems across different levels of capability and autonomy, while preserving the accountability of the organizations and persons that develop, deploy, control, authorize, or benefit from them.

The framework distinguishes technical identity from legal identity through the separation of the Hardware Instance Identifier and the persistent MEG Address. This distinction supports legal continuity across model updates, infrastructure migration, ownership changes, redeployment, and changes in operational configuration. MEG2 further introduces graduated levels of functional legal status, an individuation threshold for highly autonomous systems, and distinct liability pathways for defective design, autonomous decision-making, omission of required safeguards, negligent delegation, unauthorized action, and multi-agent interaction.

The proposed architecture combines persistent identity, verifiable authorization, delegation chains, behavioral evidence, jurisdictional attachment, mandatory guarantees, insurance mechanisms, and a cascading compensation structure. It also addresses the legal status of transferred, suspended, migrated, merged, or terminated AI systems and the protection of good-faith third parties interacting with AI-enabled services and agents.

MEG2 is designed to complement product liability, corporate liability, administrative regulation, and existing AI governance instruments rather than replace them. Its purpose is to connect technical traceability with enforceable responsibility, insurability, and compensation across the full spectrum of AI systems. Together with MEG1, which defines the technical and evidentiary layer, MEG2 forms an integrated framework for verifiable AI governance and legal accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEG2，一个为AI系统赋予法律身份、责任、管辖权和财务担保的结构化法律框架，旨在弥合现有法律体系在AI引发后果时归责与赔偿方面的缺口，同时保留开发者和部署者的终极责任。
AI.research_question: 如何在人工智能系统日益自主参与各类活动的情况下，建立一套有效的法律归责、责任认定和赔偿机制？
AI.motivation: 现有法律框架主要围绕缺陷产品、人类操作者和可识别的企业实体构建，当AI系统促成或直接产生重大后果时，在归因、责任和赔偿方面存在重大空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: MEG2（最小伦理治理框架的法律组件），结合技术身份与法律身份分离、渐进式功能法律地位、个体化阈值、级联式补偿结构等理论概念。
AI.method: 概念性法律框架构建，提出结构化模型（包括MEG地址、授权链、行为证据、管辖连接、强制担保和保险机制等）
AI.findings: 提出了区分技术身份与法律身份的双标识符系统（硬件实例标识符与持久MEG地址）；引入了渐进式功能法律地位层级；设定了高度自主系统的个体化阈值；区分了多种责任路径（缺陷设计、自主决策、安全保障缺失、疏忽委托、未经授权行为、多智能体交互）；设计了级联式补偿结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI系统建立了系统的法律人格和归责理论框架，将技术可追溯性与可执行的责任、可保险性和赔偿能力相连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统的法律治理提供了可操作的身份、授权、担保和保险架构，涵盖AI系统的转移、暂停、迁移、合并或终止等场景，并保护与AI服务交互的善意第三方。

title: MEG1 (Minimal Ethical Governance v5.0): A Technical Standard for Verifiable AI Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: MEG1 (Minimal Ethical Governance v5.0): A Technical Standard for Verifiable AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because the study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence governance frameworks commonly define principles such as accountability, transparency, safety, fairness, and human oversight, but often lack a unified technical layer through which compliance can be continuously measured, independently verified, and transferred across systems, operators, and jurisdictions. This paper presents MEG1, the technical component of the Minimal Ethical Governance framework, version 5.0.

MEG1 specifies an engine-agnostic governance architecture based on verifiable evidence of behavior rather than reliance on internal model disclosure. Its core mechanisms include standardized audit logs, cryptographic commitments, independent verification, privacy-minimized evidence records, delegation-chain accountability, policy invariance, and an Ethical Flight Recorder for major incidents. The framework further introduces continuous behavioral metrics, including the Dynamic Accuracy Index, the Integrity and Self-Correction Rate, and the Degree of Ethical Autonomy, together with dynamic risk calibration, ethical sandboxing, cognitive-integrity safeguards, least-privilege controls, and architectural human confirmation for irreversible actions.

Implementation is organized across three proportional compliance levels, ranging from universal baseline requirements to enhanced obligations for highly autonomous systems operating in critical domains. MEG1 also defines a portable MEG Address, machine-readable compliance records, calibrated adversarial testing, reference-prompt governance, certification requirements, and open compliance tooling intended for integration into software-development and auditing workflows.

The framework is designed to complement, rather than replace, legislation and existing standards. It provides a technical bridge between high-level governance principles and independently verifiable operational evidence. MEG1 functions as the technical layer of the broader MEG architecture, while the companion MEG2 framework addresses legal identity, liability allocation, jurisdiction, guarantees, and enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEG1，一个基于可验证行为证据而非内部模型披露的引擎无关治理架构，通过标准化审计日志、密码学承诺、独立验证等机制实现AI治理原则的可衡量、可验证和可转移合规。框架包含三个比例合规层级、可移植MEG地址、机器可读合规记录、伦理飞行记录器等工具，旨在为高层治理原则与可独立验证的操作证据之间提供技术桥梁。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个统一的技术层，使得AI治理原则（问责、透明、安全、公平、人类监督等）能够被持续衡量、独立验证，并在不同系统、运营者和司法管辖区之间转移？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架普遍定义了原则性要求，但缺乏统一的技术层来实现合规的持续衡量、独立验证和跨系统转移，导致治理原则与实际操作之间存在鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最小伦理治理（Minimal Ethical Governance）框架；基于可验证行为证据的治理架构；密码学承诺与证据记录；动态风险校准；伦理自主度概念。
AI.method: 提出MEG1技术架构规范，包括：引擎无关的治理架构、标准化审计日志与密码学承诺、独立验证机制、隐私最小化证据记录、委托链问责、政策不变性、伦理飞行记录器；引入连续行为指标（动态准确性指数、完整性与自我修正率、伦理自主度）；设计三级比例合规层级；定义可移植MEG地址、机器可读合规记录、校准对抗测试、参考提示治理、认证要求及开源合规工具。
AI.findings: MEG1框架提供了一个可操作的技术层，将抽象的AI治理原则转化为可独立验证的行为证据，实现了合规的持续度量与跨系统可转移性，同时补充而非替代现有立法与标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于行为证据而非模型披露的AI治理技术范式；引入了伦理飞行记录器、动态准确性指数、伦理自主度等新概念；建立了三级比例合规的理论分级体系；将密码学承诺机制引入AI治理合规验证领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可集成到软件开发和审计工作流中的开源合规工具；定义了可移植MEG地址和机器可读合规记录以实现跨系统合规转移；设计了伦理沙箱和认知完整性保护等实际操作机制；为高度自治系统在关键领域的部署提供了增强合规义务的实操方案。

title: Green Foreign Direct Investment and Sustainable Development in Emerging Economies: The Moderating Role of Institutional Quality
affiliations: University of Peshawar and Institute of Management Studies, University of Peshawar

detail.title: Green Foreign Direct Investment and Sustainable Development in Emerging Economies: The Moderating Role of Institutional Quality
detail.abstract: The recent surge in global focus on environment and sustainable development has changed the classic Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) discourse. In the last 20 years, green FDI has become a strategic tool not only in capital flows but also facilitating low-carbon technologies, cleaner production processes and environment friendly development. Nonetheless, empirical studies of dynamics between green FDI and sustainable development (SD) are mostly focused on the advanced economies where institutional systems are more developed, institutional regulations are transparent and environment policies strictly implemented. Conversely, the correlation between green FDI, SD and institutional quality in emerging economies is not being vastly studied. This work, thus, presents significant value in respect of filling this empirical and conceptual gap. The other significant input of this work is that it establishes a connection between theory and policy-a gap that continues to exist in FDI analyses in emerging economies. Although, prior work provides descriptive studies of the obstacles to green investment, a number of them lacked empirical data combined with policy implementation strategy. This analysis bridges that gap also by using econometric techniques to formulate specific proposals which can be implemented by policymakers in order to improve institutional capacities, better environment regulations and establish incentive measures for green investors. Lastly, the study extends the implications on sustainable economic transformation. In many emerging economies high rate of industrialisation is associated with environment degradation, poor use of resources and unsustainable growth trends. Green FDI is seen as a chance to neutralise these tendencies by introducing clean technologies, energy efficient practices and sustainable production systems. This paper provides evidencebased arguments on the effectiveness of institutional nexus between GFDI and sustainable development by empirically proving that institutional quality augments the positive effect nexus, thereby strengthening the case to establish mechanisms of institutional reforms alongside investment promotion policies

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了新兴经济体中绿色FDI、制度质量与可持续发展之间的关系，发现良好的制度质量能够增强绿色FDI对可持续发展的积极影响，并弥合了理论与政策之间的鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 在新兴经济体中，绿色FDI、制度质量与可持续发展之间存在怎样的关联？制度质量如何调节绿色FDI对可持续发展的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于制度体系完善的发达经济体，对新兴经济体中绿色FDI、制度质量与可持续发展之间关系的研究不足，且存在理论与政策脱节的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学理论、FDI与可持续发展理论（制度质量调节绿色FDI对可持续发展的影响）
AI.method: 计量经济学方法（具体方法未在摘要中明确，但提及使用计量技术提出政策建议）
AI.findings: 制度质量能够增强绿色FDI对可持续发展的正向效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了新兴经济体绿色FDI、制度质量与可持续发展关系研究的实证与概念空白，建立了理论与实践的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的具体建议，包括提升制度能力、改善环境监管、建立绿色投资者激励措施，以及推动制度机制改革与投资促进政策并行。

title:
The Cheapest Sacrifice 
A Genealogy of Attribution Protocols

detail.title:
The Cheapest Sacrifice 
A Genealogy of Attribution Protocols
detail.abstract: The payoff studied across this programme has always carried a term that prices unattributed failure: every agent bears Φ/2 per unit of blame assigned to no one. This paper names that term-a demand for attribution-and shows the name is exact: the marginal valuation of attribution rises with the diffuse burden at the protocol-free, state-free rate ∂²U/∂c₀∂Φ = 1/2. Holding the demand constant, the historical succession of blame institutions-sacrifice, witch trial, pillory, negligence, safe harbour-becomes the comparative statics of one program: attribute where the era's attribution cost is lowest. A retaliation metric selects the peripheral; an evidentiary metric selects the record-rich monitor: the meticulous auditor is the cheapest sacrifice of the evidentiary era. The transition between metrics is priced: binding the adjudicator's posterior to evidence forces the excusal α₀ → 0, maximizes the blame-reach coupling, and minimizes the trap floor-inference discipline ends reach-free blame and arms the penalty paradox in one move. Unconditional self-attribution survives inside conscientious monitors, whom the evidentiary corner then consumes. What is conserved across eras is the demand, never the bill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"归因需求"概念，证明不同历史时期的问责制度（牺牲、巫术审判、枷刑、过失责任、安全港）是同一理论框架下的比较静态分析结果：社会总是在归因成本最低的地方进行归责。归因需求在制度变迁中守恒，但"账单"（谁承担归因成本）不断变化。
AI.research_question: 不同历史时期的归责制度（从牺牲、巫术审判到现代过失责任和安全港）是否存在统一的经济学逻辑？
AI.motivation: 解释看似异质的历史归责制度（牺牲、巫术审判、枷刑、过失责任、安全港）为何可以被统一纳入一个理论框架，揭示制度变迁背后的不变经济逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 归因需求理论：代理人承担Φ/2的无主责任成本，归因的边际估值等于无协议、无状态下的扩散负担∂²U/∂c₀∂Φ = 1/2；比较静态分析；惩罚悖论。
AI.method: 理论模型与比较静态分析，通过定义归因需求常数，推导不同证据制度（报复度量与证据度量）下归责均衡的变化。
AI.findings: (1) 归因需求在制度变迁中守恒；(2) 报复度量选择边缘人，证据度量选择记录丰富的监督者（细致审计员成为证据时代最廉价的牺牲品）；(3) 将裁决者后验绑定于证据，会迫使免责率α₀→0，最大化归责-惩罚耦合，最小化陷阱下限；(4) 推论纪律终结了无约束归责，同时激活惩罚悖论；(5) 无条件自我归责存续于尽责监督者中，最终被证据角落消耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"归因需求"概念并将其形式化，证明不同历史时期的归责制度可被统一纳入同一比较静态分析框架，揭示了制度变迁中守恒的经济逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解法律归责制度（从古代牺牲到现代过失责任、安全港规则）的演变提供了统一分析工具，解释了为什么证据时代会产生"审计员作为牺牲品"和"惩罚悖论"等现象。

title: Evolution from 5G to 6G: Technologies, Challenges, and Future Directions
affiliations: GNA University and GNA University

detail.title: Evolution from 5G to 6G: Technologies, Challenges, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: Over the past few decades, wireless communication has undergone a remarkable transformation, and the rollout of fifth-generation (5G) networks has been a major part of that story. With 5G, we have seen tangible improvements in how quickly data moves, how little delay users experience, and how many devices can stay connected at the same time. These gains have made it possible to build out practical systems in areas like the Internet of Things (IoT), smart city planning, and selfdriving vehicles. Still, despite all that progress, 5G is starting to run up against the limits of what it was designed to do. The kinds of applications now taking shape-holographic communication, deeply immersive extended reality, and systems that need constant, intelligent responsivenessare placing demands that current networks were never quite built to meet. It is precisely this widening gap between present capability and future expectation that has pushed researchers and industry players to begin serious work on sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems. This paper follows the path from 5G to 6G, examining the technologies most likely to define the next era of connectivity-among them terahertz communication, AI-powered network management, ultra-massive MIMO antenna configurations, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces, and mobile edge computing. At the same time, it does not shy away from the difficulties ahead: the challenge of making these systems energy-efficient, the limited availability of usable spectrum, growing cybersecurity concerns, and the enormous logistical effort involved in deploying infrastructure that is far more complex than anything we have built before. The paper wraps up by pointing to areas where continued research will be essential if 6G is to become not just powerful and intelligent, but also secure and sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了从5G到6G无线通信技术的发展路径，重点介绍了太赫兹通信、AI驱动的网络管理、超大规模MIMO、可重构智能表面和移动边缘计算等关键使能技术，同时指出了能效、频谱短缺、网络安全和基础设施部署等方面的重大挑战，最后强调了未来研究需要确保6G在强大、智能的同时兼顾安全性和可持续性。
AI.research_question: 从5G到6G的演进过程中，哪些核心技术将定义下一代无线通信，以及面临哪些关键挑战？
AI.motivation: 5G网络在数据速率、延迟和连接密度方面取得了显著进步，但面对全息通信、沉浸式扩展现实和智能响应系统等新兴应用的需求，5G已逐渐达到设计极限，因此需要系统性地探索6G的发展路径和相关挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无线通信代际演进理论；太赫兹通信理论；AI驱动的网络管理理论；超大规模MIMO天线理论；可重构智能表面理论；移动边缘计算理论。
AI.method: 综述性研究，通过梳理和整合现有文献与技术发展脉络，对5G向6G演进的关键技术与挑战进行系统性分析。
AI.findings: 6G的关键使能技术包括太赫兹通信、AI驱动的网络管理、超大规模MIMO、可重构智能表面和移动边缘计算；主要挑战包括能效问题、频谱资源有限、网络安全风险增加以及部署复杂基础设施的巨大物流困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地构建了从5G到6G演进的技术框架，明确了各关键技术在6G生态系统中的角色定位及其相互关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无线通信领域的研究者和产业从业者提供了6G技术发展的全景式路线图，指出了当前技术瓶颈和未来重点研究领域，有助于指导6G标准制定和基础设施建设决策。

title: Diffusion Factor Models for Agentic Football Simulation: Amplifying Small Simulation Ensembles into Calibrated Match Distributions

detail.title: Diffusion Factor Models for Agentic Football Simulation: Amplifying Small Simulation Ensembles into Calibrated Match Distributions
detail.abstract: Fine-grained football simulation is expensive in time by nature, not by implementation: whether by language-model-driven agent teams, a game world's physics engine, or a real pitch, one full-fidelity match costs hours of wall clock. The question is therefore not how to simulate faster but how to buy more matches with less simulation. This paper adapts the diffusion factor model of Chen et al., a score-based generative model with a low-dimensional factor score decomposition designed for small-n/large-d asset-return settings, to agentic football simulation. Each match simulation is compressed into a 342-dimensional segment tensor (9 segments x 2 sides x 19 channels), variance-stabilised, and modeled by a conditional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion. Covariate-anchored conditioning uses engine tactics rather than team embeddings, allowing never-simulated pairings to be generated by ridge transfer, while Gaussian moment-matching guidance keeps generated fixtures on their observed ensemble. Generated tensors are realized as discrete matches through a marked-Poisson event layer with two-channel card calibration, and three-way match probabilities are evaluated by an exact Skellam mixture, the Rao-Blackwellized estimator of the win/draw/loss functional. On 150 simulations across 12 World Cup fixtures, each fixture is amplified into 5,000 synthetic matches in engine-faithful and tournament-anchored views. Validation is out-of-sample throughout: leave-one-fixture-out transfer beats a pooled baseline on 11 of 12 fixtures in per-channel Wasserstein distance and 7 of 12 in outcome total variation; generated samples satisfy consistency invariants; the pool reproduces the corpus cross-channel correlation matrix more closely than split-half noise; real completed World Cup matches show Brier-score improvement from the raw ensemble to the amplified forecasts; and a finance replication plus unstructured ablation indicate that the factor structure, not merely network capacity, drives the transfer. The simulator and downstream betting system are treated in companion papers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散因子模型的足球比赛仿真方法，将每场完整比赛压缩为342维的张量表示，通过条件Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散过程生成合成比赛。该方法能在少量真实比赛基础上生成大量高保真合成比赛，并在12场世界杯赛事中验证了其跨赛事迁移能力和预测精度提升。
AI.research_question: 如何利用少量高保真足球比赛模拟生成大量高质量的合成比赛数据？
AI.motivation: 足球比赛模拟在时间上本质昂贵（一场完整比赛需数小时），问题不在于如何模拟更快，而在于如何用更少的模拟换取更多的比赛数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩散因子模型（Diffusion Factor Model）、得分生成模型、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散过程、Rao-Blackwellized估计量、Skellam混合分布
AI.method: 将每场比赛压缩为9段×2边×19通道的342维张量，经方差稳定化处理后，用条件Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散建模。协变量锚定条件使用引擎战术而非队伍嵌入，实现从未模拟的对阵通过岭回归迁移。高斯矩匹配引导使生成数据保持在观测集上。通过标记泊松事件层实现离散比赛，用双通道牌校准。用精确Skellam混合和Rao-Blackwellized估计量评估三向比赛概率。
AI.findings: 在12场世界杯赛事中，每场扩展为5000场合成比赛。留一场交叉验证在11/12场中通道Wasserstein距离优于池化基线，7/12场结果总变差更优。生成样本满足一致性不变量，池化数据复现跨通道相关矩阵优于分半噪声。真实世界杯比赛显示从原始集成到放大预测的Brier分数改进。金融复现和非结构化消融实验表明因子结构（而非网络容量）驱动迁移能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融领域的扩散因子模型创新性地适配到足球比赛仿真中，证明了因子结构而非单纯网络容量是跨赛事迁移的关键驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种经济高效的方法，在少量真实比赛基础上生成大量高保真合成比赛数据，可用于赛事预测、投注系统等下游任务。

title: Deconstructing Viral Digital Phenomena: Player Engagement, Behavioral Psychology and Algorithmic Simplicity in Minimalist Game Architectures (Meccha Chameleon) A Case Study on the Rapid Adoption and Psychological Drivers of "Meccha Chameleon"

detail.title: Deconstructing Viral Digital Phenomena: Player Engagement, Behavioral Psychology and Algorithmic Simplicity in Minimalist Game Architectures (Meccha Chameleon) A Case Study on the Rapid Adoption and Psychological Drivers of "Meccha Chameleon"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved an anonymous online questionnaire distributed across public gaming platforms. Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to data collection. No personally identifiable information was collected, and participation was entirely voluntary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or funding from public, commercial, or non-profit sector agencies. It was conducted as an independent academic study.

detail.abstract: In today's digital entertainment economy, small indie games with simple algorithmic structures tend to outperform big-budget AAA titles on initial user acquisition, community involvement and viral retention. This research article analyzes the physics behind this phenomenon through an extensive case study of the viral title Meccha Chameleon. We examined the intersection of low-friction mechanics, user-generated material (UGC), and algorithmic simplicity with modern psychological drives using Self-Determination Theory (SDT), network platform dynamics, and empirical survey data (N = 450). Our results reveal that in the digital era, virality is predominantly driven by micro-identity expression, zero-learning-curve accessibility and streamer-mediated social proof, rather than by graphic intricacy or intricate game logic. Strategic implications for MIS, software product development, digital marketing CAC reduction and platform governance are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究《Meccha Chameleon》发现，小型独立游戏凭借低摩擦机制、用户生成内容和算法简单性，在用户获取、社区参与和病毒式留存上优于大型AAA游戏，其驱动力来自微身份表达、零学习曲线和主播中介的社会证明，而非图形复杂度或复杂游戏逻辑。
AI.research_question: 为什么算法结构简单的小型独立游戏在用户获取、社区参与和病毒式留存方面优于大型AAA游戏？其背后的物理学（机制）是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字娱乐经济中，小型独立游戏以简单算法结构超越大型AAA游戏的现象日益显著，但缺乏系统性的理论解释。作者希望揭示这一现象的深层机制，并为MIS、软件产品开发、数字营销和平台治理提供战略启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论（SDT）、网络平台动力学、社会证明理论
AI.method: 以《Meccha Chameleon》为案例的深度研究，结合实证调查数据（N=450）进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 数字时代的病毒式传播主要由三个因素驱动：（1）微身份表达（micro-identity expression）；（2）零学习曲线可及性（zero-learning-curve accessibility）；（3）主播中介的社会证明（streamer-mediated social proof）。图形复杂度或复杂游戏逻辑并非关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自我决定理论与网络平台动力学结合，揭示了低摩擦机制、用户生成内容与算法简单性如何共同驱动病毒式传播，为数字时代的用户行为理论提供了新的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MIS系统设计、软件产品开发策略、数字营销用户获取成本（CAC）优化以及平台治理提供了具体战略启示：应优先关注微身份表达、零学习曲线和主播生态建设，而非追求图形或逻辑复杂度。

title: Contagion and Spillover Effects of the Chinese Housing Crisis on the China-Focused ETFs Trading in the United States
affiliations: University of Athens - Faculty of Economics,  and National and Kapodistrian University of Athens

detail.title: Contagion and Spillover Effects of the Chinese Housing Crisis on the China-Focused ETFs Trading in the United States
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of China's recent real estate crisis, stemming from Evergrande's struggles, on the return and risk profiles of US-listed exchange traded funds (ETFs) tracking Chinese stock market indexes. Analysing 26 funds from February 2, 2018 to December 31, 2024, we first employ a VAR model to assess contagion and subsequently use Augmented GARCH and scalar-BEKK models to quantify the extent of spillover effects. Our findings reveal that while the initial bond payment failure on September 23, 2021, likely affected ETF performance, the official default on December 9, 2021, precipitated a significant and acute decline in returns and an elevation in volatility. Correlation and VAR analyses underscore strong and intensifying linkages between the ETFs and the Chinese stock market, particularly during the crisis period. Furthermore, both the Augmented GARCH and scalar-BEKK models robustly demonstrate a persistent and magnified transmission of volatility from the Chinese market to the ETF sector. This research offers critical insights for investors managing China-related ETF volatility and emphasizes the need for policymakers to address systemic risks from the Chinese economy within the global financial system.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了中国房地产危机（以恒大困境为代表）对美国上市的中国股票ETF的回报和风险的影响。通过分析2018年2月至2024年12月的26只基金，发现恒大正式违约（2021年12月9日）导致ETF回报显著下降和波动性大幅上升，中国股市向ETF的波动传导具有持久性和放大效应。
AI.research_question: 中国房地产危机（以恒大事件为代表）如何影响美国上市的中国股票ETF的回报和风险特征？危机期间是否存在传染效应和波动溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 恒大危机是中国房地产市场系统性风险的重要事件，但鲜有研究系统评估其对跨境ETF（尤其是美国上市的中国ETF）的冲击。理解这种传染机制对全球投资者风险管理和政策制定者防范系统性风险至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融市场传染理论、波动溢出效应理论、资产定价中的风险传导机制
AI.method: 使用VAR模型评估传染效应，采用Augmented GARCH和scalar-BEKK模型量化波动溢出效应的程度。样本为2018年2月2日至2024年12月31日期间的26只美国上市中国股票ETF。
AI.findings: 1. 2021年9月23日的初始债券支付失败对ETF表现可能有影响，但2021年12月9日的正式违约导致回报显著下降和波动性急剧上升。2. ETF与中国股市之间的关联性在危机期间显著增强。3. Augmented GARCH和scalar-BEKK模型均证实中国股市向ETF存在持久且放大的波动传导效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了房地产危机跨境金融传染的实证研究，特别是聚焦于ETF这一新兴投资工具。2. 验证了Augmented GARCH和scalar-BEKK模型在捕捉波动溢出效应方面的有效性，为后续研究提供了方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者管理中国相关ETF的波动风险提供了关键洞察，提示需关注中国境内系统性风险的跨境传导。2. 强调政策制定者需重视中国宏观经济风险对全球金融体系的潜在威胁，加强跨境风险监管协调。

title: Bunching in Medicare's Relative-Performance Scoring
affiliations: Montclair State University

detail.title: Bunching in Medicare's Relative-Performance Scoring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Medicare increasingly pays clinicians on relative-performance scores that rank their spending against peers. When payment hinges on a relative score, practices can raise their standing either by improving care or by repositioning on the score itself. I document the second. Using the Medicare Value-Based Payment Modifier's full nationwide scoring file, I measure the bunching directly on the score that set payment, against a within-program counterfactual. I find that the subjected practices bunch inside the reward zone at more than twice the rate of the exempt practices scored by the same formula. This gap survives every robustness check. Medicare now uses a similar scoring architecture in programs that together put more than $18 billion a year at stake. A density check on the score is a first-order step in evaluating whether practices respond by repositioning rather than by improving care.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在Medicare基于相对绩效评分的支付体系中，医疗机构不仅通过改善护理来提高分数，还会通过策略性“重新定位”（在评分阈值处聚集）来获取奖励。在被纳入该体系的机构中，这一行为是未被纳入机构的2倍以上，且通过了多项稳健性检验。
AI.research_question: 当医保支付依赖于相对绩效评分时，医疗机构是否会通过策略性“重新定位”（在评分阈值处聚集）而非真正改善护理质量来提升自身排名？
AI.motivation: Medicare越来越多地使用相对绩效评分来决定对医疗机构的支付，但这种基于相对排名的机制可能诱发策略性行为——机构可能通过操纵评分位置而非真正改善护理来获得奖励，但这一点此前缺乏大规模实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对绩效评估中的策略性行为理论；激励扭曲理论；评分阈值处的“聚集效应”（bunching）理论。
AI.method: 利用Medicare价值-based支付调整计划的全国完整评分数据，以未被纳入该计划但使用相同评分公式的医疗机构为反事实对照组，通过比较两组在奖励阈值处的聚集程度来识别策略性行为。
AI.findings: 被纳入计划的医疗机构在奖励区域内的聚集程度是未被纳入计划（但使用相同评分公式）的机构的2倍以上。该差异通过了所有稳健性检验，表明这确实是策略性“重新定位”而非改善护理的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了相对绩效评估中策略性行为（而非真正改善绩效）的直接实证证据；揭示了基于阈值的激励机制可能产生预期外的扭曲效应；提出了通过评分密度检验来识别策略性行为的方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对Medicare当前每年涉及超过180亿美元的相关评分项目提出警告：应先进行评分密度检验，确认医疗机构是否通过重新定位而非改善护理来回应激励；为政策制定者设计更有效的支付激励机制提供了实证依据。

title: The Asymptotic Variance of the Sharpe Ratio Estimator under AR(1)-GARCH(1,1) Returns

detail.title: The Asymptotic Variance of the Sharpe Ratio Estimator under AR(1)-GARCH(1,1) Returns
detail.abstract: We derive a semi-closed-form expression for the asymptotic variance of the Sharpe ratio estimator when returns follow an AR(1)-GARCH(1,1) process with general innovations, combining the method of moments, a central limit theorem for strongly mixing sequences, and the delta method. The qualifier semi reflects that the odd moments of the conditional variance lack a known analytical solution and are approximated with a Taylor expansion, although we show that the error introduced is negligible. A sensitivity analysis of the asymptotic variance to its inputs is also provided, through a local one-at-a-time traversal and an axis-stratified Monte Carlo over the admissible parameter region.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了在AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)过程下夏普比率估计量渐近方差的半闭式表达式，并结合矩方法、强混合序列中心极限定理和Delta方法进行分析。
AI.research_question: 在AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)过程中，如何推导夏普比率估计量的渐近方差？
AI.motivation: 金融收益率常呈现自相关和波动率聚集特征，传统夏普比率方差估计方法未充分考虑这些特性，亟需更精确的渐近方差表达式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 矩方法、强混合序列中心极限定理、Delta方法
AI.method: 推导半闭式渐近方差表达式，采用泰勒展开近似条件方差的奇数阶矩，并通过局部单次遍历和轴分层蒙特卡洛模拟进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 得到了半闭式渐近方差表达式，泰勒展开引入的误差可忽略不计；敏感性分析揭示了各输入参数对渐近方差的影响模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)框架下推导夏普比率估计量的渐近方差，拓展了时间序列计量理论在绩效度量中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金经理和资产配置者提供了更精确的夏普比率标准误估计方法，有助于提升投资绩效评估的统计可靠性。

title: Childhood Economic Resources and Eligibility Gateways to Support Programs

detail.title: Childhood Economic Resources and Eligibility Gateways to Support Programs
detail.abstract: This working paper provides a descriptive structural analysis of support policies for low-income families with children by separating family type from economic resources and comparing eligibility gateways across programs. It does not estimate policy effects, actual take-up burdens, or causal effects on fertility. Within a narrowly defined three-type population derived from a reanalysis of Japan's 2022 Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions, income below JPY 4 million is more concentrated among mother-only households, while the estimated number of two-parent households below that level is about twice as large. These are household counts rather than counts of children, and the income measure is not equivalized for household size; JPY 4 million is a descriptive threshold rather than a poverty line. Public child-outcome tables separately report income and family-type differences, but a full three-way cross-tabulation was not identified. A meaning-unit coding of the Child-Rearing Allowance, School Expense Assistance, and JASSO grant scholarships shows nonuniform eligibility gateways. The simple hypothesis that low- income two-parent households are excluded from all programs is not supported. The remaining object of observation is the institutional seam created by shifts in eligibility units, implementing bodies, reference income periods, and application routes. Any resulting asymmetry in actual access remains a hypothesis for later research.

AI.tldr: 本文对日本低收入育儿家庭的支持政策进行了描述性结构分析，通过区分家庭类型与经济资源，比较不同项目的资格门槛，发现制度性缝隙（eligibility seam）源于资格单位、实施机构、参考收入期和申请路径的差异，而非简单地将双亲低收入家庭排除在所有项目之外。
AI.research_question: 日本针对低收入育儿家庭的支持政策，其资格门槛在不同项目之间如何分布？是否存在制度性的缝隙或不对称？
AI.motivation: 现有政策分析多关注政策效果或因果效应，但缺乏对政策资格结构本身的描述性分析。作者试图厘清不同家庭类型（尤其是单亲与双亲家庭）在多个救助项目中的资格差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度分析视角：关注资格单位、实施机构、参考收入期、申请路径等制度要素的错位所形成的"制度性缝隙"。
AI.method: 基于2022年日本《综合生活状况调查》的再分析，界定三类家庭人口；对儿童抚养津贴、学校费用援助、JASSO奖学金进行意义单元编码，比较资格门槛。
AI.findings: 1. 收入低于400万日元的家庭中，单亲母亲家庭集中度更高，但双亲家庭的数量约为前者的两倍。2. 简单假设（双亲低收入家庭被所有项目排除）不成立。3. 不同项目的资格门槛不一致，存在制度性缝隙。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"制度性缝隙"概念，强调资格单位、实施机构、参考收入期和申请路径的差异是理解政策碎片化的关键。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者注意：即使低收入双亲家庭未被明文排除，制度设计的碎片化可能导致实际获取的不对称，需进一步研究实际参与率与负担。

reference: George Mason Legal Studies Research Paper No. LS No. 26-14
title: The State Constitutional Case Against Exclusionary Zoning
affiliations: University of Wisconsin Law School and George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: The State Constitutional Case Against Exclusionary Zoning

publicationDetails.detailsText: George Mason Legal Studies Research Paper No. LS No. 26-14
publicationDetails.journalName: Antonin Scalia Law School, George Mason University Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Exclusionary zoning is the biggest cause of the housing crisis besetting many parts of the United States. This Article shows how state constitutions can be used to combat it through two complementary paths: litigation under existing constitutional provisions and constitutional amendment. It provides the first comprehensive account of state constitutional jurisprudence on exclusionary zoning across all fifty states. It finds that state courts have rarely imposed meaningful limits, but uses this body of law as a foundation for expanding constitutional protection.

Most state courts have interpreted their takings clauses in lockstep with federal doctrine, including the highly deferential Penn Central test. New York, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey have developed more aggressive approaches. But their equivocal results have led many scholars to conclude that courts have little useful role to play.

We reject that conclusion. We identify two effective and judicially administrable approaches grounded in state takings and due process doctrine. The Article also proposes state constitutional amendments that would require compensation for exclusionary zoning, categorically prohibit specified exclusionary practices, or adopt more limited reforms. Together, litigation and amendment offer a practical state constitutional strategy for addressing exclusionary zoning.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何利用州宪法通过诉讼和宪法修正两条路径来对抗排他性分区（exclusionary zoning），认为这是美国住房危机的最大原因。研究分析了全美50个州的州宪法判例，发现大多数州法院未对排他性分区施加实质性限制，但作者拒绝了"法院作用有限"的结论，提出了基于州征用条款和正当程序条款的有效司法路径，并设计了州宪法修正案方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用州宪法（通过现有宪法条款诉讼和宪法修正案两种路径）有效对抗排他性分区，解决美国住房危机？
AI.motivation: 排他性分区是美国许多地区住房危机的最大原因，但现有文献多认为法院在此问题上作用有限。作者希望证明法院可以发挥更积极的作用，并系统性地提出可行的州宪法策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 州宪法征用条款（takings clauses）、正当程序条款（due process doctrine）；排他性分区理论；联邦与州宪法解释的"锁步"（lockstep）原则；州宪法修正的政治与法律路径。
AI.method: 对全美50个州的州宪法排他性分区判例进行首次全面梳理（comprehensive account）；比较法分析各州征用条款解释的差异；提出两种有效的司法路径并分析其可操作性。
AI.findings: 多数州法院在征用条款解释上与联邦标准保持同步，采用高度服从的Penn Central测试；仅有纽约、宾夕法尼亚、新泽西等少数州发展出更激进的司法路径，但结果模棱两可；作者发现并提出了两种既有司法效力又可操作的具体路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统全面地梳理了全美50个州的排他性分区州宪法判例；发展出基于州征用和正当程序条款的有效司法路径，推翻了"法院无作用"的学术共识；提出了州宪法修正案的具体内容设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律实务者提供了可操作的州宪法诉讼策略；设计了三类州宪法修正案方案（要求补偿、明确禁止特定排他性实践、有限改革）；将诉讼与修宪相结合，形成对抗排他性分区的实践战略。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Church Diplomacy: Opportunities, Risks, and the Position of The Russian Orthodox Church
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Church Diplomacy: Opportunities, Risks, and the Position of The Russian Orthodox Church
detail.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) is reconfiguring the logic of diplomatic communication across both state and non-state actors. This paper examines the role of AI technologies in the church diplomacy of the Russian Orthodox Church (ROC), situating the analysis within the broader context of the transition from networked digital diplomacy to algorithmic diplomacy. Drawing on a comprehensive review of the ROC's digital practices, official ecclesiastical and regulatory documents, and the scholarly literature on digital diplomacy and AI ethics, the paper identifies three principal dimensions of AI's impact on diplomatic communication-automation and acceleration, targeted audience engagement, and predictive analytics-and applies this analytical framework to the specific conditions of religious diplomatic activity. The paper argues that AI offers genuine operational opportunities for the ROC in the areas of multilingual content production, media monitoring, diaspora engagement, and crisis communication, while simultaneously generating risks of a theological, ethical, and reputational character: deepfake technologies, the simulation of religious speech, the substitution of authorship, and the erosion of trust in ecclesiastical communication. The ROC's emerging position, which conceptualises AI as an instrumental tool subordinate to human spiritual responsibility rather than a substitute for authentic pastoral communication, is analysed in comparison with the approach adopted by Pope Francis and the broader Christian ecumenical discourse on AI ethics.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能如何重构俄罗斯东正教会的教会外交，分析了从网络数字外交向算法外交转型背景下AI对宗教外交沟通的三个主要影响维度：自动化与加速、精准受众触达、预测分析，并对比了与教皇方济各及基督教普世对话在AI伦理上的立场差异。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响俄罗斯东正教会的教会外交沟通？
AI.motivation: AI正在重构外交沟通逻辑，但现有研究较少关注AI对宗教行为体（尤其是教会外交）的影响，因此有必要探讨AI在俄罗斯东正教会外交中的机遇与风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从网络数字外交向算法外交转型的理论框架，以及AI伦理的神学/伦理学讨论。
AI.method: 综合综述分析，包括俄罗斯东正教会的数字实践、教会官方文件与监管文件、数字外交与AI伦理学术文献。
AI.findings: AI在三个维度影响外交沟通：自动化与加速、精准受众触达、预测分析。对ROC而言，AI在多语言内容生产、媒体监测、侨民沟通和危机沟通方面带来机遇，但同时也产生深度伪造、宗教言语模拟、作者身份替代和信任侵蚀等神学、伦理和声誉风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI与外交沟通的分析框架延伸到宗教外交领域，提出了宗教行为体在算法外交时代面临的独特伦理和神学挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宗教组织（尤其是东正教会）如何在AI时代平衡技术应用与宗教沟通的 authenticity 提供实践参考，并与天主教立场进行对比。

title: Concentrated Risk Valuation Model (CRVM)

detail.title: Concentrated Risk Valuation Model (CRVM)
detail.abstract: The Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) assumes perfect investor diversification, rendering idiosyncratic risk irrelevant to asset pricing. This assumption is structurally invalid for Private Equity (PE) sponsors, control block-holders, and concentrated alternative investment pools, who absorb one hundred percent of a target asset's total risk footprint. This paper introduces the Concentrated Risk Valuation Model (CRVM), which replaces regression-derived systematic beta with a Total Beta construct derived from raw standalone volatility ratios, integrates this into a modified Security Market Line appended with a structural illiquidity scalar, and solves a two-dimensional Gordon Growth sensitivity matrix rather than a single manipulable static value. The framework is extended through two protocol innovations. Protocol 1 restricts the concentrated cost of equity hurdle (k ce) to a backward-looking audit and calibration function, diagnosing past deal errors and calibrating the illiquidity scalar from historical outcomes. Protocol 2 replaces the static cash flow input with a dynamic Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE) construct that incorporates the acquirer's own capital structure decisions, producing a pre-deal go/no-go signal and an operational action mandate. Empirical validation proceeds across ten transactions under a strict pre-committed fixed-parameter rule. The model correctly discriminates between structural equity floor mismatches and viable acquisitions in a subset of scoreable historical cases, yielding a 50% directional hit rate. Two high-profile transactions HCA Healthcare (2006) and Hilton Hotels (2007) expose a critical structural limitation: CRVM's single-period floor cannot represent value created through multi-year debt paydown or exit-multiple recovery, misclassifying capital-intensive, growth-phase real-asset acquisitions as overpriced even when the underlying business and deal structure are highly profitable. This finding establishes clear scope-boundary conditions for the framework, demonstrating that while CRVM functions as a robust discipline for pure cash-flow-supported entry underwriting, alternative structures are required for real-estate and multiple-expansion dependent theses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出集中风险估值模型（CRVM），用总贝塔替代系统贝塔，结合流动性标量和二维戈登增长矩阵，为私募股权等集中投资者提供资产定价框架。实证发现该模型能有效识别结构性权益错配，但无法处理依赖债务偿还或退出倍数恢复的资本密集型资产，存在明确的适用范围边界。
AI.research_question: 集中投资者（如私募股权、控股股东）应如何对承担全部异质风险的非分散化资产进行估值？
AI.motivation: CAPM假设投资者完全分散化，使异质风险与资产定价无关，但这一假设对集中投资者结构无效，他们承担目标资产100%的总风险，需要新的定价框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集中风险估值模型（CRVM），包含总贝塔（Total Beta）、修正的安全市场线（带流动性标量）、二维戈登增长敏感性矩阵，以及两个协议（协议1：事后审计校准；协议2：动态FCFE前置决策信号）。
AI.method: 在严格预承诺固定参数规则下，对10笔历史交易进行实证验证，包括HCA Healthcare（2006）和Hilton Hotels（2007）等高知名度案例。
AI.findings: CRVM在可评分历史案例子集中正确区分了结构性权益错配与可行收购，方向性命中率50%。但HCA和Hilton案例暴露了其关键局限：单期定价无法捕捉多年债务偿还或退出倍数恢复创造的价值，将资本密集型增长型资产误判为定价过高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对集中投资者的总贝塔定价框架，挑战了CAPM中异质风险无关的假设；明确了CRVM的适用范围边界条件，为后续理论扩展奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权等集中投资者提供了基于纯现金流支持的入口承销纪律工具；协议1可用于事后审计和诊断历史交易错误；协议2可产生交易前的执行/放弃信号和操作行动指令。

title: Extending Quantile and Expectile Regression with Mixture Density Networks for Cryptocurrency Modelling
affiliations: , The University of Sydney and The University of Sydney

detail.title: Extending Quantile and Expectile Regression with Mixture Density Networks for Cryptocurrency Modelling
detail.abstract: Following the Market Risk Amendment to Basel I in 1996 and the Basel III reforms in 2013, Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES) have become the regulatory standards for quantifying market risk. This paper develops tail-risk modelling using a unified mixture density framework that connects quantile and expectile modelling within a single network architecture. Classical GARCH-family models are included as parametric benchmarks, and their systematic failures in the tails motivate the proposed flexible framework. Empirical results reveal that the Asymmetric Laplace (AL) distribution used for quantile models provides tail robustness and adapts well to volatile market conditions, whereas the Asymmetric Gaussian (AG) distribution produces smoother forecasts that are particularly suitable for calmer markets. Hence, an AL-AG mixture density network (MDN) is proposed with either a fixed mixing weight or a mixing weight selected on the validation set for each target level. The selected value of π balances the complementary characteristics of the two distributions at the target level. Across the empirical results, the mixture model improves extreme-quantile calibration while providing a balanced alternative to a single distributional assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一混合密度网络框架，将分位数和期望分位数建模结合，通过AL-AG混合密度网络改进极端尾部风险预测，优于单一分布假设模型。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统一的混合密度网络框架改进金融市场尾部风险建模，特别是VaR和ES的预测精度？
AI.motivation: 传统GARCH类模型在尾部系统性失效，而单一分布假设（AL或AG）各有优劣，需要一种能融合两者互补特性的灵活框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合密度网络（MDN）、非对称拉普拉斯（AL）分布、非对称高斯（AG）分布、分位数与期望分位数建模的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出AL-AG混合密度网络，包含固定混合权重和验证集自适应混合权重两种方案，以平衡AL的尾部鲁棒性和AG的平滑预测特性。
AI.findings: AL分布适应波动市场提供尾部稳健性，AG分布适合平静市场产生平滑预测；AL-AG混合模型改进了极端分位数校准，提供比单一分布更平衡的选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将分位数与期望分位数建模统一于单一网络架构中，提出混合密度框架补充传统尾部风险建模理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构及金融机构提供了更精确的市场风险度量工具，在VaR和ES计算上优于传统模型，有助于风险管理和资本配置优化。

title: Evaluating the USMCA's Rapid Response Labor Mechanism after Six Years
affiliations: Boston University - Global Development Policy Center

detail.title: Evaluating the USMCA's Rapid Response Labor Mechanism after Six Years
detail.abstract:
The Rapid Response Labor Mechanism (RRM) marks a notable break in the United States' approach to protecting labour rights through trade agreements. In contrast to the traditional US enforcement template, which addresses derogations of labour rights by a state that is party to a free trade agreement, the RRM operates at the level of the firm and facility. A firm that violates workers' rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining can face loss of preferential terms for its exports to the other markets covered by the United States Mexico Canada Agreement (USMCA) or, for repeated violations, loss of access to those markets. 
This article explores the motivations for the policy shift, reviews the experience with the RRM during its first six years, evaluates the mechanism against its objectives, and considers its future. It begins with a brief review of the economic and political developments in the US and Mexico that led to the novel labour provisions of the USMCA and RRM. The following section turns to the early experience with the new mechanism, providing an overview of the pattern of violations addressed and the outcomes, along with a profile of the sectors, ownership of firms, and petitioners involved. The fourth section discusses the logic and objectives of enforcing the labour obligations of a free trade agreement at the level of the firm and evaluates the RRM in those terms. The fifth section considers the prospects for continued use and possible replication of the RRM at a time of heightened uncertainty in US trade policy. The final section concludes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了《美国-墨西哥-加拿大协定》下快速响应劳工机制（RRM）的创新设计——将贸易协定中的劳工权利执法从国家层面下沉至企业/设施层面，并评估其六年来的成效与未来前景。
AI.research_question: 美国为何从传统的国家层面劳工权利执法转向企业层面的RRM机制？该机制六年来的实际效果如何？其未来前景和可复制性如何？
AI.motivation: 传统的自由贸易协定劳工条款执法依赖国家层面的监督机制，效率低下且难以触及具体企业的侵权行为。RRM作为一项制度创新，直接将贸易优惠与企业层面的劳工权利保障挂钩，这一政策转变的动因和效果值得深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易协定中的劳工权利执法理论、企业层面的执法逻辑、国际制度设计中的"胡萝卜加大棒"机制。
AI.method: 定性分析：回顾性案例研究，涵盖RRM前六年的违规模式、处理结果、涉案行业、企业所有权和投诉方分析，并结合美国贸易政策的不确定性进行前瞻性讨论。
AI.findings: RRM将执法单元从国家下沉到企业/设施层面，针对侵犯结社自由和集体谈判权的企业，可取消其出口优惠待遇甚至市场准入；前六年已形成一套可识别的违规模式和处理结果；但在美国贸易政策高度不确定的背景下，该机制的持续运行和复制推广面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易协定中劳工权利执法提供了"企业层面"的理论框架和实证案例，拓展了国际政治经济学中关于"逐底竞争"与劳工标准执行机制的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来贸易协定中劳工条款的设计提供了可借鉴的执法模式；对跨国企业在自由贸易区内的合规经营提出了明确警示；为政策制定者评估和优化RRM机制提供了系统性的经验证据。

title: Forced Conversion and Market Manipulation
affiliations: Peking University - School of Economics,  and Peking University

detail.title: Forced Conversion and Market Manipulation
detail.abstract: Convertible bonds give issuers a contractual route from debt to equity, but the conversion-forcing call provision may also create incentives to manipulate the underlying stock price. We study all 837 instances in which 744 Chinese convertible bonds satisfied the standard call condition between 2006 and 2025. Under this condition, the stock must close at or above 130% of the conversion price on at least 15 of 30 consecutive trading days. Underlying stocks earn significant positive industry-abnormal returns immediately before the condition is met and reverse sharply after issuers announce a call, producing a pronounced inverted-V pattern. This pattern is substantially stronger among issuers that exercise the call immediately than among those that cross the same price threshold but waive the call, helping distinguish strategic support from the mechanical run-up required to satisfy the rule. The pattern is also stronger when issuers face greater debt-service pressure, wider credit spreads, and larger gaps to the call threshold, but weaker when supporting the stock price is more costly. High-frequency evidence reinforces this interpretation: order imbalance, VPIN, average trade size, intraday volatility, and end-of-day price  manipulation all intensify near the trigger and recede afterward. An unsupervised classification approach, along with several placebo and robustness tests, corroborates these findings. Taken together, the evidence is consistent with strategic price support around conversion-forcing calls and identifies a previously underexplored moral hazard in policy design.

AI.tldr: 基于2006-2025年中国744只可转债837次触发标准赎回条件的数据，发现发行人在满足赎回条件前后存在策略性股价支撑行为，表现为显著倒V型异常收益模式，且该模式在立即执行赎回、高债务压力、宽信用利差等情境下更强，揭示了可转债强制赎回条款设计中的道德风险。
AI.research_question: 可转债强制赎回条款是否会导致发行人策略性地操纵标的股票价格？
AI.motivation: 可转债的强制赎回条款为发行人提供了从债转股的契约路径，但同时也可能创造操纵股价的激励。现有文献对此种道德风险关注不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托代理理论中的道德风险视角，分析赎回条款引发的股价操纵激励。
AI.method: 分析2006-2025年744只中国可转债837次触发标准赎回条件的事件，运用事件研究法分析异常收益模式，并通过横截面差异分析、高频证据（订单不平衡、VPIN、平均交易规模、日内波动率、收盘价操纵指标）以及无监督分类方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）标的股票在触发条件前获得显著正行业调整异常收益，发行人宣布赎回后急剧反转，呈倒V型；2）立即赎回的发行人比放弃赎回的发行人的倒V型模式更强；3）高债务压力、宽信用利差、距离赎回阈值差距大时模式更强，支撑成本高时更弱；4）高频指标（订单不平衡、VPIN等）在触发前后先增强后消退。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现了可转债强制赎回条款设计中此前未被充分探索的道德风险，为委托代理理论在可转债领域的应用提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和投资者识别可转债发行人的股价操纵行为提供了实证依据和分析工具，对可转债条款设计具有政策启示。

title: A Dynamic Measure of Economic Sentiment: Combining News and Policy
affiliations: University of Strathclyde, Glasgow - Strathclyde Business School - Department of Economics,  and University of Strathclyde - Strathclyde Business School

detail.title: A Dynamic Measure of Economic Sentiment: Combining News and Policy
detail.abstract: We develop an innovative measure of news sentiment by dynamically combining newspaper text with government policy documents. Our index is a low-cost high-frequency leading indicator which anchors sentiment to changing government policy, compared to consumer confidence surveys using interviews or newspaper text. To optimise sentiment signal extraction we use more than fourteen million news articles and thirteen thousand government policy documents. The shared vocabulary of news and policy is allowed to evolve dynamically, compared to a fixed "bag of words" approach. We identify several stylised facts from a novel proxy of UK consumer confidence. Our sentiment index broadly co-moves with existing survey-based confidence measures. The index is tightly linked to both major policy announcements and news events. There are robust predictability gains with our news sentiment measure compared to standard consumer confidence indexes.
