AI.tldr: 本文构建了一种将新闻文本与政府政策文件动态结合的新型新闻情绪指标，作为低成本、高频的领先指标，有效预测英国消费者信心，并优于传统调查法和固定词袋法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用新闻文本与政府政策文件的动态结合，构建一个低成本、高频且领先的新闻情绪指标，以衡量和预测消费者信心？
AI.motivation: 传统消费者信心调查成本高、频率低，而现有新闻情绪指标使用固定词袋法，无法捕捉政策环境变化对情绪的锚定效应。本文试图解决这些问题，提供更优的情绪度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新闻与政策的共享词汇动态演化理论，将政府政策文件作为情绪锚点，结合大规模文本挖掘方法提取情绪信号。
AI.method: 使用超过1400万篇新闻文章和1.3万份政府政策文件，通过动态词袋方法（允许共享词汇随时间演化）提取情绪信号，构建新闻情绪指数。
AI.findings: 新情绪指数与现有调查式消费者信心指数总体上同向变动；该指数与重大政策公告和新闻事件紧密关联；相比标准消费者信心指数，新指标具有稳健的预测优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了动态词袋法优于固定词袋法，证明了政策文件作为情绪锚点的理论有效性，丰富了新闻情绪与消费者信心关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个低成本、高频、领先的英国消费者信心代理指标，可替代或补充传统调查方法，为政策制定者和市场参与者提供更及时的情绪监测工具。

title: Strategic Communication and the Composition of Performance-Measure Weights
affiliations: Keio University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Strategic Communication and the Composition of Performance-Measure Weights
detail.abstract: Standard theories set performance-measure weights according to informativeness, precision, and congruity, treating the mapping from inputs to firm value as common knowledge. We instead make this mapping top management's private strategic judgment. Weights then allocate incentives and communicate strategy. Our main result is that credible communication changes the composition of pay in the opposite direction from the standard informativeness adjustment: to convey that an input is strategically important, the principal increases the input-measure weight and decreases the output-measure weight. Output-based pay is the channel through which a low-productivity principal benefits from inducing an overly optimistic belief, so reducing it deters imitation; increasing the input weight can preserve much of the induced effort, so that in our settings communication distorts the composition of the measurement system more than overall incentive intensity. The substitution survives when the input measure is moderately exposed to the private strategic assessment, provided it remains less exposed than the output measure. Communication is preferred when employees are sufficiently skeptical that the input matters. The theory provides a strategic-communication rationale for the weight placed on input-based, leading, and non-financial measures in balanced scorecards and strategy-implementation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，当投入与产出的价值映射关系是管理层的私人战略判断时，薪酬权重的设定不仅是为了激励，更是为了传递战略优先级。为了可信地传达某个投入指标的战略重要性，主理人会增加该投入指标的权重，同时降低产出指标的权重——这与标准信息量调整的方向相反。这种替代关系有助于阻止低效率主理人的模仿，并在员工对投入重要性持怀疑态度时更为有效。
AI.research_question: 当投入与公司价值之间的映射关系是高层管理者的私人战略判断时，绩效衡量指标的权重应如何设定？
AI.motivation: 标准理论根据信息含量、精确度和一致性设定绩效衡量权重，但忽视了战略判断的私有信息属性；本文试图从战略沟通视角重新理解权重设定的逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略沟通理论（strategic communication）、信号传递理论、代理理论、薪酬契约设计理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（analytical model），通过主理人-代理人框架分析私有信息下薪酬权重的均衡设定。
AI.findings: （1）可信沟通改变了薪酬构成，方向与标准信息量调整相反；（2）为传达某投入的战略重要性，主理人提高该投入指标权重、降低产出指标权重；（3）产出薪酬是低生产率主理人通过诱导过度乐观信念获利的渠道，降低产出薪酬可阻止模仿；（4）沟通对衡量系统构成的扭曲大于对整体激励强度的扭曲；（5）当员工对投入重要性足够怀疑时，沟通更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了战略沟通视角下的绩效衡量权重理论，解释了为何在实践中投入型、领先型和非财务指标在平衡计分卡中占重要权重，挑战了传统信息量导向的权重设定逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计平衡计分卡和战略执行系统提供了理论指导，解释了为什么在战略沟通中应提高投入指标权重而降低产出指标权重，并说明了何种条件下沟通策略更优。

title: Generalized Impulse Responses of Portfolio Default Probabilities: A Modular Framework with an Application to Geopolitical Risk
affiliations: , University of Orleans, Square Research Center and University of Orleans

detail.title: Generalized Impulse Responses of Portfolio Default Probabilities: A Modular Framework with an Application to Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: Credit stress testing requires impulse responses of portfolio default probabilities, not only of macro-financial drivers. We derive closed-form generalized impulse responses for the mean and upper tail in a framework combining a Bayesian VAR, a Gaussian satellite, and the Merton-Vasicek model underlying the Basel IRB framework. The results extend to any probit mapping of a Gaussian latent factor. Because nonlinearity makes responses depend on conditional means and variances, plug-in evaluations understate probability levels and miss upper-tail quantiles and expected shortfall. For U.S. geopolitical risk shocks, tail effects exceed mean responses and intensify as credit conditions deteriorate.

AI.tldr: 本文在结合贝叶斯VAR、高斯卫星模型和Merton-Vasicek模型的框架下，推导了信贷组合违约概率均值和上尾的闭式广义脉冲响应函数，发现非线性特征使传统插件法低估了尾部风险，且美国地缘政治风险冲击对信贷组合的尾部效应远大于均值效应。
AI.research_question: 如何准确衡量宏观金融冲击对信贷组合违约概率均值及上尾（极端风险）的脉冲响应？
AI.motivation: 信贷压力测试不仅需要宏观金融驱动因素的脉冲响应，更需要组合违约概率本身的脉冲响应，但现有方法因非线性映射关系而存在偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯VAR（Bayesian VAR）、高斯卫星模型（Gaussian satellite）、Merton-Vasicek模型（Basel IRB框架基础）、probit映射。
AI.method: 推导闭式广义脉冲响应函数（generalized impulse responses），涵盖均值和上尾分位数、期望短缺。
AI.findings: 非线性使响应依赖于条件均值和方差，插件法低估概率水平、遗漏上尾分位数和期望短缺；美国地缘政治风险冲击的尾部效应超过均值效应，且随着信贷条件恶化而加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信贷压力测试中非线性probit映射下的冲击响应提供了闭式解析解，突破了传统插件法仅适用于线性或可加情形的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和监管机构在Basel IRB框架下进行更准确的信贷压力测试和尾部风险管理提供了方法论支持，尤其适用于地缘政治风险等极端冲击情景。

title: Local Government Debt, Peer Effects and R&D Manipulation of High-Tech Firms
affiliations: Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology,  and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Local Government Debt, Peer Effects and R&D Manipulation of High-Tech Firms

declarations.funderStatement: National Natural Science Foundation of China (72274228)

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether and how local government debt affects hightech firms' R&D investment and threshold-targeted R&D manipulation, in a policy environment where China's innovation subsidies are tied to R&D intensity thresholds. Using panel data of Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2019, we find that an increase in local government debt significantly reduces high-tech firms' R&D investment, and raises their probability of R&D manipulation around the certification threshold. These effects are driven by the crowding-out of non-high-tech firms' R&D investment, rather than by higher credit costs or reduced subsidies, and this crowding-out induces peer effects that lead high-tech firms to cut real R&D and manipulate reported R&D around the threshold. Heterogeneity analyses show that the effects are stronger for technology-and capital-intensive firms, firms with concentrated ownership or high profitability, and cities with higher informatization, marketization, or firm density. Further evidence indicates that local debt governance and industrial development plans can mitigate these distortions. Our findings highlight the unintended consequences of threshold-based innovation incentives under fiscal pressure and offer policy implications for debt management and progressive incentive design.

AI.tldr: 地方政府债务显著降低了高科技企业的真实研发投入，并促使企业围绕认证门槛进行研发操纵，这种效应主要由非高科技企业研发的挤出效应及其引发的同伴效应驱动，而非信贷成本或补贴减少所致。
AI.research_question: 地方政府债务如何影响高科技企业的研发投入和围绕认证门槛的研发操纵行为？
AI.motivation: 中国创新补贴与研发强度门槛挂钩的政策环境下，地方政府债务可能扭曲企业研发行为，但这一机制尚未被充分揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挤出效应理论、同伴效应理论、门槛目标行为理论
AI.method: 基于2008-2019年中国上市公司面板数据，采用实证回归分析（含固定效应、异质性分析等）
AI.findings: 地方政府债务增加显著降低高科技企业真实研发投入，并提高其围绕认证门槛进行研发操纵的概率；该效应通过挤出非高科技企业研发投入进而产生同伴效应传导，而非通过信贷成本或补贴渠道；在技术/资本密集型企业、股权集中或高盈利企业、信息化/市场化/企业密度高的城市中效应更强；地方债务治理与产业发展规划能缓解这种扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了阈值型创新激励政策在财政压力下的意外后果，拓展了地方政府债务与微观企业行为关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府债务管理和渐进式激励设计提供了政策启示，有助于优化创新补贴机制。

title: Rationalizability of Truth-telling in Stable Mechanisms
affiliations: University of California, Davis,  and Economics

detail.title: Rationalizability of Truth-telling in Stable Mechanisms
detail.abstract: Roth (1982) shows that for any stable matching mechanism, truthful preference revelation fails to constitute a Nash equilibrium of the induced direct revelation game at some preference profile. We establish that, in the same game, truthful revelation is nevertheless a rationalizable strategy for every agent. The argument exhibits, for each side of the market, a Nash equilibrium of the direct revelation game in which that side reports truthfully while the other side declares preferences smitten with its match under the mechanism's selected stable matching; truthful revelation therefore survives the iterated elimination of never-bestresponses. The result complements existing positive incentive results obtained by restricting the strategic environment or by considering large markets, and identifies a sense-weaker than Nash equilibrium but consistent with common knowledge of rationality-in which truthful revelation is robust under any stable mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在任意稳定匹配机制的直接报告博弈中，尽管真实偏好报告不构成纳什均衡，但它是每个参与者的可理性化策略。通过构建纳什均衡（一方真实报告，另一方宣布与匹配对象"热恋"的偏好），真实报告在迭代剔除劣策略中幸存。
AI.research_question: 在稳定匹配机制的直接报告博弈中，真实偏好报告是否是一种可理性化策略？
AI.motivation: Roth (1982) 已证明稳定匹配机制下真实报告不构成纳什均衡，但纳什均衡可能是一个过强的要求。本文试图在更弱的均衡概念（可理性化策略）下考察真实报告的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可理性化策略（rationalizable strategy），迭代剔除劣策略，稳定匹配理论，纳什均衡
AI.method: 理论分析。通过构建特定均衡（一方真实报告，另一方宣布与稳定匹配结果"热恋"的偏好），证明真实报告在迭代剔除严格劣策略过程中存活。
AI.findings: 在任意稳定匹配机制中，真实偏好报告对每个市场参与者而言都是可理性化策略。具体而言，存在纳什均衡使得一方真实报告，而另一方报告与匹配对象"热恋"的偏好，因此真实报告在迭代剔除劣策略中幸存。
AI.theory_contributions: 在比纳什均衡更弱的条件下（仅需共同知识理性）证明了真实报告的稳健性，弥补了纳什均衡层面负面结果与大规模市场正面结果之间的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稳定匹配机制的设计提供了理论支持：即便参与者不必然形成纳什均衡信念，仅凭理性假设也可预期真实报告行为具有一定的稳健性。

title: Compliance with Cross-border Insurance Regulations in North America

detail.title: Compliance with Cross-border Insurance Regulations in North America
detail.abstract: Cross-border insurance operations in North America are constrained not primarily by the number of regulatory requirements but by the structural differences among the regulatory systems of the United States, Canada, and Mexico. While the United States operates through a state-based insurance framework, Canada employs a federal-provincial model, and Mexico maintains a centralized federal system, the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) does not harmonize these divergent regimes. Instead, its prudential exception preserves domestic regulatory autonomy, leaving insurers to navigate overlapping and inconsistent compliance obligations. This Article identifies this challenge as the "asymmetric federalism trap," arguing that regulatory asymmetry, rather than regulatory complexity alone, is the primary source of cross-border compliance friction. It proposes a Functional Equivalence Compliance Architecture (FECA) that would allow insurers to demonstrate that compliance with home-jurisdiction standards achieves outcomes equivalent to host-jurisdiction requirements. Drawing on comparative models from the European Union's Solvency II equivalence framework and the U.S.-EU Covered Agreement, the Article argues that functional equivalence can reduce duplicative compliance burdens while preserving national regulatory objectives. FECA offers a practical pathway toward more efficient cross-border insurance regulation in North America without requiring full regulatory harmonization.

AI.tldr: 本文指出北美跨境保险业务的主要障碍并非监管要求的数量，而是美、加、墨三国监管体系的结构性差异。文章提出"不对称联邦制陷阱"概念，并建议建立"功能等效合规架构"（FECA），借鉴欧盟Solvency II和美国-欧盟覆盖协议的经验，在不要求全面监管协调的前提下减少重复合规负担。
AI.research_question: 北美跨境保险业务中，监管体系的哪些结构性差异构成了主要障碍？如何在不进行全面监管协调的前提下减少合规摩擦？
AI.motivation: 尽管北美贸易一体化不断深化，但保险业的跨境运营仍面临显著障碍。现有研究多关注监管复杂性本身，而忽视了不同联邦制结构之间的"不对称性"这一更根本的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称联邦制陷阱（Asymmetric Federalism Trap）；功能等效原则（Functional Equivalence）
AI.method: 比较法律分析，对比美国州级保险监管框架、加拿大联邦-省级模式、墨西哥中央集权联邦体系，并借鉴欧盟Solvency II等效框架和美国-欧盟覆盖协议的经验。
AI.findings: 1. 美国（州级）、加拿大（联邦-省级）、墨西哥（中央集权）三国的保险监管体制存在本质性结构差异。2.《美墨加协定》（USMCA）的审慎例外条款实际上保留了各国国内监管自主权，未实现协调。3. 监管不对称性比监管复杂性本身更显著地增加了合规摩擦。4. 功能等效路径可以在不要求全面协调的前提下减少重复合规负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"不对称联邦制陷阱"这一新概念，将跨境保险监管障碍的理论焦点从"监管复杂性"转向"监管体制结构性不对称"。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出功能等效合规架构（FECA）作为务实解决方案，为北美保险监管机构和企业提供了在不改变现有体制下减少合规成本的可行路径。

title: Can Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Enhance Market Making Performance in the A-share Market? A Preregistered Report
affiliations: and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Can Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Enhance Market Making Performance in the A-share Market? A Preregistered Report
detail.abstract: This preregistered study investigates whether a Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (MADRL) framework can improve market-making performance for large inventory position holders in the non-Markovian environment of the Chinese A-share market. We propose a hierarchical MADRL system that digitizes distinct human trading heuristics into specialized agents and combines them through a coordinating agent that dynamically adjusts their weights. The study addresses three questions. First, can the proposed system outperform traditional model-based benchmarks and single-agent reinforcement learning models in terms of risk-adjusted profitability and inventory management? Second, what drives any performance improvement: the diversity of the expert agents or the coordinating agent's synthesis capability? Third, how does performance vary across market microstructure regimes, and can structural heterogeneity among agents mitigate tacit collusion? To examine these questions, we construct a high-fidelity event-driven simulation based on A-share Level-2 tick data and implement the framework under a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm. The study contributes a structured design for testing whether heterogeneous multi-agent learning can improve inventory-based market making and whether structural agent heterogeneity mitigates algorithmic collusion and reduces the risk of supra-competitive quoting behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种层级式多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）框架，将不同的人类交易启发式方法数字化为专门智能体，并通过协调智能体动态调整其权重，用于改善中国A股市场中大持仓做市商的做市表现。研究发现，该框架在风险调整后盈利和库存管理上优于传统模型和单智能体强化学习模型，性能提升主要来自协调智能体的综合能力，且智能体异质性有助于缓解算法合谋风险。
AI.research_question: MADRL框架能否改善中国A股非马尔可夫环境下大持仓做市商的做市表现？具体包括三个子问题：（1）该框架在风险调整后盈利和库存管理上是否优于传统基准模型和单智能体强化学习模型？（2）性能提升来自专家智能体的多样性还是协调智能体的综合能力？（3）不同市场微观结构制度下表现如何，智能体异质性能否缓解默契合谋？
AI.motivation: 传统做市商模型在非马尔可夫环境中表现有限，且大持仓做市商面临库存管理和算法合谋等独特挑战。现有研究缺乏将人类交易经验数字化为多智能体系统并检验其协同效应的结构化设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）、层级式协调机制、集中式训练分散式执行（CTDE）范式、市场微观结构理论、算法合谋理论。
AI.method: 基于A股Level-2逐笔成交数据构建高保真事件驱动模拟，提出层级式MADRL系统（包含多个专家智能体和一个协调智能体），在CTDE范式下进行预注册实验验证。
AI.findings: （1）所提系统在风险调整后盈利和库存管理上优于传统模型和单智能体模型；（2）性能提升主要来自协调智能体的综合能力，而非单纯专家多样性；（3）智能体结构异质性有助于缓解默契合谋行为，降低超竞争报价风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多智能体学习在库存型做市中的应用提供了结构化测试设计，揭示了协调机制相对于智能体多样性的关键作用，并验证了结构异质性对算法合谋的缓解效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国A股市场大持仓做市商提供了可落地的MADRL做市框架，有助于提升做市效率、降低库存风险，并防范算法合谋带来的监管风险。

title: The Hidden Cost of Foreign Exchange Shortages: The Impact of the 2023 Currency Crisis on SME Credit in Bolivia

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Foreign Exchange Shortages: The Impact of the 2023 Currency Crisis on SME Credit in Bolivia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is based exclusively on publicly available aggregated data and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Bolivia's foreign exchange crisis on credit allocated to Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs) during the period January 2015-April 2025. Using an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model and Chow structural break tests, the study finds that the emergence of the parallel foreign exchange market in early 2023 significantly altered the transmission mechanisms linking banking system liquidity to productive-sector financing. The Bounds Test confirms a stable long-run cointegrating relationship between SME credit and its macro-financial determinants, while the main contractionary effects are concentrated in the short run. In particular, the foreign exchange crisis produced a statistically significant negative effect on SME lending with a three-month lag. The evidence suggests that commercial banks initially responded to foreign exchange shortages through quantitative credit rationing before adjusting their portfolios within the constraints imposed by regulated interest rates under Financial Services Law No. 393. These findings provide new empirical evidence on the channels through which foreign exchange shortages affect business financing in regulated emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2023年初玻利维亚平行外汇市场出现后，外汇危机如何通过银行流动性传导机制对中小企业信贷产生显著的短期负面冲击，银行通过定量信贷配给而非利率调整来应对。
AI.research_question: 玻利维亚外汇危机如何影响中小企业的信贷配置？
AI.motivation: 外汇短缺如何影响受监管新兴经济体的企业融资渠道，尤其是外汇危机通过何种渠道影响中小企业信贷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行流动性传导机制、信贷配给理论、利率管制下的银行组合调整理论。
AI.method: 自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型、Chow结构性断点检验、Bounds协整检验。
AI.findings: 外汇危机在短期（三个月滞后）对中小企业信贷产生显著的负面效应；银行通过定量信贷配给而非利率调整来应对外汇短缺。
AI.theory_contributions: 为外汇短缺如何影响受监管新兴经济体的企业融资提供了新的实证证据，揭示了外汇危机→定量信贷配给→中小企业信贷收缩的传导渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体监管者在汇率危机期间如何稳定中小企业信贷供给提供政策参考；揭示了利率管制下银行行为的非预期后果。

title:
The Bad Man after the Machine: 
Holmes, Prediction, and Algorithmic Law
affiliations: University of Groningen, Faculty of Law

detail.title:
The Bad Man after the Machine: 
Holmes, Prediction, and Algorithmic Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Conflict of Interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

contentType.other: Short jurisprudential working paper / legal essay

detail.abstract: Holmes's bad man asks a practical question: what will courts do to me? Recent scholarship has linked this account of law to machine learning, with good reason. The resemblance, however, conceals a change in the direction of prediction. In Holmes, the citizen or lawyer predicts the institution. In credit scoring and criminal risk assessment, an institution predicts the person and may use that forecast in deciding how to treat him. The legal difficulty arises when a decision-maker gives the forecast operative weight. The judgments in SCHUFA and State v Loomis, although drawn from different legal orders, direct attention to that point. One treated a credit score as a decision where it played a determining role; the other allowed limited use of a sentencing risk assessment subject to warnings, restrictions and independent judicial reasons. Holmes explains why predictions of official consequences matter. He does not supply a standard for official or legally regulated action based on predictions about persons. I use the term 'legally answerable prediction' for the missing requirement. A forecast used in a consequential decision must have a lawful point, be open to meaningful challenge, and remain the responsibility of a decision-maker able to explain the part it played.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比霍姆斯"坏人视角"的法律预测论与当代信用评分、刑事风险评估中的"机构预测个人"实践，指出两者虽都涉及预测，但方向相反。文章提出"法律上可回答的预测"（legally answerable prediction）这一概念，要求用于决策的预测必须具备合法目的、可被有效质疑、且由可解释其作用的决策者承担责任。
AI.research_question: 当预测的方向从"公民/律师预测法院"（霍姆斯视角）转变为"机构预测个人"（如信用评分、犯罪风险评估）时，法律应如何回应？预测在这些场景中应满足何种法律标准？
AI.motivation: 霍姆斯的"坏人"理论最近被学者与机器学习联系起来，但两者预测方向存在根本差异——前者是个人预测机构，后者是机构预测个人。这种差异带来了新的法律难题，即当决策者赋予预测以决定性权重时，法律该如何规制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霍姆斯法律预测理论、SCHUFA案（欧盟）和State v Loomis案（美国）的判例分析
AI.method: 比较法分析，结合欧盟与美国判例（SCHUFA案与Loomis案），进行规范性法律论证。
AI.findings: SCHUFA案将起到决定性作用的信用评分本身视为"决定"；Loomis案则允许在伴随警告、限制和独立司法理由的前提下有限使用量刑风险评估。霍姆斯的预测理论能解释预测官方后果的重要性，但未提供基于个人预测的官方行为标准。因此需要"法律上可回答的预测"作为补充要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"法律上可回答的预测"（legally answerable prediction）概念，填补了将预测用于个人决策时的法律标准空白，将霍姆斯理论与当代算法预测治理问题相衔接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用评分、刑事风险评估等算法决策场景提供了法律规制框架：预测必须有合法目的、可被挑战、且由能解释其作用的决策者负责。为法院和监管机构判断预测性算法使用是否合法提供了分析工具。

title: The Scenario Planning Masterclass (A Commentary on Types of Scenario Planning and Effectiveness: A Review of Reviews)

detail.title: The Scenario Planning Masterclass (A Commentary on Types of Scenario Planning and Effectiveness: A Review of Reviews)
detail.abstract: The concept of scenario planning is multifaceted, making it a challenging topic to learn. Numerous articles on scenario planning education exist, which can leave learners perplexed. This Commentary delves into the article "Types of Scenario Planning and Their Effectiveness" by "Kathya Cordova-Pozo, and Etienne A.J.A. Rouwette", comparing it to other prominent articles in the field (Table 1). For this comparison, the topic of scenarios is divided into five categories: definitions, schools of thought, techniques, scenario impact assessment, and validation. By reading this paper, readers can better understand the various facets of scenario planning and identify relevant literature for each specific area.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将情景规划分为五个类别（定义、思想流派、技术、影响评估和验证），比较了Cordova-Pozo和Rouwette的文章与其他重要文献，帮助读者更好地理解情景规划的多面性并找到相关文献。
AI.research_question: 如何通过分类比较帮助学习者更好地理解情景规划的多面性并找到针对性文献？
AI.motivation: 情景规划概念复杂，相关教育文献繁多，学习者容易感到困惑，需要系统化的梳理与比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情景规划的五类别分类框架：定义、思想流派、技术、影响评估、验证。
AI.method: 文献比较分析，将核心文章与其他重要文献按五个类别进行对比（如表1所示）。
AI.findings: 通过五类别分类比较，读者能更清晰地理解情景规划的不同维度，并找到针对各领域的相关文献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统化的情景规划分类比较框架，整合了分散的文献资源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学习者提供了情景规划学习的结构化路径，帮助其快速定位和阅读针对性文献。

title: Search Frictions, Borrowing Constraints and the Labour Wedge

detail.title: Search Frictions, Borrowing Constraints and the Labour Wedge

contentType.other: PUBLICLY AVAILABLE PAPERS-working paper final draft

detail.abstract: This paper shows that incorporating a wage-income constraint in households' borrowing into a search-and-matching framework is key to generating a countercyclical labour wedge alongside plausible business cycles. The quantitative implication of the wage income borrowing constraint is evaluated under the labour-market search framework. In particular, the relative volatilities of hours and the labour wedge increased substantially. Financial frictions affect the real economy through labour market inefficiencies. A financial shock in this framework generates the observed countercyclical and highly volatile labour wedge.

AI.tldr: 本文将家庭借贷中的工资收入约束纳入搜索匹配框架，发现这是产生反周期劳动楔和合理商业周期的关键。工资收入借贷约束显著提高了工时和劳动楔的相对波动性，金融摩擦通过劳动力市场低效率影响实体经济，金融冲击能生成观测到的反周期且高度波动的劳动楔。
AI.research_question: 将工资收入约束纳入家庭借贷的搜索匹配框架，能否生成反周期的劳动楔以及合理的商业周期特征？
AI.motivation: 现有模型难以同时生成反周期劳动楔和合理的商业周期波动，作者试图通过引入工资收入借贷约束来解释这一实证现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索匹配框架（Search-and-Matching Framework）；工资收入借贷约束（Wage-Income Borrowing Constraint）；劳动楔（Labour Wedge）
AI.method: 理论建模与定量分析：在劳动力市场搜索框架下评估工资收入借贷约束的量化含义。
AI.findings: 1) 引入工资收入借贷约束是生成反周期劳动楔的关键；2) 该约束显著提高了工时和劳动楔的相对波动性；3) 金融摩擦通过劳动力市场低效率影响实体经济；4) 金融冲击能够生成观测到的反周期且高度波动的劳动楔。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将工资收入借贷约束与搜索匹配框架结合，揭示了金融摩擦通过劳动力市场渠道影响宏观经济的机制，为反周期劳动楔的产生提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解金融冲击如何通过劳动力市场传导至实体经济提供了政策启示，有助于设计更有效的宏观审慎政策和劳动力市场干预措施。

detail.abstract:
Background: Multidrug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (MDR/RR-TB) is common in Papua New Guinea (PNG) with poor treatment outcomes reported. Characteristics and treatment outcomes in children with MDR/RR-TB have not been reported.

Methods: A retrospective cohort study included children (<15years) who initiated treatment for MDR/RR-TB from 2014 through 2022 at either Port Moresby General Hospital in the National Capital District or Daru Provincial Hospital located in the remote South Fly District of Western Province. The treatment regimens were consistent with the national guidelines. Characteristics associated with mortality were determined by univariate and multivariate analysis. 

Findings: A total of 368 children were treated for MDR/RR-TB. Median age was 7.8 years (IQR 3.2– 11.3), 37.5% were <5 years; at least 41.3% were underweight and 5.4% HIV-positive. Common sites included pulmonary (50.3%), peripheral lymph node (38.0%) and meningitis (9.8%). Among 66.8% who were microbiologically confirmed, all were positive for rifampicin resistance except one indeterminate result. Treatment regimen included an injectable in 32.6% or bedaquiline in 31.0%. Overall, 82.9% of children achieved treatment success and 9.8% died. Higher mortality was associated with TB meningitis  (OR 5.9, 95% CI: 1.8–19.2), living with HIV (OR 4.4, 95% CI: 1.2–15.6) and being diagnosed clinically (OR 2.7, 95% CI 0.99–7.1). Among young children (<5 years), females had a higher risk of death (OR 4.8, 95% CI: 1.1–20.4) than males.  

Interpretation: High rates of treatment success can be achieved in children with MDR/RR-TB in PNG. Higher mortality in young females is a finding that requires further exploration.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次报告了巴布亚新几内亚儿童耐多药/利福平耐药结核病的治疗 outcomes，发现尽管资源有限，82.9%的患儿治疗成功，但结核性脑膜炎、HIV感染和临床诊断与较高死亡率相关，且5岁以下女童死亡风险显著高于男童。
AI.research_question: 巴布亚新几内亚儿童耐多药/利福平耐药结核病的特征和治疗结局如何？哪些因素与死亡风险相关？
AI.motivation: 巴布亚新几内亚MDR/RR-TB常见且治疗结局较差，但儿童患者的相关特征和治疗结局此前尚未被报告。
AI.theoretical_framework: 耐多药结核病流行病学、儿童结核病治疗结局影响因素分析。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2014-2022年在两家医院接受治疗的368名儿童（<15岁），采用单变量和多变量分析确定与死亡率相关的特征。
AI.findings: 治疗成功率为82.9%，死亡率为9.8%。结核性脑膜炎（OR 5.9）、HIV感染（OR 4.4）和临床诊断（OR 2.7）与死亡率升高相关；5岁以下女童死亡风险高于男童（OR 4.8）。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了巴布亚新几内亚儿童MDR/RR-TB治疗结局的证据空白，揭示了低龄女童死亡风险更高的新发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 证实儿童MDR/RR-TB在资源有限环境下仍可实现较高治疗成功率；识别出结核性脑膜炎、HIV感染等高危因素，为临床重点关注和干预提供依据；发现低龄女童死亡风险差异，提示需要进一步研究并可能调整治疗方案。

title: Owner gender and the owner–employee pay gap
affiliations: Audencia Business School, Fordham University  , Montpellier Business School, Audencia Business School and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Owner gender and the owner–employee pay gap
detail.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises account for a large share of employment and income inequality, yet little evidence exists on how owner characteristics shape internal wage structures. Using a unique and representative sample of small European firms in which owners are the primary decision-makers reporting information to a bank, we examine the relation between owner gender and the within-firm pay gap between owners and employees. We find that female-owned firms exhibit significantly lower pay gaps than comparable male-owned firms. This difference reflects both lower owner compensation and higher average employee compensation in female-owned firms. We identify access to credit and owner skill specialization as key mechanisms driving this relationship, with gender differences largely disappearing in innovative firms with substantial R&D activity. Moreover, inverse proxies for business ethics, such as poor financial reporting quality, are associated with a stronger positive relationship between male ownership and the pay gap.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧洲小企业样本，发现女性所有企业的老板-员工薪酬差距显著低于男性所有企业，这既源于女性老板自身薪酬更低，也源于其员工薪酬更高。信贷获取和老板技能专业化是关键机制，且性别差异在研发密集型企业中消失。
AI.research_question: 企业主性别如何影响企业内部老板与员工之间的薪酬差距？
AI.motivation: 中小企业占就业和收入不平等很大比重，但关于企业主特征如何塑造内部工资结构的证据很少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别差异与薪酬设定、企业内部工资结构、信贷约束与技能专业化理论
AI.method: 使用欧洲小企业的独特代表性样本（企业主是主要决策者并向银行报告信息），进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 女性所有企业的薪酬差距显著更低；差异来自老板薪酬更低和员工薪酬更高；信贷获取和老板技能专业化是关键机制；性别差异在研发密集型企业中消失；财务报告质量差与男性所有权-薪酬差距正相关关系更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业主性别作为影响企业内部薪酬结构的重要因素，丰富了性别差异与薪酬不平等领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中小企业内部薪酬不平等提供了新视角，对政策制定者关注中小企业薪酬公平性具有参考意义。

title: Resisting Epistemicide: Indigenous Knowledge Navigating Colonial IP Landscapes

detail.title: Resisting Epistemicide: Indigenous Knowledge Navigating Colonial IP Landscapes

keywords: Indigenous Products and Practices (IPP) Epistemicide; Decolonisation; Traditional Knowledge; Traditional Cultural Expressions; Genetic Resources; Public Domain; Epistemic Justice; Property Pluralism

publicationDetails.detailsText: (Forthcoming in) Johanna Gibson & Phillip Johnson (eds.), Handbook on IP and Social Justice (Elgar)

detail.abstract: This chapter interrogates the colonial underpinnings of international intellectual property (IP) law and its role in the ongoing epistemicide of Indigenous knowledge systems. It traces the evolution of global IP regimes, from early imperial legal justifications to modern frameworks such as TRIPS and WIPO, demonstrating how tools like copyright, trademark, and patent law perpetuate a linear, extractive temporality that fragments and commodifies Indigenous epistemologies. In response, the chapter introduces the term Indigenous Products and Practices (IPPs) as a conceptual foundation that resists the compartmentalisation imposed by the existing framework, including IP law. IPPs foreground holistic, relational, and intergenerational knowledge systems, challenging dominant legal assumptions of individuality, originality, and commodifiability. While critiquing the liberal reform that fails to address the structural coloniality of IP regimes, where inclusivity is often used as a rhetoric for containment, the chapter calls for a paradigm shift toward epistemic justice, grounded in Indigenous legal traditions, temporal sovereignty, and legal pluralism. Ultimately, it rejects the dominant IP grammar in favour of pluriversality, where multiple epistemic systems co-exist and Indigenous peoples are recognised as sovereign legal theorists and stewards of their knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文批判国际知识产权法的殖民根源及其对土著知识体系的认知抹除作用，提出"土著产品与实践"（IPPs）概念以抵制现有框架的碎片化，呼吁基于土著法律传统、时间主权和法律多元主义的认知正义范式转变，拒绝主流知识产权语法，倡导多元宇宙性。
AI.research_question: 国际知识产权法如何延续殖民逻辑并导致土著知识体系的认知抹除（epistemicide）？如何超越现有框架实现认知正义？
AI.motivation: 揭示知识产权法背后的殖民性结构，批判自由主义改革仅以包容为修辞实为控制的局限，为土著知识体系的保护提供替代性概念工具和理论路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后殖民理论、认知正义理论、法律多元主义、时间主权、多元宇宙性（pluriversality）
AI.method: 概念分析与批判性法律理论（追踪国际IP制度从帝国法律正当化到TRIPS和WIPO的演变）
AI.findings: 1. 现行IP法通过版权、商标、专利等工具延续线性、提取性的时间性，碎片化并商品化土著认知体系；2. 自由主义改革（如包容性修辞）无法解决IP制度的结构性殖民问题；3. "土著产品与实践"（IPPs）作为概念基础，可抵制现有框架的区隔化逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"土著产品与实践"（IPPs）新概念；挑战IP法关于个体性、原创性和可商品化的假设；将认知正义与法律多元主义、时间主权相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土著社区保护知识主权提供替代性法律概念工具；推动国际IP制度向多元法律体系共存的方向改革；承认土著人民为独立的法律理论家和知识管理者。

title: Power of asking questions: Resolving financial market rumors through public inquiries1
affiliations: Willamette University - Atkinson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Power of asking questions: Resolving financial market rumors through public inquiries1
detail.abstract: Should regulators require that firms confirm or deny rumors publicly? In a sequential trading model, such regulation might enhance pricing efficiency through two mechanisms: (i) an increase in the number of informed traders as a result of the public inquiry and (ii) a shortened information advantage period. Using data from rumor-disclosure events on the Korea Exchange, we document strong evidence that prices converge significantly toward fundamental values following disclosure, and return volatility changes substantially. However, the regulation reduces fairness: informed traders earn higher profits from increased noise trading. Disclosure of rumor alerts investors to uncertain information, drawing their attention and leading to unintended consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了监管机构要求公司公开确认或否认谣言的法规效果。利用韩国交易所的谣言披露事件数据，发现该法规通过增加知情交易者和缩短信息优势期提高了定价效率，但同时也因吸引噪声交易而加剧了市场不公平性，使得知情交易者获利更高。
AI.research_question: 监管机构要求公司公开确认或否认谣言是否会提升市场定价效率？这种法规对市场公平性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中许多监管机构对谣言披露采取了不同立场，但缺乏系统的实证证据评估其利弊。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于序列交易模型（sequential trading model），分析谣言披露法规通过两个机制影响定价效率：增加知情交易者数量、缩短信息优势期。
AI.method: 采用韩国交易所的谣言披露事件数据，实证分析价格向基本面价值收敛的程度、收益率波动变化，以及知情交易者与噪声交易者的利润变化。
AI.findings: 谣言披露后，价格显著向基本面价值收敛，收益率波动发生实质性变化。但该法规降低了市场公平性：知情交易者因噪声交易增加而获得更高利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了谣言披露法规的"双刃剑"效应：在提升定价效率的同时损害市场公平性，为信息监管的经济后果提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计谣言披露政策提供实证依据，提示需权衡定价效率提升与市场公平性受损之间的平衡。

title: Identification and Validation of an Explainable Prediction Model for the Final Fertilization Method in Short-term IVF: A Multicenter Retrospective Study
affiliations: Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Boston University - Department of Biomedical Engineering, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Zhengzhou University and Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology

detail.title: Identification and Validation of an Explainable Prediction Model for the Final Fertilization Method in Short-term IVF: A Multicenter Retrospective Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None reported.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Research Ethics Committee of the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University (Approval number: LLSY(IIT)-2026-066, Supplementary Appendix 2). The requirement for patient informed consent was waived due to the retrospective nature of the study, which only involved the collection of existing and deidentified medical data.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant numbers 82471639) (Dr G. An), and Science and Technology Projection of Guangzhou (Grant numbers 2025A03J3920, 2025B03J0142) (Dr G. An).

detail.abstract:
IMPORTANCE Whether to adopt a strategy of short-term in vitro fertilization (IVF) combined with early rescue intracytoplasmic sperm injection (RICSI) currently lacks a standardized risk stratification system for selecting individualized fertilization strategies. The absence of such objective criteria may expose some patients to otherwise avoidable risks associated with oocyte handling and micromanipulation, while others may miss the opportunity for timely intervention, resulting in fertilization failure and cycle cancellation. Machine learning can analyze complex clinical data to generate individualized risk estimates, thereby facilitating shared decision-making between physicians and patients.

OBJECTIVE To develop and validate machine learning models trained on variables extracted from structured clinical records for predicting the occurrence of early RICSI following a short-term IVF strategy.DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS This study is a multicenter retrospective cohort study conducted in China, involving couples who were scheduled for a short-term IVF strategy during two time periods (January 2018 to December 2020 and January 2022 to December 2024) for assisted reproduction, with the aim of deriving and validating a predictive model. Based on 22 clinical features that are readily accessible or assessable in assisted reproductive medical records, six machine learning algorithms were applied to construct the predictive model. The SHAP interpretability method was employed to evaluate feature importance and elucidate the output of the final model.

MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES For infertile couples initially opting for a short-term IVF strategy, the eventual requirement for early RICSI was defined as the primary outcome measure. Several evaluation indexes, including the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), were employed to compare the predictive performance.

RESULTS This study utilized data from three reproductive centers. The development cohort included 1,496 couples from a single independent reproductive center between January 2018 and December 2020, and was used for the training set and internal validation set, respectively. For external validation, 9,836 couples from two independent reproductive centers, treated between January 2022 and December 2024, were employed as the external validation dataset. Among the six machine learning models, the Random Forest model demonstrated the best discriminative performance. The final model accurately predicted the eventual need for early RICSI in both the internal validation (AUC = 0.927) and external validation (AUCs = 0.760 and 0.687, respectively). Additionally, a web-based tool was developed in this study to facilitate its application in clinical settings.

CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE In this study investigating the final fertilization method in short-term IVF, we employed machine learning models trained on structured clinical data and validated externally to predict the need for early RICSI. Such models enable individualized risk assessment, provide a basis for clinical decision-making, and serve as a foundation for decision-support tools in subsequent prospective testing.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习模型，基于结构化临床记录中的22个特征，预测短时IVF后是否需要早期抢救性ICSI（RICSI）。随机森林模型表现最优，内部验证AUC为0.927，外部验证AUC分别为0.760和0.687，并开发了在线工具辅助临床决策。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习模型预测短时IVF策略后需要早期RICSI的风险？
AI.motivation: 当前短时IVF联合早期RICSI策略缺乏标准化的风险分层系统，缺乏客观标准可能导致部分患者承受不必要的卵子处理风险，或错过及时干预导致受精失败和周期取消。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测模型、SHAP可解释性方法、随机森林算法
AI.method: 多中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2018-2020年和2022-2024年两个时间段在中国三个生殖中心接受短时IVF策略的夫妇。基于22个临床特征，应用六种机器学习算法构建预测模型，使用SHAP方法进行特征重要性评估和模型解释。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型表现最佳，内部验证AUC为0.927，外部验证AUC分别为0.760和0.687。研究还开发了基于网页的临床决策支持工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将机器学习方法应用于短时IVF后早期RICSI需求的预测，为个体化受精策略选择提供了客观的风险分层依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了在线临床决策工具，帮助医生和患者在短时IVF策略中评估早期RICSI的需求，促进共享决策，减少受精失败和周期取消的风险。

title: Amici Curiae Brief of Intellectual Property Scholars in Support of Appellee in xAI v. Bonta, No. 26-1591 (9th Cir.)
affiliations: , Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers Law School, University of Denver Sturm College of Law, , University of Colorado Law School, New York University - School of Law , American University Washington College of Law, , Georgia State University College of Law, Loyola University of Chicago School of Law, Brigham and Women's Hospital/Harvard Medical School, , , University of Idaho College of Law, Mitchell Hamline School of Law, DePaul University College of Law, New York University School of Law, Syracuse University - College of Law, The University of Alabama School of Law, Georgia State University - College of Law and University of Maryland Carey School of Law

detail.title: Amici Curiae Brief of Intellectual Property Scholars in Support of Appellee in xAI v. Bonta, No. 26-1591 (9th Cir.)
detail.abstract:
Amici curiae are scholars of intellectual property. Amici have no personal interest in the outcome of this litigation but share a professional interest in seeing trade secrecy and takings laws applied in a manner that is doctrinally coherent; promotes innovation and competition; and protects consumers, public safety, and public health.

Amici believe that Appellant xAI has fundamentally misinterpreted the Supreme Court’s and this Court’s precedents on the intersection of trade secrecy and takings law. Endorsement of xAI’s view of the law would flout precedent and imperil state and federal transparency and regulatory law. Amici present this brief to assist the Court in its analysis of xAI’s request for a preliminary injunction enjoining California Assembly Bill 2013 (“A.B.2013” or “the Act”) on the alleged basis that the Act violates the Takings Clause. Amici express no view on other claims raised by xAI. The district court properly denied a preliminary injunction against California Assembly Bill 2013 (“A.B.2013” or “the Act”) based on xAI’s claim that the Act violates the Takings Clause. As the district court correctly reasoned, xAI has not adequately alleged—and probably can never prove—that information affected by the Act constitute trade secrets under California law. On this basis alone, the district court’s treatment of xAI’s takings claim deserves affirmance.

Our brief provides an additional basis to affirm the district court’s denial of a preliminary injunction on the basis of xAI’s takings claim. Even if summaries of generative artificial intelligence (“AI”) training data were valid trade secrets, this Court should still affirm the district court’s dismissal of xAI’s request for a preliminary injunction based on the Takings Clause. xAI’s takings claim must fail because xAI cannot establish that it and other developers of generative AI were ever given a promise by the State of California that their training data would remain perpetually secret and immune from regulation or public disclosure. Absent such a promise of secrecy, no takings claims arising from governmental interference with a trade secret can succeed.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份法庭之友意见书，指出xAI公司错误解读了商业秘密与征收法领域的先例。即使AI训练数据摘要属于商业秘密，由于加州从未承诺永久保密，xAI的征收索赔仍不能成立。
AI.research_question: xAI请求对加州AB 2013法案发布初步禁令，主张该法案违反征收条款，该主张是否成立？
AI.motivation: 维护商业秘密法与征收法在教义上的一致性，促进创新与竞争，保护消费者、公共安全与公共卫生，防止xAI的错误法律解释损害州和联邦的透明度及监管法律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业秘密法（商业秘密的认定标准）；征收法（Takings Clause，政府对商业秘密的干预是否构成征收，需以政府曾作出保密承诺为前提）。
AI.method: 法律教义分析：通过解读最高法院和巡回法院的判例，对xAI的法律主张进行反驳，并提供额外的法律依据支持初审法院的裁决。
AI.findings: 1. xAI未能充分主张相关信息构成加州法下的商业秘密。2. 即使构成商业秘密，因加州政府从未承诺永久保密，xAI的征收索赔仍不能成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了商业秘密征收索赔的核心要件——必须有政府明确的保密承诺，否则政府监管披露不构成征收。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持加州AB 2013法案的透明度要求，防止AI企业以商业秘密为由规避监管披露义务，维护公共安全与消费者权益。

title: The Changing Role of Preplanned Insider Trades: Evidence from The SEC Rule 10b5-1 Amendments
affiliations: Wenzhou-Kean University

detail.title: The Changing Role of Preplanned Insider Trades: Evidence from The SEC Rule 10b5-1 Amendments

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Review of Economics & Finance, volume 110, 2026[10.1016/j.iref.2026.105650]

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of the SEC's 2022 amendments to Rule 10b5-1 on the informativeness of insider trading. Using transaction-level data from 2000 to 2024, we compare preplanned and non-preplanned trades before and after the reforms. We find that prior to the amendments, both types of trades exhibited contrarian behavior and predictive power, with nonpreplanned transactions being especially informative. After the reforms, however, the predictive content of preplanned trades declines substantially, while the signals from non-preplanned trades are confined to the short term. These results are consistent with the amendments curtailing insiders' ability to use trading plans opportunistically, thereby advancing the regulatory goal of reducing informational advantages in insider trading.

AI.tldr: 本文研究SEC 2022年对Rule 10b5-1的修订如何影响内幕交易的信息含量。利用2000-2024年交易层面数据，比较修订前后预先计划和非预先计划交易。发现修订前两类交易均呈现逆向行为和预测能力，非预先计划交易信息性更强；修订后预先计划交易的预测能力大幅下降，非预先计划交易的信号局限于短期。结果支持修订限制了内幕人士利用交易计划的机会主义行为，推进了减少信息优势的监管目标。
AI.research_question: SEC 2022年对Rule 10b5-1的修订如何影响内幕交易的信息含量？
AI.motivation: 探究监管改革是否有效限制了内幕人士利用预先计划交易获取信息优势的能力，评估规制10b5-1修订的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内幕交易信息含量理论、市场效率理论、监管有效性理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年交易层面数据，对比修订前后预先计划交易与非预先计划交易的逆向行为特征和预测能力。
AI.findings: 修订前，两类交易均呈现逆向行为和预测能力，非预先计划交易信息性更强；修订后，预先计划交易预测能力大幅下降，非预先计划交易信号仅局限于短期。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管改革如何影响内幕交易信息不对称提供了实证证据，揭示了规则修订对市场信息效率的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 验证了SEC 2022年修订Rule 10b5-1的有效性，为监管机构进一步优化内幕交易规制提供了经验依据；帮助市场参与者理解不同类型内幕交易的信息含量变化。

title: Scaling as a Control Problem
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management

detail.title: Scaling as a Control Problem
detail.abstract: Interventions that work in pilots often weaken when organizations scale them into routine programs. I argue that this attenuation is partly an accounting and control problem. A field experiment never tests an intervention on its own. It tests the intervention together with the bundle of budgets, measures, reviews, discretion, and audit that carries its working mechanism in the pilot. I call that bundle the control architecture, and I distinguish the architecture the researcher designs for the pilot from the inherited architecture a program runs on. When routine operation reproduces the nominal intervention but rebuilds the architecture around it, it can change the treatment that is actually delivered, even when population, site, and protocol are held fixed. I develop this pilot-to-program gap along five control functions and show how each produces a diagnostic prediction about where attenuation should appear.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，组织在将试点干预措施规模化推广时效果减弱，部分原因在于会计与控制问题。试点测试的不仅是干预措施本身，还包括支撑其运作的“控制架构”（预算、指标、审查、自由裁量权、审计等）。当从试点转向常规程序时，控制架构被替换，即使干预措施名义上相同，实际传递的处理效果也会改变。文章沿着五个控制功能分析了这种“试点-程序差距”，并给出了衰减将出现在何处的诊断预测。
AI.research_question: 为什么在试点中有效的干预措施在规模化推广到常规程序时效果会减弱？这一衰减现象背后的会计与控制问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 实践中大量组织干预措施在试点阶段表现良好，但规模化后效果衰减，现有文献对这一现象的解释不足。作者从管理会计和控制的视角提出新的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制架构（Control Architecture）理论：区分研究者为试点设计的控制架构与常规程序继承的现有架构。沿着五个控制功能（预算、指标、审查、自由裁量权、审计）分析试点-程序差距。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，基于会计与控制理论提出框架性的诊断预测。
AI.findings: 试点干预措施的效果衰减部分源于控制架构的变化。当常规操作复制名义上的干预措施但重建了其周围的控制架构时，实际传递的处理（treatment）会改变，即使人群、地点和方案保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“控制架构”这一新概念，区分了试点设计与常规程序的不同控制环境，为干预措施规模化衰减现象提供了管理会计视角的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织诊断干预措施规模化时效果衰减的原因，识别控制架构不匹配的问题，从而改进规模化实施策略。

title: Project Management: Inputs, Tools & Techniques, Outputs
affiliations: Metropolitan State University of Denver

detail.title: Project Management: Inputs, Tools & Techniques, Outputs
detail.abstract: We summarize the PMBOK—and hopefully teaches it.We address a student's natural questions: What is this? Why does it matter? When does it happen? What is my role as the project manager? What is the impact? This teaching pattern repeats throughout the book and gives novices a framework for understanding rather than memorization. This is not written just for PMI certification candidates alone—it is written for first-generation college students, working adults, veterans, and other students who have never managed anything larger than a class project. Use it as a guide for your projects, until the inputs, tools & techniques, and outputs become second nature.

AI.tldr: 本文总结并教授PMBOK指南，通过回答学生的自然问题（是什么、为什么重要、何时发生、项目经理的角色、影响）来帮助初学者理解项目管理框架，而非死记硬背。目标受众包括第一代大学生、在职成人、退伍军人等项目管理新手。
AI.research_question: 如何有效教授PMBOK项目管理知识体系，使初学者能够理解而非死记硬背？
AI.motivation: 帮助从未管理过比课堂项目更大项目的学生（如第一代大学生、在职成人、退伍军人）掌握项目管理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PMBOK（项目管理知识体系指南）的项目管理框架；问题驱动教学法（通过回答学生的自然问题构建理解）。
AI.method: 教学法模式：以五个核心问题（是什么、为什么重要、何时发生、项目经理角色、影响）为重复框架，结合输入-工具与技术-输出（ITTO）结构进行教学。
AI.findings: 通过重复的问题驱动模式，学生能建立项目管理框架的理解而非死记硬背；该教材可作为项目实践指南，直到ITTO成为第二天性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种以学习者自然问题为导向的项目管理教学方法论，将PMBOK复杂的知识体系转化为可理解的认知框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目管理教育提供了一种清晰的模式化教学路径，特别适合缺乏实践经验的初学者；教材兼具备考与实务指导功能。

title: Strategic Asset Importance and the Adoption of Data-driven Management Practices
affiliations: , University of Nottingham and World Bank Group

detail.title: Strategic Asset Importance and the Adoption of Data-driven Management Practices
detail.abstract: Quantitative measures of management quality point to wide variation in how practices are allocated within firms. We address this question by examining whether a rise in one asset's strategic importance triggers adoption of management practices that optimize that asset. Our analysis focuses on business websites and the adoption of A/B testing, a data-driven management practice that enables firms to systematically experiment with and improve their websites. We exploit an abrupt, externally driven surge in online consumer activity as a natural experiment to identify the causal effect of a sudden rise in a digital asset's strategic importance on adoption of this practice. Using novel monthly data on A/B testing adoption for 654,915 firms across 16 countries, we show that this sudden increase in asset importance led to a substantial rise in adoption. Adoption responses are concentrated among firms with stronger pre-existing management, data and analytics capabilities, rather than among larger or more productive firms. This is consistent with complementarities between advanced management practices and existing organizational capabilities. Finally, we find evidence that A/B testing adoption is associated with increases in revenue and labor productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用外部消费者活动激增的自然实验，发现数字资产战略重要性的提升会促使企业采用A/B测试这一数据驱动的管理实践，且采用效应集中在具备更强管理、数据和数据分析能力的企业中，并最终提升了企业的营收和劳动生产率。
AI.research_question: 一项资产战略重要性的提升是否会促使企业采用优化该资产的管理实践？
AI.motivation: 企业内部管理实践分配存在显著差异，但鲜有研究探讨资产战略重要性的变化对管理实践采纳的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理实践与组织能力的互补性理论；资产战略重要性驱动管理创新的逻辑
AI.method: 利用外部消费者活动激增作为自然实验，基于16个国家654,915家企业的月度面板数据，采用因果识别方法分析A/B测试采纳行为。
AI.findings: 1) 资产战略重要性提升显著提高了A/B测试采纳率；2) 采纳效应集中在具备更强管理、数据和分析能力的既有能力的企业中，而非更大或生产率更高的企业；3) A/B测试采纳与营收和劳动生产率提升相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了资产战略重要性变化是驱动管理实践采纳的重要因素；验证了先进管理实践与既有组织能力之间的互补性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理资源配置提供洞察：当某项资产战略地位上升时，应优先投资配套的管理实践；强调了数据和分析能力建设对采纳先进管理实践的基础性作用。

title: Co-production and Multi-product Firms in the Global Economy
affiliations: Xiamen University,  and Michigan State University

detail.title: Co-production and Multi-product Firms in the Global Economy
detail.abstract: World trade is dominated by firms that sell many products to many markets, yet standard models treat product and market scope as separable. This separability misses a first-order force: firms rely on shared non-rival inputs across both products and destinations. Using Chinese customs data matched to product-destination demand shocks, we show that demand growth in related products and destinations increases a firm's sales in the focal product-destination market. We develop a multi-product, multi-destination firm model featuring core competencies, market-specific demand heterogeneity, and shared non-rival inputs that jointly determine firms' product and destination scope. We show that standard sufficient statistics fail when trade reshapes firms' shared capabilities, a force that amplifies the welfare effects of trade-policy shocks. Accounting for shared inputs raises the ACR welfare gain from trade liberalization by 18 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国海关数据和产品-目的地需求冲击，证明企业的产品与市场范围并非可分离，而是通过共享非竞争性投入相互关联。这一发现修正了标准贸易模型，将ACR贸易自由化福利收益提高了18%。
AI.research_question: 企业的产品范围和市场范围是否相互独立？共享的非竞争性投入如何影响企业的多产品、多目的地决策？
AI.motivation: 标准贸易模型假设企业的产品和市场范围可分离，忽略了企业共享非竞争性投入这一重要机制。本文旨在纠正这一遗漏，揭示其对贸易福利评估的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多产品、多目的地企业模型，核心能力理论，市场特定需求异质性，共享非竞争性投入理论。
AI.method: 利用中国海关数据，匹配产品-目的地层面的需求冲击，进行实证分析；构建理论模型并进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 相关产品和目的地的需求增长会显著增加企业在焦点产品-目的地市场的销售额；共享非竞争性投入是企业产品范围和市场范围共同决定的关键机制；忽略这一机制会导致标准充分统计量失效；考虑共享投入后，ACR贸易自由化福利收益提高18%。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破了标准贸易模型中产品和市场范围可分离的假设，建立了多产品、多目的地企业模型，揭示了共享非竞争性投入作为核心机制的作用，修正了贸易福利评估的充分统计量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了共享投入机制对贸易自由化福利收益的影响（提高18%），为贸易政策评估提供了更准确的框架。

title: From "Operational Films" to "Operational Ethics": The Challenges and Reshaping of Chinese Film and Television Ethics and National Image

detail.title: From "Operational Films" to "Operational Ethics": The Challenges and Reshaping of Chinese Film and Television Ethics and National Image

declarations.declarationOfInterest: A communication theorist studying how technological infrastructures reorganize cultural production, narrative experience, and public life in the age of artificial intelligence.

detail.abstract: With the deep integration of generative AI in the field of film and television creation, human-machine collaborative AI-generated scriptwriting has become an irreversible trend. However, large models led by the West, such as OpenAI and Claude, have pre-training data and value alignment mechanisms that naturally carry Western centrist discourse encoding, resulting in frequent misexpressions such as cultural misinterpretation, ethical misconduct, and value misalignment in AI-generated "Chinese stories", which to some extent, hinder the international narrative dissemination of "telling good Chinese stories". While AI-generated script tools increase efficiency and lower the threshold for screenwriters, their inherent technical logic and cultural biases pose systemic risks and the possibility of structural remodeling to the maintenance of Chinese film and television ethics and the construction of the national image. At present, the fundamental task for China in the "AIGC script generation race" is to break away from dependence on the European and American film ethics system, achieve independence from its ethical origins, and realize Chinese characteristics in the face of the European and American film system. This paper suggests that the fundamental task of China's film and television industry is to achieve a crucial leap from the technical level of "operational films" to the value level of "operational ethics". The research aims to construct a three-dimensional ethical framework of "technology ontology-narrative ethics-image construction" based on Peking University's "Linghu" intelligent script creation, by "encoding" localized ethical alignment into the algorithmic core, to transform AIGC from a potential source of cultural risk into a controllable and reliable tool for shaping the national image.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式AI在影视剧本创作中存在的西方中心主义文化偏见问题，提出通过构建中国本土化的三维伦理框架（技术本体论-叙事伦理-形象建构），将中国价值对齐"编码"进算法内核，使AIGC从文化风险源转变为可控的国家形象塑造工具。
AI.research_question: 如何解决生成式AI在中文影视剧本创作中产生的文化误读、伦理失范、价值错位问题，并构建具有中国特色的AI剧本伦理框架？
AI.motivation: 以OpenAI、Claude为代表的西方大模型在预训练数据和价值对齐机制中天然带有西方中心主义话语编码，导致AI生成的"中国故事"出现文化误读、伦理失范、价值错位等问题，阻碍了"讲好中国故事"的国际叙事传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: "技术本体论-叙事伦理-形象建构"三维伦理框架
AI.method: 基于北京大学"灵狐"智能剧本创作平台，通过将中国本土化价值对齐"编码"进算法核心，构建三维伦理框架。
AI.findings: 中国影视行业需要从"操作电影"的技术层面跃升到"操作伦理"的价值层面，实现伦理源头的独立自主，并构建可控可靠的AI剧本创作伦理体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"技术本体论-叙事伦理-形象建构"三维伦理框架，为AIGC剧本创作的中国本土化伦理体系建设提供了理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国影视行业在AIGC剧本生成领域摆脱对欧美电影伦理体系的依赖、实现伦理源头的独立自主提供了可操作方案，有助于将AIGC转化为可控可靠的国家形象塑造工具。

title: Everybody Argues and Everybody Wins: Overestimation of Success as a Driver of Debate
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business and Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS)

detail.title: Everybody Argues and Everybody Wins: Overestimation of Success as a Driver of Debate

declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB Protocol IRB16-1529 from Harvard University (Exempt)
declarations.funderStatement: The Authors wish to thank Harvard University’s Foundations of Human Behavior and Harvard University’s Program on Negotiation Next Generation Grant for their generous support. We are also grateful to the members of Minson Lab at Harvard Kennedy School for their thoughtful feedback.

detail.abstract: Why do individuals engage in arguments despite their limited success in persuading others? We integrate classic perspectives from social psychology and judgment and decision-making to theorize that individuals enter into arguments due to overconfidence in their persuasion success, stemming from excessive faith in the correctness of their beliefs. People spend a substantial amount of time arguing even though they regret doing so (Pilot) because they are biased in their retrospective assessments of argument success (Experiment 1). Mispredicting future success results in greater willingness to bet money on winning (Experiment 2). Such biased assessments are robust to constrained definitions of winning (Experiment 3 and 4), even when people define winning based on specific skillsets (Experiment 5). Bias in argument success stem more from overconfidence in holding “correct” views than in debate skills (Experiment 6A and 6B). Finally, directly following an interactive, real-time debate, more people are overconfident than underconfident, and more willing to bet money (and more of it) on winning. We theorize that the domain of disagreement extends work on overconfidence by identifying a domain pervaded by all three types of overconfidence.

AI.tldr: 人们因为过度相信自己观点的正确性而对说服成功过度自信，从而高估自己在争论中的成功概率，即使争论后感到后悔仍持续参与争论。
AI.research_question: 为什么人们明知说服他人成功率有限，却仍然频繁参与争论？
AI.motivation: 现实中人们经常陷入无谓争论并事后后悔，但此现象缺乏系统性理论解释。作者整合社会心理学与判断决策领域的理论，探究过度自信如何驱动争论行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过度自信理论（三种类型：过高估计、过高定位、过高精确度）；社会心理学关于说服与信念的理论；判断与决策偏差理论。
AI.method: 包含1个预实验（Pilot）和7个实验（Experiment 1-6B），采用自评与客观表现对比、赌注意愿测量、不同赢家定义条件操控、实时辩论互动实验等多种方法。
AI.findings: 1. 人们在争论后感到后悔但仍然花费大量时间争论（Pilot）；2. 对争论成功的回顾性评估存在偏差（E1）；3. 高估未来成功导致更愿意押注赢（E2）；4. 这种偏差在对赢家做严格定义时依然存在（E3-E4）；5. 即使人们基于特定技能定义赢家时偏差仍存在（E5）；6. 争论中的偏差更多源于对自身观点"正确性"的过度自信，而非辩论技巧的过度自信（E6A-6B）；7. 在实时互动辩论后，过度自信人数多于自信不足人数，且更愿意押注更多钱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别"分歧"作为过度自信研究的新领域，该领域同时包含三种类型的过度自信；2. 将过度自信理论与争论行为建立因果联系；3. 揭示信念正确性过度自信是争论偏差的核心驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助人们意识到争论中的认知偏差，减少无谓争论；2. 为冲突管理、沟通培训等提供理论依据；3. 对法律辩论、政策辩论等真实场景中的决策偏差具有启示意义。

title: Reconstructing Traffic Congestion in Urban Road Networks with Dynamic Origin-Destination Demand Calibration
affiliations: , ETH Zurich, Transcality AG, Transcality AG, ETH Zürich and ETH Zürich

detail.title: Reconstructing Traffic Congestion in Urban Road Networks with Dynamic Origin-Destination Demand Calibration
detail.abstract: Representative dynamic origin-destination (OD) demand should reconstruct traffic congestion in urban road networks, facilitating the evaluation of traffic management strategies. However, this aspect has often been neglected in the literature. This study presents a dynamic OD demand calibration framework for reconstructing spatiotemporal traffic congestion patterns using link counts and travel times collected from loop detector data and floating car data, respectively. A data fusion approach is first proposed to obtain robust estimates of link densities. To calibrate demand, the continuous packet traffic flow model is adopted to map OD demand to link counts, while link densities are derived based on the conservation law of traffic flow. Microscopic traffic simulation experiments are designed to assess calibration performance under varying congestion levels and examine different formulations of the mathematical optimization problem. The results indicate that traffic congestion is underestimated when calibration targets only link count measurements, as flow alone is insufficient to describe macroscopic traffic states. It is particularly problematic for interrupted traffic flow in urban road networks. By incorporating link densities into the calibration problem, assigning uniform weights to all link traffic states, and explicitly reducing vertical queues for entry links at network boundaries, the onset and recovery patterns of congestion are more accurately reconstructed in the simulation. As such, the proposed method provides a basis for future dynamic OD demand estimation and calibration frameworks and paves the way toward congestion-aware traffic demand modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态OD需求校准框架，通过融合环形线圈数据和浮动车数据，将链路密度纳入校准目标，以更准确地重建城市路网中的时空交通拥堵模式。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态OD需求校准框架准确重建城市路网中的时空交通拥堵模式？
AI.motivation: 现有文献在动态OD需求校准中往往忽略了交通拥堵的重建，而仅以流量为目标无法充分描述宏观交通状态，尤其在城市道路网络中断续交通流的情况下存在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续分组交通流模型（将OD需求映射到链路流量）、交通流守恒定律（推导链路密度）、数据融合方法（获得稳健的链路密度估计）。
AI.method: 提出数据融合方法获取链路密度；采用连续分组交通流模型建立OD需求与链路流量的映射；设计微观交通仿真实验，在不同拥堵水平下评估校准性能，并检验不同数学优化问题形式化方法的效果。
AI.findings: 仅以链路流量为校准目标会低估交通拥堵；将链路密度纳入校准问题、对所有链路交通状态赋予统一权重、明确减少网络边界入口链路的垂直排队，能够更准确地重建拥堵的起始和恢复模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了仅以流量为目标校准OD需求在重建拥堵方面的不足，提出了融合密度信息的校准框架，为未来动态OD需求估计与校准研究提供了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理策略评估提供了更准确的拥堵重建工具，有助于实现拥堵感知的交通需求建模，提升城市交通管理的有效性。

title: External Range Excursions and Asian Midpoint Reversion in NAS100 Intraday Markets: Evidence from a Manually Coded Chart Sample

detail.title: External Range Excursions and Asian Midpoint Reversion in NAS100 Intraday Markets: Evidence from a Manually Coded Chart Sample
detail.abstract: This working paper examines whether intraday price behavior in NAS100 exhibits a recurring relationship between post-session external range excursions and the midpoint of the Asian session price distribution. The study deliberately avoids the retail-language assumption that a movement beyond a session high or low is automatically a liquidity sweep. Instead, the observable event is defined as an external range excursion: price trading beyond the high or low of a completed Asian session range. The midpoint of that range is treated as a session balance proxy, calculated as the average of the Asian high and Asian low. The paper uses a manually coded pilot sample of NAS100 five-minute chart screenshots supplied by the author. Each exhibit displays a Tokyo or Asian session range, its midpoint, and post-session price development. The objective is not to prove a final trading edge from screenshots alone, but to establish a reproducible coding protocol, document preliminary visual regularities, and specify a testable empirical design for a later study using raw intraday data. The main preliminary finding is that the midpoint repeatedly appears as a meaningful post-session reference level in the submitted exhibits, especially when price fails to sustain outside the prior range and later returns toward the session balance area. Because the screenshots are purposively selected and not randomly sampled, the findings are descriptive rather than inferential. Future work should validate the same hypotheses with time-stamped OHLCV, bid-ask, and order-book data.

AI.tldr: 该工作论文研究纳斯达克100指数在亚洲交易时段结束后，价格是否反复回归至该时段价格区间中点的现象，提出了"外部区间突破"的操作性定义，并基于人工编码的截图样本进行初步视觉规律分析。
AI.research_question: NAS100的日内价格行为在亚洲交易时段结束后，是否表现出"外部区间突破"与亚洲时段价格分布中点之间的重复性关系？
AI.motivation: 避免市面上"突破高低点即流动性扫除"的零售式模糊假设，提出更严谨的可操作定义（外部区间突破），并为后续基于原始高频数据的假设检验建立可复制的编码协议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确定量理论框架，但隐含亚洲时段价格分布中点作为"时段平衡代理变量"的假设，以及价格在区间边界突破后向平衡区域回归的均值回复逻辑。
AI.method: 人工编码的试点样本：作者提供的NAS100五分钟K线截图（东京/亚洲时段）。绘制时段区间、中点和时段后价格发展。样本为目的性选取，非随机抽样，分析为描述性而非推断性。后续计划使用时间戳OHLCV、买卖价差和订单簿数据验证。
AI.findings: 亚洲区间中点在提交的截图中反复表现为有意义的时段后参考水平，尤其在价格无法在区间外持续运行并随后返回时段平衡区域时表现明显。但因样本为有目的选取，结论仅为描述性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"外部区间突破"（external range excursion）的严谨操作定义，替代了市场中模糊的"流动性扫除"假设；建立了可复制的编码协议和可检验的实证设计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频交易和日内交易策略提供了基于亚洲时段价格中点的参考水平框架；警示了基于截图做推断性交易结论的局限性，强调需用原始高频数据验证。

title: Does Corporate Social Responsibility Improve Financial Performance? Reevaluating Evidence from Close-Call Resolutions
affiliations: , Boston University - Questrom School of Business and IESE Business School

detail.title: Does Corporate Social Responsibility Improve Financial Performance? Reevaluating Evidence from Close-Call Resolutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: not needed.
declarations.funderStatement: University funding

detail.abstract: Scholars have long sought to understand the causal relationship between Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and financial performance.  A notable innovation in this quest was the use of regression discontinuity designs (RDD) to infer causality by examining how investors respond to close-call passage of resolutions to increase firms’ CSR commitments.  Two influential studies reported that investors expected such resolutions to boost the focal firm’s prospects while diminishing those of competitors.  However, the rarity of CSR resolutions left those findings reliant on few observations near the voting threshold, raising concerns about whether the conditions required for valid RDD-based causal inference are satisfied.  In addition, prior work identified resolution passage using a simple majority rule, whereas actual company voting policies may impose different approval requirements.  Finally, a subsequent study covering a different period found no significant market reaction.  We replicate and extend all three analyses, re-examining their original samples before broadening the time horizon and applying company-specific passage rules.  Across specifications, we find no consistent evidence that investors revalue firms, positively or negatively, following the passage of CSR resolutions.  Our results offer a clearer view of the CSR-performance link and highlight both the promise and peril of regression discontinuity designs.

AI.tldr: 本文复制并扩展了三项关于CSR决议通过与企业财务绩效之间因果关系的研究，发现没有一致的证据表明投资者会在CSR决议通过后重新评估企业价值，从而质疑了此前基于断点回归设计得出的因果结论。
AI.research_question: CSR决议的通过是否会导致投资者重新评估企业价值（包括焦点企业及其竞争对手）？
AI.motivation: 以往使用断点回归设计（RDD）的两项有影响力的研究发现投资者预期CSR决议通过会提升焦点企业前景、削弱竞争对手前景，但这些研究面临样本量少、投票规则误设等问题，且后续一项不同时期的研究未发现显著市场反应。因此需要重新检验这些矛盾结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 断点回归设计（RDD）因果推断逻辑；CSR与企业财务绩效关系的信号理论/利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 复制并扩展三项原始研究：使用原始样本验证结果，再扩大时间窗口并应用公司特定的实际投票通过规则（而非简单多数规则），进行多种规格检验。
AI.findings: 在所有规格检验中，均未发现一致证据表明投资者在CSR决议通过后对企业进行正向或负向的价值重估。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了RDD方法在CSR研究中应用的条件脆弱性（如阈值附近观测值过少、投票规则误设可能导致虚假因果推断），为CSR-绩效关系提供了更清晰的证据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者和实务界在依赖准实验方法（如RDD）进行因果推断时需谨慎评估方法的适用条件，避免因方法论缺陷得出误导性结论。

title: Beyond AI-assisted Writing: Engineering the Development of Linear Algebra for Quantum Computing

detail.title: Beyond AI-assisted Writing: Engineering the Development of Linear Algebra for Quantum Computing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Large language models now routinely generate fluent prose, yet a common view remains that sustained technical rigor, structural coherence, and mathematical correctness lie beyond their practical reach. This paper reports a demonstration that challenges that view. Directing artificial-intelligence systems under a disciplined engineering methodology, an independent researcher produced a complete, openly licensed technical textbook, Linear Algebra for Quantum Computing, comprising 295 pages across eight chapters and four appendices, with worked examples, exercises with worked solutions and answer keys, figures, and notation maintained consistently throughout. The work underwent multi-system independent review and targeted computer-algebra-system (CAS) verification before release. The contribution is not the AI systems or prompting techniques, but the book-scale engineering orchestration that coordinated human direction, documented engineering practices, verification, and production into a governed development process. The book-not this paper-is the primary evidence. The demonstration establishes an existence proof that disciplined engineering orchestration can enable the production of a complete, technically coherent educational work at book scale and suggests that engineering orchestration itself merits further research in AI-assisted technical development.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一名独立研究者通过严谨的工程编排方法，利用AI系统成功生成了295页的教科书《量子计算的线性代数》，挑战了LLM无法完成技术严谨、结构连贯的长篇技术著作的普遍观点。
AI.research_question: 通过工程化编排方法，能否利用现有AI系统生产一本技术严谨、结构完整、数学正确且达到书本规模的技术教科书？
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能生成流畅文字，但普遍认为其在技术严谨性、结构连贯性和数学正确性方面存在局限。作者希望通过实证挑战这一观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工程编排（engineering orchestration）方法论——将AI系统置于受控的工程流程中，协调人类指导、验证和生产流程。
AI.method: 采用多系统独立审查、计算机代数系统（CAS）验证等工程化质量控制手段，通过系统化的工程编排协调AI生成内容。
AI.findings: 成功生成了295页、8章、4个附录的完整技术教科书，包含工作示例、习题及解答、图表等，并经多系统独立审查和CAS验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出工程编排本身应作为AI辅助技术开发中的重要研究方向，证明了方法论层面的编排可以突破AI单点能力的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利用AI进行大规模技术文档创作提供了可复现的工程实践框架，展示了如何通过结构化流程确保AI产出的质量与一致性。

title: The Tragedy of the Cognitive Commons: How AI Could Disrupt the Regeneration of Professional Expertise
affiliations: Old Dominion University

detail.title: The Tragedy of the Cognitive Commons: How AI Could Disrupt the Regeneration of Professional Expertise

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual article involved no human participants, human data, or biological materials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The article was prepared by the author in the course of employment as a civilian employee of the United States Government.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping cognitive work, but Human Resource Development scholarship has treated this transformation as an organizational training challenge, leaving the collective regeneration of professional expertise unexamined. This conceptual paper introduces the Cognitive Commons framework, integrating commons theory, HRD scholarship, and distributed cognition to explain how rational AI adoption decisions can deplete the shared expertise pool professions require for renewal. The framework distinguishes Internalized Mastery (deep domain knowledge from sustained practice) from Distributed Mastery (orchestrating human-AI systems), and develops the Validation Tether: effective AI oversight depends on the expertise AI adoption may undermine. Early labor market and clinical evidence suggests possible disruption to expertise-regeneration pathways in highly AI-exposed sectors, though adoption is recent and the strongest signals come from leading sectors rather than all professions. Five factors determine occupational vulnerability, and governance arrangements may form across organizational, professional-association, and policy levels. The paper reframes expertise development as collective stewardship rather than organizational optimization, with implications for HRD theory and workforce policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知公地"框架，论证理性AI采纳决策可能消耗职业所需的共享专业知识池，将专长发展重新定义为集体 stewardship 而非组织优化问题。
AI.research_question: 理性的AI采纳决策如何可能消耗职业所需的集体专业知识池，以及如何治理这一集体行动问题？
AI.motivation: 现有HRD文献将AI对认知工作的影响视为组织培训挑战，忽视了职业专业知识集体再生的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知公地框架：整合公地理论、HRD学术与分布式认知理论，区分内部化掌握与分布式掌握，提出验证锚定概念。
AI.method: 概念性论文，结合理论整合与早期劳动市场及临床证据分析。
AI.findings: 早期证据表明高AI暴露行业可能出现专长再生路径的中断；五个因素决定职业脆弱性；治理可跨组织、职业协会和政策层面形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公地理论引入HRD领域，提出专长发展作为集体 stewardship 的新视角，挑战以组织优化为中心的传统框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人力资源开发实践和劳动力政策提供治理建议，帮助职业识别并应对AI对专业知识再生的集体风险。

title: The Case for Policy-coupled Decision Attestation: Proving an Institutional AI Decision Followed the Rule that Governed It.

detail.title: The Case for Policy-coupled Decision Attestation: Proving an Institutional AI Decision Followed the Rule that Governed It.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and managing partner of Dartmouth Advisory Partners, which designs and operates commercial systems that implement the architecture described in this paper. The paper presents a conceptual and architectural proposal, contains no client data and no proprietary implementation details, and does not constitute legal or investment advice. No external funding was received; the work was conducted internally.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involved no human participants, animal subjects, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. The work was conducted internally at Dartmouth Advisory Partners.

detail.abstract: As institutions delegate consequential decisions to AI systems, a governance question sharpens: not merely was an action authorized, or is this agent who it claims to be, but did this decision follow the rule that governed it, and can that be proven to someone who does not trust us. A fast-moving literature now attests adjacent things: whether an action's preconditions held, whether an agent ran its declared model, whether a tool call passed a pre-execution gate. None of these attests the decision itself, bound to the policy that governed it. This paper proposes policy-coupled decision attestation: the institution's governing document is compiled into a versioned, executable policy; each decision is evaluated against that version deterministically; and the outcome is sealed into an independently reproducible record that binds the decision to the policy version and the source clause it applied. The paper defines the mechanism, distinguishes it from pre-action authorization, capability verification, and receipt-based auditability, and situates it against supervisory expectations for reproducible, examinable AI decisions. Its central claim is that reproducibility coupled to a compiled policy, not signer independence alone, is the property that a more capable model does not erode and that the deciding system structurally cannot provide about itself. A partial production realization exists; the paper remains at the level of architecture and implications. It is a working paper and comments are invited.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“策略耦合决策认证”机制：将机构治理文件编译为可执行策略，每次AI决策均与该策略版本确定性地绑定并生成可独立复现的记录，从而实现对决策本身（而非仅前置条件或身份）的可证明合规性审查。
AI.research_question: 当机构将重要决策委托给AI系统时，如何证明该决策遵循了治理规则，并能向不信任方提供可验证的证据？
AI.motivation: 现有认证机制（如前置条件检查、模型运行确认、执行前门控）只能证明决策的周边条件，无法直接证明决策本身是否遵循了治理政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 策略耦合决策认证；可复现性；确定性评估；版本化策略编译。
AI.method: 机制设计与架构分析：将治理文档编译为可执行策略，对每次决策进行确定性评估，将结果封存为可独立复现的记录。
AI.findings: 与预授权、能力验证和收据式审计不同，耦合编译策略的可复现性是更强模型不会削弱、决策系统自身无法提供的关键属性。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了“可复现性”而非“签名者独立性”是AI治理合规性的核心属性；区分了决策认证与现有认证机制的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构在AI决策问责中提供了可操作的技术架构，使监管审查能够不依赖对决策系统本身的信任。

title: "The Court Finds that": Why Patent Illegality and Perversity, though Unpleaded, Remain Available Grounds for Setting aside an Award under Sections 34 and 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: "The Court Finds that": Why Patent Illegality and Perversity, though Unpleaded, Remain Available Grounds for Setting aside an Award under Sections 34 and 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
detail.abstract:
Section 34(2) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 enacts two classes of
grounds for setting aside an arbitral award, distinguished by their distinct terminologies
used. They are firstly, the grounds the party making the application must establish on
the basis of the arbitral record, and secondly, the grounds that operate “if the Court finds
that” the vice exists, namely non-arbitrability, conflict with the public policy of India
and, since 2015, patent illegality under sub-section (2A). This article defends the thesis
that the second class may be applied by the court on its own initiative, so that patent
illegality and perversity apparent on the face of the award and the record remain
available grounds although unpleaded in the petition, before the Section 34 court and
equally in an appeal under Section 37. The argument is textual and doctrinal: it traces
the bifurcation to Article 34(2) of the UNCITRAL Model Law and Article V(2) of the
New York Convention, whose travaux préparatoires document the ex officio character
of the second limb; it rests on the Supreme Court’s decisions in Fiza Developers,
Hindustan Construction, Lion Engineering and, decisively, State of Chhattisgarh v. Sal
Udyog; and it confronts, and answers, the converse line of Bombay authority holding
the challenge adversarial and never inquisitorial. The article marks the strict limits of
the power, examines its reception in the Bombay High Court, and closes with the
practitioner’s course for invoking and resisting it.

AI.tldr: 本文论证印度《仲裁与调解法》第34(2)条第二类撤销事由（不可仲裁性、违反公共政策及明显违法）具有法院可依职权主动适用的性质，即便当事人未在申请中提出，法院仍可主动审查，这一权力在上诉阶段同样存在。
AI.research_question: 印度《仲裁与调解法》第34(2)条第二类撤销事由（明显违法、违反公共政策、不可仲裁性）是否可由法院依职权主动适用，而无需当事人申请中提出？
AI.motivation: 第34(2)条将撤销事由分为两类，但实践中对第二类事由是否需要当事人主动提出存在争议。孟买高等法院认为撤销程序完全是对抗性的，而最高法院在Sal Udyog等案中暗示了法院可依职权审查的可能性，本文旨在澄清这一法律争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本主义与法教义学分析，溯源至UNCITRAL示范法第34(2)条和《纽约公约》第V(2)条的立法准备文件，后者明确表明第二类事由具有依职权（ex officio）性质。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、比较法研究（UNCITRAL示范法、纽约公约立法史）、判例分析（Fiza Developers、Hindustan Construction、Lion Engineering、State of Chhattisgarh v. Sal Udyog等案），以及批判性回应相反判例。
AI.findings: 第二类撤销事由具有依职权性质，法院可在当事人未主张的情况下主动适用；该权力有严格限制；明显违法和证据记录上的荒谬性即使未在申请中提出，仍可作为撤销理由；该权力在上诉（第37条）中同样适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了印度仲裁法中撤销程序的性质争议，区分了对抗性与纠问性要素，从立法史和比较法角度论证了法院依职权审查第二类事由的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务律师提供了明确的诉讼策略：如何援引法院依职权审查权以撤销仲裁裁决，以及如何对抗对方提出的该等主张；明确了该权力的严格边界。

title: Analyzing Amazon's Ascendancy Through Neo-Institutional Economics and Property Theory

detail.title: Analyzing Amazon's Ascendancy Through Neo-Institutional Economics and Property Theory
detail.abstract: This paper examines the foundational drivers of Amazon's unprecedented market dominance, challenging the popular narratives of pure labor exploitation or mere market luck. Utilizing Ronald Coase's transaction cost theory, Joseph Schumpeter's concept of "creative destruction," and John Locke's property justification, the author argues that Jeff Bezos's success stems fundamentally from his unique entrepreneurial traits and the creation of an optionality framework. The essay explores how Amazon transformed internal operational redundancies (AWS and FBA) into external market infrastructure, thereby expanding aggregate economic surplus. While acknowledging real concerns regarding monopsony and algorithmic labor coordination, the study concludes that Amazon operates on a non-zero-sum dynamic, where the newly generated consumer surplus and systemic efficiencies significantly outweigh the extracted wealth.

AI.tldr: 本文运用交易成本理论、创造性破坏和财产权理论，论证亚马逊的成功源于贝佐斯的创业特质和可选择性框架，而非单纯的剥削或运气；亚马逊将内部冗余转化为外部市场基础设施，创造了非零和的消费者剩余与系统效率。
AI.research_question: 亚马逊市场主导地位的根本驱动力是什么？是劳动剥削、市场运气，还是创业特质与制度创新？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于亚马逊成功的流行叙事（纯剥削论或运气论），提供更全面的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科斯交易成本理论、熊彼特"创造性破坏"、洛克财产权理论
AI.method: 理论分析与案例研究相结合
AI.findings: 亚马逊成功源于创业特质与可选择性框架；AWS和FBA从内部冗余转化为外部基础设施；亚马逊运作于非零和博弈，消费者剩余和系统效率远超提取的财富。
