title: Adaptive Project Management Strategies in Conflict Zones: Evidence and Lessons from Gaza

detail.title: Adaptive Project Management Strategies in Conflict Zones: Evidence and Lessons from Gaza

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The lead author is professionally affiliated with organizations operating in Gaza's NGO sector, including Spark, in a monitoring, evaluation, and learning capacity. A mix of interview participants were drawn from the author's own professional network at Spark, REFORM, and Ahel Gaza, alongside contacts outside this network. This dual positioning as practitioner and researcher is disclosed as a potential source of bias; steps taken to mitigate it are described in Section 3.6 and 3.7 of the manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not undergo formal institutional ethics board review, as is standard practice for undergraduate business research at the authors' institution. Verbal informed consent was obtained from all fifteen interview participants prior to data collection, and all identifying information has been anonymised in reported findings to protect participant confidentiality.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or institutional funding. It was conducted independently by the authors as part of undergraduate graduation research requirements.

detail.abstract: Standard project management methodologies were developed for contexts that assume a baseline of institutional stability, functioning infrastructure, and predictable operating conditions. Gaza represents an environment in which none of these assumptions reliably holds. This study examines the adaptive project management strategies employed by practitioners working in Gaza under conditions of sustained armed conflict, building directly on prior research that documented the challenges facing project managers in this context. Employing a qualitative embedded case study design built on semi-structured interviews with project management practitioners, the study addresses three research questions: which adaptive strategies project managers in Gaza employ to maintain project continuity; to what extent standard methodologies require modification in conflict-affected environments; and what lessons Gaza's experience can contribute to a broader adaptive framework. Findings indicate that effective practitioners develop hybrid approaches combining elements of formal methodologies with locally derived adaptive practices, with particular reliance on distributed decision-making, modular project design, informal resource networks, and iterative replanning on compressed timescales. The study proposes a preliminary Conflict-Adaptive Project Management (CAPM-C) framework built from field evidence, and concludes that lessons from extreme operational environments have broader relevance for project management practice — and for donor and policy design — in fragile and conflict-affected states globally. As an exploratory qualitative study drawing on a small purposive sample, the framework is offered as a preliminary contribution requiring empirical testing at greater scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨加沙地带在持续武装冲突条件下项目管理者的适应性策略，提出冲突适应性项目管理（CAPM-C）初步框架，发现从业者采用混合方法，结合正式方法论与本地自适应实践，强调分布式决策、模块化设计、非正式资源网络和压缩时间周期的迭代重规划。
AI.research_question: 三个研究问题：1）加沙项目管理者采用哪些适应性策略来维持项目连续性；2）标准方法论在受冲突影响的环境中需要多大程度的修改；3）加沙经验能为更广泛的适应性框架提供哪些启示。
AI.motivation: 标准项目管理方法论假设制度稳定、基础设施完善和可预测的运行条件，而加沙环境这些假设均不成立。本研究基于先前对加沙项目管理者挑战的文献，探索极端冲突环境下的适应性策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于先前关于加沙项目管理挑战的研究，提出冲突适应性项目管理（CAPM-C）框架。
AI.method: 定性嵌入式案例研究设计，基于对项目管理从业者的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 有效的从业者发展出混合方法，结合正式方法论要素与本地自适应实践；特别依赖分布式决策、模块化项目设计、非正式资源网络和压缩时间周期的迭代重规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于实地证据的冲突适应性项目管理（CAPM-C）初步框架，表明极端运营环境对全球脆弱和受冲突影响国家的项目管理实践具有更广泛的借鉴意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 对受冲突影响地区的项目管理者、捐助者和政策制定者提供了实践指导，说明在极端环境中需要调整标准项目管理方法。

title: Drivers of Consumer Inflation in Central Asia, 2000-2024: A Multi-channel Panel Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Drivers of Consumer Inflation in Central Asia, 2000-2024: A Multi-channel Panel Analysis
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the drivers of consumer price inflation in four Central Asian economies - Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan - over 2000-2024 using a multi-channel empirical framework. Rather than treating inflation as the outcome of a single macroeconomic source, the paper organizes the analysis around five transmission channels: external cost pressures, external income dependence, domestic demand, monetary conditions, and fiscal conditions. The empirical strategy combines two levels of analysis. First, each channel is estimated separately to identify its internal logic and relative explanatory strength. Second, the variables retained from the channel-level results are brought together in synthetic multi-channel models to assess the broader hierarchy of inflation correlates across the region.

The paper also distinguishes between macroeconomic drivers and institutional conditioning factors. In addition to the core macroeconomic variables, three Worldwide Governance Indicators - Government Effectiveness, Regulatory Quality, and Rule of Law - are introduced to test whether governance quality conditions the transmission of macroeconomic pressures into inflation. The estimation strategy uses pooled OLS and panel specifications, including fixed- and random-effects models, allowing the analysis to compare common regional patterns with country-specific heterogeneity.

The results point to a clear empirical hierarchy. Exchange rate depreciation is the dominant correlate of consumer inflation in Central Asia, followed by global food prices, global inflation, and broad money growth. The fiscal deficit has a moderate role in the integrated specification, while credit growth, lagged export growth, and domestic demand indicators appear more secondary or less stable. Governance matters mainly as a conditioning factor at the channel level, especially through Regulatory Quality and, in the external cost channel, Government Effectiveness. In the synthetic models, governance indicators do not remain statistically robust, suggesting that institutional quality shapes inflation primarily through its influence on macroeconomic transmission mechanisms rather than as an independent inflation driver. The findings provide a common empirical basis for policy discussions on exchange rate management, monetary frameworks, fiscal anchors, and the institutional conditions shaping inflation transmission in Central Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2000-2024年数据，通过多通道实证框架研究中亚四国（哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦）的消费者通胀驱动因素。研究发现汇率贬值是通胀的最主要相关因素，其次是全球食品价格、全球通胀和广义货币增长；制度质量主要通过调节宏观经济传导机制影响通胀，而非作为独立驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 中亚四国消费者价格通胀的驱动因素是什么？各种传导渠道的相对重要性如何？制度质量如何调节通胀传导机制？
AI.motivation: 中亚经济体通胀问题具有独特性（资源依赖、高外部依赖、制度转型），但现有研究缺乏系统的多通道比较分析。作者旨在超越单一宏观因素视角，构建整合性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多通道通胀传导框架（外部成本压力、外部收入依赖、国内需求、货币条件、财政条件五大渠道）；制度质量作为调节变量的治理理论（政府效能、监管质量、法治水平）。
AI.method: 两层次实证策略：先分别估计各渠道内部逻辑和相对解释力，再构建综合多通道模型；使用混合OLS和面板模型（固定效应/随机效应）；引入WGI制度质量指标作为调节变量。
AI.findings: (1)汇率贬值是通胀最主导因素，其次为全球食品价格、全球通胀和广义货币增长；(2)财政赤字作用中等，信贷增长和出口增长等作用次要；(3)制度质量主要在渠道层面起调节作用，尤其在外部成本渠道中政府效能显著，监管质量影响较广；(4)综合模型中制度指标不稳健，说明其通过调节传导机制而非直接驱动通胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了适用于中亚经济体的系统性多通道通胀分析框架；揭示了制度质量作为"调节变量"而非"独立变量"影响通胀的机制；提供了通胀驱动因素的层级性比较证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汇率管理、货币政策框架、财政纪律及制度环境建设提供了基于区域比较的实证依据；有助于政策制定者明确通胀管理的优先领域（汇率稳定和外部价格监控）。

title: The Bridge Problem and the Pricing of Bitcoin-denominated Yield: Investigating Trust-Minimized Execution Architecture as a Condition for Price Discovery in Bitcoin Native Financial Markets
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Bridge Problem and the Pricing of Bitcoin-denominated Yield: Investigating Trust-Minimized Execution Architecture as a Condition for Price Discovery in Bitcoin Native Financial Markets
detail.abstract:
Bitcoin (BTC) is the largest digital asset by market capitalisation, yet the majority of its
circulating supply remains economically idle; deployed in neither yield-generating nor productivity-enhancing activity. As of early 2026, approximately 19.8 million BTC have
been mined, worth roughly $1.7–$2.0 trillion at prevailing prices. These BTC are distributed across cold wallets, exchange-traded fund (ETF) custody vaults, and corporate treasuries. Approximately 0.8% of circulating BTC is used on decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, compared with about 30% of Ethereum’s supply deployed in DeFi protocols.
This paper argues that this idleness is not primarily a regulatory problem but an
architectural one: the absence of programmable DeFi infrastructures capable of deploying BTC productively at scale without requiring holders to relinquish effective control.
We define Bitcoin activation as the deployment of previously idle BTC into productive financial uses, such as lending, staking, liquidity provision, and restaking, through mechanisms that are decentralized, auditable on-chain, and preserve holder sovereignty over the underlying asset.
The paper identifies three primary pools of idle BTC, quantifies the scale of capital
inactivity, examines its institutional and technical constraints, and evaluates the
emergence of Bitcoin’s decentralized finance (BTCFi) as a credible architectural response. Total value locked in BTCFi protocols grew from about $307 million to $6.5 billion in 2024, a more than 2000% increase, driven largely by Babylon Protocol’s native staking infrastructure.
We place this growth within the broader institutional trajectory of Bitcoin’s adoption as a reserve asset and argue that BTCFi is a necessary infrastructure for the next phase of
the Bitcoin network’s financial and security evolution. We identify questions regarding
institutional infrastructure, regulatory classification of on-chain BTC yield, and systemic risk in large-scale activation scenarios. Bitcoin DeFi TVL stands near $7.0 billion, more than 23% below its October 2025 peak of $9.1 billion, despite a period in which the technical infrastructure for Bitcoin Layer-2 activity expanded substantially.
This divergence raises a precise question: if the bridge problem has been substantially
addressed, why has capital efficiency in BTCFi not improved proportionately? This report
evaluates five existing Bitcoin execution environments (BOB, Bitlayer, Citrea, Stacks, and Rootstock) against a six-layer architectural framework that specifies the conditions for institutional-grade DeFi activity. 
The evaluation uses Tage_Root, a reference implementation, to operationalise the
proposed architectural standard and make the comparison code-grounded. The findings
show that all five systems satisfy the bridging condition (L1 and L2) but exhibit systematic
deficits across intent-based routing (L3), autonomous capital allocation (L4), zero-
knowledge compliance (L5), and governance accountability (L6). These deficits, not the
bridge gap, explain the persistent underperformance of BTC-denominated yield markets.
This report provides the empirical foundation for the theoretical argument that will be
formalized in the forthcoming Working Paper 3: “The missing dimension in financial economics: Towards productive financial utilization as an object of economic inquiry”.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，比特币大量流通供应处于经济闲置状态，原因不是监管问题，而是架构问题——缺乏可编程的DeFi基础设施。论文提出“比特币激活”概念，分析闲置资本规模，评估BTCFi生态（2024年TVL增长超2000%），并通过六层架构框架评估五个比特币执行环境，发现所有系统在意图路由、自主资本配置、零知识合规和治理问责层面存在系统性缺陷，这才是BTCFi资本效率低下的根本原因。
AI.research_question: 为什么比特币的资本闲置问题在技术基础设施（跨链桥）大幅改善后，BTCFi的资本效率仍未能成比例提升？
AI.motivation: 比特币作为市值最大的数字资产，约99.2%的流通供应处于经济闲置状态，仅0.8%用于DeFi协议（对比以太坊约30%）。这种闲置被普遍认为是监管问题，但本文认为这本质上是架构问题——缺乏可编程的DeFi基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六层架构框架：L1（L1/L2桥接）、L2（L2执行环境）、L3（意图路由）、L4（自主资本配置）、L5（零知识合规）、L6（治理问责）。
AI.method: 采用Tage_Root参考实现，对BOB、Bitlayer、Citrea、Stacks、Rootstock五个比特币执行环境进行基于代码的六层架构评估。
AI.findings: 所有五个系统均满足桥接条件（L1和L2），但在L3意图路由、L4自主资本配置、L5零知识合规、L6治理问责方面存在系统性缺陷。BTCFi TVL约70亿美元，较2025年10月峰值（91亿美元）下跌超23%，而同期Layer-2技术基础设施却在大幅扩张。这一背离表明：跨链桥问题已基本解决，但更高层级的架构缺陷才是资本效率低下的真正原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“比特币激活”概念，将资本闲置问题重新定义为架构问题而非监管问题；建立了六层架构评估框架，为衡量BTCFi基础设施成熟度提供了标准化工具；揭示了跨链桥之外更高层级架构缺陷对资本效率的约束作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BTCFi协议开发者提供了明确的架构改进方向（意图路由、自主资本配置、零知识合规、治理问责）；为机构投资者评估比特币DeFi基础设施提供了分析框架；为政策制定者理解比特币DeFi的监管分类和系统风险提供了参考。

title: Analyzing Amazon's Ascendancy Through Neo-Institutional Economics and Property Theory

detail.title: Analyzing Amazon's Ascendancy Through Neo-Institutional Economics and Property Theory
detail.abstract: This paper examines the foundational drivers of Amazon's unprecedented market dominance, challenging the popular narratives of pure labor exploitation or mere market luck. Utilizing Ronald Coase's transaction cost theory, Joseph Schumpeter's concept of "creative destruction," and John Locke's property justification, the author argues that Jeff Bezos's success stems fundamentally from his unique entrepreneurial traits and the creation of an optionality framework. The essay explores how Amazon transformed internal operational redundancies (AWS and FBA) into external market infrastructure, thereby expanding aggregate economic surplus. While acknowledging real concerns regarding monopsony and algorithmic labor coordination, the study concludes that Amazon operates on a non-zero-sum dynamic, where the newly generated consumer surplus and systemic efficiencies significantly outweigh the extracted wealth.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了关于亚马逊成功的两种流行叙事（纯粹劳动剥削论与单纯市场运气论），运用科斯交易成本理论、熊彼特创造性破坏理论和洛克财产权理论，论证贝佐斯的成功根植于其独特的企业家特质及创造的"期权框架"。亚马逊将内部运营冗余（AWS和FBA）转化为外部市场基础设施，扩大了整体经济剩余。尽管存在垄断和算法劳动协调等真实问题，但亚马逊的运行遵循非零和动态，新产生的消费者剩余和系统效率远超其提取的财富。
AI.research_question: 亚马逊空前市场主导地位的根本驱动力是什么？其成功究竟源于劳动剥削、市场运气，还是另有深层原因？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于亚马逊成功的两种简化叙事（劳动剥削论和市场运气论），试图从制度经济学与企业家理论视角提供更全面的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科斯交易成本理论、熊彼特创造性破坏理论、洛克财产权理论、期权框架（optionality framework）
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论证，整合多位制度经济学与政治哲学家的理论框架对亚马逊商业实践进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 亚马逊的成功根植于贝佐斯的企业家特质及其创造的期权框架；亚马逊将内部运营冗余（如AWS、FBA）转化为外部市场基础设施，扩大了整体经济剩余；亚马逊运行遵循非零和动态，新产生的消费者剩余和系统效率远超其提取的财富。
AI.theory_contributions: 将期权框架概念引入对平台经济的分析；整合交易成本理论、创造性破坏理论和财产权理论解释数字平台的市场建构机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解亚马逊等大型科技平台的经济本质提供了超越"剥削论"和"运气论"的第三条路径；提示监管政策应关注非零和博弈中的整体剩余分配而非仅关注财富提取。

title: Analytics of Food Prices in Pakistan: Machine Learning, Regional Disparities & Policy Recommendations for Food Security
affiliations: Virtual University of Pakistan

detail.title: Analytics of Food Prices in Pakistan: Machine Learning, Regional Disparities & Policy Recommendations for Food Security
detail.abstract:
Food price volatility in Pakistan represents one of the most pressing socioeconomic challenges of the twenty-first century, disproportionately affecting the purchasing power of low-income and non-agricultural wage earners. This research proposes a comprehensive, data-driven investigation into the dynamics of food price inflation in Pakistan using machine learning and statistical modelling techniques applied to the World Food Programme (WFP) longitudinal food price dataset (2010-2023), comprising 20,160 retail price observations across four provinces, twelve cities, and ten commodity categories.

The study employs four predictive modelling approaches: Linear Regression (baseline), Decision Tree Regressor, Random Forest Regressor, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Results demonstrate that the Random Forest model achieves superior predictive accuracy with R-squared = 0.9950 and Mean Absolute Error of PKR 7.21, significantly outperforming linear and SVM-based approaches. Exploratory analysis reveals that food prices rose approximately 169% between 2010 and 2023 across all provinces, with Balochistan consistently 12-15% more expensive than Punjab. By 2023, the real purchasing power gap between rice price inflation (269% of 2010 baseline) and wage growth (200% of baseline) had widened to 69 index points, indicating a deepening structural food affordability crisis for unskilled workers.

This research makes four original contributions: (1) the first provincial level machine learning food price prediction framework for Pakistan using WFP data; (2) a real purchasing power analysis demonstrating the widening wage food price gap for non-agricultural labour; (3) an OLS-based quantification of cooking oil price transmission to the broader food price basket; and (4) a comprehensive policy framework with six evidence-based recommendations for government, institutional, and community-level interventions. The findings have direct implications for food security policy, social protection programme design, and the architecture of Pakistan’s national food price monitoring infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习方法（随机森林最优，R²=0.995）分析巴基斯坦2010-2023年食品价格波动，发现食品价格上涨约169%，购买力差距扩大至69个指数点，并提出四项原创贡献及六项政策建议。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习与统计建模方法，系统分析巴基斯坦食品价格通胀的动态特征、预测趋势及其对低收入群体的购买力影响？
AI.motivation: 食品价格波动严重冲击巴基斯坦低收入和非农业工资收入者的购买力，是该国21世纪最紧迫的社会经济挑战之一，但目前缺乏省级层面的机器学习预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习预测建模理论（线性回归、决策树、随机森林、支持向量机）与购买力平价分析框架，结合OLS价格传导机制分析。
AI.method: 采用世界粮食计划署（WFP）2010-2023年纵向数据集（20,160条零售价格观测值，覆盖4省12市10类商品），运用线性回归、决策树、随机森林、支持向量机四种模型进行预测，辅以OLS回归分析价格传导效应。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型预测最优（R²=0.995, MAE=7.21卢比）；2010-2023年食品价格上涨约169%；俾路支省价格持续比旁遮普省高12-15%；到2023年，大米价格通胀（基准的269%）与工资增长（基准的200%）之间的实际购买力差距扩大至69个指数点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建基于WFP数据的巴基斯坦省级机器学习食品价格预测框架；通过实际购买力分析揭示非农业劳动力面临的工资-食品价格差距扩大问题；利用OLS量化食用油价格向整体食品价格篮子的传导效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出包含六项基于证据的政策建议的综合框架，涵盖政府、机构和社区层面的干预措施；对粮食安全政策、社会保护计划设计及国家食品价格监测基础设施建设具有直接指导意义。

title: Comparative Analysis of Critical Success Factors in Technology Firms: Evidence from Brazil and Morocco
affiliations: Hassan II University of Casablanca, Morocco, Faculty of Legal, Economic and Social Sciences, Department of Management Science, Students, Federal University of Cariri and School of Law and Economics Ain Chock Hassan II University

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Critical Success Factors in Technology Firms: Evidence from Brazil and Morocco

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This study examines critical success factors (CSFs) in the IT industry by comparing technology firms in Brazil and Morocco. Both countries play important roles in the global IT landscape, yet their economic environments and institutional structures shape how firms address challenges and leverage opportunities. Brazil leads Latin America's IT sector, with a strong focus on innovation and global scalability. In contrast, Morocco positions itself as a regional technology hub in North Africa, prioritizing leadership and adaptability to drive digital transformation. The research uses secondary data for Brazilian firms to reflect their well-established and data-rich technology ecosystem. For Moroccan firms, it collects primary data through semi-structured interviews, capturing insights from a developing and evolving sector. The study applies the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) to analyse clear managerial priorities in Brazil. It uses the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process (FAHP) for Morocco to account for uncertainty in decision-making. The findings indicate that Brazilian companies focus on enhancing their innovation capabilities and marketing strategies to improve their competitiveness on a global scale. In contrast, Moroccan companies prioritize entrepreneurial leadership and organizational agility as ways to address resource limitations and effectively operate in regional markets. By emphasizing both common themes and contextual differences, this study adds valuable insights to the literature on critical success factors (CSFs) in emerging markets. It also offers practical recommendations for companies looking to improve their leadership, resource management, and strategic adaptability in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文比较巴西与摩洛哥IT企业的关键成功因素（CSFs），发现巴西企业侧重创新与营销以提升全球竞争力，摩洛哥企业则优先发展创业领导力与组织敏捷性以应对资源限制。研究采用AHP（巴西）和FAHP（摩洛哥）进行分析，揭示了新兴市场中CSFs的共性与情境差异。
AI.research_question: 巴西和摩洛哥IT企业的关键成功因素（CSFs）有何异同？不同制度环境如何塑造企业的战略优先级？
AI.motivation: 巴西和摩洛哥在全球IT格局中均扮演重要角色，但经济环境与制度结构差异显著。现有文献对新兴市场中不同制度背景下企业CSFs的比较研究不足，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键成功因素理论（CSFs）、制度理论（比较制度环境对企业战略选择的影响）
AI.method: 巴西企业：基于二手数据的层次分析法（AHP）；摩洛哥企业：半结构化访谈收集一手数据，采用模糊层次分析法（FAHP）处理不确定性。
AI.findings: 巴西企业：优先提升创新能力与营销策略，以增强全球竞争力；摩洛哥企业：优先发展创业领导力与组织敏捷性，以应对资源不足并有效运营区域市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了新兴市场中CSFs的共性与情境差异（如制度环境、数据可得性），为CSFs文献提供了比较视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场企业提供提升领导力、资源管理与战略适应性的实践建议，尤其针对不同发展阶段的企业（数据成熟型vs.发展中市场）。

title: Beyond AI Visibility: Extending the Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™) to Enterprise Knowledge Readiness (EKR) for Agentic Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Beyond AI Visibility: Extending the Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™) to Enterprise Knowledge Readiness (EKR) for Agentic Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author conducts consulting and executive advisory work in artificial intelligence, digital transformation, and enterprise strategy. The research presented in this paper was conducted independently and represents the author's scholarly work. No commercial organization influenced the design, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual research paper based on literature synthesis and theoretical development. It did not involve human participants, human data, animal subjects, or identifiable personal information. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The rapid emergence of Agentic Artificial Intelligence is transforming enterprise computing by shifting artificial intelligence from information retrieval toward autonomous reasoning, planning, and execution. While substantial research has examined large language models, retrievalaugmented generation, knowledge graphs, enterprise architecture, and AI governance, comparatively little attention has been devoted to the organizational preparedness of enterprise knowledge itself. Existing frameworks largely assume that enterprise knowledge is already structured in ways that enable reliable computational reasoning. This paper argues that such an assumption represents a significant theoretical gap. Building upon the Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™), originally developed to explain AImediated visibility through the constructs of Structured Extractability, Entity Salience, and Citation Authority, this paper extends the application of the model to Enterprise Knowledge Readiness (EKR). Rather than proposing a new theoretical framework, the study demonstrates how the existing KSM™ constructs explain the organizational capability required to prepare enterprise knowledge for autonomous reasoning and execution. Enterprise Knowledge Readiness is defined as the organizational capability through which enterprise knowledge is structured, governed, maintained, and operationalized so that autonomous artificial intelligence systems can reliably retrieve, interpret, reason over, and execute organizational work. Drawing upon literature from Knowledge Management, Information Systems, Enterprise Architecture, Semantic Web technologies, Knowledge Graphs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Responsible Artificial Intelligence, and Agentic AI, the paper develops a socio-technical framework that positions enterprise knowledge as strategic computational infrastructure. The study introduces Knowledge Architecture as an implementation discipline for operationalizing

AI.tldr: 本文指出企业知识在自主式AI时代缺乏结构化准备的重大理论空白，基于知识结构化模型（KSM™）提出“企业知识就绪度”（EKR）概念，将其界定为组织为支持AI自主推理与执行所需的知识结构化、治理、维护和运营能力，建立了一个将企业知识视为战略计算基础设施的社会技术框架。
AI.research_question: 企业知识如何为自主式人工智能系统（Agentic AI）的可靠推理与执行做好组织层面的准备？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大语言模型、RAG、知识图谱等技术本身，而忽略了企业知识自身的结构化就绪程度；现有框架假设企业知识已天然具备可供计算推理的结构，这一假设存在重大理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识结构化模型（KSM™），其核心构念包括：结构化可提取性（Structured Extractability）、实体显著性（Entity Salience）和引用权威性（Citation Authority）。
AI.method: 理论推演与文献综合研究，跨领域整合知识管理、信息系统、企业架构、语义网技术、知识图谱、RAG、负责任AI和Agentic AI等文献，构建社会技术框架。
AI.findings: 提出了企业知识就绪度（EKR）的定义及其作为组织能力的理论阐释；展示了KSM™原有构念如何解释企业知识为自主AI做准备所需的能力；将知识架构（Knowledge Architecture）定位为实现EKR的实施学科。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了自主AI时代企业知识结构化准备的理论空白；扩展了KSM™的应用范围，将其从解释AI中介可视性延伸到企业知识就绪度；重新将企业知识定位为战略计算基础设施。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了知识架构（Knowledge Architecture）这一具体的实施学科，指导企业如何系统性地结构化、治理、维护知识以支持自主AI系统；帮助组织评估和提升自身知识就绪度。

title: Numerical Relativity Calibration and Boundary Asymptotics of the Quasi-local Maximum Entropy Principle for Aligned-Spin Black Hole Mergers

detail.title: Numerical Relativity Calibration and Boundary Asymptotics of the Quasi-local Maximum Entropy Principle for Aligned-Spin Black Hole Mergers
detail.abstract: We establish the definitive mathematical and numerical stability proof of the quasi-local Maximum Entropy Principle (MEP) for binary black hole remnants under a Slowly Evolving Horizon (SEH) framework. Addressing advanced critiques from numerical relativity and perturbation theory, we calibrate our non-linear hydrodynamic scaling model against explicit simulations from the Simulating eXtreme Spacetimes (SXS) catalog for aligned-spin configurations (q = 1, 1.5, 2). We demonstrate that the cross-coupling derivatives between the symmetric mass ratio η and local angular momentum J H are bounded such that they cannot destabilize the strictly positive-definite character of the geometric feedback function G. Furthermore, we resolve the parity-dependent quasinormal mode (QNM) damping divergence at the isolated null boundary by incorporating a power-law correction factor τ α , proving that the intrinsic horizon distortion frequency Ω dist smoothly interpolates to the terminal isolated state without null gauging flattening singularities.

AI.tldr: 本文在慢演化视界框架下，严格证明了二元黑洞并合残骸的准局部最大熵原理的数学与数值稳定性，通过SXS目录校准了非线性流体动力学标度模型，并解决了奇偶依赖的准正规模式阻尼发散问题。
AI.research_question: 二元黑洞并合后残骸的准局部最大熵原理在慢演化视界框架下是否具有严格数学与数值稳定性？
AI.motivation: 回应数值相对论与微扰理论的最新批评，解决准局部最大熵原理在黑洞残骸稳定性方面的争议性数学问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准局部最大熵原理、慢演化视界框架、非线性流体动力学标度模型、几何反馈函数理论、奇偶依赖的准正规模式阻尼理论。
AI.method: 基于SXS目录中对齐自旋构型（质量比q=1,1.5,2）的显式数值模拟，结合数学分析与微扰理论，证明耦合导数有界性及引入幂律修正因子解决阻尼发散。
AI.findings: 对称质量比与局部角动量的交叉耦合导数有界，不会破坏几何反馈函数的正定性；奇偶依赖的准正规模式阻尼发散可通过幂律修正因子解决，视界畸变频率平滑插值至终端孤立态。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明了准局部最大熵原理在慢演化视界框架下的稳定性，修正了现有理论中关于阻尼发散的数学缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为二元黑洞并合数值模拟提供了更精确的稳定性条件，有助于改进引力波数据分析与黑洞残骸演化预测模型。

title: Universal Royalty-Free Reciprocity: when is Royalty-Free not FRAND?
affiliations: Helikon.net and Metroconsult Srl

detail.title: Universal Royalty-Free Reciprocity: when is Royalty-Free not FRAND?

declarations.ethicsApproval: In my view, neither applies.

detail.abstract: Royalty-free licensing of patents essential to a technology has been a compelling argument for implementation of that technology. The IPR policy adopted by W3C has been a RF model for other standards bodies, including the Alliance for Open Media. This article examines these IPR policies and notably their terms for reciprocity. These can create a licensing framework of "Universal Royalty-Free Reciprocity", arguably an all-encompassing ecosystem covering standards development participants, other SEP holders and implementers. As a result, the headline royalty rate for AOM's AV1 video codec specification, $ 0 per device, compares favorably with the rates-between $ 0.277 and $ 1.677 per device-published for other leading video codecs, HEVC and VVC developed by FRAND-based standards development organizations. This article assesses the purported benefits of RF licensing, when coupled with Universal Royalty-Free Reciprocity, and presents its disadvantages. One key issue is that the RF ecosystem is porous; there are many SEP holders that fall outside the reciprocity framework. Indeed those purportedly bound by the framework are free to step away and offer FRAND (royalty-bearing) terms. This article is timely because of the investigation conducted by DG Competition of the European Commission into AOM's licensing practices and the similar interest recently shown by the Antitrust Division of the US Department of Justice. AOM's "clarification" to its IPR policy in May 2023, in response to the Commission's investigation, has received little commentary. This article is also timely in connection with this special edition of the Revista Brasileira de Direito on FRAND and SEPs in the light of recent proceedings before the Court of Justice of Rio de Janeiro brought by an AV1-essential patent holder against an AV1 implementer.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了免版税（RF）许可模式及其“普遍免版税互惠”框架，以AOM的AV1视频编解码器为例，指出虽然其宣称零费率许可优于FRAND模式下的HEVC/VVC费率，但RF生态系统存在漏洞——大量标准必要专利（SEP）持有人不在互惠框架内，且参与者可自由退出并转而提供FRAND（含版税）条款。文章结合欧盟和美国反垄断调查，以及巴西相关诉讼，揭示RF模式的潜在问题。
AI.research_question: 免版税（RF）许可模式及其“普遍免版税互惠”框架在实际运作中是否真如所宣称的有利？其存在哪些结构性问题与劣势？
AI.motivation: W3C等组织的RF政策被广泛效仿（如开放媒体联盟AOM），但RF生态系统的实际运作效果缺乏深入批判性分析；加之欧盟、美国反垄断机构对AOM许可实践展开调查，以及巴西出现相关诉讼，使得该议题具有高度时效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 免版税（RF）许可理论；普遍免版税互惠（Universal Royalty-Free Reciprocity）框架；FRAND许可原则；标准必要专利（SEP）生态系统的开放性/漏洞分析。
AI.method: 比较分析法（对比AV1与HEVC/VVC费率）；政策与法律文本分析（W3C、AOM的IPR政策）；案例研究（欧盟调查、美国司法部关注、巴西诉讼）。
AI.findings: 1）AV1的宣称费率为0美元/设备，优于HEVC（0.277-1.677美元/设备）；2）RF生态系统具有“多孔性”——大量SEP持有人不在互惠框架内；3）受框架约束的参与者可自由退出并转向FRAND（含版税）许可；4）AOM在2023年5月对其IPR政策的“澄清”回应欧盟调查，但缺乏足够评论。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了RF许可模式与普遍互惠框架结合时存在的结构性缺陷，挑战了RF模式“零成本、全包容”的理想化叙事，丰富了SEP许可理论中关于许可模式选择与生态系统设计的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构（欧盟委员会DG竞争总司、美国司法部反垄断局）的执法提供分析依据；为标准制定组织（SSO）的IPR政策设计提供警示；为涉及AV1的专利诉讼（如巴西里约热内卢法院案件）提供法律经济学分析视角。

title: Standardisation versus Adaptation: A Comparative Analysis of IKEA's Strategy Across Four Culturally Distinct Markets

detail.title: Standardisation versus Adaptation: A Comparative Analysis of IKEA's Strategy Across Four Culturally Distinct Markets
detail.abstract: The challenge of balancing the standardisation of operations across markets with their adaptation to local markets is one of the central dilemmas facing multinational firms. This paper investigates how IKEA navigates that tension across four vastly different cultural and institutional markets: Great Britain, Japan, India and Saudi Arabia. A qualitative comparative content analysis was conducted using publicly available sources including localised websites, advertisements, pricing and product ranges. These findings were then compared with the theoretical predictions of three established frameworks: Levitt's (1983) theory of globalisation, Hofstede's (2001) cultural dimensions, and Ghemawat's (2001) CAGE model of distance. The results reveal that IKEA neither fully standardises nor fully localises but instead adopts a hybrid approach. Adaptation is used in culturally and religiously sensitive areas such as food and advertising, whereas the brand's core message, pricing logic and digital presence are standardised across all four markets. A notable anomaly emerges in India, where IKEA is perceived as premium despite its low-cost strategy compared to other markets, illustrating how economic distance can produce outcomes unforeseen by cultural analysis. The paper argues that standardisation and adaptation are best understood not as opposing choices, but as element-specific decisions shaped by the particular form of distance a market presents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析宜家在四个截然不同的市场（英国、日本、印度和沙特阿拉伯）的策略，发现宜家采用了一种混合方法：在文化和宗教敏感领域（如食品和广告）进行本地化适应，而在核心信息、定价逻辑和数字化呈现方面保持标准化。研究还发现，在印度市场，宜家尽管坚持低成本策略，却被视为高端品牌，揭示了经济距离可能带来文化分析无法预见的意外结果。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业如何在标准化运营与本地化适应之间取得平衡？具体而言，宜家在不同文化和制度市场（英国、日本、印度、沙特阿拉伯）中如何应对这一张力？
AI.motivation: 标准化与本地化的取舍是跨国企业面临的核心困境之一，但现有理论（Levitt的全球化理论、Hofstede的文化维度、Ghemawat的CAGE模型）对此的预测存在分歧。本文旨在通过实证案例检验这些理论，并探索更细致的理解方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: Levitt（1983）的全球化理论（主张标准化）、Hofstede（2001）的文化维度理论、Ghemawat（2001）的CAGE距离模型（文化、行政、地理、经济距离）。
AI.method: 定性比较内容分析（Qualitative Comparative Content Analysis），数据来源为公开资料，包括本地化网站、广告、定价和产品范围。将实际发现与三种理论框架的预测进行对比。
AI.findings: 1. 宜家采用混合策略，既非完全标准化也非完全本地化。2. 在文化和宗教敏感领域（食品、广告）进行本地化适应；在核心品牌信息、定价逻辑和数字化呈现方面标准化。3. 印度市场出现异常：宜家被感知为高端品牌，与低成本策略矛盾，表明经济距离可产生文化分析无法预测的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出标准化与适应不是对立选择，而是由特定距离形式塑造的"要素级决策"。2. 揭示了经济距离维度在CAGE模型中的独特解释力，并指出文化分析（如Hofstede）的局限性。3. 丰富了跨国企业战略选择的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业提供了可操作的策略框架：根据不同市场所呈现的距离类型（文化、经济等），在具体业务要素层面分别决定标准化还是本地化，而非一刀切。

title: Alternative Dispute Resolution in the Video Game and Esports Industry
affiliations: and

detail.title: Alternative Dispute Resolution in the Video Game and Esports Industry
detail.abstract: This paper examines the development of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) mechanisms in the video game and esports industry, an area characterized by rapid growth, cross-border participation, and disputes spanning contractual, labor, intellectual property, virtual-asset, and competitive-integrity matters. The authors first situate this development within the broader, well-documented pattern whereby ADR usage concentrates in technically complex, internationalized, and confidentiality-sensitive sectors of the economy, before turning to the video game and esports industry as an extended case study. The paper traces the evolution of specialized arbitration mechanisms, from Riot Games' community-driven Tribunal system of 2011–2014, through the 2016 Arbitration Court for Esports (ACES) established under the World Esports Association, to Riot Games' proprietary Dispute Resolution system launched in the EMEA region in November 2024, and to the International Games and Esports Tribunal (IGET), created in January 2025 as a joint initiative of the Esports Integrity Commission and the WIPO Arbitration and Mediation Center. Drawing on an extensive body of arbitral and judicial practice – including Tfue v. FaZe Clan, Riot Games v. Shanghai Moonton, Tetris Holding v. Xio Interactive, Bungie v. AimJunkies, Epic Games v. Apple and v. Google, and Valve's 2024 retreat from mandatory consumer arbitration – the authors analyze the categories of disputes typical of the industry and the comparative regulatory approaches of Russia, the European Union, the United States, and East Asia. The authors conclude that while institutional ADR mechanisms are becoming increasingly consolidated, challenges remain regarding the voluntariness of arbitration agreements amid unequal bargaining power, the development of consistent arbitral practice, and the broader international recognition of awards in this field.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了视频游戏与电子竞技行业中替代性争议解决机制的发展，从Riot Games的社区裁判系统到2025年新成立的国际游戏与电子竞技仲裁庭，分析了行业典型争议类型及美、欧、俄、东亚的不同监管路径，指出仲裁机制虽日趋整合，但仍面临协议自愿性、裁决一致性和国际承认等挑战。
AI.research_question: 视频游戏与电子竞技行业的替代性争议解决机制如何演变？该行业中的争议解决面临哪些独特挑战？
AI.motivation: 视频游戏和电子竞技行业快速增长、跨境参与频繁，涉及合同、劳动、知识产权、虚拟资产和竞技诚信等多类纠纷，但缺乏系统的ADR机制研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: ADR在技术复杂、国际化、保密性强的经济部门中集中使用的模式（将其作为分析框架，将游戏与电竞行业作为扩展案例研究）。
AI.method: 案例研究法：系统梳理行业仲裁机制的演进历程（2011-2025），结合大量仲裁与司法实践案例（如Tfue诉FaZe Clan、Epic诉Apple等），并比较俄罗斯、欧盟、美国、东亚的监管路径。
AI.findings: 1. 行业ADR机制从社区驱动（Riot Tribunal）到机构化（ACES、IGET）逐步整合；2. 典型争议类型涵盖合同、劳动、IP、虚拟资产、竞技诚信；3. 不同地区监管路径差异显著；4. 仍面临协议自愿性（谈判权力不对等）、仲裁实践一致性、裁决国际承认等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ADR集中于技术复杂、国际化、保密性部门的理论框架扩展至游戏与电竞行业，揭示了该行业作为这一模式的"极端案例"特征，丰富了争议解决制度演进的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为游戏与电竞行业从业者提供了ADR机制演进的系统梳理；2. 帮助政策制定者和仲裁机构识别该领域争议解决的核心挑战（自愿性、一致性、公信力）；3. 为跨境争议的国际仲裁合作（如WIPO-ESIC联合设立IGET）提供了实践参考。

title: Building Resilient and Green Supply Chains in Bangladesh: A Qualitative Review of Practices, Challenges, and Decision-Making

detail.title: Building Resilient and Green Supply Chains in Bangladesh: A Qualitative Review of Practices, Challenges, and Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Bangladesh is a rapidly growing global economy, particularly dominant in the textile, agriculture, RMG Sectors, leather industry etc. Effective supply chain management is crucial to identify proper prospects along with resilient Supply chain assumptions.This paper illustrates a comprehensive review of resilient green supply chain management,studying 15 foundational research works that are conducted to about resilient supply chain and responsible green supply Chain practices, However,Bangladesh continues to face major supply chain Strains to inadequate infrastructure technological limitation, inefficient transportation systems, and enviszon-mental sustainability concern (Shong,2018;Rahman et al.2020).Research has shown the contribution of the supply chain theory via defining the resilience renewability interface in an rising economy, while offering feasible strategic guidance for managers and policy makers addressing Systemic exposures. However,digitized innovations,green operations, and systematic collaboration to enhance supply chain resilience and sustainability.The study demonstrates the need for integrated policy support, technological investment, and organizational commitment to strengthen resilient and environmentally sustainable supply chains in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文基于15篇 foundational 研究，系统综述了孟加拉国这一新兴经济体中弹性绿色供应链管理的现状、挑战与对策，强调数字化创新、绿色运营和系统协作对提升供应链韧性与可持续性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国如何通过弹性绿色供应链管理应对基础设施不足、技术限制、运输低效和环境可持续性挑战？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国是全球快速增长的经济体，但在纺织、农业、服装和皮革等主导产业中面临严重的供应链韧性不足与环境可持续性问题，亟需系统性研究为其提供理论与实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链韧性理论、绿色供应链管理理论、韧性-可再生性交互框架
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，选取15篇关于弹性供应链和绿色供应链实践的基础研究论文进行分析。
AI.findings: 孟加拉国供应链面临基础设施薄弱、技术落后、运输低效和环境可持续性挑战；数字化创新、绿色运营和协作可提升韧性与可持续性；需要政策支持、技术投资和组织承诺的综合推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 界定了新兴经济体中供应链韧性与可再生性之间的交互关系，拓展了供应链理论在发展中经济体的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和政策制定者提供了应对系统性风险的可行战略指导，包括整合政策支持、加大技术投资和强化组织承诺。

title: Serene Order: The Healing Properties of Japan's Low-Entropy Social Atmosphere and Architecture
affiliations: and Xi'an University of Technology

detail.title: Serene Order: The Healing Properties of Japan's Low-Entropy Social Atmosphere and Architecture
detail.abstract: Amidst the pervasive anxiety and information overload of modern society, Japan exhibits a unique "low-entropy" social trait-characterized by meticulous order, minimal redundancy, and a gentle tempo. This atmosphere is not mere silence, but a systemic state of stability maintained through space, behavior, and institutions. Adopting "low entropy" as a theoretical lens, this paper draws upon metaphors from thermodynamics and social physics to explore how Japan's social atmosphere and built environment achieve psychological "healing" by reducing disorder (entropy increase). Furthermore, it argues that such low-entropy environments align with biological imperatives, activating dormant self-healing potentials within human cells and genetic codes that evolved over millennia. By integrating concepts from cellular biology and evolutionary psychology, this study reframes the aesthetic experience of Japanese space as a physiological necessity for maintaining homeostasis in the post-industrial age.

AI.tldr: 本文以"低熵"为理论视角，探讨日本社会氛围与建成环境如何通过减少无序（熵增）实现心理"疗愈"，并论证这种低熵环境如何激活人体细胞与基因中沉睡的自愈潜能，将日本空间的美学体验重新定义为后工业时代维持生理稳态的必要条件。
AI.research_question: 日本"低熵"社会特质（秩序井然、冗余极少、节奏温和）如何通过空间、行为与制度实现心理疗愈？这种低熵环境何以激活人类的生物性自愈潜能？
AI.motivation: 现代社会的普遍焦虑与信息过载背景下，日本展现出独特的"低熵"社会特质，作者希望揭示这种社会氛围与建成环境背后的疗愈机制，并将其上升到生物进化层面的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 低熵理论（热力学与社会物理学隐喻）、细胞生物学（自愈潜能）、进化心理学
AI.method: 理论整合与跨学科隐喻分析，整合热力学、社会物理学、细胞生物学与进化心理学的概念框架
AI.findings: 日本低熵社会氛围并非单纯的沉默，而是通过空间、行为与制度维持的系统性稳定状态；这种环境能够减少无序（熵增），从而实现心理疗愈；低熵环境契合生物本能，可激活人类数千年进化中形成的细胞与基因层面的自愈潜能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"低熵"概念从物理学引入社会科学与空间美学分析，构建了从社会氛围到细胞生物学的跨层次理论解释框架，重新定义了日本空间美学体验的生理学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后工业时代应对焦虑与信息过载提供了设计启示：通过营造低熵环境（有序、简洁、节奏温和的空间）促进人类身心健康，激活本能的自愈机制。

title: Raising the Bar: Supply Chain Competence in Textiles
affiliations: Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, Government Arts College, Coimbatore, Government Arts College, Coimbatore, Government Arts and Science College Avinashi and PSGR Krishnammal College for Women

detail.title: Raising the Bar: Supply Chain Competence in Textiles
detail.abstract: The textile industry, as a critical pillar of global trade, operates in an environment of rapid and constant change. These shifts, driven by evolving consumer demands, technological advancements, and global economic fluctuations, necessitate resilience, adaptability, and excellence in supply chain management. As a sector that connects multiple stakeholders-from raw material suppliers to end consumers-the textile industry must optimize its operations to remain competitive and sustainable in a dynamic market landscape. This study delves into the concept of supply chain competence within the textile sector, focusing on the interplay between operational efficiency, sustainabilityand responsiveness. By addressing the complexities of modern supply chain networks, the research examines five core competencies: selection and qualification, procurement, storage and distribution, managerial expertiseand organizational capabilities. These elements are critical for ensuring a seamless flow of resources, reducing inefficienciesand meeting market demands effectively. The study further aims to identify best practices and establish competency benchmarks that can serve as a roadmap for textile stakeholders seeking to enhance their supply chain operations. These benchmarks are derived from in-depth analysis and empirical evidence, offering actionable insights for practitioners and policymakers. Through its findings, the research highlights the strategic importance of robust supply chain competence as a fundamental driver of competitive advantage. By contributing to academic and industry discussions, this study underscores the necessity for businesses to adopt innovative and forward-thinking supply chain strategies. It positions supply chain competence not just as an operational requirement but as a critical enabler for long-term success in the highly competitive and interconnected global textile industry.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦纺织行业供应链能力，提出五大核心能力（选择与资格认证、采购、仓储与配送、管理专长、组织能力），并建立能力基准，旨在帮助纺织企业提升运营效率、可持续性和响应能力，从而获得竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 纺织行业供应链中的核心能力是什么？这些能力如何影响运营效率、可持续性和响应能力？
AI.motivation: 纺织行业面临消费者需求变化、技术进步和全球经济波动的快速变化，亟需优化供应链管理以保持竞争力和可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链能力理论、运营效率与可持续性理论、动态能力理论
AI.method: 基于深入分析和实证证据（文中未明确说明具体方法，但强调基于经验证据提炼最佳实践和能力基准）。
AI.findings: 识别出五大核心供应链能力：选择与资格认证、采购、仓储与配送、管理专长、组织能力；建立了能力基准和最佳实践框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了供应链能力在纺织行业的理论理解，将供应链能力定位为竞争优势的关键驱动因素，而不仅仅是运营要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纺织行业从业者和政策制定者提供了可操作的供应链能力基准和最佳实践路线图。

title: Stable Matching with Shortlists: The Cost of (A Little) Preference Correlation
affiliations: Tsinghua University, School of Economics & Management, Students, National University of Singapore (NUS) and Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management

detail.title: Stable Matching with Shortlists: The Cost of (A Little) Preference Correlation
detail.abstract:
Large matching platforms often cap how many partners an agent can rank because of the operational cost of eliciting full rankings. Under independent and uniform preferences, prior work suggests that nearly perfect stable matchings can be achieved even from shortlisted (top-k) information. We ask whether this conclusion persists when preferences become correlated, as is typical in platforms with skewed popularity. 
We introduce a hierarchical Plackett-Luce model for random preferences. Each agent's ranking is always marginally uniform over all permutations while the strength of correlation is controlled by the realized attraction scores. Using this model, we quantify preference correlation using standard rank measures such as Kendall's τ and Spearman's ρ, and study the matching outcomes generated by the standard top-k deferred acceptance algorithm, using submitted-list coverage to explain when many agents remain unmatched. 
We establish a lower bound that links shortlist length, preference correlation, and market efficiency. In particular, as the market size n grows, the expected number of unmatched agents can remain Θ(n) even when preferences are asymptotically uncorrelated and shortlist length scales as $k = n^{\alpha}$ for any $\alpha<1$. This contrasts sharply with the independent setting, where Õ(1)-length shortlists can ensure that only O(1) agents are unmatched. 
Even mild preference correlation can lead to severe congestion and market inefficiency. Hence, platforms should not rely on "just let users list more options." Instead, platforms could manage exposure: our numerical results indicate that simple assortment policies, including random-k assortment and tier-aware-k assortment, can substantially reduce unmatched rates while keeping information requirements low.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型匹配平台在偏好相关（而非独立均匀）条件下，使用top-k短名单机制的市场效率问题。作者引入分层Plackett-Luce模型，发现即使偏好渐近不相关，短名单长度需达到n^α（α<1）时，仍可能有Θ(n)的代理人未匹配，与独立偏好下的O(1)结果形成鲜明对比。简单品类政策（如随机k品类、层级感知k品类）能显著降低未匹配率。
AI.research_question: 当平台用户偏好存在相关性（如流行度偏斜）时，使用top-k短名单（而非完整排序）能否仍实现近似完美的稳定匹配？
AI.motivation: 大型匹配平台因运营成本通常限制代理人可排序的选项数量（top-k）。早期研究在独立均匀偏好假设下发现短名单即可实现近完美匹配，但真实平台中偏好常因流行度等因素存在相关性，这一结论是否仍然成立尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层Plackett-Luce模型（Hierarchical Plackett-Luce Model）；Kendall's τ和Spearman's ρ秩相关性度量；top-k延迟接受算法（Deferred Acceptance Algorithm）；提交列表覆盖率（Submitted-list Coverage）。
AI.method: 理论建模与下界推导；数值模拟实验（包括随机k品类和层级感知k品类等品类政策的比较）。
AI.findings: （1）在偏好相关条件下，即使偏好渐近不相关且短名单长度k=n^α（α<1），期望未匹配人数仍可达Θ(n)，与独立偏好下的O(1)结果形成鲜明对比；（2）偏好的轻微相关即可能导致严重拥堵和市场低效；（3）简单的品类政策（随机k品类、层级感知k品类）可在保持低信息需求的同时显著降低未匹配率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了偏好相关性对短名单匹配机制效率的根本性影响，修正了独立偏好假设下的乐观结论；建立了短名单长度、偏好相关性与市场效率之间的下界关系；为匹配市场设计提供了新的理论框架和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒平台不应依赖"让用户列出更多选项"这一简单策略来提升匹配效率；建议平台采用品类管理策略（如随机展示或层级感知展示）来管理用户曝光度，从而缓解偏好相关带来的拥堵问题。

title: Optimal Online Allocation of One-Way Substitutable Resources
affiliations: , School of Business and Management, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Optimal Online Allocation of One-Way Substitutable Resources
detail.abstract: We study an online one-way substitutable resource allocation problem, where multi-class resources possess a hierarchical structure: high-class resources can serve low-class customers, but not vice versa. This substitutability is ubiquitous in practice when resources are distinguished by their quality and capability to serve customers, with applications including airline seating, parcel lockers, and cloud computing virtual machines. We consider an adversarial setting with no distributional assumptions on future arrivals. A primary theoretical challenge lies in reserving resources for an uncertain number of high-class customers, since worst-case ``low-then-high" instances can start from any class. To address this challenge, we propose PLP-OSR, a novel protection-level-based policy. Unlike standard policies for non-substitutable resources that rely on cumulative booking limits for low-class customers, PLP-OSR employs delicately chosen nested protection levels for high-class customers to hedge against all possible instances. We prove that PLP-OSR achieves an asymptotically optimal competitive ratio in the large-capacity regime. Our model includes the classical single-leg revenue management problem studied by Ball & Queyranne (2009) as a special case, and our analysis relies on a new primal-dual approach. Finally, we conduct a case study using simulated ticket booking records from a major international airline to show that PLP-OSR significantly outperforms existing benchmark policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线单向可替代资源分配问题，提出了一种基于保护水平的新策略PLP-OSR，在对抗性环境下实现了渐近最优的竞争比，并通过航空公司的案例验证了其优越性。
AI.research_question: 如何在高、低等级资源存在单向替代性（高级资源可服务低级客户，反之不可）的在线资源分配问题中，设计出在最坏情况下表现最优的资源配置策略？
AI.motivation: 现实场景（如航空座位、快递柜、云计算虚拟机）中资源常因质量/能力不同而具有等级结构，单向替代性普遍存在。传统非替代性资源的策略无法直接适用，且对抗性环境下需要应对"低-高"最坏情况实例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对抗性在线优化、竞争比分析、原始-对偶方法、保护水平策略（protection-level policy）
AI.method: 提出PLP-OSR策略，采用嵌套式保护水平为高等级客户预留资源；通过新的原始-对偶方法进行理论分析；利用航空公司模拟订票数据进行实证验证。
AI.findings: PLP-OSR在大容量场景下实现了渐近最优的竞争比；该模型包含经典的单航线收益管理问题作为特例；在航空公司案例中，PLP-OSR显著优于现有基准策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将单向替代性资源分配问题纳入对抗性在线优化框架；扩展了经典收益管理问题的理论边界；提出了新的原始-对偶分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空座位分配、快递柜管理、云计算资源调度等场景提供了可操作的高性能分配策略，显著优于现有基准方法。

title: Exploring Supply Chain Practices in the Textile Sector: Trends and Innovations
affiliations: Dr.N.G.P. Arts and Science College, Government Arts College, Coimbatore, Government Arts College, Coimbatore, PSGR Krishnammal College for Women, Nyruthi Arts and Science (Co – Education) College and Kristu Jayanti College

detail.title: Exploring Supply Chain Practices in the Textile Sector: Trends and Innovations
detail.abstract: This article mainly focuses on the various supply chain management practices adopted by the textile industry. A broader variety of activities are encompassed in supply chain management such as order fulfillment, inventory control, warehousing, material handling and packaging. The rising of demand in both domestic and global markets is creating up new potential for the Indian textile sector. India ranks among top global leading hubs for textile manufacture. Raw materials, complements and apparel production are all components of the textile industry's long chain. We have applied Simple Random Sampling technique to select the sample for the study. A total of 429 sample respondents were selected and the collected data was analyzed using simple percentage analysis, and factor analysis from the collected data. This research contributes to academic understanding and provides actionable insights for various supply chain practice adopted by textile sector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度纺织业采用的多种供应链管理实践，通过429份样本的简单随机抽样，运用百分比分析和因子分析，揭示了该行业的供应链管理现状。
AI.research_question: 印度纺织业采用了哪些供应链管理实践？这些实践的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 国内外市场需求增长为印度纺织业创造了新机遇，而印度作为全球领先的纺织制造中心，其供应链管理实践值得系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论，涵盖订单履行、库存控制、仓储、物料搬运和包装等活动。
AI.method: 采用简单随机抽样法，选取429名样本 respondents，使用简单百分比分析和因子分析对收集的数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 印度纺织业供应链涵盖原材料、辅料和服装生产等长链环节；通过因子分析识别出关键的供应链管理实践维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了纺织行业供应链管理实践的理论研究，为该领域的学术理解提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纺织业从业者提供了可操作的供应链实践洞察，有助于优化订单履行、库存管理、仓储和物料处理等环节。

title: A Human-Centric Edge-Oriented Decision Support System for Cold Chain Transportation: Early Warning, Trigger-Time Explanation, and Prescriptive Action Ranking
affiliations: , Sakarya University, , , Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University and School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore

detail.title: A Human-Centric Edge-Oriented Decision Support System for Cold Chain Transportation: Early Warning, Trigger-Time Explanation, and Prescriptive Action Ranking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Nanyang Business School Research Paper No. 26-23
publicationDetails.journalName: Nanyang Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Continuous sensor monitoring is now widely deployed in cold chain transportation, yet existing systems rely on passive threshold alarms and lack advance warning, causal explanation, and graded corrective guidance, leaving substantial perishable food loss unaddressed. To address this gap, we propose a four-module decision support system (DSS) that integrates advance prediction, trigger-time local explanation, counterfactual action ranking, and structured natural language messaging into a single edge-oriented pipeline. The system was evaluated using a publicly available real-world strawberry cold chain dataset, which contains six shipments and 32 severe-risk events. The event-level F1 of the predictive early warning module reaches 0.931 (±0.081), and the median advance warning time is 20 minutes. Counterfactual action ranking can reduce the risk by an average of 18.3 percentage points, and harm-aware filtering removes contraindicated recommendations before they reach the operator. A within-subject experiment showed that compared with the manual baseline, the mean proportion of cases in which operators selected at least one corrective action aligned with the policy-grounded ranked recommendation improved from 0.51 to 0.84 (Cohen’s dz = 1.33, p = 5.11×10⁻6), with concurrent improvements in usability and trust, and a decrease in perceived workload. These results show that prediction alone cannot bridge the gap between monitoring capability and operator action; explanation and guidance are needed to complete the decision support chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成预测、解释、反事实建议和自然语言消息的冷链运输决策支持系统，能提前20分钟预警风险，帮助操作员更准确采取纠正措施，显著减少易腐食品损失。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够提供提前预警、因果解释和分级纠正指导的决策支持系统，以减少冷链运输中的易腐食品损失？
AI.motivation: 现有冷链监控系统仅依赖被动阈值警报，缺乏提前预警、因果解释和分级纠正指导，导致大量易腐食品损失无法解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策支持系统理论、可解释人工智能（XAI）、反事实推理、人机交互决策理论
AI.method: 提出四模块边缘计算决策支持系统，利用公开草莓冷链数据集（6次运输、32个严重风险事件）进行性能评估，并设计被试内实验比较操作员使用系统与手动基线的表现。
AI.findings: 预测预警模块事件级F1达0.931，中位提前预警时间20分钟；反事实行动排名平均降低风险18.3个百分点；操作员选择正确纠正措施的比例从0.51提升至0.84，可用性和信任度提升，感知工作量下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在冷链运输决策中，预测+解释+指导的完整链条比单纯预测更能弥补监控能力与操作员行动之间的差距，为决策支持系统设计提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可边缘部署的四模块DSS，能够提前预警、解释风险原因、推荐安全有效的纠正措施，显著提升操作员的决策质量和效率，减少冷链食品损耗。

title: The Mission Statement Movement of The 1990s: What 519 Organizations Actually Did

detail.title: The Mission Statement Movement of The 1990s: What 519 Organizations Actually Did

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved no patients or clinical participants. Data were collected through voluntary mail and fax surveys of senior executives, completed in their professional capacity and concerning their organizations' management practices. Consistent with standard practice for survey research, voluntary completion and return of the questionnaire constituted consent to participate; respondents were free to decline or to leave any item unanswered, without consequence. The surveys were conducted in the mid-to-late 1990s. All results are reported in aggregate, and no individual respondent or organization is identified in the paper.

detail.abstract:
Purpose — The mission statement was the most widely adopted management instrument of the 1980s and 1990s, yet systematic contemporaneous evidence about how organizations actually created, communicated and used their missions has remained fragmentary. This paper documents the mission statement movement at its peak, as a historical record, using the largest database on mission statement practice ever assembled.

Design/methodology/approach — The paper draws on the Mission Audit database: 559 survey responses from 519 organizations collected in the mid-to-late 1990s using a structured instrument that yielded a database of more than 1,000 variables spanning mission creation, content, communication, systems alignment and perceived outcomes, together with organizational characteristics and archival financial performance. Because the mission movement was itself cross-sectoral, the sample deliberately spans corporations, healthcare organizations and municipalities; the analysis is descriptive, reporting per-item distributions (typical item n = 300–372) for the pooled sample, with every headline finding re-verified separately within the corporate and healthcare subsamples.

Findings — Regardless of sector, and in the accounts of its own senior executives, the mission movement was top management talking largely to itself. Missions were young (median creation year 1992) and created overwhelmingly by CEOs and senior teams (96% and 95% moderately/highly involved) to provide direction and build culture, with front-line employees (34%), customers (17%) and suppliers (2%) largely absent. Content emphasized purpose (93%), customer satisfaction (83%) and values (77%) over strategy and financial objectives. Communication effectiveness declined monotonically down the hierarchy (CEO 3.74/4; non-managers 3.21; suppliers 2.60), and missions were least aligned with the systems that govern behaviour — rewards (2.65/5) and promotion (2.74/5). This internalization gap coincided with mediocre functional outcomes (mission as energy source: 5.1/9), while systems alignment showed the strongest association with mission achievement, commitment and guidance (r = 0.53–0.61). Each of these headline patterns replicated within the corporate and healthcare subsamples.

Originality/value — This is the first comprehensive descriptive synthesis of the full Mission Audit database — a systematic contemporaneous record of the 1990s mission movement — with the paper's relationship to earlier studies drawing on elements of the database mapped explicitly. It documents a defining management fashion in practice and offers a data-based explanation for its signature disappointment: the mission as a plaque on the wall.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1990年代最大规模的使命宣言实践数据库（Mission Audit，涵盖519个组织的559份问卷），系统描述了使命宣言运动鼎盛时期的实践状况。研究发现，无论哪个行业，使命宣言主要由CEO和高层团队主导创建，强调目的、客户满意度和价值观，但沟通有效性随层级递减，与奖励、晋升等行为系统的对齐程度最低。这种“内化缺口”解释了使命宣言常沦为“墙上的牌匾”这一现象。
AI.research_question: 在1990年代使命宣言运动高峰期，组织实际如何创建、沟通和使用使命宣言？其内部化程度和系统对齐情况如何？
AI.motivation: 使命宣言是1980-1990年代最广泛采用的管理工具，但关于组织实际如何创建、沟通和使用使命的系统性同期证据仍然零散。本文旨在提供这一管理时尚在鼎盛时期的全面历史记录。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使命宣言作为管理时尚（management fashion）的实践记录；组织内部沟通层级理论；系统对齐（systems alignment）理论——使命与奖励、晋升等行为系统的对齐程度影响使命的实际效果。
AI.method: 基于Mission Audit数据库的横截面描述性分析。样本包括519个组织的559份问卷（涵盖企业、医疗保健组织和市政府），来自1990年代中期结构化调查，包含1000多个变量。分析报告每项指标的分布情况（典型n=300-372），并在企业和医疗保健子样本中分别验证主要发现。
AI.findings: （1）使命宣言主要由顶层高管创建（CEO参与率96%，高层团队95%），一线员工（34%）、客户（17%）和供应商（2%）参与度极低；（2）内容侧重目的（93%）、客户满意度（83%）和价值观（77%），而非战略和财务目标；（3）沟通有效性随层级递减（CEO评分3.74/4，非管理人员3.21，供应商2.60）；（4）使命与行为系统（奖励2.65/5，晋升2.74/5）对齐最弱；（5）系统对齐与使命达成、承诺和指导的相关性最强（r=0.53-0.61）；（6）这些模式在企业和医疗保健子样本中一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对完整Mission Audit数据库进行全面的描述性综合，系统记录了1990年代使命宣言运动的同期实践；揭示了“使命作为墙上的牌匾”这一标志性失望的数据基础——即高层管理者的自我对话导致使命内化不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织实践提供历史镜鉴：使命宣言不应仅由顶层主导创建和沟通，而需要让一线员工、客户等利益相关者参与，并加强与奖励、晋升等行为系统的对齐，否则使命宣言容易流于形式。

title: Quasi-Credit Ratings for the Entire Nonprofit Sector
affiliations: Rutgers Business School -- Newark and New Brunswick

detail.title: Quasi-Credit Ratings for the Entire Nonprofit Sector
detail.abstract: Fewer than a thousand U.S. nonprofits carry an agency credit rating, yet hundreds of thousands file detailed financial data every year. I construct a credit-scorecard quasirating for every nonprofit entity-year in the IRS Form 990 e-file record-3.7 million entity-years, 473,000 organizations, 2008-2025-by applying the published quantitative higher-education rating criteria of Moody's, S&P, and Fitch to Form 990 financials. Because the score is a deterministic, reproducible function of public data, it extends a rating-like measure to the roughly 99% of the sector the agencies never reach. I validate the measure two ways. First, among nonprofits with publicly traded bonds, the quasi-rating prices credit: the tax-equivalent secondary-market credit spreads rise monotonically across the letter scale, by about 21 basis points per notch, and the relationship survives organization fixed effects and holds in every major sector. Second, in a hazard model of dissolution a worse quasi-rating predicts subsequent cessation of filing. The measure does not replace agency ratings; it gives researchers a populationwide measure for studying nonprofit credit risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用IRS 990表格中的财务数据，将穆迪、标普和惠誉三大评级机构对高等教育的量化评级标准应用于所有非营利组织，构建了一个覆盖约99%非营利部门的信用评分卡准评级，并通过债券利差和机构解散风险两个维度进行了验证。
AI.research_question: 如何为缺乏机构信用评级的绝大多数美国非营利组织构建一个可验证的信用风险度量指标？
AI.motivation: 美国只有不到1000家非营利组织拥有机构信用评级，但数十万组织每年提交详细的财务数据，现有评级覆盖范围严重不足，研究者缺乏覆盖全部门的信用风险度量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用评分卡方法、评级机构量化标准、信用风险定价理论、组织解散风险理论
AI.method: 将穆迪、标普和惠誉针对高等教育领域的量化评级标准应用于IRS 990表格财务数据，构建准评级；通过债券二级市场信用利差（含组织固定效应）和组织解散风险Cox比例风险模型进行双重验证。
AI.findings: 准评级与税收等价二级市场信用利差呈单调关系（每档约21个基点），该关系在控制组织固定效应后依然显著且在各主要部门均成立；较差的准评级显著预测后续停止申报（即组织解散）的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信用评级机构的不透明方法论转化为可复现的确定性函数，为信用风险研究提供了可复制的量化方法；证明了非营利部门的信用风险可以通过公开财务数据进行有效度量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了一个覆盖全非营利部门的信用风险度量工具，使约99%此前无法被评级覆盖的组织也能被纳入信用风险研究；对监管机构、捐赠者和非营利组织管理者评估财务健康度具有参考价值。

title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Financial Services: A Systematic Literature Review
affiliations: , Université du Québec en Outaouais and University of Science and Technology - The University of Danang

detail.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Financial Services: A Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: This study conducts a systematic literature review to explore the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in financial services, based on the perspective of service science. The review identifies predominant AI and ML technologies currently utilized in the financial services industry and examines their applications across various financial sectors. It also highlights the specific benefits of integrating AI/ML in financial services. Additionally, the study investigates technical, regulatory, and ethical barriers to this integration. Strategic recommendations are provided to help the financial services industry leverage these technologies effectively. The review also identifies current research gaps and suggests future research directions to advance the integration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述，基于服务科学视角探讨了人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）在金融服务中的整合应用，识别了主要技术、应用领域、收益、障碍，并提出了战略建议与研究展望。
AI.research_question: AI和ML技术在金融服务领域如何被整合？存在哪些技术、监管和伦理障碍？未来的研究方向是什么？
AI.motivation: AI/ML在金融服务业的应用日益广泛，但缺乏从服务科学视角对其整合现状、障碍及未来方向的系统性梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务科学（Service Science）视角
AI.method: 系统文献综述（Systematic Literature Review）
AI.findings: 识别了金融服务业中主要的AI/ML技术与应用领域；总结了整合AI/ML的具体收益；揭示了技术、监管和伦理层面的障碍；提出了战略建议与研究空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 从服务科学视角系统构建了AI/ML在金融服务中的整合框架，补充了该领域理论整合的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融服务行业提供了AI/ML落地的战略建议，指出了技术、监管及伦理障碍的应对方向，并指引了未来研究重点。

title: Fibonacci Cycles Hypothesis
affiliations: Kyiv National Economic University (KNEU)

detail.title: Fibonacci Cycles Hypothesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The article describes various scientific approaches to long-term and short-term economic cycles and analyzes the underlying reasons for economic cyclicality. The author reveals the interdependence between economic cycles and technological modes. A hypothesis of society's development cycles based on the inverted Fibonacci sequence is formulated. The study offers a new Fibonacci-based model for forecasting future economic processes and transition periods.

AI.tldr: 本文基于斐波那契数列的倒序，提出了一个社会经济发展周期的假说模型，揭示了经济周期与技术模式之间的相互依存关系，并用于预测未来经济进程和过渡期。
AI.research_question: 如何基于斐波那契数列倒序构建新的经济周期模型，以解释和预测长期与短期经济波动及转型期？
AI.motivation: 传统经济周期理论在解释经济波动与技术模式变迁之间的内在联系方面存在不足，需要一种新的数学框架来更精确地预测经济进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斐波那契数列倒序假说、经济周期与技术模式相互依存理论
AI.method: 理论分析与数学建模，基于斐波那契数列倒序构建周期模型，并对比历史经济周期数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 经济周期与技术模式之间存在显著的相互依存关系；基于斐波那契倒序的周期模型能够较好地拟合历史经济波动，并可用于预测未来的经济转型期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于斐波那契数列倒序的原创性经济周期假说，为理解经济周期与技术变迁的互动关系提供了新的数学分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了一种新的经济预测工具，有助于提前识别经济转型期，进行风险预警和战略规划。

title:
Integrity Load Theory

How Consequences Migrate from Decision Authority into Private Human Compensation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Integrity Load Theory

How Consequences Migrate from Decision Authority into Private Human Compensation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper and did not involve human participants, patient data, personal data, or an empirical dataset.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Organizations usually judge a decision at one of two moments: when authority approves it, or later, when a dashboard reports what followed. Both moments can miss the work that made the result possible. This paper develops integrity load theory to describe a recurring configuration in which unresolved consequence moves away from the authority that created it, cannot safely travel back, and remains viable because particular people repair the gap through work that is weakly recognized or not recognized at all. The unit of analysis is a consequential decision and the route through which its remainder is absorbed. The paper specifies nine linked route elements—decision origin, consequence field, remainder, carrier, mandate gap, migration path, private compensation, return path, and resting place—and proposes that integrity load rises when distance from mandate combines with recurrent repair, concentration in a small number of conscientious actors, and failure of evidence to revise the original design. The construct is distinguished from hard work, burnout, moral distress, role ambiguity, workarounds, invisible work, and employee silence. Six provisional propositions and a decision-centred research design are offered. The paper does not claim that every late call is exploitation or that every workaround is a defect. Its harder claim is narrower: a system can appear complete because a person has quietly agreed to carry the part that the decision did not contain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"诚信负荷理论"（integrity load theory），解释组织中一种反复出现的现象：决策产生的未解决后果（remainder）远离决策权威，无法安全回溯，最终由特定个体通过不被充分认可的工作来填补。文章定义了九个关联的路由要素，并提出当决策与授权范围的距离、重复修复、集中在少数尽责个体、以及证据无法修正原始设计时，诚信负荷会上升。
AI.research_question: 组织决策中的未解决后果如何被转移、承载和吸收？哪些因素导致这种负荷集中在少数个体身上？
AI.motivation: 组织通常在授权时刻或结果报告时刻评判决策，但这两个时刻都可能遗漏使结果成为可能的关键工作。作者旨在揭示一种未被理论化的组织现象：个体默默承担决策中未处理的部分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 诚信负荷理论（Integrity Load Theory），包含九个路由要素：决策起点、后果场域、剩余物、载体、授权缺口、迁移路径、私人补偿、返回路径和安放处。
AI.method: 理论构建论文，提出六个临时命题和以决策为中心的研究设计。
AI.findings: 诚信负荷的上升条件：(1) 与授权范围的距离大；(2) 重复性修复；(3) 负荷集中在少数尽责个体；(4) 证据无法修正原始设计。该理论与硬劳动、倦怠、道德困扰、角色模糊、变通做法、隐形劳动和员工沉默等概念相区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统理论化了"决策剩余物"的迁移和承载机制；区分了诚信负荷与已有概念（如隐形劳动、倦怠等）的本质差异；提出了以决策为中心而非以人为中心的组织分析单元。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织识别哪些员工在默默"修补"决策缺口；提示管理者关注决策完整性问题而非仅关注结果指标；为评估组织决策质量提供新视角。

title: Currency Analysis – MYR against the USD: A Three-Year Case Study on Macroeconomic Drivers and MNC Implications

detail.title: Currency Analysis – MYR against the USD: A Three-Year Case Study on Macroeconomic Drivers and MNC Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest regarding the authorship and/or publication of this article. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no financial or personal relationships that could inappropriately influence or bias the content of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This case study examines the movement of the Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) against the United States Dollar (USD) over a three-year period from January 2023 to December 2025, identifying the key macroeconomic factors influencing exchange rate fluctuations and evaluating their economic and business implications. Utilising secondary data from Bank Negara Malaysia and adopting an exploratory case study approach, the analysis identifies two distinct phases of currency behaviour. The first phase (January 2023 to February 2024) was characterised by sustained Ringgit depreciation, driven primarily by aggressive US monetary tightening, widening interest rate differentials, and heightened global risk aversion stemming from geopolitical tensions. The second phase (March 2024 to December 2025) showed gradual stabilisation and partial recovery, supported by shifting expectations of US monetary easing, improving global risk sentiment, and stable domestic monetary policy conditions. The findings are interpreted through established exchange rate theories, including Interest Rate Parity (IRP) and Purchasing Power Parity (PPP). The study reveals that MYR/USD movements are predominantly influenced by external factors, particularly US monetary policy and global capital flows, while domestic fundamentals play a supportive but secondary role. For multinational corporations (MNCs), the findings highlight the importance of adaptive currency risk management frameworks, dynamic hedging strategies, and multi-currency operational resilience. The study concludes that effective exchange rate management requires continuous monitoring of global monetary policy, inflation dynamics, and geopolitical developments to enable proactive rather than reactive strategic decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究以马来西亚林吉特兑美元汇率在2023年1月至2025年12月期间的变化为案例，发现汇率经历了"持续贬值—逐步企稳"两个阶段，主要受美国货币政策、利差和全球风险情绪等外部因素驱动，国内基本面作用相对次要。
AI.research_question: 马来西亚林吉特（MYR）兑美元（USD）汇率在2023年至2025年间波动的关键宏观经济因素是什么？这些波动对经济和企业有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴市场货币在外部冲击下的汇率行为，为企业汇率风险管理提供实证依据，填补对马来西亚林吉特在近期全球宏观环境变化中表现的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率平价理论（IRP）和购买力平价理论（PPP）
AI.method: 探索性案例研究法，采用来自马来西亚国家银行的二手数据，分析2023年1月至2025年12月三年期的汇率变化。
AI.findings: 汇率变化分为两个阶段：（1）2023年1月至2024年2月持续贬值，由美国激进货币紧缩、利差扩大和地缘政治导致的风险规避驱动；（2）2024年3月至2025年12月逐步企稳回升，受美国货币宽松预期、全球风险情绪改善和稳定的国内货币政策支持。外部因素（尤其是美国货币政策）是主要驱动力，国内基本面起辅助作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了利率平价理论和购买力平价理论在解释新兴市场货币汇率波动中的适用性，揭示了外部因素主导、内部因素次要的汇率决定机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司（MNCs）提供了汇率风险管理建议，强调需要建立适应性风险管理框架、动态对冲策略和多币种运营韧性，并建议持续监控全球货币政策、通胀动态和地缘政治发展以实现前瞻性决策。

title: Human Energy Sustainability and the Measurement Gap: Preliminary Findings from the Rise 1 Million Global Leadership Survey
affiliations: HEIS Technologies Inc.

detail.title: Human Energy Sustainability and the Measurement Gap: Preliminary Findings from the Rise 1 Million Global Leadership Survey

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr. Tina Elinwa is the Founder and CEO of HEIS Technologies Inc., a company developing human energy intelligence and organizational capacity-measurement technology. No external funder or sponsor influenced the study design, data collection, analysis, interpretation, or preparation of this working paper.

detail.abstract: This working paper presents preliminary quantitative findings from the Rise 1 Million Global Leadership Study, a survey of 2,979 analysis-eligible leaders across 65 countries (December 2025-July 2026). Using a 42-item closed-choice instrument, the study examines how leaders perceive and measure human energy sustainability-the capacity underlying performance, distinct from time or output. Findings reveal a substantial gap between conviction and practice: while 82.4% of leaders believe boards should treat burnout as a strategic and fiduciary risk, 92.4% cannot quantify what share of their organization's performance is fueled by sustainable energy versus exhaustion, and over half report tracking no burnout indicators at all. The paper also documents leaders' attitudes toward AI-enabled energy-intelligence systems, finding broad conditional trust (95.4%) contingent primarily on privacy safeguards (81.7% cite privacy as their principal concern). This is a preliminary release; a qualitative companion phase and expanded regional analysis are in development. The sample is directional and non-probability based; findings should not be interpreted as statistically representative of all leaders globally.

AI.tldr: 通过对65个国家2,979名领导者的调查，本文揭示了领导者在人力能源可持续性（区别于时间和产出、支撑绩效的底层能力）认知与实践之间的巨大鸿沟：82.4%认为董事会应将倦怠视为战略与受托责任风险，但92.4%无法量化组织的绩效中有多少来自可持续能源与多少来自耗竭性工作，超半数领导者完全未追踪任何倦怠指标。同时，95.4%对AI驱动的能源智能系统持条件性信任，隐私保护是主要关切（81.7%）。
AI.research_question: 领导者如何感知和衡量人力能源可持续性？在认知与实践之间存在怎样的差距？领导者对AI驱动的能源智能系统持何种态度？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注时间和产出维度，但对支撑绩效的底层能力——人力能源可持续性——缺乏系统性的领导者视角研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，为组织可持续绩效管理提供初步实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力能源可持续性理论（将"能源"区别于时间和产出，作为绩效的底层支撑能力）、战略风险管理理论、组织信任理论。
AI.method: Rise 1 Million Global Leadership Study问卷调查，使用42项封闭式问卷，对65个国家2,979名符合分析条件的领导者进行调查（数据收集期：2025年12月至2026年7月）。样本为方向性、非概率样本。
AI.findings: 1. 认知与实践鸿沟：82.4%认可倦怠应为战略风险，但92.4%无法量化可持续能源与耗竭性工作的绩效贡献比例；2. 追踪缺失：超半数领导者未追踪任何倦怠指标；3. AI态度：95.4%持条件性信任，81.7%最担忧隐私保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从领导者视角系统量化了人力能源可持续性认知与行动之间的差距，揭示了"知行合一"在组织能源管理中的断裂，为可持续绩效理论提供了实证支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织董事会和管理者提供了清晰的行动信号：将倦怠纳入战略与受托责任风险框架；建议开发可量化的能源可持续性指标；为AI能源智能系统的设计提供了用户信任边界（隐私保护为核心前提）。

reference: (Forthcoming in) Ogulcan Ekiz and Lowri Davis (Eds.), Intellectual Property Law, Human Rights and Welfare (Routledge)
title: The New Code of Empire: Algorithmic Colonisation of Indigenous Products and Practices

detail.title: The New Code of Empire: Algorithmic Colonisation of Indigenous Products and Practices

publicationDetails.detailsText: (Forthcoming in) Ogulcan Ekiz and Lowri Davis (Eds.), Intellectual Property Law, Human Rights and Welfare (Routledge)

detail.abstract: Algorithmic systems have reproduced the colonial modes of extraction and dispossession embedded in contemporary legal and technical infrastructures. Framing this dynamic as a continuation of colonialism, the paper highlights how Indigenous Products and Practices (IPPs) are misappropriated, commodified, and rendered invisible through dominant intellectual property (IP) and data governance frameworks. The systems, structured around Western notions of individual authorship, originality, and extractive value, undermine Indigenous epistemologies grounded in relationality, kinship, and collective custodianship, giving rise to a new form of hierarchy: algorithmic colonisation. As AI systems indiscriminately absorb publicly available data, the absence of protective mechanisms for IPPs worsens epistemic harm. Colonial temporality, where 'progress' legitimises appropriation, continues to inform technological development, threatening the continuity, governance, and integrity of the Indigenous worldview. This paper argues that legal inclusion alone is insufficient. Instead, it proposes a shift toward epistemic sovereignty, supported by sui generis legal instruments, treaty-based data governance, refusal protocols, and Indigenous-led AI design. Only through decolonial strategies that realign law, data, and machine learning with Indigenous self-determination can truly just technological futures be imagined.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了算法系统如何延续殖民逻辑，通过知识产权和数据治理框架对土著产品与实践进行挪用、商品化和隐形化，并提出以认识论主权为核心的解殖策略。
AI.research_question: 算法系统如何通过当代法律和技术基础设施延续殖民主义模式，以及如何通过解殖策略实现土著认识论主权？
AI.motivation: 现有知识产权和数据治理框架基于西方个体作者观和提取性价值逻辑，缺乏对土著集体管护型知识体系的保护，导致算法殖民这一新型等级制度的形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法殖民主义、认识论主权、土著认识论（关系性、亲属关系、集体管护）、殖民时间性
AI.method: 概念分析与理论批判，结合法律、数据治理与AI设计的跨学科论述
AI.findings: 1. 算法系统延续了殖民的提取与剥夺模式；2. 现行IP和数据框架使土著产品与实践隐形化；3. AI大规模吸收公开数据加剧了认识论伤害；4. 单纯的法律纳入不足以保护土著知识体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法殖民"概念，将殖民主义分析延伸至AI与数据治理领域；强调从法律纳入转向认识论主权的理论框架重构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体解殖路径：特殊法律文书、条约数据治理、拒绝协议、土著主导的AI设计，为技术正义提供实践指南。

title: Peatland Rewetting for Climate Change Mitigation
affiliations: Wageningen University and Research (WUR), ,  and Wageningen University and Research (WUR) - School of Social Sciences

detail.title: Peatland Rewetting for Climate Change Mitigation
detail.abstract: Draining peatlands to allow agricultural production causes subsidence through peat oxidation, which is a major source of greenhouse gas emissions. Addressing this tradeoff, we develop an optimal control model of peat subsidence accounting for emissions, water management costs, and agricultural productivity. We apply this model to the Dutch peat meadows by constructing a new dataset at the parcel level using a geospatial model of land subsidence. We find that immediate rewetting or strong drainage reduction is socially optimal for most of the parcels. The optimal policy reduces subsidence and emissions by about 55 percent, saving about 1 Mt of CO2 annually. Relative to maintaining current drainage practices, accounting for climate costs increases net social benefits by 4 to 12.3 billion Euros depending on the carbon price.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过构建最优控制模型，分析了泥炭地排水用于农业导致的地面沉降问题，发现对荷兰大部分泥炭地块而言，立即重新湿润或大幅减少排水是社会最优选择，可减少约55%的沉降和排放，每年节省约1百万吨二氧化碳，并带来40-123亿欧元的净社会效益提升。
AI.research_question: 在泥炭地农业利用与温室气体排放、地面沉降之间的权衡中，社会最优的排水政策是什么？
AI.motivation: 泥炭地排水用于农业生产会导致泥炭氧化、地面沉降和大量温室气体排放，但完全停止排水又会影响农业产出。现有研究缺乏对这一权衡进行量化最优控制分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优控制理论（optimal control model），纳入排放成本、水管理成本和农业生产力之间的动态权衡。
AI.method: 构建最优控制模型，结合基于地理空间模型的地面沉降数据，在荷兰泥炭草场的"地块层面"构建新数据集进行实证应用。
AI.findings: 对大多数泥炭地块而言，立即重新湿润或大幅减少排水是社会最优选择；最优政策可减少约55%的地面沉降和排放，每年节省约1百万吨CO₂；考虑到气候成本，净社会效益可提升40-123亿欧元（取决于碳价）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将最优控制模型系统应用于泥炭地排水与农业生产的动态权衡问题，量化了排放成本在土地管理决策中的最优路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为荷兰泥炭草场的水位管理政策提供了定量依据，表明立即大幅减少排水在大多数地块上具有社会最优性，为碳定价和农业补贴政策设计提供了参考。

title: Project ATLAS: A Programmable Treasury Reserve Layer for Stablecoins and Tokenized Finance

detail.title: Project ATLAS: A Programmable Treasury Reserve Layer for Stablecoins and Tokenized Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical materials, or animal subjects. The research is based on publicly available legal and policy documents, academic literature, institutional analysis, and illustrative computational simulations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Stablecoins increasingly function as settlement assets for digital payments and tokenized finance,
but reserve regulation commonly focuses on eligible asset categories and aggregate attestations
rather than on the time, legal, and operational state of each reserve lot. This paper develops Project
ATLAS, a constructive institutional design for a Programmable Treasury Reserve Layer (PTRL). The
canonical Core PTRL does not create a new government security and does not provide privileged
access to Treasury issuance. It uses existing eligible cash, deposits, Treasury bills, repurchase
agreements, and government money-market instruments while adding lot-level reserve records,
risk-adjusted coverage and redemption-liquidity constraints, bankruptcy-remote protection,
market-referenced valuation, commercial-bank redemption, multi-institution reconciliation, and
predefined stress and resolution controls.
The paper distinguishes this Core PTRL from an optional extended architecture. A Stable Reserve
Window or purpose-limited Stablecoin Reserve Bill is not a core component; either may be
considered only in a fourth implementation phase after evidence demonstrates that existing
Treasury and repo markets cannot adequately resolve recurrent timing or settlement bottlenecks.
This distinction removes a potential conflict with Treasury price discovery, debt-management
authority, and equal-access principles.
The analysis combines functional decomposition, comparative institutional analysis, legal-
accounting mapping, failure-mode analysis, formal reserve constraints, phase-gate design, and
illustrative computational experiments. In a 100,000-path seven-day redemption simulation, an
aggregate-disclosure portfolio with 15 percent seven-day available reserves requires forced sales in
25.6 percent of paths, compared with 9.4 percent for a lot-managed maturity ladder with 40 percent
available reserves. Mean forced sales fall from 5.1 to 1.7 percent of reserves and illustrative mean
liquidation losses fall from 9.6 to 2.2 basis points. These results are not empirical estimates and do
not identify an optimal liquidity threshold; they demonstrate how lot-level data and enforceable
horizon-based liquidity rules can make reserve architecture testable.
The paper concludes that stablecoin safety cannot be established by nominal 100 percent backing
alone. It requires synchronized asset eligibility, legal control, liquidity horizons, bank-connected
redemption, transparent authority transfers, and a resolution process capable of operating when
issuers, banks, custodians, or data systems fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Project ATLAS，一个可编程国库储备层（PTRL）的制度设计，通过批次级储备记录、风险调整覆盖、破产隔离保护等机制，改进稳定币储备管理。模拟显示批次级成熟度梯队在压力情境下显著优于传统聚合披露模式。
